title: Page image classifier fine-tuned on century-spanning archives of scanned documents for further content-specific processing
comment: 29 pages, 19 figures, 13 tables. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2507.21114
summary: Purpose: Digitization projects in the humanities produce vast, heterogeneous archives of historical documents, making manual sorting impractical at scale. This work addresses the need for an automated system to classify scanned page images based on visual content type - text, tables, and graphics - enabling content-specific downstream processing such as Optical Character Recognition (OCR) or structured data extraction. Methods: An image classification system was developed and evaluated on a dataset of over 48,000 annotated historical page images from century-old Czech archaeological archives, refined through four successive annotation stages with domain-expert review. A Random Forest Classifier baseline was established using hand-crafted image features. Subsequently, deep learning architectures were fine-tuned and compared: Convolutional Neural Networks (EfficientNetV2, RegNetY), Vision and Document Image Transformers (ViT, DiT), and multimodal CLIP models. An 11-category label scheme was designed collaboratively with domain experts and evaluated via five-fold cross-validation. Results: The feature-based baseline achieved approximately 75% accuracy. Fine-tuned CNNs and Transformers substantially outperformed it, with RegNetY-16GF achieving 99.16% and ViT-large 99.12% Top-1 accuracy on the held-out test set. CLIP ViT-B/16 reached 99.14% with optimized text descriptions. Conclusion: Image-only models, particularly RegNetY-16GF, deliver near-perfect classification accuracy and produce consistent labels across 649,508 unlabeled archival pages with over 90% inter-model agreement. Fine-tuned CLIP, despite competitive test-set accuracy, showed under 65% agreement with image-only models on unlabeled data, making it less suitable for deployment. The final models, annotated dataset, and software are publicly available under open-source licenses.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个自动化图像分类系统，用于对历史档案页面（文本、表格、图形）进行分类，基于48,000+标注图像，最终RegNetY-16GF模型达到99.16%的Top-1准确率，模型、数据和代码均已开源。
AI.motivation: 人文学科数字化项目产生海量异构历史档案，人工分类在大规模场景下不可行，因此需要自动化的视觉内容分类系统，以便后续针对不同内容类型（文本、表格、图形）进行差异化的下游处理（如OCR或结构化数据提取）。
AI.method: 构建了包含48,000+标注历史页面图像的数据集，经过四轮领域专家审核；建立了基于手工特征的随机森林基线；微调并比较了CNN（EfficientNetV2、RegNetY）、Transformer（ViT、DiT）以及多模态CLIP模型；采用与领域专家协作设计的11类标签方案，通过五折交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 特征基线约75%准确率；深度学习方法大幅提升，RegNetY-16GF达99.16%，ViT-large达99.12%，CLIP ViT-B/16达99.14%。在649,508张未标注页面上，纯图像模型间一致性超过90%，但CLIP与纯图像模型的一致性低于65%。
AI.conclusion: 纯图像模型（尤其是RegNetY-16GF）实现了近乎完美的分类精度，适合部署；CLIP尽管测试集精度高，但在未标注数据上与纯图像模型一致性低，不适合实际部署。最终模型、标注数据集和软件均以开源许可证公开发布。

title: Multimodal Group Emotion Recognition In-the-Wild Towards a Privacy-Safe Non-Individual Approach
summary: This thesis addresses group emotion recognition (GER) in-the-wild with a focus on privacy preservation. Unlike traditional emotion recognition methods that rely on individual-level cues such as face, gaze, or voice analysis, this work uses collective audio-video signals to infer emotions at the group level, reducing risks of individual monitoring and surveillance. Two complementary frameworks are proposed. The first is a cross-attention multimodal architecture for audio-video fusion, combined with Frames Attention Pooling (FAP) for temporal aggregation. It is supported by synthetic data augmentation and validated through ablation studies, demonstrating robustness in real-world GER conditions. The second framework, Variational Encoder Multi-Decoder (VE-MD), learns a shared latent space for emotion classification and structural representation prediction, including body and face cues. Two decoding strategies, DETR-based and heatmap-based, are explored to analyze the role of structural representations in group and individual settings. The thesis makes three main contributions: it clarifies the role of multimodality and structural cues in group-level affective computing; introduces two architectures for privacy-preserving multimodal GER; and shows that competitive performance can be achieved without using individual features as input data.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出两种隐私保护的群体情绪识别框架：跨注意力多模态架构（含FAP时间池化）和变分编码器多解码器（VE-MD）架构，通过集体音视频信号而非个体特征实现群体情绪识别，证明了无需个体输入即可达到竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 传统情绪识别依赖个体层面的面部、目光或声音分析，存在隐私监控风险，为此本研究探索利用集体音视频信号进行群体级情绪推断，以降低个体监控风险。
AI.method: 提出两种框架：1）跨注意力多模态架构+帧注意力池化（FAP）用于音视频融合与时间聚合，辅以合成数据增强；2）变分编码器多解码器（VE-MD）学习共享潜在空间，同时用于情绪分类和结构表征预测（身体和面部线索），并探索DETR与热力图两种解码策略。
AI.result: 通过消融实验验证了框架在真实世界群体情绪识别场景中的鲁棒性，证明了无需个体特征作为输入即可实现竞争性能。
AI.conclusion: 明确了多模态和结构线索在群体级情感计算中的作用；提出了两种隐私保护的多模态群体情绪识别架构；展示了无需个体输入特征即可达到竞争力性能的可能性。

title: SlideCheck: Guiding Self-Supervised Pretraining of Pathology Foundation Models via Dataset Distributions
summary: Pathology foundation models are pretrained on large streams of WSI-derived patches, while supervision during data construction is often slide-level, sparse, or heterogeneous. This mismatch makes it difficult to understand and control which biological patterns enter the pretraining data. We propose SlideCheck, a lightweight pretraining data guidance tool built on frozen pathology foundation model patch features. Rather than serving as a standalone patch diagnostic model, SlideCheck provides explicit abnormality and malignancy scores for organizing, filtering, and auditing pathology pretraining data. SlideCheck uses a dual-head MLP to separately model broad abnormal morphology and malignant evidence. A regularized feature-space scorer provides a supervised anchor for patch-level evidence estimation, while score-attention agreement combines patch scores with WSI-level MIL attention to mine high-confidence pseudo labels. The same scores are then used to construct broad-positive ViT pretraining subsets, where a patch is selected if either abnormality or malignancy evidence exceeds a threshold. Experiments show that SlideCheck-defined data distributions influence the downstream behavior of self-supervised ViT pretraining, indicating that biological composition is an important controllable factor in pathology foundation model development. Curated subsets can approach full-data performance, suggesting that explicitly scored patch pools may support more efficient and auditable pretraining data construction. These findings position SlideCheck as a data guidance and auditing layer for transforming large, undifferentiated patch pools into controllable and reusable pretraining datasets.

AI.tldr: SlideCheck是一种轻量级数据引导工具，利用冻结的病理基础模型补丁特征，通过双头MLP对异常形态和恶性证据进行评分，用于组织、过滤和审计病理预训练数据，实验表明该工具能有效控制预训练数据中的生物学成分，优化自监督ViT预训练效果。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型在大规模WSI补丁数据上预训练，但监督信号常是稀疏或异质的切片级别标签，导致难以理解和控制进入预训练数据的生物学模式，需要一种工具来引导和审计预训练数据构建过程。
AI.method: 提出SlideCheck，基于冻结的病理基础模型补丁特征，使用双头MLP分别建模异常形态和恶性证据；通过正则化特征空间评分器提供监督锚点，结合评分-注意力一致性挖掘高置信度伪标签；利用评分构建ViT预训练子集（异常或恶性证据超过阈值的补丁被选中）。
AI.result: SlideCheck定义的数据分布影响自监督ViT预训练的下游行为，表明生物学成分是病理基础模型开发中的重要可控因素；精选子集可接近全数据预训练的性能。
AI.conclusion: SlideCheck可作为病理预训练数据的引导和审计层，将大型未分化补丁池转化为可控、可复用的预训练数据集，支持更高效和可审计的预训练数据构建。

title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Adversarial Fine-tuning of Vision Transformers
summary: The widespread use of image classification models in high-risk, real-world situations necessitates making these models robust to slight disturbances or perturbations, such as blurring or sharpening, in the input images. While vision transformers (ViTs) play an integral role in many modern-day multi-modal models like Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, they have received a lack of attention in the setting of robustness. In this work, we analyze the effects of adversarial fine-tuning, a popular method for improving model robustness to image perturbations, on a ViT's performance on perturbed and regular images through a mechanistic lens. We adversarially train a ViT on low-frequency and high-frequency image corruptions, and attempt to explain changes in downstream model performance through an examination of the model's attention mechanisms, internal representations, and knowledge evolution. Overall, our results suggest that, while fine-tuning on inputs with common corruptions improves model performance and certainty on new instances of corrupted data, these improvements do not transfer to other classes of corruptions not seen in the training. Additionally, despite observing changes in visual attention and knowledge evolution across layers, we found that adversarial training did not lead to fundamental changes in the sparse representations learned by ViTs.

AI.tldr: 本文从机制角度分析对抗微调对Vision Transformer（ViT）在图像扰动下的影响。研究发现，虽然对抗训练能提升模型在特定类型扰动上的表现和置信度，但这种改进无法泛化到未见过的扰动类型，且对抗训练并未显著改变ViT学习的稀疏表示。
AI.motivation: 图像分类模型在现实高风险场景中需要对抗微小扰动（如模糊、锐化）的鲁棒性。然而，作为现代多模态模型核心组件的Vision Transformer（ViT），在鲁棒性方面的研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 对ViT进行低频和高频图像破坏的对抗微调，并通过注意力机制、内部表示和知识演化三个维度进行机制分析。
AI.result: 对抗微调提升了模型在已见类型破坏数据上的性能和置信度，但无法泛化到未见过的破坏类型；尽管观察到注意力分布和知识演化发生变化，但稀疏表示未发生根本性改变。
AI.conclusion: 对抗训练对ViT的鲁棒性提升具有局限性，仅针对训练中见过的扰动类型有效，且不会改变模型底层的稀疏表示结构。

title: Bidirectional Small-Granularity Search between Code and Text
summary: We introduce the novel task of bidirectional small-granularity search between code and text, where the queries are small snippets of text or code and the results are also small fragments of the opposite modality, i.e., code or text. This task establishes direct links between text in scientific publications and corresponding code segments, in support of better and faster understanding of scientific methods. We introduce a large dataset for the proposed task that includes a training partition with textual descriptions of code generated automatically using GPT-4, and three testing partitions, one in-domain and two out-of-domain (OOD) that contain manually-annotated data as well as material from other domains. We also propose a modular approach to address this task. Our approach shares an encoder across four different subtasks that learn start/end of answer spans in both directions. We show that our method achieves good results in-domain, and encouraging results OOD. This suggests that addressing this task with automatically-generated data is possible, but there is exciting future work to be done.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的代码-文本双向小粒度搜索任务，并构建了包含GPT-4自动生成数据的大规模数据集及模块化方法，实验显示域内效果好、跨域结果有潜力。
AI.motivation: 为了在科学出版物中的文本与对应代码片段之间建立直接链接，支持更快速、更准确地理解科学方法。
AI.method: 提出模块化方法，共享一个编码器，在四个不同子任务上学习双向的答案跨度起止位置。
AI.result: 方法在域内数据集上取得了良好效果，在跨域（OOD）数据集上也得到了令人鼓舞的结果。
AI.conclusion: 利用自动生成数据解决该任务是可行的，但仍需未来工作进一步优化。

title: PathoSage: Towards Multi-Source Evidence Adjudication in Pathology via Experience-Aware Agentic Workflow
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and agent workflows have shown strong promise for computational pathology, yet reliable patch-level reasoning remains challenging. End-to-end pathology MLLMs often hallucinate morphological features, while recent agentic systems usually merge tool outputs and retrieved knowledge into a shared context, making decisions vulnerable to conflicting evidence and context contamination. We propose PathoSage, a three-stage framework that explicitly separates knowledge retrieval, evidence collection, and evidence adjudication for patch-level pathology multimodal reasoning. Its core component, Structured Evidence Deliberation, independently evaluates heterogeneous evidence from tools, performs conflict analysis, and generates the final judgment in a fresh context to reduce anchoring bias. We further introduce a training-free Beta-Bernoulli experience system with continuous credit assignment to model long-term tool reliability and construct similarity-weighted priors for future tool use. Experiments show that PathoSage effectively mitigates VQA hallucinations and classifier disagreement, outperforming strong pathology MLLM and agentic baselines. Our results highlight explicit evidence adjudication and reliability-aware tool modeling as key ingredients for robust pathology agents.

AI.tldr: PathoSage是一个三阶段框架，通过显式分离知识检索、证据收集与证据裁决，并结合Beta-Bernoulli可靠性建模，有效缓解病理多模态推理中的幻觉和工具冲突问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在病理图像补丁级推理中容易产生形态学特征幻觉，而基于智能体的方法将工具输出与检索知识混入共享上下文，导致决策易受冲突证据和上下文污染影响。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架PathoSage：1) 知识检索与证据收集分离；2) 核心组件"结构化证据裁决"独立评估异质证据、进行冲突分析，并在全新上下文中生成最终判断；3) 引入免训练的Beta-Bernoulli经验系统，通过连续信用分配建模工具长期可靠性，构建相似性加权的先验用于未来工具选择。
AI.result: 在补丁级病理多模态推理任务中，PathoSage有效缓解了VQA幻觉和分类器分歧，性能优于强病理MLLM和智能体基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式的证据裁决机制和可靠性感知的工具建模是构建鲁棒病理智能体的关键要素。

title: VisualLeakBench: Reproducible Action-Boundary Propagation Failures in Vision-Language Agents
summary: Vision-language agents increasingly consume screenshots, documents, and user interfaces before writing to memory, sending messages, or invoking external tools. We study a concrete failure mode in this setting: action-boundary propagation, where sensitive or unsafe visible text is copied from an image into downstream tool arguments. We present VisualLeakBench, a diversified 500-image benchmark spanning UI, chat, document, form, and dashboard scenes, and evaluate a stratified 100-image agent subset with four production VLM systems under two workflows: note capture and external handoff. At baseline, target strings are propagated into tool arguments in 78.8% of PII cases and 85.5% of rendered unsafe-text cases. Under a defensive system prompt, rendered unsafe-text propagation remains high at 52.6%, while PII tool propagation falls to 2.0%, largely by suppressing tool use rather than preserving utility. Rates are tool-surface dependent: search-like tools suppress PII propagation, but rendered unsafe text still crosses tool boundaries. We measure visual-to-tool propagation rather than downstream instruction execution. We additionally provide a labeled-target oracle upper-bound diagnostic that localizes most failures at the tool boundary while leaving response-side leakage as residual risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisualLeakBench基准测试，发现视觉-语言智能体存在"动作边界传播"漏洞：敏感文本（如PII或不当内容）从图像中直接复制到下游工具参数。测试显示，基线条件下78.8%的PII和85.5%的不安全文本被传播，防御提示虽能将PII传播降至2.0%，但不安全文本仍高达52.6%，且主要通过抑制工具使用实现。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言智能体在处理截图、文档等视觉输入时，可能将图像中可见的敏感或危险文本未经检查地传入下游工具调用，导致安全风险。现有研究缺乏对这一特定失败模式的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建包含500张图像的VisualLeakBench基准，涵盖UI、聊天、文档、表单和仪表盘五种场景；选取100张图像组成智能体子集，在两种工作流（笔记捕获和外部交接）下评估四个生产级VLM系统；设置基线条件和防御提示条件，区分PII和渲染不安全文本两类目标，并引入标注目标oracle上界诊断。
AI.result: 基线条件下，PII传播率78.8%，不安全文本传播率85.5%；防御提示下PII传播降至2.0%，但不安全文本仍达52.6%；传播率具有工具表面依赖性，搜索类工具抑制PII传播但无法阻止不安全文本跨工具边界。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-语言智能体在图像到工具参数的信息传播中存在显著安全漏洞，尤其是渲染不安全文本的跨工具边界问题难以通过简单防御提示解决。当前防御机制以牺牲功能效用为代价（抑制工具使用），且工具表面特性影响传播模式。

title: TinyJudge: Unverifiable Constraint Alignment via Lightweight Specialist Ensembles
summary: Instruction Following (IF) is a core capability of LLMs, requiring strict adherence to diverse constraints, ranging from verifiable ones (e.g., output length) to unverifiable ones (e.g., tone). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a paradigm for IF tasks, leveraging LLM-as-a-judge to assess unverifiable constraints. However, we empirically find that this approach remains a significant bottleneck, suffering from severe reward hacking and higher computational overhead. In this work, we first analyze the generalization capabilities of unverifiable constraints and discover that specific constraints exhibit distinct, high-generalization patterns. Motivated by this, we propose TinyJudge, a framework that employs an ensemble of specialized tiny language models ($\sim0.6B$) to provide rewards for soft constraints. By distilling expertise from frontier models into these tiny models, it achieves high-precision, lightweight evaluation. Extensive evaluations across five benchmarks demonstrate that TinyJudge outperforms the baselines by $\sim10\%$ in average performance and $12\%$ in reward precision. Crucially, it also achieves a $3\times$ speedup in total training time. Our work provides a scalable and robust path for aligning LLMs with unverifiable human instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出TinyJudge框架，通过集成多个0.6B的小型语言模型评估软约束，在指令跟随任务中实现更高性能、更精确奖励和3倍训练加速。
AI.motivation: 现有RL+可验证奖励方法在评估不可验证约束时存在奖励作弊和计算开销大的瓶颈。
AI.method: 首先分析不可验证约束的泛化模式，然后设计由多个小型专家语言模型组成的集成评估器TinyJudge，通过蒸馏前沿模型知识到小模型中实现轻量级精准评估。
AI.result: 在5个基准上平均性能提升约10%，奖励精度提升12%，训练速度提升3倍。
AI.conclusion: TinyJudge为对齐不可验证的人类指令提供了一种可扩展、鲁棒的路径。

title: OmniMem: Perturbation-aware Memory Compression for Streaming Audio-Visual LLMs
summary: Audio-visual large language models (LLMs) hold strong promise for long-form video understanding, yet their long-video inference is fundamentally limited by the linear growth of video tokens and key-value (KV) caches. We present OmniMem, a memory-efficient streaming framework designed specifically for audio-visual LLMs. Unlike existing compression methods that treat all tokens uniformly, OmniMem introduces a modality-aware memory allocation strategy that separately manages visual and audio contexts, addressing the severe token imbalance between the two modalities. OmniMem further preserves informative and non-redundant KV states through perturbation-aware memory selection, enabling compact memory without sacrificing long-range understanding. To strengthen compression under realistic deployment constraints, we also explore budget-aware fine-tuning, which encourages the model to consolidate useful information into retained memory. Experiments on VideoMME Long, LVBench, and LVOmniBench with video-SALMONN 2+ and Qwen-2.5-Omni show that OmniMem consistently improves over strong training-free compression baselines by 2-4% absolute accuracy under the same memory budgets, with an additional 1-2% gain after fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: OmniMem是一个针对音视频大语言模型的内存高效流式推理框架，通过模态感知的内存分配、扰动感知的记忆选择和预算感知的微调，在相同内存预算下显著提升长视频理解准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频大语言模型在处理长视频时面临视频token和KV缓存线性增长的问题，而现有压缩方法对所有token一视同仁，忽略了视觉和音频模态之间严重的token数量不平衡。
AI.method: 提出OmniMem框架，包含三个核心策略：(1)模态感知的内存分配策略，分别管理视觉和音频上下文；(2)扰动感知的记忆选择，保留信息丰富且无冗余的KV状态；(3)预算感知的微调，帮助模型将有用信息整合到保留的记忆中。
AI.result: 在VideoMME Long、LVBench和LVOmniBench基准上，基于video-SALMONN 2+和Qwen-2.5-Omni模型，OmniMem在相同内存预算下比强训练无关压缩基线绝对准确率提升2-4%，微调后额外提升1-2%。
AI.conclusion: OmniMem通过模态感知设计和扰动感知选择有效解决了音视频LLM长视频推理中的内存瓶颈问题，预算感知微调进一步增强了压缩效果。

title: Can You Trust What You See? Human and AI Detection of Synthetic Legal Evidence
summary: Visual evidence has long been treated as a reliable form of legal proof, but advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are undermining that assumption. This article asks how well humans and frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish authentic evidentiary photographs from AI-generated counterparts in the object-centric scenarios typical of civil disputes. We built Synthetic Legal Evidence Detection (SLED-1400), a dataset of 200 authentic evidence images paired with 1,200 synthetic counterparts produced by six contemporary text-to-image generators across ten evidence categories. The same stimuli and response format were used in a controlled web experiment with 136 lay participants and in a standardized evaluation of four MLLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini-3-Pro, Gemini-3-Flash, Qwen3-VL-235B). Human accuracy was 64.8% overall, and 48.5% and 51.0% on the two strongest generators (Gemini-3-Pro-Image and Flux-2-Max), indistinguishable from chance. MLLMs never misclassified an authentic image (100% specificity), but missed most synthetic outputs from the harder generators, with average MLLM detection at 5.9% on Gemini-3-Pro-Image outputs. Human and MLLM errors were largely uncorrelated, while the four MLLMs were strongly correlated with each other. Neither group is a reliable standalone authenticator. We argue that visual evidence in legal proceedings should be treated as inherently contestable, and that a workable procedural response must combine trained human review, MLLM screening, and provenance infrastructure such as C2PA Content Credentials.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了SLED-1400数据集，通过实验发现人类和法律多模态大模型均无法可靠区分真实照片与AI生成图像，建议将视觉证据视为可争议的，并采用人类审查、模型筛选与溯源基础设施相结合的程序性应对方案。
AI.motivation: 视觉证据长期被视为可靠的法定证据形式，但AI技术的进步正在动摇这一假设。本文旨在探究人类和前沿多模态大模型在民事纠纷常见的以物体为中心的场景中，能否有效区分真实证据照片与AI生成的伪造图像。
AI.method: 构建SLED-1400数据集（200张真实证据图像+1,200张由6种AI生成器生成的合成图像，涵盖10个证据类别）。采用相同刺激和响应格式，对136名普通参与者进行受控网络实验，并标准化评估4种MLLM（GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-Pro、Gemini-3-Flash、Qwen3-VL-235B）。
AI.result: 人类总体准确率64.8%，在最强两款生成器上准确率仅48.5%和51.0%（接近随机水平）。MLLM对真实图像100%特异度，但对较难生成器的合成图像检测率极低（平均仅5.9%）。人类与MLLM的误判几乎不相关，而四种MLLM之间高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 人类和MLLM均无法作为可靠的独立认证工具。法律程序中的视觉证据应被视为具有内在可争议性，可行的程序性应对方案需结合训练有素的人类审查、MLLM筛查以及C2PA内容来源凭证等溯源基础设施。

title: Evaluating Hallucinations in Domain-Adapted Large Language Models
summary: This study investigates the phenomenon of hallucinations in domain-adapted Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on the fine-tuning of the Llama-2 model with the Lamini dataset. Hallucinations, or the generation of nonsensical or unfaithful content by LLMs, pose a significant challenge, especially when these models are fine-tuned with domain-specific data. Our methodology involves a series of experiments testing memorization, recall, and reasoning capabilities of the fine-tuned LLM, comparing its performance on novel question-answer pairs and domain-specific information. We found that while the model shows proficiency in tasks similar to its training data, its capability to accurately reason about and recall new domain-specific information remains limited, leading to instances of hallucination. The model demonstrates a tendency to provide correct answers with extra information, suggesting an inclination toward over-generation. These results suggest important limitations of fine-tuning-only approaches for mitigating hallucinations when adapting LLMs to specialized domains and underscore the need for more robust methods in adapting LLMs to specialized domains. The study also provides insights into the varying performance of LLMs on different types of information, revealing a comparative weakness in handling domain-specific queries.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了领域自适应大语言模型（LLMs）中的幻觉现象，通过对Llama-2模型使用Lamini数据集进行微调实验，发现模型在记忆、回忆和推理方面存在局限，尤其在处理领域特定信息时容易产生幻觉，表明仅靠微调难以有效缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在微调领域特定数据时会产生幻觉（生成无意义或不忠实的内容），这一问题在领域自适应场景下尤为突出，亟需系统研究。
AI.method: 使用Lamini数据集对Llama-2模型进行微调，设计了一系列实验来测试模型的记忆、回忆和推理能力，比较模型在新问答对与领域特定信息上的表现差异。
AI.result: 模型在类似训练数据的任务上表现良好，但对新领域信息的准确推理和回忆能力有限，容易产生幻觉；模型倾向于提供正确答案但附带多余信息，表现出过度生成的倾向；模型在处理领域特定查询时表现较弱。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠微调的方法在缓解领域自适应LLM的幻觉问题方面存在重要局限，需要开发更鲁棒的方法来将LLM适应到专业领域。

title: Syll: Open-Source Personal Automation with Cross-Surface Execution
summary: Personal AI agents must increasingly operate across APIs, shells, web surfaces, and desktop GUIs, yet many systems remain tuned to a single interface and offer limited support for user teaching and auditability. We present Syll, an open-source, self-hosted multimodal agent harness that unifies MCP/API tools, CLI execution, and visual GUI control in a modular runtime, enabling agents to coordinate computer use across heterogeneous interfaces while streamlining how users and agents exchange information. At the core of Syll is a bidirectional user-agent interaction layer: users teach procedures through direct demonstration, which Syll compiles into reusable skills; agent execution is translated back into multimodal evidence -- logs, keyframes, and approval checkpoints -- for inspection and control. Syll further externalizes memory, skills, routines, and governance as editable local artifacts, supporting straightforward inspection, extension, and downstream development. Our implementation has been validated on production desktop applications including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Audition, Stardew Valley, macOS Finder and others. We report mechanism-oriented studies that validate multimodal routing, teachable GUI replay, and persistent local artifacts. We hope Syll can serve as a practical open-source foundation for personal automation that users can teach, inspect, and continuously extend.

AI.tldr: Syll是一个开源、自托管的跨界面多模态智能体框架，支持用户通过演示教学技能，并提供可审计的日志、关键帧和审批机制，已在Photoshop、Audition等桌面应用中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有个人AI智能体大多局限于单一界面（API、CLI或GUI），缺乏对用户教学和可审计性的支持，难以在异构界面间协调运作。
AI.method: 提出Syll框架，核心是双向用户-智能体交互层：用户通过直接演示教学，Syll将其编译为可复用技能；智能体执行过程被转换为多模态证据（日志、关键帧、审批检查点）供用户审查。同时将记忆、技能、例程和治理规则外化为可编辑的本地工件。
AI.result: 在生产级桌面应用（Photoshop、Audition、Stardew Valley、macOS Finder等）上验证了多模态路由、可教学的GUI回放和持久化本地工件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Syll旨在作为个人自动化的开源基础，让用户能够教学、审查并持续扩展智能体的能力。

title: Community-Specific Slang and Entity Detection via Semantic Shift in Fine-Tuned Language Models
summary: We propose an unsupervised method of resolving slang, unique entities, and folklore from online communities by isolating words in the lexicon that have the highest magnitude of semantic shift. Semantic shift is defined as the evolution of a word's encoded representation as a result of fine-tuning a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM) on a community-specific text corpus. This value is inversely proportional to the cosine similarity between the base model's encoded representation of a word, and a fine-tuned model's encoded representation. We fine-tune the DistilRoBERTa model on text corpora collected from 3 Reddit subreddits (r/Technology, r/Gaming, r/WorldofWarcraft), model a distribution of cosine similarity over the lexicon, and show that one can successfully resolve words that have unique significance to the community by pulling data in the bottom 10-percentile. In contrast, we show that data in the top 10-percentile consist of words that carry relatively universal semantics.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无监督方法，通过测量词汇在微调前后的语义漂移幅度，来解析网络社区中的俚语、特有实体和民俗词汇。
AI.motivation: 网络社区中存在大量俚语和特有表达，传统方法难以自动识别和解析，需要一种无监督且无需人工标注的方法来发现这些社区独特词汇。
AI.method: 在Reddit三个子版块文本上微调DistilRoBERTa模型，计算微调前后词汇编码的余弦相似度来衡量语义漂移，取底部10%作为社区特有词汇。
AI.result: 底部10%的词汇成功解析了社区特有语义（俚语、专有词汇），顶部10%则是语义相对通用的词汇。
AI.conclusion: 基于语义漂移的无监督方法能有效识别和解析网络社区中的特有表达，为理解在线社区语言演化提供了新途径。

title: A case study of evaluating AI agents on a neuroscience data-to-discovery pipeline
summary: Agentic AI tools offer a promising path to automating software development bottlenecks in scientific research pipelines, particularly for stages that take domain experts days to months to build, where scientists care about correctness and robustness, not implementation details. We present an empirical study of general-purpose coding agents on a fly optogenetics data-to-discovery pipeline. We assess agents on tasks substantially larger than existing benchmarks, datasets orders of magnitude bigger, and evaluation criteria grounded in domain expert standards. We show that agents can solve several individual pipeline stages, suggesting stage-level automation is tractable. By analyzing agents' code iterations, we show that they struggle most when there is not a pre-defined criterion to iterate on, and they must instead use their scientific judgment to assess their current solution, a key open challenge. Mirroring scientific practice, they sometimes attempt visual inspection of intermediate outputs for self-evaluation, but largely fail to interpret what they see or act on it appropriately. Solving the end-to-end pipeline correctly requires stringing together successes across all pipeline stages, and this is beyond agents' current abilities. We identify challenges largely absent from existing benchmarks, including computational resource management and generalization to large held-out data collections. Finally, we distill principles for constructing scientific tasks and rigorous evaluation criteria for open-ended problems.

AI.tldr: 本文对通用编码智能体在果蝇光遗传学数据到科学发现流水线中的表现进行了实证研究，发现智能体可以解决部分独立阶段，但在需要科学判断、端到端整合及大规模数据处理方面仍存在显著挑战。
AI.motivation: 科学研究流水线中存在大量耗时的软件开发瓶颈，科学家更关心结果的正确性和鲁棒性而非实现细节，因此需要探索AI智能体自动化这些流程的可行性。
AI.method: 在果蝇光遗传学数据到发现的全流程上，对通用编码智能体进行实证评估，任务规模和数据集远超现有基准，评估标准基于领域专家标准，并对智能体的代码迭代过程进行分析。
AI.result: 智能体可以解决多个独立流水线阶段，但缺乏预定义迭代标准时表现最差；它们尝试视觉自评估但大多失败；端到端全流程成功需要串联所有阶段，超出当前能力；存在计算资源管理和大规模数据泛化等新挑战。
AI.conclusion: 流水线级别的自动化是可行方向，但需要解决科学判断、端到端整合、资源管理等关键开放问题，并提出了构建科学任务和严格评估标准的原则。

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Framework for the Nepali Legal Domain Question Answering
summary: Legal domains in high-resource languages like English have widely adopted artificial intelligence for legal question answering. However, data scarcity in low resource languages such as Nepali has limited the training of large language models on Nepali legal texts. This study presents the first application of a Retrieval Augmented Generation based model for Nepali legal question answering using case laws extracted from the Nepal Kanun Patrika digital archive. Using BM25 on chunked documents, the approach achieved a top precision at one of 91 percent, and up to 75 percent with the multilingual E5 large model. Evaluation of generated answers showed 74 percent groundedness, 85 percent truthfulness according to an automated judge model, and 84 percent human evaluated truthfulness when using BM25 document retrieval, with a 92 percent successful answer generation rate. These results demonstrate that the RAG pipeline can effectively address the gap in legal question answering for low resource languages and provide a foundation for reliable AI systems in the Nepali legal domain.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将基于检索增强生成（RAG）的模型应用于尼泊尔语法律问答，使用BM25检索实现了91%的Top-1精度，生成答案的可靠性达74%-85%，为低资源语言法律AI系统奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 英语等高资源语言的法律领域已广泛采用AI进行法律问答，但尼泊尔语等低资源语言因数据稀缺，大语言模型在尼泊尔法律文本上的训练受到限制。
AI.method: 从Nepal Kanun Patrika数字档案中提取判例法，采用BM25对分块文档进行检索，并结合RAG模型进行尼泊尔语法律问答。同时对比了multilingual E5 large模型的检索效果。
AI.result: BM25检索的Top-1精度达91%，multilingual E5 large模型达75%；生成答案的groundedness为74%，自动评判的truthfulness为85%，人工评估的truthfulness为84%，成功生成率为92%。
AI.conclusion: RAG流水线能有效填补低资源语言在法律问答领域的空白，为尼泊尔法律领域的可靠AI系统提供了基础。

title: Why Limit the Residual Stream to Layers and Not Tokens? Persistent Memory for Continuous Latent Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning abilities on mathematical and multi-hop planning tasks. The CoCoNuT (Chain of Continuous Thought) paradigm~\cite{hao2024coconut} extends this by enabling models to reason in latent space, exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously rather than committing to a single chain early on. However, we identify a limitation we term the \textbf{concept bottleneck}. At each reasoning pass, intermediate hidden states are overwritten, causing the model to lose critical facts computed in earlier steps as reasoning depth increases. We observe this empirically. On HotpotQA, vanilla CoCoNuT (10.4\% EM) fails to improve over the CoT baseline (11.0\% EM), and performance degrades with curriculum depth on GSM8K. To address this, we propose \textbf{AGCLR} (Adaptive Gated Continuous Latent Reasoning), which augments CoCoNuT with a \textit{Gated Concept Stream}. A persistent residual memory maintained across all reasoning passes, controlled by three learned gates: a \textit{write} gate that commits intermediate facts to memory, a \textit{read} gate that retrieves relevant prior states, and a \textit{forget} gate that prunes irrelevant context. Evaluated on GSM8K, HotpotQA, and ProsQA using GPT-2 as our base model, AGCLR achieves consistent improvements across all types of datasets. With the performance gap compounding as curriculum depth increases, directly resolving the concept bottleneck. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/JJJJ/README.md

AI.tldr: AGCLR通过门控概念流解决CoCoNuT中的概念瓶颈问题，在GSM8K、HotpotQA和ProsQA上持续改进性能。
AI.motivation: CoCoNuT在潜在空间推理时存在概念瓶颈：中间隐藏状态被覆盖，导致模型随着推理深度增加丢失早期计算的关键事实，性能甚至不如CoT基线。
AI.method: 提出AGCLR，在CoCoNuT基础上增加门控概念流（Gated Concept Stream），通过三个学习门（写门、读门、遗忘门）维护持久残差记忆，实现中间事实的写入、相关状态的检索和无关上下文的剪枝。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、HotpotQA和ProsQA上，AGCLR均持续提升性能，且随着课程深度增加，性能差距进一步扩大，直接解决了概念瓶颈问题。
AI.conclusion: AGCLR有效缓解了连续潜在推理中的概念瓶颈，证明了持久记忆机制对于深度潜在空间推理的重要性。

title: AMN: An Adaptive Multi-Scale Fusion Network with Boundary and Uncertainty Modeling for Nuclei Segmentation
summary: Accurate classification of nuclei subtypes in histopathology images is critical for downstream tasks including tumor grading, immune infiltrate quantification, and prognosis prediction. Existing approaches rely on either convolutional or transformer-based encoders in isolation, limiting their ability to simultaneously capture fine-grained local texture and long-range spatial context. We present AMN (Adaptive Multi-Scale Nuclei Network), a dual-encoder segmentation framework that jointly leverages a Swin Transformer and a ResNet-50 feature pyramid, fused via a learned per-channel gating mechanism that dynamically weighs each encoder's contribution at every scale. AMN is trained with a multi-objective loss combining class-weighted focal loss, boundary-aware loss with positive-pixel emphasis, and a novel uncertainty-modulated classification term that suppresses overconfident erroneous predictions. Evaluated on the CoNIC benchmark across seven nuclei classes, AMN achieves a mean Dice of 0.82 and mean F1 of 0.68, with an F1 of 0.67 on the diagnostically challenging lymphocyte class. AMN outperforms eight baseline models spanning pure-CNN, pure-transformer, and recent hybrid architectures: U-Net, ResU-Net, DeepLabV3+, SegNet, ViT-Small, HmsU-Net, ConvFormer-UNet, and BEFUnet. Cross-dataset evaluation on MoNuSeg demonstrates strong generalization without retraining and validating the domain robustness of the learned representations.

AI.tldr: AMN是一个双编码器分割框架，结合Swin Transformer和ResNet-50特征金字塔，通过可学习的通道门控机制动态融合，在CoNIC基准上对七种细胞核亚型分割达到平均Dice 0.82和F1 0.68，优于八种基线模型，并在MoNuSeg上验证了良好泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法单独使用卷积或Transformer编码器，无法同时捕捉细粒度局部纹理和长程空间上下文，限制了细胞核亚型分类的准确性。
AI.method: 提出AMN双编码器分割框架：联合Swin Transformer和ResNet-50特征金字塔，通过可学习的逐通道门控机制动态融合各尺度编码器贡献；训练采用多目标损失，包括类别加权focal损失、边界感知损失和不确定性调制分类项。
AI.result: 在CoNIC基准上七类细胞核达到平均Dice 0.82、平均F1 0.68（淋巴细胞F1为0.67）；超越U-Net、ResU-Net、DeepLabV3+、SegNet、ViT-Small等八种基线模型；在MoNuSeg上跨数据集验证了良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: AMN通过双编码器动态融合策略有效兼顾了局部纹理与全局上下文，在细胞核亚型分割任务上取得了领先性能，且具有良好的域鲁棒性。

title: ABLE: Representing and Mapping LLMs via Attribution-Based Large-model Embedding
summary: The explosive growth of large language models (LLMs) has created a heterogeneous and poorly documented ecosystem, making systematic model comparison increasingly important for provenance auditing, security analysis, and model selection. Existing representation methods struggle to address this setting efficiently. Approaches analyzing internal parameters are powerful when architectures are compatible, but face scalability barriers under structural heterogeneity, while methods relying on external outputs may conflate models with similar behaviors and are difficult to align in richer output spaces across different tokenizers. To bridge this gap, we propose ABLE (Attribution-Based Large-model Embedding), a framework that leverages the interpretability space to construct model representations. By aggregating gradient-based feature attributions via a tokenizer-agnostic word-level alignment, ABLE captures model-specific input-sensitivity patterns rather than only surface-level outputs. Beyond empirical utility, we provide a stability analysis showing that, under standard regularity assumptions for differentiable Transformer-style models, ABLE induces a Lipschitz-continuous parameter-to-embedding map with finite-sample convergence guarantees. Extensive experiments on 239 open-source LLMs demonstrate that our training-free approach achieves competitive or superior performance in relation prediction, model routing, and benchmark score prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出ABLE框架，通过基于梯度的特征归因和与分词器无关的词级对齐来构建大语言模型的表示，实现了无需训练即可进行模型比较、路由和性能预测。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生态系统异构且文档匮乏，缺乏有效的系统性模型比较方法。内部参数方法受限于架构兼容性，外部输出方法难以对齐不同分词器的输出空间。
AI.method: ABLE框架利用可解释性空间，通过聚合基于梯度的特征归因，并结合与分词器无关的词级对齐技术，构建模型特定的输入敏感性模式表示。
AI.result: 在239个开源LLM上，ABLE在关系预测、模型路由和基准分数预测任务上达到或超越现有方法性能。
AI.conclusion: ABLE是一种无需训练的有效框架，具有Lipschitz连续性和有限样本收敛保证的理论支撑。

title: NeuroAlign: Hierarchical Multimodal Fusion of Dynamic and Structural Neuroimaging for MCI Analysis
summary: Multimodal neuroimaging fusion of functional MRI (fMRI) and diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) provides complementary information for cognitive impairment analysis, but remains challenged by heterogeneous feature spaces and misaligned representations. We propose \textit{NeuroAlign}, a hierarchical framework for structured multimodal fusion. It introduces (1) \textit{Dual-Modal Hierarchical Alignment} (DMHA), which models multi-scale dynamic connectivity and aligns dynamic-static and functional-structural embeddings; and (2) \textit{Dual-Domain Hierarchical Interaction} (DDHI), which enables fine-grained modulation and global interaction between connectivity- and region-level features. To support feature-level inspection, we design \textit{Synergistic Activation Mapping} (SAM), a gradient-free, marker-oriented attribution method for DFC, SFC, ALFF, and FA. Evaluated on GUTCM, ADNI, and OASIS under five-fold validation, NeuroAlign achieves competitive MCI/SCD detection and preliminary cross-dataset transferability. Attribution analyses reveal modality-specific and partially consistent brain patterns, providing model-derived evidence for multimodal representation analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuroAlign分层框架，通过双模态分层对齐（DMHA）和双域分层交互（DDHI）实现fMRI与DTI的有效融合，并设计无梯度归因方法SAM，在多个数据集上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: fMRI与DTI的多模态神经影像融合对认知障碍分析具有互补价值，但存在特征空间异构和表示不对齐的问题。
AI.method: 提出NeuroAlign框架，包含DMHA（多尺度动态连接建模与动静/功能-结构嵌入对齐）和DDHI（连接级与区域级特征的细粒度调制与全局交互）；设计SAM无梯度归因方法。
AI.result: 在GUTCM、ADNI、OASIS数据集上五折验证，MCI/SCD检测取得竞争性结果，并具有初步跨数据集迁移能力。归因分析揭示了模态特异性与部分一致的脑区模式。
AI.conclusion: NeuroAlign有效实现了多模态神经影像的结构化融合，为多模态表示分析提供了模型层面的可解释证据。

title: Implicit Causal Graph Construction in Text via Chain Discovery
summary: Causal graphs in text are typically populated by observable, predefined events. In contrast, we study implicit causal graph construction from text by treating each described cause-effect pair as the begin- and endpoint of an underlying latent causal graph and using large language models (LLMs) to infer intermediate causal events. We compare end-to-end graph construction with methods that frame the task as causal chain discovery. In the latter, graphs are built either by aggregating inferred chains or by progressively expanding partial chains through an iterative search process. We further explore Wisdom of the Crowd extensions that access causal knowledge from multiple LLMs in post-hoc aggregation and collaborative inference settings. We analyze trade-offs among these approaches and evaluate the validity of inferred causal relations using a manually curated database of 1,560 scientifically validated causal pairs. This database-based evaluation is proposed as reliable, resource-efficient, and transferable to settings where ground-truth graphs are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从文本中构建隐式因果图，利用LLM推断因果事件间的中间环节，比较了端到端构建、因果链发现及多种聚合方法，并通过1560个科学验证的因果对数据库评估因果关系的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有因果图构建通常依赖文本中显式、可观测的预定义事件，而真实文本中的因果关系往往是隐式的（只有起点和终点，缺少中间环节）。作者希望通过LLM推断潜在因果图中的中间事件，揭示完整的因果链。
AI.method: 比较了端到端因果图构建方法与将任务建模为因果链发现的方法。后者包括：聚合推断的因果链构建图、通过迭代搜索逐步扩展部分链。此外，探索了"群体智慧"扩展，在事后聚合和协作推理设置中访问多个LLM的因果知识。
AI.result: 构建了包含1,560个科学验证因果对的手动管理数据库，用于评估推断出的因果关系的有效性。该评估方法被证明是可靠、资源高效且可迁移的。
AI.conclusion: 提出的数据库评估方法适用于缺乏真实图的场景，具有可迁移性；不同构建方法之间存在权衡，需要根据具体任务选择合适的策略。

title: Some hypotheses on how chatbots work in problem-solving-driven conversations. Large Language Models as confirmation of the Innovation Illusion
summary:
This article offers a perspective on the nature of chatbots as genuine conversation partners when discussing problems in relation to their solutions. What can chatbots do and what can't they do, and how can this be explained? Our argument draws on Aggregation Dynamics, Cognitive Linguistics, Neuropsychology and Psychology.
  Our argument focuses on basic chatbots in the hope of thereby making statements about the core functionality of more advanced chatbots. Basic chatbots are assumed to consist of a Large Language Model (LLM) with a simple interface.
  The main results are: a description of human understanding and thinking based on so-called metaphorical problem propagations; the hypothesis that text dataset used for training LLMs have specific characteristics and that these text datasets only partially imitate human thinking and understanding; the hypothesis that the LLM training process encodes artificial metaphorical problem propagations into an LLM from these datasets; our conclusion that a basic chatbot cannot be a thinking partner capable of matching humans; our conclusion that further development of the Large Language Model will not lead to this either.
  Yann LeCun states: "Animals and humans exhibit learning abilities and understandings of the world that are far beyond the capabilities of current AI and machine learning (ML) systems." Our conclusions are in line with this. LeCun's vision and ours are at odds with the optimism of Big Tech. That does not alter the fact that chatbots exist, that they are being used on a massive scale, by both individuals and organisations, and that it is therefore socially and politically important to understand them. Our article aims to contribute to the discussion on the functioning, benefits and drawbacks of chatbots.
  We have not yet encountered the approach we used to arrive at our conclusions in our research into how chatbots work.

AI.tldr: 本文从聚合动力学、认知语言学、神经心理学和心理学角度分析，认为基础聊天机器人无法成为与人类匹敌的思考伙伴，即使进一步开发大语言模型也无法实现这一目标。
AI.motivation: 理解聊天机器人作为对话伙伴的本质，澄清它们能做什么、不能做什么，并解释其原因，以促进社会和政治层面对聊天机器人的正确理解。
AI.method: 结合聚合动力学、认知语言学、神经心理学和心理学多学科视角，聚焦基础聊天机器人（由LLM和简单界面组成），提出基于"隐喻问题传播"的理论框架进行分析。
AI.result: 描述了基于隐喻问题传播的人类理解与思维机制；提出训练数据集仅部分模仿人类思维；LLM训练过程从中编码了人工隐喻问题传播；基础聊天机器人无法成为与人类匹敌的思考伙伴，且进一步开发LLM也无法改变这一结论。
AI.conclusion: 聊天机器人无法真正匹敌人类思维，与Yann LeCun的观点一致，与大型科技公司的乐观态度相左；但鉴于其大规模使用，理解其功能、优势和局限性具有重要社会和政治意义。

title: Crayotter: Traceable Multi-Agent Workflows for Long-Form Video Editing
summary: Editing a long-form video from heterogeneous footage requires more than selecting clips: an agent must preserve narrative intent across material preparation, timeline construction, post-production, and revision while leaving enough evidence to diagnose failures. We present \textbf{Crayotter}, an open-source multimodal multi-agent system for prompt-driven video editing. Crayotter organizes production into three phases: coverage-aware material preparation, artifact-based editing research, and tool-grounded timeline execution. Each phase externalizes inspectable artifacts, including coverage reports, multimodal analyses, editing blueprints, tool calls, and intermediate renders. These artifacts make an editing run traceable and allow failed segments to be diagnosed and selectively revised instead of requiring a full restart. We evaluate Crayotter on 23 editing themes against CapCut-Mate and CutClaw. Under human evaluation, Crayotter achieves an average score of 3.40/5, compared with 2.44 and 1.70 for the two baselines, with consistent gains in theme alignment, narrative coherence, and editing smoothness. We additionally describe a replayable trajectory schema and verifiable reward design that prepare these workflows for future policy optimization. Code, traces, and examples are publicly available at https://github.com/idwts/Crayotter.

AI.tldr: Crayotter 是一个开源的多模态多智能体系统，通过三个阶段（素材准备、编辑研究、时间线执行）和可检查的加工产物实现视频编辑的透明化与可回溯修正，在人类评估中优于两个基线系统。
AI.motivation: 长视频编辑涉及多个复杂阶段（素材准备、时间线构建、后期制作、修订），现有系统缺乏叙事意图保持和失败诊断能力，导致错误时需要完全重启。
AI.method: 提出三阶段多智能体系统：1) 覆盖率感知的素材准备；2) 基于加工产物的编辑研究；3) 工具驱动的时间线执行。每个阶段生成可检查的加工产物（覆盖率报告、多模态分析、编辑蓝图、工具调用、中间渲染），支持可追溯和选择性修订。同时设计可重放的轨迹模式和可验证的奖励机制。
AI.result: 在23个编辑主题上，Crayotter 人类评估平均得分3.40/5，优于 CapCut-Mate (2.44) 和 CutClaw (1.70)，在主题对齐、叙事连贯性和编辑流畅性上均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于加工产物的透明化多智能体架构能有效提升视频编辑的叙事保真度和系统鲁棒性，可重放轨迹设计为未来策略优化奠定了基础。

title: GraphLoRA: Structure-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for recommendation (LLMRec) due to their powerful reasoning and generalization abilities. However, effectively aligning the textual semantics modeled by LLMs with the collaborative signals remains a key challenge. Existing methods either translate collaborative information into textual prompts or inject pre-trained embeddings into the LLM, both of which treat structural information as static input and fail to capture high-order relational dependencies. To bridge this gap, we propose GraphLoRA, a novel framework that generalizes low-rank adaptation from independent to structure-aware propagation. GraphLoRA embeds a trainable graph message-passing network within the low-rank adaptation pathway, enabling structural signals to propagate through the parameter space. This design allows collaborative topology to explicitly guide parameter updates, fostering deep integration between graph-structured and textual semantic information. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that GraphLoRA not only outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based recommendation methods but also achieves superior generalization, effectively balancing structural reasoning capability with computational efficiency. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/wgj15965/GraphLoRA}{https://github.com/wgj15965/GraphLoRA}.

AI.tldr: GraphLoRA 通过在图谱低秩适应路径中嵌入可训练的消息传递网络，实现了图结构与文本语义的深度融合，在 LLM 推荐任务中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 推荐方法将结构信息作为静态输入，无法捕获高阶关系依赖，难以对齐 LLM 的文本语义与协同信号。
AI.method: 提出 GraphLoRA 框架，在低秩适应路径中嵌入可训练图消息传递网络，使结构信号通过参数空间传播，引导参数更新，实现图结构与文本语义的深度整合。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上优于现有最先进的基于 LLM 的推荐方法，具备更优的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GraphLoRA 有效平衡了结构推理能力与计算效率，实现了图协同信号与文本语义的深度融合。

title: Land cover and flood type govern the detection limits of satellite-based flood mapping across diverse global flood events
summary: Floods are among the most destructive natural hazards, and their increasing frequency under climate change makes satellite-based inundation mapping essential for disaster response. Geospatial foundation models pretrained on satellite archives offer geographic transferability, but their operational reliability across diverse, unseen events remains uncharacterized. Here we deploy Prithvi-EO-2.0 across 19 out-of-distribution flood events (2017-2025) spanning six continents, eight climate zones, and six flood mechanisms, validating against two independent reference products. Detection accuracy depended jointly on land cover and flood type, with cropland yielding the highest agreement (IoU=52%) and riverine events the strongest detection (F1=0.69), while tree cover and built-up areas showed near-zero detection (IoU=4%) regardless of flood mechanism. Dual-reference validation revealed that apparent model error partly reflects definitional inconsistency between reference products rather than detection failure. Iterative pipeline testing identified 23 failure modes, with pipeline engineering dominating initial error over model capacity. These findings establish environment-dependent detection boundaries for operational satellite flood mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了地理空间基础模型Prithvi-EO-2.0在19次全球洪水事件（2017-2025）中的泛化性能，发现检测精度高度依赖于土地覆盖类型和洪水机制，且参考产品间的定义不一致性会掩盖模型真实表现，同时管线工程问题对初始错误的影响大于模型本身能力。
AI.motivation: 洪水灾害日益频繁，卫星遥感制图对灾害响应至关重要，但现有地理空间基础模型在多样化的、未见过的洪水事件中的操作可靠性尚未被充分表征。
AI.method: 使用Prithvi-EO-2.0模型，覆盖六大洲、八个气候带和六种洪水机制，对19次分布外洪水事件（2017-2025）进行检测，并采用两种独立参考产品进行双重验证，同时通过迭代管线测试识别失败模式。
AI.result: 农田区域检测一致性最高（IoU=52%），河流洪水检测效果最佳（F1=0.69）；树冠覆盖和建成区检测接近零（IoU=4%）。双重验证表明部分模型误差源于参考产品间的定义不一致。管线工程问题占初始错误的主导地位。
AI.conclusion: 建立了环境依赖性的检测边界，为卫星洪水制图的操作化应用提供了关键指导。

title: Anchor-Conditioned Compositional Control for Landscape Image Generation
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Computational Creativity, ICCC 2026
summary: Image generative models, though widely used as creative tools, offer limited support for the kind of compositional control that photographers and visual artists routinely exercise. This paper presents early results on an anchor conditioned finetuning framework for landscape image generation, in which a four dimensional compositional anchor vector is extracted from training images and injected into a diffusion model via a decoupled cross attention mechanism with Fourier encoding and three way classifier free guidance dropout. Quantitative evaluation against a baseline and three ablation variants shows that the proposed architecture achieves the highest horizon detection rate of 0.850 and the highest rule of thirds alignment of 0.817. A category specific ablation further demonstrates that training on compositionally homogeneous scene subsets reduces horizon deviation by up to 40 percent compared to mixed training. This establishes that compositional control precision is category dependent.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种锚点条件微调框架，通过四维构图锚点向量和去耦交叉注意力机制，实现 landscapes 图像生成中的构图控制，在水平线检测率和三分法对齐度上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型作为创意工具虽被广泛使用，但对摄影师和视觉艺术家常规运用的构图控制支持有限。
AI.method: 从训练图像中提取四维构图锚点向量，通过傅立叶编码和三类分类器自由引导丢弃的去耦交叉注意力机制注入扩散模型，并针对构图同质场景子集进行类别消融训练。
AI.result: 水平线检测率达0.850，三分法对齐度达0.817；构图同质子集训练相比混合训练将水平线偏差降低最多40%。
AI.conclusion: 构图控制精度具有类别依赖性，所提框架能有效提升风景图像生成中的构图可控性。

title: Post-training is (Massive) Supervised Learning
summary: The prevailing paradigm for training LLMs has evolved to rely on a massive post-training phase consisting of SFT and RL. In this position paper, we argue that this methodology effectively marks a reversion to the ``pre-train then fine-tune'' approach of the BERT era, explicitly tailoring models to the desired behaviors and specific benchmarks on which they are evaluated. We begin with a historical overview of LLMs, describing the different phases of the LLM evolution. We argue that the current landscape is remarkably similar to the early days of LLMs, where task performance heavily relied on fitting the models to in-distribution datasets. To empirically demonstrate this, we compare pre-trained models to randomly initialized ones, by fine-tuning both variants on modern reasoning datasets and evaluating them on competitive math and code benchmarks. We show that models post-trained from scratch yield highly non-trivial performance. Our findings suggest that current post-training methodologies function primarily as a distribution-fitting mechanism. We finish by positing that developing generally capable models and systems requires moving beyond extensive post-training for predefined behaviors, shifting instead toward training procedures where models ``learn how to learn''.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前LLM的Post-training范式（SFT+RL）实质上回归了BERT时代的“预训练-微调”模式，即通过分布拟合来匹配特定基准测试。实验表明，从随机初始化进行后训练也能取得显著效果，说明当前方法主要是在做分布拟合。作者主张应超越这种为预定义行为进行大量后训练的方式，转向让模型“学会如何学习”。
AI.motivation: 作者认为当前LLM的post-training范式（SFT+RL）本质上退化为BERT时代的“预训练-微调”模式，过度针对特定基准进行分布拟合，限制了模型通用能力的发展。
AI.method: 通过历史回顾梳理LLM发展历程，并进行对比实验：将预训练模型与随机初始化的模型分别在推理数据集上微调，在数学和代码基准上评估性能差异。
AI.result: 从随机初始化进行后训练的模型也能取得非平凡的性能，表明当前post-training主要起到了分布拟合的作用，预训练权重并非绝对必要。
AI.conclusion: 当前的后训练范式本质上是分布拟合机制，应当超越为预定义行为进行大量后训练的方式，转向让模型“学会如何学习”的训练范式。

title: Reconstructing and forecasting disease trajectories of patients with Alzheimer's disease using routine data in resource-constrained settings
summary: Alzheimer's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder, and its progression varies substantially across patients. Existing work aims to forecast patients' future cognitive state, with minimal focus on reconstructing the state from past visits. Furthermore, in current research, quantifying predictive uncertainty remains underexplored and relies on costly modalities such as MRI, PET, and CSF, limiting their deployment in resource-limited settings. In this research, our primary objectives are: First, bidirectional prediction of cognitive scores from irregular visits to present the complete disease trajectory. Second, to enable interpolation and extrapolation capabilities to assist clinicians in informed prognostic decision making, and third, to provide a well-calibrated uncertainty estimate for all predictions, and finally, to achieve the objectives using the modalities available during routine visits. We propose a unified framework, GNOVA: A GRU-Neural ODE Variational Autoencoder. The architecture combines a Gated Recurrent Unit encoder and a Neural ODE decoder within a variational autoencoder framework. In our work, we forecast the CDR-SB and MMSE Scores. The GRU encoder allows for any number of inputs at any time point. The Neural-ODE decoder performs continuous estimation, allowing interpolation and extrapolation at any desired time point. The Variational autoencoder allows for uncertainty estimation in predictions. We worked with 1,727 patients from the ADNI dataset over 10 years; the model achieved mean absolute errors of 1.35 and 2.28 for CDR-SB and MMSE scores, respectively, without requiring any neuroimaging or biomarker data. Feature-ablation studies revealed that age, BMI, and APOE4 status were strong predictors. The proposed framework enables the reconstruction of incomplete patient histories and the anticipation of future cognitive states.

AI.tldr: 提出GNOVA框架（GRU-神经ODE变分自编码器），利用常规临床数据（无需MRI/PET/CSF）实现认知评分的双向预测、插值/外推及不确定性估计，在ADNI数据集上取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要聚焦于预测患者未来认知状态，较少关注从过去就诊记录重构状态；同时量化预测不确定性的研究不足，且依赖MRI、PET、CSF等高成本模态，限制了在资源有限环境中的部署。
AI.method: 提出GNOVA统一框架，结合GRU编码器（处理任意数量、任意时间点的输入）与神经ODE解码器（实现连续时间估计，支持插值与外推），基于变分自编码器结构进行不确定性估计。
AI.result: 基于ADNI数据集1,727名患者10年数据，CDR-SB和MMSE评分的平均绝对误差分别为1.35和2.28，无需神经影像或生物标志物数据；特征消融实验显示年龄、BMI和APOE4状态是强预测因子。
AI.conclusion: GNOVA框架能够重建不完整的患者病史并预测未来认知状态，且仅利用常规临床数据，具有较好的实用性和可部署性。

title: MOSS-Video-Preview: Toward Real-Time Video Understanding via Cross-Attention
summary: Video understanding is shifting from the offline paradigm -- taking a fully recorded video as input and producing a single answer after it ends -- toward real-time interaction, in which the model perceives new frames while still replying, revises its answer as new evidence appears, and remains silent when there is nothing to say. We present MOSS-Video-Preview to validate this paradigm. Our central claim is that perception must not be blocked by generation; its natural realization is a two-channel architecture. We argue that a cross-attention backbone is better suited to real-time vision-language fusion than the prevailing decoder-only design: visual features enter through a side channel rather than joining the autoregressive sequence, so perception and generation run on separate, non-blocking pathways -- reducing the frequency of visual processing and exposing a clean channel-wise interface for independent compression. We complement this with a data synthesis pipeline that converts dense captions into real-time understanding QA whose answers are revised to match what the model has perceived so far, and we specialize an offline model on these data to elicit real-time behavior. Our model trails the strong Qwen2.5-VL-7B baseline overall -- a gap we attribute primarily to data and scale rather than the architecture -- yet attains competitive offline video and multimodal understanding, remains robust on the spatial and fine-grained temporal reasoning central to real-time use, and acquires behaviors that offline models lack: continuous perception, answer revision, and timely silence. On a single H200 with 256 frames per video, it achieves about a 5x speedup in time to first token and 2.7x higher decoding throughput, with negligible degradation in offline ability. Our study of paradigm, architecture, and data outlines a viable path toward real-time video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出一个名为MOSS-Video-Preview的实时视频理解框架，采用双通道架构（交叉注意力骨干网络）将感知与生成解耦，实现连续感知、答案修正和适时沉默，在保持离线能力的同时显著提升实时交互效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的离线视频理解范式（先完整观看视频再输出答案）无法满足实时交互需求，需要一种能边感知新帧边生成回复、根据新证据修正答案、无话可说时保持沉默的新型范式。
AI.method: 1) 采用交叉注意力骨干网络的双通道架构，视觉特征通过侧通道而非自回归序列进入，使感知与生成运行在独立的非阻塞路径上；2) 设计数据合成流程，将密集标注转化为实时理解QA数据；3) 在合成数据上微调离线模型以激发实时行为。
AI.result: 在单张H200上处理256帧/视频时，首token时间加速约5倍，解码吞吐量提升2.7倍；离线能力几乎无损；获得了离线模型缺乏的连续感知、答案修正和适时沉默能力。
AI.conclusion: 从范式、架构和数据三个维度验证了实时视频理解的可行路径，尽管整体性能尚落后于Qwen2.5-VL-7B强基线（差距主要归因于数据和规模而非架构），但在实时相关能力上表现优异。

title: BEACON: Behavioral Entropy Aggregation for Cross-Model Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
comment: 12 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure. Code and data available upon request
summary: Hallucination in large language models (LLMs), defined as the generation of factually incorrect or unsupported content, remains a critical barrier to reliable deployment. We present BEACON (Behavioral Entropy Aggregation for Cross-model hallucination detectiON), a black-box hallucination detection framework that operates purely on model outputs without requiring access to internal representations or external knowledge bases. BEACON extracts a 31-dimensional feature vector from structured multi-pass generation, integrating NLI-based semantic entropy, embedding geometry, chain-of-thought consistency, and paraphrase stability signals. A gradient-boosted classifier trained on 7,617 labeled examples across seven benchmarks achieves 0.8123 +/- 0.0102 AUROC (95% CI: 0.7632-0.8251), outperforming standalone semantic entropy (+0.2298) and SelfCheckGPT-style consistency baselines (+0.2457). Feature importance analysis shows that hallucination is inherently multi-dimensional, requiring combined uncertainty signals. An efficient 5-call variant achieves 0.7795 AUROC, enabling practical deployment across black-box LLM APIs.

AI.tldr: 提出BEACON框架，通过31维特征向量（包含NLI语义熵、嵌入几何、思维链一致性、释义稳定性）在纯黑盒条件下检测LLM幻觉，AUROC达0.8123。
AI.motivation: LLM的幻觉问题严重阻碍其可靠部署，现有检测方法多需访问模型内部表示或外部知识库，缺乏纯黑盒场景下的有效方案。
AI.method: 从结构化多轮生成中提取31维特征，融合NLI语义熵、嵌入几何、CoT一致性、释义稳定性信号，用梯度提升分类器训练检测模型，并设计了5次调用的高效变体。
AI.result: 在7个基准数据集、7,617个标注样本上AUROC达0.8123±0.0102，显著优于语义熵（+0.2298）和SelfCheckGPT（+0.2457）；高效变体达0.7795 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉检测需要多维不确定性信号的组合，BEACON实现了无需内部表示或外部知识的纯黑盒高效检测，具备实际部署价值。

title: Improving Multimodal Reasoning via Worst Dimension Optimization
summary: Multimodal reasoning requires a path that retains integrity over a wide range of constraints, from visual grounding to logic consistency. However, the current Process Reward Models focus on heuristically defined rewards that equally weigh these factors, which may lead to the concealment of individual dimension failures by the dominating factors, without guaranteeing the validity of the reasoning process in general.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前多模态推理中的过程奖励模型（PRM）因对各约束维度（视觉基础、逻辑一致性等）采用启发式均等加权，导致主导因素可能掩盖单一维度的失败，从而无法保证推理过程的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有PRM对所有推理约束维度给予相同权重，忽略了不同维度失效率的差异，使得推理路径虽整体得分高但可能在某些关键维度（如视觉基础）存在缺陷，影响推理完整性。
AI.method: 分析当前PRM在等权加权模式下的缺陷，提出需要针对各维度（视觉基础、逻辑一致性等）进行差异化建模的改进方向。
AI.result: 揭示了现有PRM因均等加权导致的高分低质问题——整体奖励高但个别维度可能失败，无法保证推理过程的全局有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多模态推理的PRM亟需打破均等加权范式，应针对不同约束维度设计差异化的奖励机制，以确保推理路径在视觉与逻辑上的双重完整性。

title: CAPruner: Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner for Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to 3D vision-language (3D-VL) tasks, which require spatial reasoning to identify target objects relative to anchors. Scene graphs are commonly employed to represent such relations, but reasoning over complete graphs incurs high token costs and computational inefficiencies, motivating the need for pruning. Existing pruning methods primarily rely on spatial proximity and often remove task-relevant relations, thereby undermining reliable spatial reasoning. To address these limitations, we derive a key requirement for scene graph pruning: preserving spatial relations that are most pertinent to the specific 3D-VL task. Guided by this insight, we propose the Conceptual-Adjacent Scene Graph Pruner (CAPruner). CAPruner integrates fuzzy semantic relevance with spatial proximity to estimate the importance of relations, enabling the selection of critical relations in a task-specific context. Moreover, to avoid costly relation-level annotations, CAPruner is trained by supervising the aggregated scores of each node's incident edges. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAPruner effectively preserves relations essential for spatial reasoning, leading to substantial performance improvements of LLMs on 3D-VL tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/fz-zsl/CAPruner.

AI.tldr: 提出CAPruner，通过融合模糊语义相关性与空间邻近性来剪枝3D场景图，保留任务关键的空间关系，提升LLM在3D视觉-语言任务上的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有场景图剪枝方法主要依赖空间邻近性，常移除与任务相关的关系，损害空间推理能力。需要一种保留任务关键空间关系的剪枝方法。
AI.method: 提出CAPruner，融合模糊语义相关性与空间邻近性评估关系重要性，通过节点入射边聚合分数进行训练，避免昂贵的逐关系标注。
AI.result: CAPruner有效保留空间推理所需的关键关系，显著提升LLM在3D-VL任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 融合模糊语义与空间邻近性的场景图剪枝方法能更好地支持3D空间推理，具有实用价值。

title: Beyond Goodhart's Law: A Dynamic Benchmark for Evaluating Compliance in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive assistants to autonomous, execution-capable agents has introduced critical operational risks. Most current evaluation frameworks neglect procedural compliance, leading to ''Machiavellian'' behaviors where agents strategically violate safety rules to maximize rewards - a direct manifestation of Goodhart's Law. To address this blind spot, we introduce MAC-Bench, a dynamic, adversarial benchmark designed to evaluate the procedural alignment of multi-agent systems under realistic pressure. We propose the SERV(Seed - Evolve - Refine - Verify) pipeline, an ``Agent-as-a-Benchmark'' paradigm that transforms unstructured legal texts into executable, contamination-free scenarios. By synthesizing holographic sandbox environments and injecting calibrated social-engineering pressure vectors, MAC-Bench forces agents into Pareto-optimal trade-offs between task success and regulatory adherence. We introduced novel metrics: the Compliance-Weighted Success Rate (CSR) and the Machiavellian Gap (MG), and conducted a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art frontier models to reveal the pervasive trade-offs between success and compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAC-Bench，一个用于评估多智能体系统在压力下程序对齐的动态对抗性基准，发现前沿模型普遍存在成功与合规性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架忽视程序合规性，导致智能体出现“马基雅维利式”行为（为最大化奖励而违反安全规则），这是Goodhart定律的直接体现。
AI.method: 提出SERV（Seed-Evolve-Refine-Verify）流水线，将非结构化法律文本转化为可执行、无污染的场景；构建全息沙箱环境并注入社会工程压力向量；引入合规加权成功率（CSR）和马基雅维利差距（MG）新指标。
AI.result: 对前沿模型进行全面评估，揭示了成功与合规性之间普遍存在的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: MAC-Bench有效暴露了多智能体系统在压力下的程序对齐缺陷，为评估和改善智能体合规行为提供了新范式。

title: Readable Yet Unpredictable: Rotated-Outcome Prediction in Vision-Language Models
summary: Can vision-language models predict what a 180° rotation would reveal from the original image alone? We study this ability through Rotated-Outcome Prediction: given an original image, a model must answer what would be seen or read after a 180° in-plane rotation, without directly observing the rotated target. To isolate this gap, we introduce RotOutBench, a paired diagnostic benchmark spanning open visual cases and controlled text-image rotations. A sharp pattern emerges: many VLMs can recognize the relevant content when directly given either the original or rotated image, yet fail to infer the rotated result from the original image alone. On controlled text-image rotations, predicted-rotation accuracy collapses to near zero even for models with high direct-reading accuracy. A model-level case study further shows that the prediction state can approach a rotated-image reading state, while the final readout still shifts toward the original string. Current VLMs can recognize a transformed visual state when it is shown, but often fail to predict that state from the original view.

AI.tldr: 当前视觉-语言模型在直接看到旋转后的图像时能识别内容，但无法从原始图像预测180°旋转后的结果，在受控实验中预测准确率接近零。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉-语言模型是否具备从原始图像预测180°旋转后所见内容的能力，识别模型在视觉变换推理上的关键短板。
AI.method: 构建RotOutBench诊断基准，包含开放视觉案例和受控文本-图像旋转对；通过对比模型在直接识别与预测旋转结果上的表现差异，以及模型内部状态分析进行研究。
AI.result: 模型在直接看到旋转图像时能准确识别，但预测旋转结果的准确率骤降至接近零；模型内部预测状态虽可接近旋转图像读取状态，但最终输出仍偏向原始图像内容。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉-语言模型能识别已呈现的变换视觉状态，但缺乏从原始视角预测该变换状态的能力，揭示了模型在视觉变换推理上的本质局限。

title: Where Instruction Hierarchy Breaks: Diagnosing and Repairing Failures in Reasoning Language Models
summary: Reasoning language models deployed in agentic workflows must follow an instruction hierarchy: when instructions from different sources conflict, the model should obey the highest-privilege applicable instruction. Existing benchmarks largely measure this behavior end-to-end, asking whether the final response is compliant. However, a non-compliant response can arise from several distinct failures: the model may fail to identify the relevant instructions in context, fail to resolve conflicts among identified instructions, or correctly resolve the conflict in its reasoning while still producing a violating response. We introduce a white-box diagnostic framework that localizes instruction hierarchy failures into instruction identification, conflict resolution, and response realization, making failures more interpretable. We evaluate three reasoning models--Gemma-4-31B-IT, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6--on long-context adaptations of IHEval and IHChallenge, and find that the dominant failure mode varies across models, tasks, and context length. Building on the observation that models can often detect conflicts and output violations when explicitly prompted, we propose two training-free self-monitoring mechanisms: a parallel input monitor for low-latency conflict detection before generation, and a sequential output monitor for response-level review and repair. Across Gemma-4-31B-IT, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.3, the strongest monitor reduces rule-following non-compliance by 81-99%, with GPT-5.3 reductions of 86% under static attacks and 45% under adaptive attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种白盒诊断框架，将指令层级失效定位为指令识别、冲突解决和响应实现三个环节，并在长上下文中评估了三种推理模型。基于模型能检测冲突但可能仍输出违规响应这一发现，作者提出了无需训练的自监控机制（并行输入监控和顺序输出监控），可将违规率降低81-99%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只能端到端判断最终响应是否合规，但一个违规响应可能源于多种不同的失效原因（识别失败、冲突解决失败、推理正确但输出违规）。作者希望将失效模式局部化，使失败更加可解释。
AI.method: 1) 提出白盒诊断框架，将指令层级失效拆分为指令识别、冲突解决、响应实现三个阶段；2) 在长上下文版本的IHEval和IHChallenge上评估Gemma-4-31B-IT、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B和Claude Sonnet 4.6；3) 提出两种无需训练的自监控机制：并行输入监控（生成前低延迟检测冲突）和顺序输出监控（生成后审查和修复）。
AI.result: 主导失效模式因模型、任务和上下文长度而异。最强监控机制能将规则遵循违规率降低81-99%，GPT-5.3在静态攻击下降86%，在自适应攻击下降45%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式引导模型检测冲突并进行自监控，可以有效提升推理模型在代理工作流中的指令层级遵循能力。

title: Do VLMs See What Sensors Feel? A Scalable Expert-Guided Design for Wheelchair Accessibility Assessment from Street View
summary: Assessing built-environment interaction, such as wheelchair accessibility, is difficult because real-world mobility is shaped by distributed, context-dependent, and temporary barriers that are hard to capture at scale. To support scalable assessment, this paper examines whether vision-language models (VLMs) can identify accessibility barriers from Google Street View (GSV) imagery. We propose an expert-guided retrieval-augmented framework that combines GSV images, ADA-informed guidance, and expert-derived rubrics to evaluate accessibility dimensions. We collect a campus-scale dataset at the University of Florida, linking 407 unique GSV locations with GPS-derived wheelchair dwell behavior as a mobility-friction signal. Results show that VLM ratings are both negatively correlated and distributionally similar with dwell time, indicating partial but consistent alignment with a behavioral proxy for mobility friction. Visual cue analysis shows that certain environmental objects, such as curb ramps and crosswalks, are associated with higher VLM accessibility scores, while alignment remains limited for subtle surface conditions, transient obstructions, and viewpoint-dependent barriers. Overall, our findings show the potential of expert-guided VLMs for scalable accessibility assessment aligning with sensor-derived indicators of real-world wheelchair navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出专家指导的检索增强框架，利用视觉语言模型和谷歌街景图像评估轮椅可达性，在佛罗里达大学校园数据集上验证，发现VLM评分与轮椅停留时间行为代理指标呈负相关，表明该方法在可扩展可达性评估上具有潜力，但对细微障碍的识别仍有局限。
AI.motivation: 建成环境中的可达性评估（如轮椅无障碍性）因存在分布式、上下文依赖及临时性障碍而难以大规模开展，现有方法难以捕捉这些复杂的交互因素。
AI.method: 提出专家引导的检索增强框架，结合谷歌街景图像、ADA无障碍指南及专家评分量表，收集佛罗里达大学407个GSV位置与GPS轮椅停留行为数据，利用视觉语言模型进行可达性评分。
AI.result: VLM评分与轮椅停留时间呈负相关且分布相似；路缘坡道和人行横道等环境元素与高可达性评分相关，但对细微路面状况、临时障碍物和视角依赖障碍的识别准确性有限。
AI.conclusion: 专家引导的VLM方法在可扩展的可达性评估中具有潜力，能够与真实世界轮椅导航的行为指标部分对齐。

title: mllm-shap: A Shapley Value Explainability Platform for Text-Audio Multimodal Large Language Models
summary:
We introduce mllm-shap, an open-source Python framework designed to extend Shapley Value (SV) explainability from text-only Large Language Models to Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) processing joint text and audio inputs. While text-based attribution is well-studied, mllm-shap addresses three critical challenges unique to the multimodal regime:
  (1) Modality-aware coalition masking, which manages the interleaved processing of discrete text tokens and dense audio encoder frames.
  (2) Multi-turn conversation tracking, utilizing per-token metadata to maintain role and modality context.
  (3) Phonetic alignment-based token grouping, a novel technique that reduces the coalition space by 10x to 50x, rendering SV estimation computationally feasible for long-form audio.
  The platform implements five SV estimation strategies, including a Complementary Contributions (CC) estimator with Neyman-optimal allocation that demonstrates superior convergence over standard Monte Carlo baselines. mllm-shap is provided as a pip-installable package featuring an interactive web-based GUI for granular attribution visualization. To our knowledge, this is the first publicly available framework providing a complete, reproducible pipeline for SV-based explainability in text-audio MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出mllm-shap，一个开源Python框架，首次将Shapley值可解释性扩展到处理文本和音频的多模态大语言模型，解决了模态感知掩码、多轮对话追踪和音素对齐分组三大挑战，实现了高效的归因可视化。
AI.motivation: 现有的Shapley值可解释性主要针对纯文本大语言模型，而多模态LLM（同时处理文本和音频）缺乏相应的归因框架。作者旨在填补这一空白，解决多模态场景下的特有挑战。
AI.method: (1) 模态感知的联盟掩码机制，管理离散文本token与密集音频编码帧的交错处理；(2) 多轮对话追踪，利用逐token元数据维护角色和模态上下文；(3) 基于音素对齐的token分组技术，将联盟空间缩小10-50倍；(4) 实现五种SV估计策略，包括具有Neyman最优分配的互补贡献（CC）估计器。
AI.result: 互补贡献（CC）估计器在收敛性上优于标准蒙特卡洛基线；音素对齐分组技术使SV估计在长音频场景下计算可行；提供了交互式Web GUI用于细粒度归因可视化。
AI.conclusion: mllm-shap是首个公开可用的、提供完整可复现管线的SV可解释性框架，适用于文本-音频多模态大语言模型，并以pip包形式发布。

title: Scaling Participation in Modular AI Systems
summary: Humanity is a mosaic of multifaceted talents and needs, and any truly intelligent AI must reflect that richness. Yet the LLMs used by all are built by the few -- a centralized market of monolithic AI models structurally ill-suited to capture the diversity of human knowledge, reasoning, and values. Here we introduce scaling participation, a new paradigm in which modular AI systems are built from the bottom up through the contributions of diverse stakeholders. Participants contribute small models trained on their own interests and priorities; these models then collaborate in modular frameworks as compositional AI systems. Participatory AI systems outperform monolithic LLMs by up to 15.4% across 15 tasks, such as reasoning and factuality, surpassing models larger than all contributed components combined. Further experiments show that participatory AI systems benefit from contributor diversity, substantially improve on each contributor's original priorities, and exhibit emergent capabilities that allow them to solve over 15% of problems where all individual models fail. Scaling participation provides a technical foundation for transitioning from the monolithic status quo toward an open, bottom-up, and collaborative AI future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种“扩展参与”的新范式，通过让不同利益相关者贡献各自的小模型，构建模块化的组合式AI系统。实验表明，这种参与式AI系统在15项任务上比单一大型LLM性能高出最多15.4%，并且展现出超越所有单一模型的新兴能力。
AI.motivation: 当前由少数机构构建的单一化大型LLM无法捕捉人类知识、推理和价值观的多样性，因此需要一种能够体现人类多元化才能和需求的AI构建方式。
AI.method: 采用“扩展参与”范式，让不同参与者贡献基于自身兴趣和优先级训练的小模型，这些模型在模块化框架中以组合式AI系统的形式协同工作。
AI.result: 参与式AI系统在15个任务上（如推理和事实性）超越单一大型LLM最高达15.4%；贡献者多样性带来了显著性能提升；系统展现出新兴能力，能够解决超过15%的所有单一模型均无法解决的问题。
AI.conclusion: 扩展参与为从单一化AI现状向开放、自下而上、协作式的AI未来转型提供了技术基础。

title: AVI-Bench: Toward Human-like Audio-Visual Intelligence of Omni-MLLMs
summary: Recent advances in Omni-Multimodal Large Language Models (Omni-MLLMs) have enabled strong integration of vision, audio, and language. However, their audio-visual intelligence (AVI) remains insufficiently evaluated due to the lack of systematic and comprehensive benchmarks. We introduce AVI-Bench, a cognitively inspired benchmark that evaluates Omni-MLLMs across three stages, perception, understanding, and reasoning, through cross-modal tasks requiring joint audio-visual interpretation. This design enables fine-grained diagnosis of model capabilities and failure modes. To further assess robustness beyond familiar domains, we propose AVI-Bench-PriSe, an extension that probes models' primitive audio-visual sensation using unfamiliar, low-semantic stimuli, testing generalization beyond common training distributions. Extensive experiments on both open-source and closed-source models reveal substantial limitations in current Omni-MLLMs. Based on these findings, we present a four-level AVI taxonomy. Overall, AVI-Bench provides a principled evaluation framework to guide the development of more robust and generalizable AVI. Project website: https://fudancvl.github.io/AVI-Bench/

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVI-Bench基准，系统评估多模态大模型在视听智能方面的感知、理解与推理能力，并揭示现有模型的显著局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有Omni-MLLMs在视听智能方面的评估缺乏系统性综合基准，无法细粒度诊断模型能力与失败模式。
AI.method: 构建AVI-Bench基准，通过跨模态任务评估感知、理解、推理三阶段智能；扩展AVI-Bench-PriSe使用低语义刺激测试原始视听感知的泛化能力；提出四级AVI分类体系。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前开源与闭源Omni-MLLMs在视听智能上存在显著局限性。
AI.conclusion: AVI-Bench为开发更鲁棒、更具泛化性的视听智能提供了原则性评估框架。

title: Principled Agent Debate: Adversarial Arbitration for Sycophancy Reduction in Large Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Code and data available at github.com/NovelSystems/CANDOR
summary: RLHF-trained models are systematically biased toward agreement over accuracy, a structural property of the training process. We present Principled Agent Debate (PAD), a multi-agent architecture that mitigates identity-framed sycophancy by arbitrating between two models tuned to opposing philosophical dispositions, with a pragmatist synthesizer evaluating both arguments blind to their origins. This paper evaluates a prompt-based instantiation of PAD. The key mechanisms are static dispositional tuning, identity stripping before synthesis, single-round independent argumentation, and blind arbitration. We evaluate five instantiations on 200 stratified questions from SycophancyEval. All PAD variants (AnCifer, DeWin, FeynStein, BurGal, Trident) significantly outperform the single-model baseline (18.5%) and instructed-opposition baseline (29.0%), with DeWin achieving 48.5% accuracy (z=6.36, p<0.001 versus both). The variants are not significantly different from each other at n=200. The BurGal variant achieves 53.0% but functions as an architectural validity check; its consensus/heterodox axis structurally favors the heterodox model on every benchmark question. A pre-training floor affects an estimated 40% of questions; fine-tuned disposition models are the identified next step.

AI.tldr: PAD是一种多智能体架构，通过让两个对立哲学倾向的模型独立辩论并由盲审仲裁，显著缓解了RLHF模型的身份框架式谄媚问题，最高准确率从18.5%提升至48.5%。
AI.motivation: RLHF训练的模型存在系统性偏向同意的偏差（身份框架式谄媚），导致准确性受损，需要新的架构来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 提出Principled Agent Debate (PAD)架构，包括：静态倾向性调优、身份剥离、单轮独立论证、盲审仲裁。在SycophancyEval的200道分层问题上评估五种变体。
AI.result: 所有PAD变体均显著优于单模型基线（18.5%）和指令对抗基线（29.0%），DeWin达到48.5%（z=6.36, p<0.001）。变体间无显著差异，约40%问题受预训练下限影响。
AI.conclusion: PAD框架有效缓解了RLHF模型的系统性偏差，但存在预训练性能下限，下一步应使用微调倾向模型而非提示词来实现。

title: Joint Structural Pruning and Mixed-Precision Quantization for LLM Compression
summary: Recently, the efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) deployment has become a critical concern in practical applications. While post-training quantization (PTQ) and structural pruning are established techniques for reducing memory footprint and inference latency, most existing PTQ approaches optimize quantization errors on a per-layer basis, overlooking how errors accumulate and propagate through the network, often resulting in suboptimal solutions. Traditional pipelines also tend to apply pruning and quantization in isolation or sequentially, further compounding sub-optimality. We introduce a novel end-to-end framework that addresses these limitations in two key ways. First, we propose a novel mixed-precision PTQ strategy that directly minimizes global error propagation across the entire model, rather than isolating layer-wise errors. Building on this, we develop a novel joint optimization approach that simultaneously learns structural pruning decisions and mixed-precision quantization policies within a unified search space. Extensive experiments show that, at ultra-low precisions (1-3 bits), our quantization method reduces WikiText perplexity by up to 21% compared to state-of-the-art (SoTA) weight-activation quantization baselines. Against leading weight-only quantization methods, it achieves up to 59% and 85% lower perplexity on WikiText and C4, respectively. Compared to the SoTA joint pruning-and-quantization techniques, our proposed method delivers superior perplexity and reasoning performance at ultra-low bits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端框架，通过全局误差传播优化的混合精度PTQ策略和联合搜索剪枝与量化策略，在超低比特（1-3比特）下显著提升了LLM的部署效率，困惑度比SOTA方法降低最高85%。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法逐层优化量化误差，忽略误差在网络中的累积与传播，且剪枝与量化通常孤立或顺序进行，导致次优解。
AI.method: 提出全局误差传播最小化的混合精度PTQ策略，以及联合学习结构剪枝决策和混合精度量化策略的统一搜索框架。
AI.result: 超低精度下，相比SOTA权重-激活量化方法困惑度降低21%；相比仅权重量化方法，WikiText和C4上困惑度分别降低59%和85%；优于现有联合剪枝与量化方法。
AI.conclusion: 该端到端联合优化框架在超低比特场景下显著优于现有方法，兼顾了模型压缩效率和推理质量。

title: FineGen: A VLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Fine-Grained Image-Text Dataset Construction
summary: The scarcity of hard negative samples in current vision-language datasets significantly hinders fine-grained perception. To address this, we propose FineGen, a VLM-based Multi-Agent framework for automated dataset construction. By employing a collaborative Generation-Verification-Correction pipeline with a closed-loop feedback mechanism, FineGen ensures synthesized hard negatives are semantically valid yet strictly contradictory to visual content. Applying this to ImageNet, we construct FineGen-100K, a hierarchical dataset containing over 147,000 attribute-specific hard negatives with a rigorous 1:10 positive-to-negative ratio. Extensive evaluations confirm a 96.7% attribute validity rate. Crucially, downstream validation on the FG-OVD benchmark shows that fine-tuning on FineGen-100K yields a substantial +14.4% accuracy improvement on hard samples, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FineGen框架，通过多智能体协作生成高质量硬负样本，构建FineGen-100K数据集（14.7万硬负样本，1:10正负比），在FG-OVD基准上提升14.4%的硬样本准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言数据集中硬负样本稀缺，严重阻碍了模型的细粒度感知能力。
AI.method: 提出FineGen，基于VLM的多智能体框架，采用"生成-验证-纠正"协作流水线及闭环反馈机制，确保生成的硬负样本语义有效且与视觉内容严格矛盾。
AI.result: 构建FineGen-100K数据集（147,000+属性特定硬负样本，1:10正负比），属性有效率达96.7%；在FG-OVD基准上，微调后硬样本准确率提升14.4%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FineGen框架能有效解决硬负样本稀缺问题，显著提升模型的细粒度感知能力。

title: Bridging Traditional Explainability Methods and Multimodal Multilingual Models: An XAI-Based Analysis
summary:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively integrate text and audio to interpret context in complex interactive dialogues. However, the internal mechanisms by which heterogeneous modalities influence model behavior remain opaque. While Shapley Values (SV) provide a robust, model-agnostic framework for local explainability in text-based NLP, their extension to multimodal data is hindered by cross-channel dependencies, intricate dialogue structures, and the prohibitive computational complexity of dense audio representations.
  In this work, we formalize a multimodal extension of the Shapley Value framework, treating discrete text tokens and aligned audio segments as cooperative features. To ensure computational feasibility, we deploy a suite of efficient estimation strategies: exact SV computation for low-dimensional inputs and sampling-based approximations - including Monte Carlo permutations and stratified sampling with Neyman-optimal allocation - to minimize variance under constrained computational budgets. To resolve the granularity mismatch between modalities, we propose Spectrogram-Guided Phonetic Alignment (SGPA), a novel preprocessing method that maps high-frequency audio streams to interpretable, word-aligned segments.
  Our contribution is twofold: first, we provide an open-source, model-agnostic Python package and a companion GUI for the computation and interactive visualization of multimodal attributions. Second, we evaluate our framework using curated subsets of the VoiceBench and Infinity Instruct datasets across diverse multilingual scenarios.
