AI.motivation: AI代理从过去经验中复用工件（如代码、工作流）可提升效率，但环境漂移、任务定义不充分或任务分布变化会导致生命周期可靠性问题，特别是在Web自动化场景中。
AI.method: 提出选择性形式化方法，根据执行证据决定工作流步骤应转为可执行代码还是保留自然语言引导；工作流存储为可审计、版本化的笔记本，包含自然语言、多语言可执行单元、验证门、回退路径及多模态证据；运行时通过门控条件执行，验证通过则执行代码，否则本地回退。
AI.result: WebArena-Verified上单轮成功率53.7%，比最强基线高3.9个百分点；三次重执行保留91.7%初始成功任务，比次优方法高15.5个百分点；有限修复下恢复72.9%后续失败，修复后回归率仅4.2%；在Mind2Web跨网站和跨域拆分上领先；GitLab迁移测试中冻结状态与最新版本差距极小。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期治理和门控条件执行是超越单次任务成功率的可靠性新维度。

title: Whose Norms? Disentangling Cultural and Personal Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for social decision-making situations that require balancing cultural norms with personal preferences. For example, a user preferring honesty might ask whether to correct a coworker publicly when local norms favor indirect feedback. Yet existing research studies cultural alignment and personalization largely separately. We introduce PACT, the Personal-Preference and Cultural-Norm Trade-off framework, which evaluates whether models choose to follow a cultural norm or allow personal preferences. We find that LLMs vary in how rigidly they enforce cultural norms, with behavior shifted more by country context (7.8%) than age (1%) and gender (0.7%) and shifting non-uniformly after instruction tuning. Furthermore, our five-country human study on PACT shows that culture-following in humans is mainly driven by scenario country, with the lowest agreement when participants judge their own cultural contexts, showing within-culture pluralism. Finally, human-LLM alignment experiments show that models can match majority choices, but fail to capture response distributions and uncertainty (with best correlations reaching only 0.24). Together, these findings motivate alignment evaluations that go beyond majority to capture cultural pluralism and disagreement in social judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACT框架，评估大语言模型在社交决策中如何在文化规范与个人偏好之间权衡。研究发现模型对文化规范的遵循程度因国家背景差异最大（7.8%），且指令微调后变化不均匀。人类实验显示文化遵循主要由场景国家驱动，模型虽能匹配多数选择，但无法捕捉响应分布和不确定性（最佳相关性仅0.24）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将文化对齐与个性化分开研究，缺乏同时评估模型在文化规范与个人偏好之间权衡能力的框架。
AI.method: 提出PACT框架，通过对比不同国家、年龄、性别背景下模型的行为选择，并进行五国人类实验和人类-LLM对齐实验。
AI.result: 国家背景对模型行为影响最大（7.8%），年龄（1%）和性别（0.7%）影响较小；指令微调后变化不均匀；模型能匹配多数选择但无法捕捉分布和不确定性（最佳相关性0.24）。
AI.conclusion: 社会判断中对齐评估应超越多数投票，需捕捉文化多元性和分歧。

title: How Small Can You Go? LoRA Fine-Tuning 270M-8B Models for Merchant Information Extraction in Financial Transactions
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM) 2026
summary: Financial transaction processing requires extracting structured merchant information from noisy, abbreviated bank transaction strings at scale. Our current production system, a LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1-8B, achieves 96.95% F1 on this task, but deploying 8-billion-parameter models imposes prohibitive memory, latency, and cost constraints. To identify more efficient alternatives, we conduct a deployment-focused study of 24 model variants spanning four model families: Gemma 3 (270M, 1B, 4B), Qwen 3.5 (0.8B, 2B, 4B), Aya (3.35B), and LLaMA 3.1-8B, systematically evaluating accuracy, inference throughput, training cost, and hardware behavior to assess production suitability. Our findings show that: (1) reproducing the LLaMA 3.1-8B fine-tune with a LoRA rank of 8 achieves 96.75% F1, only 0.20 points below the rank-32 baseline; (2) Qwen 3.5 4B with JSON-only prompting reaches 96.60% F1, within 0.35 points of the 8B baseline while using roughly half the parameters; (3) the 0.8B Qwen 3.5 model achieves 94.75% F1, matching models 2.5-4x larger and offering an attractive latency-accuracy trade-off; (4) chain-of-thought fine-tuning generally improves F1 by 0.3-1.8 points across most models, although Qwen 3.5 4B performs best with direct JSON-only prompting; and (5) Qwen 3.5 Think and Nothink training templates produce nearly identical results (F1 differences <0.004), indicating that explicit reasoning supervision is unnecessary for structured extraction tasks. We further deploy all 14 fine-tuned sub-8B models as Databricks Model Serving endpoints and observe that benchmark performance transfers reliably to production, with an average F1 change of only 0.8 points. Aya 3.35B, based on the Cohere2 architecture, is the sole exception, exhibiting a 3-5 point decline under serving conditions. Based on these results, we provide deployment recommendations across accuracy and latency requirements, ...

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了24种小参数模型在金融交易结构化信息提取任务上的表现，发现Qwen 3.5 4B在精度接近8B模型的同时参数量减半，0.8B小模型在延迟与精度间取得良好平衡，并为生产部署提供了实际建议。
AI.motivation: 现有的8B参数模型（LLaMA 3.1-8B）虽然精度高（96.95% F1），但部署时存在内存、延迟和成本过高的限制，亟需寻找更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 对24个模型变体（涵盖Gemma 3、Qwen 3.5、Aya、LLaMA 3.1四个系列）进行系统评估，比较LoRA微调、不同秩设置、JSON-only提示、链式思维微调等多种训练策略，并将14个模型部署到Databricks Model Serving进行生产环境验证。
AI.result: (1) LoRA rank=8仅比rank=32低0.20 F1；(2) Qwen 3.5 4B用一半参数量达到96.60% F1；(3) 0.8B模型匹配2.5-4倍大的模型；(4) 链式思维微调提升0.3-1.8 F1；(5) Qwen 3.5两种训练模板结果几乎一致；(6) 生产环境与基准F1平均仅差0.8，但Aya 3.35B下降3-5点。
AI.conclusion: Qwen 3.5 4B是8B模型的最佳替代品，0.8B模型适合延迟敏感场景；链式思维微调整体有效但非必要；不同模型的生产性能需单独验证。研究为金融交易处理提供了实用的部署指南。

title: Quantum-Enhanced Similarity Measures for Polarimetric Materials Classification
summary: We present a quantum--classical hybrid pipeline for polarimetric material classification that casts this as a point-matching problem. Voxel cubes, containing polarized light reflections, are used to train an encoder to produce 32-dimensional embeddings for the voxels of the cubes. At inference, the encoder head is discarded and the embeddings are encoded as probability amplitudes of quantum states. Next, a SWAP-test circuit estimates the fidelity between each of the 32D embeddings from the query cube and a dataset of anchor cubes. The aggregated fidelity serves as materials similarity scores, and the class of the anchor with highest aggregated fidelity is deemed as the class of the queried material. We evaluate our approach on a dataset of 23 materials ($\approx$800 samples each) derived from their Mueller matrices. The point-matching approaches from the proposed quantum SWAP-test and a classical classifier using Optimal Transport are compared. Our results demonstrate the competitive classification accuracy alongside open-set discrimination potential, establishing it as a viable path toward NISQ-based material recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种量子-经典混合流水线，利用SWAP测试电路和点匹配方法实现极化材料分类，在23种材料数据集上取得了与经典最优传输方法相当的分类精度，并具备开放集判别潜力。
AI.motivation: 探索在NISQ（含噪声中等规模量子）设备上实现材料识别的可行路径，将极化材料分类构建为点匹配问题，利用量子计算的优势提升分类性能。
AI.method: 首先用经典编码器将体素立方映射为32维嵌入向量，推理时丢弃编码器头部，将嵌入编码为量子态的概率幅；然后通过SWAP测试电路计算查询体素与锚点体素嵌入之间的保真度；聚合保真度作为材料相似度得分，最高得分对应锚点类别即为查询材料类别。
AI.result: 在23种材料（每种约800样本）的穆勒矩阵数据集上，量子SWAP测试方法与经典最优传输分类器相比，分类精度具有竞争力，同时展现出开放集判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 该混合流水线是NISQ时代材料识别的可行方案，兼具竞争性分类精度和开放集判别潜力。

title: Beyond Individual Personas: Aligning Synthetic Dialogue to Population-Level Behavior Distributions
summary: Synthetic dialogue corpora are increasingly used as proxies for target dialogue data, yet persona-grounded generators optimize individual conversations rather than corpus composition, yielding locally plausible dialogues with distorted population-level behavior mixes. We introduce GroupPersona, a framework that aligns synthetic dialogue corpora to the behavior distribution of a reference corpus. GroupPersona turns population statistics into generation controls: it separates each dialogue's core behavioral signature from predictable side effects, and uses the resulting behavioral groups to condition user agents on the interaction patterns that define the reference population. We evaluate GroupPersona on four corpora crossing two dialogue sources, assistant-style and Reddit-derived, with two construction variants: structure-preserving and variation-enhanced. GroupPersona lowers Jensen-Shannon divergence between synthetic and reference distributions over 12 behavior attributes from 0.234 to 0.177 relative to the strongest average baseline, a 24.4% reduction, and is best or tied-best on all four corpora while preserving structural alignment. It also achieves the closest calibration to reference-conversation quality scores, reducing mean absolute deviation from the reference-conversation profile to 0.63 versus 0.91 for the next-best baseline.

AI.tldr: GroupPersona是一个通过群体行为分布对齐来生成更真实合成对话语料的框架，在12个行为属性上将JS散度从0.234降至0.177（降低24.4%），且在所有四个语料库上表现最佳或并列最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于人物特征的对话生成器优化的是单个对话的合理性，而非整个语料库的组成结构，导致合成的对话在局部看似合理，但在整体上扭曲了目标人群的行为分布。
AI.method: GroupPersona将群体统计数据转化为生成控制：首先分离每个对话的核心行为特征与可预测的副作用，然后利用这些行为组来调节用户代理，使其模仿参考人群的交互模式。在四个语料库上评估，涵盖两种对话来源（助手风格和Reddit）及两种构建变体（结构保持和变体增强）。
AI.result: 相比最强平均基线，GroupPersona将12个行为属性的JS散度从0.234降至0.177（降低24.4%），在所有四个语料库上最佳或并列最佳；同时保持结构对齐，并将参考对话质量分数的平均绝对偏差从0.91降至0.63。
AI.conclusion: GroupPersona能有效对齐合成语料与参考语料的行为分布，在保持结构一致性的同时显著提升群体层面的真实性，是合成对话数据生成的重要改进。

title: DALE-CT: Depth-Aware Foundation Models for Computed Tomography
summary: Recent breakthroughs in self-supervised learning (SSL), such as the Latent-Euclidean Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (LeJEPA), alongside successes in integrating visual encoders with language models, have driven the demand for adaptable, high-capacity vision encoders in Computed Tomography (CT). In this work, we explore 2D slice-based architectures as a flexible alternative to native 3D models for processing volumetric CT data. Using the CT-RATE dataset, we trained DALE-CT (Depth-Aware Latent-Euclidean Computed Tomography), a 2D model family built entirely from scratch using LeJEPA, and compared its performance against a continually pre-trained DINOv2 baseline. To enhance representation quality, we developed a novel 3D depth-aware pre-training strategy anchored by dense auxiliary supervision from both automated anatomical masks and human-annotated abnormalities. Under linear probe evaluation with Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) for multi-abnormality detection, the frozen backbone of this dual-supervised model (DALE-CT-2S) achieves a Macro AUROC of 0.833. This performance demonstrates near-parity with state-of-the-art 3D vision-language models, achieved entirely from scratch with significantly less data and no textual supervision. To ensure reproducibility, all training code, evaluation scripts, and model weights have been made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DALE-CT，一种基于2D切片架构的CT图像自监督学习模型，通过深度感知预训练和双重监督（解剖掩膜+异常标注），在仅使用2D方法的情况下达到了与3D视觉语言模型相当的性能（Macro AUROC 0.833）。
AI.motivation: 近年来SSL和视觉-语言模型的成功推动了对高容量CT视觉编码器的需求，但原生3D模型计算成本高、灵活性差，需要探索更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 基于LeJEPA框架从头训练2D切片模型DALE-CT，采用3D深度感知预训练策略，结合自动解剖掩膜和人工标注异常的密集辅助监督，通过线性探针+MIL进行多异常检测评估。
AI.result: DALE-CT-2S在冻结骨干网络上达到Macro AUROC 0.833，与最先进的3D视觉语言模型性能相当，且完全从头训练、数据量更少、无需文本监督。
AI.conclusion: 2D切片架构配合深度感知预训练和双重监督，能有效替代3D模型处理CT体积数据，实现高性能且可复现。

title: ROSUM-MCTS: Monte Carlo Tree Search-Inspired HDL Code Summarization with Structural Rewards
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in code summarization, yet their effectiveness for Hardware Description Languages (HDLs) like VHDL and Verilog remains underexplored. We propose ROSUM-MCTS, an LLM-guided approach inspired by Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) that refines summaries through structured exploration and reinforcement-driven optimization. Our method integrates both local and global context via a hierarchical candidate expansion mechanism and optimizes summaries using a composite reward function balancing functional correctness (FC), local content adequacy (LCA), and fluency. We evaluate ROSUM-MCTS on the VHDL-eval and Verilog-eval datasets, demonstrating its consistent outperformance over baseline methods by leveraging structured bottom-up refinement and reinforcement-based optimization. Ablation studies confirm the necessity of both local and global expansion strategies, as well as the importance of balancing FC and LCA for optimal performance. Furthermore, ROSUM-MCTS proves robust against superficial modifications, such as variable renaming, maintaining summary quality where baselines degrade. These results establish ROSUM-MCTS as an effective and robust HDL summarization framework, paving the way for further research into reinforcement-enhanced code summarization.

AI.tldr: 提出ROSUM-MCTS，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索引导LLM，通过结构化探索和强化优化，提升VHDL/Verilog代码摘要质量，在多个数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: LLM在代码摘要方面表现出潜力，但在VHDL和Verilog等硬件描述语言上的有效性尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）引导LLM，通过分层候选扩展机制整合局部与全局上下文，并使用复合奖励函数（平衡功能正确性FC、局部内容充分性LCA和流畅性）优化摘要。
AI.result: 在VHDL-eval和Verilog-eval数据集上一致优于基线方法；消融实验证实局部与全局扩展策略及FC与LCA平衡的必要性；对变量重命名等表面修改具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ROSUM-MCTS是一种有效且鲁棒的HDL摘要框架，为强化学习增强的代码摘要研究奠定了基础。

title: When Does Delegation Beat Majority? A Delegation-Based Aggregator for Multi-Sample LLM Inference
summary: Majority voting over sampled answers is the dominant unsupervised aggregator for multi-sample LLM inference. We show that piping the signals every sample carries into a delegation-based aggregator (Propagational Proxy Voting, PPV) yields an unsupervised consensus rule that beats majority on MMLU-Pro by +1.5 pp overall and +2.24 pp on the non-trivial subset (paired McNemar p ~ 1.0e-14, n = 8,099). Majority discards two free signals every sample carries: within-group letter entropy and between-group reasoning geometry. PPV exposes two per-voter levers that consume exactly these signals: WHEN (how much weight a voter keeps on its own pick) and WHOM (how it splits the remainder across peers). We drive WHEN with letter entropy and WHOM with per-question-centered embedding cosine. The method needs no gold labels and no auxiliary training: per question, we partition 128 sampled generations into 16 groups, compute each group's letter-level semantic entropy and reasoning embedding centroid, and feed both into a stochastic delegation matrix whose stationary distribution selects the consensus answer. We walk through an example in which PPV overturns a clear 10-6 majority for the wrong letter: the 10-voter majority cluster is geometrically incoherent (mean within-cluster cosine -0.02) while the 6-voter minority is tight (+0.26), so propagated delegation mass concentrates on the minority's answer even though entropy alone would keep the majority ahead. We further report delegation strategies with negative results that constrain the design space for unsupervised LLM aggregation: no within-question ensemble of confidence modes closes the oracle gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Propagational Proxy Voting (PPV)的无监督聚合方法，通过利用每个样本携带的组内字母熵和组间推理几何结构两个信号，构建随机委托矩阵来聚合多次LLM采样结果，在MMLU-Pro上比多数投票提升+1.5个百分点，并展示了多数投票失败的具体案例。
AI.motivation: 现有多数投票方法丢弃了每个采样样本携带的两个重要信号：组内字母熵（反映组内置信度）和组间推理几何结构（反映推理空间的一致性），作者希望充分利用这些信号来改进无监督聚合效果。
AI.method: 将128个采样生成分成16组，计算每组字母级语义熵和推理嵌入质心，构建随机委托矩阵：WHOM（将多少权重分配给其他投票者）由嵌入余弦相似度驱动，WHEN（保留多少自身投票权重）由字母熵驱动，通过矩阵的平稳分布选择共识答案。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro上整体比多数投票高+1.5个百分点，在非平凡子集上高+2.24个百分点（配对McNemar检验p≈1.0e-14, n=8,099）。展示了一个案例：PPV推翻了一个明确的10-6多数投票错误结果（多数簇平均余弦-0.02，少数簇+0.26）。
AI.conclusion: PPV比多数投票更有效地聚合了多次LLM采样中的信息，且无需真实标签或辅助训练。同时，实验表明在无监督LLM聚合中，简单的置信度集成方法无法缩小与Oracle的差距。

title: The Last Visible Pixel: Probing Fine-Scale Perception in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) excel at multimodal understanding and reasoning, yet their fine-grained visual perception remains underexplored. A natural extension of ``How many r are there in Strawberry?'' asks: how small a visual pattern can a VLM reliably perceive? As such, we introduce FineSightBench, a new benchmark that systematically probes this limit by separating perception tasks (pixel-level recognition of letters, shapes, objects) from reasoning tasks (spatial reasoning, counting, ordering over small targets) across controlled scales of 4--48px. Through comprehensive experiments and detailed failure mode analysis on state-of-the-art models, we reveal a sharp dissociation: perception saturates around 12px, while reasoning remains limited even at larger scales, with persistent numeracy and sequence errors. These findings expose fundamental deficiencies in VLMs' fine-scale visual reasoning that demand more rigorous evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FineSightBench基准，系统评估了视觉语言模型在细粒度视觉感知（像素级识别）与推理（空间计数、排序）能力上的极限，发现感知能力在12像素左右饱和，而推理能力即使在更大尺度下仍存在明显缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在多模态理解和推理上表现出色，但其细粒度视觉感知能力尚未得到充分探索。作者希望系统性地探究VLM能够可靠感知的最小视觉模式尺寸。
AI.method: 构建FineSightBench基准，在4-48像素的受控尺度下，将感知任务（字母、形状、物体的像素级识别）与推理任务（空间推理、计数、排序）分离，对多个最先进模型进行实验和失败模式分析。
AI.result: 感知能力在12像素左右饱和，而推理能力即使在更大尺度下仍受限，存在持续的计数和序列错误。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了VLM在细粒度视觉推理上存在根本性缺陷，需要进行更严格的评估。

title: Illusions of the Gold Standard: A Large-scale Analysis of Human Evaluation Protocols for Long-form Text Generation
summary: Human evaluation plays a critical role in assessing the quality of generated text. However, the reliability and reproducibility of these evaluations depend on transparent and well-documented protocols -- details that are frequently missing in current practice. In this work, we conduct a large-scale analysis of human evaluation protocols for evaluating long-form generation tasks in *CL conference publications from 2023--2025, including a full manual review of 284 papers and LLM-assisted analysis for another 1.8k+ papers. We define a set of 20 reportable criteria related to reproducibility of human evaluation studies, and apply these criteria to systematically examine reporting norms and practices within the community. We find widespread under-reporting of important aspects of human evaluation study design, leading to ambiguity about what was measured and how, who contributed judgments, and how judgments should be interpreted. Based on these findings, we outline actionable recommendations to support more transparent and reproducible reporting in future research. Our analysis code and annotated dataset can be found at: https://github.com/larchlab/Illusions-of-the-Gold-Standard

AI.tldr: 本文对2023-2025年*CL会议论文中长文本生成任务的人工评估协议进行了大规模分析，发现评估报告普遍缺乏透明性和可重复性，并提出了改进建议。
AI.motivation: 人工评估是评估生成文本质量的关键手段，但当前实践中评估协议的透明性和可重复性严重不足，缺乏系统的报告标准。
AI.method: 定义了20项与可重复性相关的报告标准，对284篇论文进行全手动审查，并利用LLM辅助分析了另外1800+篇论文。
AI.result: 发现人工评估研究设计中重要方面的报告普遍不足，导致评估内容、方式、评判人员及结果解读存在模糊性。
AI.conclusion: 基于发现提出了 actionable 建议，以促进未来研究更透明和可重复的报告实践。

title: PACE: Anytime-Valid Acceptance Tests for Self-Evolving Agents
summary:
Self-evolving agents improve by repeatedly proposing changes to their own prompts, skills, or workflows and keeping those that score higher on a small held-out set. Almost all effort has gone into the proposer that generates candidates; we argue the weak point is the acceptor, the rule that decides whether to commit a change. Applied hundreds of times against the same noisy dev estimate, the ubiquitous "keep it if the score went up" rule is uncontrolled adaptive multiple testing: the agent effectively p-hacks itself, accumulating false commits that make it churn and drift rather than improve.
  We recast committing as a sequential hypothesis test and propose PACE (Paired Anytime-valid Commit Evaluation), a training-free, anytime-valid commit gate. Each candidate is compared to the incumbent on identical instances and committed only when a testing-by-betting e-process accumulates decisive evidence, stopping early to save evaluations and controlling each candidate's false-commit probability at a user-set level even under optional stopping (a per-decision guarantee).
  On Qwen2.5 agents (0.5B-3B) self-evolving at the prompt level on GSM8K, SVAMP, and ARC-Challenge, greedy acceptance commits 30-42% false and 10-33% harmful edits when a genuine improvement is hidden among noisy proposals, while PACE commits the real one and essentially nothing else, matching greedy's held-out accuracy at sharply lower variance and about 18% lower evaluation cost. With no real gain available, greedy commits 13-21 spurious self-modifications per run (72-100% false) and degrades the most fragile agent by 4.9 points, while PACE holds at baseline. Reliability of self-evolution depends on the acceptor, not only on the proposer.

AI.tldr: 论文指出自我进化智能体容易因"贪心接受"规则导致虚假提交和性能漂移，提出基于顺序假设检验的PACE方法，在控制假阳性率的同时降低评估成本，实验证明PACE能有效甄别真实改进并防止性能退化。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化智能体在迭代改进时，使用"分数提高就保留"的简单规则，这本质上是未加控制的自适应多重检验，导致智能体不断积累虚假修改（p-hacking），产生漂移而非真正改进。
AI.method: 将提交过程重新定义为顺序假设检验，提出PACE（成对任意有效提交评估）方法。基于"测试-下注"的e-process，在相同实例上比较候选方案与当前方案，仅在累积到决定性证据时才提交，支持早期停止以节省评估次数，并严格控制在用户设定的假阳性概率水平下。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5智能体（0.5B-3B）的提示级别自我进化实验中，贪心接受引入30-42%虚假修改和10-33%有害编辑，而PACE几乎只提交真正的改进；无可改进时贪心每个运行提交13-21次虚假修改（72-100%虚假），使脆弱智能体性能下降4.9分，PACE则保持基线水平。PACE还降低了约18%的评估成本。
AI.conclusion: 自我进化的可靠性不仅取决于提案生成器，更取决于接受器。PACE方法在没有额外训练的情况下，通过严格的统计检验机制有效解决了虚假提交问题，为智能体安全自我进化提供了关键保障。

title: VisualFLIP: Do Predictions Depend on Task-Critical Visual Evidence in Multimodal Reasoning?
summary: When a multimodal large language model answers a visual reasoning question correctly, is the prediction actually supported by the task-critical visual evidence? Correct answers can coexist with flawed reasoning, making accuracy alone an incomplete test of grounding. We introduce VisualFLIP, a paired benchmark with 1,374 images arranged as same-question perturbation pairs across cardinality, attribute, spatial, and logic tasks. Each pair keeps the question fixed but minimally changes the evidence so the gold answer deterministically flips. We evaluate 24 MLLMs with pair accuracy, which requires solving both sides of a pair, and Collapse Rate (CR), which measures how often a model that solves at least one side repeats the same non-empty answer for both images. Together, these metrics show that paired correctness and evidence dependence are related but distinct: capable models can still fail to update after task-critical visual changes, and collapse becomes more severe for some models when the edited image follows an earlier answer in a sequential setting. Further details are available on our project page: https://didizhu-judy.github.io/VisualFLIP/

AI.tldr: VisualFLIP是一个通过成对图像扰动（仅改变关键视觉证据，答案随之翻转）来测试多模态大模型是否真正基于视觉证据推理的基准。研究发现，模型正确率与视觉归因能力存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型虽然在视觉推理任务上准确率可观，但正确回答可能源自错误推理或捷径学习，而非真正依赖视觉证据。现有评估方法仅关注答案正确性，无法检测模型是否看到了"应该看的"视觉信息。
AI.method: 构建包含1,374张图像的VisualFLIP基准，图像以"相同问题+最小视觉扰动"组成成对样本（扰动涉及基数、属性、空间和逻辑四种任务类型）。提出两个评估指标：Pair Accuracy（成对两题均答对）和Collapse Rate（CR，在至少答对一侧时，对两张不同图像输出相同非空答案的频率）。
AI.result: 对24个多模态大模型的评估显示，成对正确率与证据依赖性虽然相关但本质不同：高能力模型在关键视觉证据改变后仍可能无法更新答案；在顺序推理场景中，若后出现的图像紧随已回答的图像，崩溃现象更加严重。
AI.conclusion: 仅仅依赖准确率无法衡量模型是否真正"看到了"视觉证据，VisualFLIP揭示了准确率与视觉归因之间的鸿沟，为多模态模型评估提供了新的视角和工具。

title: Think Before You Act: Intention-Guided Reasoning for LLM-Based Location Prediction
summary: Predicting a user's next Point-of-Interest (POI) based on their historical check-in records is a fundamental task in location-based services. While recent methods incorporating large language models have shown strong reasoning capabilities and promising results, they typically formulate the prediction task as a one-step trajectory-to-location mapping problem, making predictions prone to shallow trajectory correlations and historical frequency bias. We argue that users rarely choose locations directly and instead, they usually first form a traveling intention and then accordingly select specific POIs. Motivated by this insight, we propose IntentPOI, a two-stage intention-guided reasoning framework. In the thinking stage, we infer users' intermediate intentions by incorporating historical mobility patterns, similar peer behaviors, and the temporal contexts. In the acting stage, we first construct a compact candidate pool, and then perform intention-guided reasoning to identify locations that best align with the inferred intention. By explicitly decoupling intention inference from location prediction, IntentPOI transforms the next POI prediction from direct trajectory matching into intention-guided reasoning. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that IntentPOI consistently outperforms eleven state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IntentPOI，一种两阶段意图引导推理框架，将下一POI预测从直接轨迹匹配转变为意图推理，在三个数据集上优于11个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的方法将下一POI预测视为一步轨迹到位置的映射，容易受浅层轨迹相关性和历史频率偏差影响。然而用户通常先形成出行意图再选择POI，因此需要将意图推理显式引入预测过程。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：1）思考阶段：融合历史移动模式、相似用户行为和时空上下文推断用户中间意图；2）行动阶段：构建紧凑候选池，执行意图引导推理选出与意图最匹配的POI。将意图推理与位置预测显式解耦。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，IntentPOI一致优于11个最先进基线方法，验证了意图引导推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦意图推理与位置预测，将下一POI预测从直接轨迹匹配转化为意图引导推理，有效缓解了浅层轨迹相关性和频率偏差问题，提升了预测性能。

title: What Does Debiasing Really Remove? A Geometric Study of PCA-Based Gender Debiasing in Word Embeddings
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Source code available at https://github.com/AlexeyKresin/embedding-bias-geometry
summary: Debiasing methods based on principal component analysis (PCA) are broadly used to reduce gender bias in word embeddings used in LLMs, yet it remains unclear what aspects of bias they actually remove and how destructive this process is. These methods are based on the understanding that bias resides in a low-dimensional subspace, with the assumption that most of it can be captured by a few principal components. In this work, we conduct a systematic geometric analysis of PCA-based gender debiasing and investigate what is actually removed from the embedding space. Our experiments across multiple embeddings show that direct gender bias is primarily concentrated in the first principal component, supporting the low-rank bias hypothesis. However, associative bias measured by WEAT does not align with these principal directions and is instead spread across multiple embedding dimensions. Furthermore, as expected, we demonstrate that removing an increasing number of principal components leads to a consistent degradation of the embedding geometry, affecting semantic structure and vector relationships. These results reveal that PCA-based debiasing operates as a trade-off: while it effectively reduces certain forms of direct bias, it fails to eliminate distributed associations and introduces geometric distortion. Moreover, there is no universal optimal level of debiasing, as the balance between bias reduction and semantic preservation depends on the chosen metric and embedding. Overall, our findings suggest that bias in word embeddings is not purely low-rank and that simple subspace removal methods may be insufficient for comprehensive debiasing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了基于PCA的词嵌入性别去偏方法，发现直接性别偏差主要集中于第一主成分（支持低秩假设），但关联性偏差（如WEAT）分散在多维度中；同时去除主成分会破坏嵌入几何结构，导致去偏与语义保留之间存在权衡，且无通用最优解。
AI.motivation: 现有基于PCA的去偏方法虽被广泛使用，但其实际去除的偏差类型及对嵌入空间的破坏程度尚不明确，需要系统性几何分析来揭示其内在机制。
AI.method: 对多种词嵌入进行系统性几何分析，考察PCA去偏方法移除不同数量主成分后，直接性别偏差、关联性偏差（WEAT）以及嵌入几何结构的变化。
AI.result: 直接性别偏差主要集中于第一主成分；关联性偏差分散于多个维度；去除更多主成分会导致嵌入几何结构持续退化，影响语义结构和向量关系。
AI.conclusion: PCA去偏存在权衡：能有效减少某些直接偏差，但无法消除分布式关联偏差且引入几何失真；偏差并非纯粹低秩结构，简单子空间去除方法不足以实现全面去偏。

title: Cross-LLM Consistency in Inference: Evidence from Shared Interactions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) differ in architecture, training data, and optimization procedures, yet they may still develop similar internal inference patterns. In this paper, we examine this hypothesis using interaction-based explanations. We find that LLMs often share interaction patterns when predicting the same target token from the same prompt. This consistency is more pronounced among advanced LLMs. Shared interactions also tend to be lower-order and show weaker positive-negative cancellation than non-shared interactions. These results suggest that advanced LLMs may be implicitly optimized toward common inference patterns, even though the mechanisms that give rise to such cross-model consistency remain open.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）虽然在架构、训练数据和优化方法上不同，但在预测相同目标token时会共享相似的交互模式，尤其是先进模型更明显，这些共享交互通常是低阶的且正负抵消较弱。
AI.motivation: 探索不同LLM是否在内部推理模式上存在相似性，即使它们在架构、数据和优化上各不相同。
AI.method: 使用基于交互的解释（interaction-based explanations）方法，分析不同LLM在相同提示下预测相同目标token时的交互模式。
AI.result: LLM经常共享交互模式，先进模型中这种一致性更明显；共享交互往往是低阶的，且正负抵消比非共享交互更弱。
AI.conclusion: 先进LLM可能被隐式优化趋向于共同的推理模式，但产生这种跨模型一致性的机制仍不清楚。

title: C3VD-DEFCOL: A Deformable Colonoscopy Dataset with Time-Resolved 3D Ground Truth and Realistic Appearance
summary: 3D reconstruction could improve colonoscopy by estimating mucosal coverage and alerting clinicians to missed regions during screening. However, algorithm development is limited as no current datasets provide both a realistic in vivo appearance and dense, time-resolved 3D ground truth, especially under non-rigid deformation. We present C3VD-DEFCOL, a framework and dataset for evaluating deformable colonoscopy reconstruction with paired geometry and realistic texture. Starting from C3VD/C3VDv2 colon meshes and camera trajectories, we generate controlled deformations of the colon surface, including peristaltic waves and centerline motion, and render per-frame depth, surface normals, optical flow, camera poses, and time-stamped 3D meshes. We then use the rendered geometry, primarily depth, to condition an LTX-2.3-based sim-to-real translation model that produces RGB clips with in vivo-like mucosal color, texture, vasculature, and specular appearance while preserving the underlying 3D scene structure. The resulting dataset contains 110 videos from 11 unique colon mesh geometries, with varying camera trajectories, appearances, and parameterized deformation regimes, including three peristaltic severity levels that serve as controlled evaluation axes. We evaluate the generated videos using appearance realism, geometric consistency, and temporal consistency metrics, and use the paired ground truth to benchmark the downstream task of pose estimation in deformable 3D reconstruction. Our experiments show how pose estimation error increases with increasing deformation severity, providing a controlled stress test that is not possible with existing in vivo datasets. Overall, C3VD-DEFCOL is designed as a reproducible, quantitative evaluation platform for testing deformable 3D reconstruction algorithms, with the goal of reducing the domain gap between synthetic datasets and in vivo colonoscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了C3VD-DEFCOL，一个用于评估可变形结肠镜3D重建的框架和数据集，包含带有真实纹理和几何信息的110个视频，通过可控的结肠变形（包括蠕动波和中心线运动）和sim-to-real翻译生成，可用于测试在变形条件下的重建算法性能。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏同时具备真实体内外观和密集时间分辨3D地面真值的数据集，特别是在非刚性变形条件下，这限制了结肠镜3D重建算法的发展。
AI.method: 基于C3VD/C3VDv2结肠网格和相机轨迹，生成可控的结肠表面变形（蠕动波和中心线运动），渲染每帧深度、法线、光流等几何信息，然后利用LTX-2.3-based sim-to-real翻译模型生成具有体内黏膜外观的RGB视频。
AI.result: 生成了110个视频，涵盖11种结肠网格几何、不同相机轨迹和三种蠕动严重程度等级；实验表明位姿估计误差随变形程度增加而增加，提供了现有体内数据集无法实现的可控压力测试。
AI.conclusion: C3VD-DEFCOL作为可重复的定量评估平台，用于测试可变形3D重建算法，旨在缩小合成数据集与体内结肠镜之间的领域差距。

title: Neutrality Bites: Gender Representation in AI-Generated Animal Stories
comment: FAccT(ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency) 2026
summary: Gender bias in AI-generated stories is a well-documented problem. While much attention has been paid to reducing or mitigating this bias, it is not always clear whether interventions produce genuinely fairer results. To investigate this issue, we examine how large language models (LLMs) handle gender assignment in a narrative context that is popular, highly ambiguous, and also known to closely reproduce human stereotypes: stories about talking animals. We prompt six leading LLMs to complete an English-language story about seven different anthropomorphic animal characters whose gender is unstated. We additionally iterate with four different narrative settings and a range of model temperatures. Across the 23.8K stories, we find that models frequently avoid gendering the animal character in the story (19% on average) or use gender-neutral language like "it" or "its" (38.2% on average). However, when gender is assigned, there is a significant masculine bias. Feminine animal characters are virtually absent, present in just 2.2% of stories vs. 40.6% that feature masculine characters. Our findings point to a broader argument: neutrality bites. In other words, models that prioritize neutrality to address social bias may actually contribute to the erasure of marginalized perspectives and identities. We suggest that alternative strategies beyond neutrality need to be pursued, such as ones that more equally distribute social possibilities across imagined subjects.

AI.tldr: LLM在生成拟人化动物故事时，虽频繁使用中性语言避免性别指代，但一旦明确性别则存在显著男性偏向（40.6% vs 2.2%），导致女性角色近乎消失；作者指出“中性即偏误”——追求中性策略反而抹除了边缘化视角，主张采用更均衡分配社会可能性的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注如何减少或缓解AI生成故事中的性别偏见，但较少评估干预措施是否真正带来了公平结果；本文希望探究LLM在高度模糊且易复现人类刻板印象的叙事语境（会说话的动物）中如何处理性别分配。
AI.method: 对6个主流LLM进行提示，要求完成关于7种拟人化动物角色的英语故事（性别未指定），在4种不同叙事设定和多种模型温度下迭代，共生成23.8K个故事，统计角色性别指代情况。
AI.result: 19%的故事避免性别指代，38.2%使用中性语言；但明确性别时，40.6%的故事出现男性角色，仅2.2%出现女性角色，女性角色几乎缺席。
AI.conclusion: 追求中性的去偏策略可能适得其反，造成边缘化视角和身份的抹除；应探索更均衡分配社会可能性的替代方案，而非单纯强调中性。

title: TBD-VLA: Temporal Block Diffusion Vision Language Action Model
summary: Discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically formulate action generation as next-token prediction over discretized action spaces, conditioning each token autoregressively on prior context. While effective, this paradigm incurs high inference latency and largely ignores the temporal structure inherent in action trajectories. Recent efforts introduce parallel decoding to improve efficiency, enabling faster inference, but lack explicit mechanisms for modeling token dependencies. We introduce TBD-VLA, a discrete token-based VLA framework that incorporates block diffusion to enable temporal action generation. We partition action sequences into temporal blocks and perform masked discrete diffusion within each block, while maintaining autoregressive generation across blocks. This design unifies temporal autoregression and parallel action decoding, achieving both strong temporal coherence and improved inference speed. In addition, the explicit temporal modeling enables asynchronous execution of action chunks (e.g., Real-Time Chunking) via temporal in-painting. TBD-VLA significantly outperforms prior VLA approaches in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, offering a scalable path toward fast, temporally aware, discrete VLA models. Project webpage: https://tbd-vla.github.io/

AI.tldr: TBD-VLA提出了一种结合块扩散与自回归机制的离散VLA框架，通过时序块划分和掩码扩散实现并行动作解码与时间一致性，显著提升推理速度与任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有离散VLA模型将动作生成视为自回归的下一token预测，导致推理延迟高且忽略了动作轨迹中的时间结构；尽管并行解码提升了效率，但缺乏对token间依赖关系的显式建模。
AI.method: 将动作序列划分为时序块，在块内进行掩码离散扩散（并行生成），块间保持自回归生成；利用时序显式建模实现异步执行（如实时分块的时间修补）。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务中，TBD-VLA显著优于现有VLA方法，实现强时间一致性与更快推理速度。
AI.conclusion: TBD-VLA为离散VLA模型提供了一条可扩展的路径，兼顾快速推理与时间感知能力。

title: Defending Against Malicious Finetuning by Scaling Train-time Adversarial Attacks
summary: Current open-weight large language models (LLMs) are prone to malicious finetuning attacks, which could compromise the safety alignment of LLMs with only a few steps of supervised finetuning (SFT) on poisoned datasets. Existing alignment-stage defenses are primarily designed to defend against attacks that use parameter-efficient finetuning methods. However, they fail to defend against stronger attacks that use full-parameter finetuning. In this paper, we propose Patcher, a method inspired by adversarial training and bi-level optimization, to combat such attacks. Patcher strengthens the simulated attack by scaling up the optimization steps in the adversarial loop, thus forcing the defender to find model parameters that are insensitive to stronger attacks. Furthermore, we propose an efficient parallel algorithm to implement Patcher, decreasing the wall-clock time of training while preserving Patcher's performance. Extensive experiments show that Patcher substantially improves the model's robustness compared to vanilla SFT alignment, and transfers to diverse attack scenarios and model sizes. Code is available at https://github.com/haomingwen/patcher.

AI.tldr: 提出Patcher方法，通过对抗训练和双层优化防御针对开源大语言模型的全参数微调攻击，能显著提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐防御主要针对参数高效微调攻击，无法抵御更强的全参数微调攻击，需要更鲁棒的防御方法。
AI.method: 受对抗训练和双层优化启发，在对抗循环中增加优化步数来模拟更强的攻击，迫使模型找到对强攻击不敏感的参数；并提出高效并行算法加速训练。
AI.result: 相比标准SFT对齐，Patcher显著提升了模型鲁棒性，并能迁移到不同攻击场景和模型规模。
AI.conclusion: Patcher有效防御了全参数微调攻击，具备良好的泛化能力，代码已开源。

title: Decision-Aware Memory Cards: Counterfactual-Inspired Context Selection and Compression for Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/stephen-guan-researcher/CICL; Qwen-QLoRA adapter is available at https://huggingface.co/XinyuGuan/CICL
summary: Tool-using LLM agents often fail not because relevant text is absent, but because decisive evidence is not selected, compressed, or surfaced at action time. We present CICL, a decision-aware context layer that turns instance evidence into a context graph, routes deterministic, Opus-assisted, Qwen, Codex/GPT-5.5, and Qwen-QLoRA judgments through a shared eight-field schema, scores units by action shift, outcome uplift, necessity, and negative-transfer risk, and packs high-utility evidence as typed memory cards for a budgeted agent. The design separates the measured decision signal from the judge model, so frontier annotation, local surrogates, and lightweight rankers can be compared under one auditable protocol. Empirically, CICL yields a concrete open-benchmark gain while exposing its limits. On 50 SWE-bench Verified file-retrieval instances, direct Qwen3.6-plus reranking of BM25 top-50 candidates raises hit@1 from 0.58 to 0.78 and MRR@10 from 0.634 to 0.790, with all 2,500 judgments parseable. Controlled diagnostics show action-criticality: at budget 120, CICL reaches F1 0.620 on v1 and 0.425 on v3, and removing the top-utility semantic v3 unit collapses F1 to 0.000. Supplementary checks add Qwen-QLoRA agreement over 710 candidates, a small 200-label real-code Opus-assisted signal, and a three-instance patch smoke validating retrieval-to-patch plumbing without claiming official SWE-bench success. RepoBench-R summaries still beat cards, and compact rankers do not yet replace the heuristic. CICL contributes a reproducible measurement and selection layer for decision-critical context, not an end-to-end coding-agent repair claim.

AI.tldr: CICL 是一个决策感知的上下文层，通过构建上下文图、结构化评分和类型化记忆卡，提升 LLM 智能体在决策关键场景中选择证据的能力，实验显示在 SWE-bench 等任务上有明显收益但仍有局限。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在工具使用中失败的原因往往不是缺乏相关文本，而是在行动时刻未能选择、压缩或突出决定性证据，现有方法缺乏对决策关键信息的可度量、可审计的选择机制。
AI.method: CICL 将实例证据转化为上下文图，通过八字段模式路由多种判断（Opus、Qwen、Codex/GPT-5.5、Qwen-QLoRA），按行动偏移、结果提升、必要性和负迁移风险评分，将高效用证据打包为类型化记忆卡供预算有限的智能体使用。
AI.result: 在50个SWE-bench文件检索实例上，Qwen3.6-plus重排序将 hit@1 从0.58提升至0.78，MRR@10从0.634提升至0.790；在预算120下，CICL在v1上F1达0.620，v3上0.425，移除最高效用单元后F1降至0.000；QLoRA一致性、小规模真实代码信号和三实例烟雾测试验证了管道的可行性。
AI.conclusion: CICL 提供了一个可复现的测量和选择层用于决策关键上下文，而非端到端的编码智能体修复方案；仍存在 RepoBench-R 摘要优于记忆卡、紧凑型排序器无法替代启发式方法等局限。

title: MechLens: Late Crystallization of Factual Knowledge Explains Intervention Effectiveness in Language Models
summary:
Understanding where LLMs store factual knowledge is critical for hallucination mitigation. We systematically quantify Late Crystallization: factual knowledge does not gradually emerge across layers but "crystallizes" abruptly at the final layers. Across five model families (Pythia, Gemma, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, Mistral; 0.5--14B), 26.8%--93.4% of correct answers never enter top-10 predictions at any intermediate layer, with late emergence (>80% depth) consistent across architectures. Cross-scale (Qwen2.5-14B) and cross-benchmark (MMLU: 98.2%) results confirm generality; tuned lens rules out probe artifacts. A sentiment-classification control (0.5% for Qwen vs. 85.9% factual; 2.0% for Mistral vs. 26.8%) confirms the phenomenon is specific to factual recall.
  Late Crystallization yields a crystallization-guided intervention principle: CAA outperforms DoLa on moderate-crystallization models (Llama, Mistral; p<0.001), with a directionally consistent reversal on high-crystallization Qwen (+25.4% vs. +15.5% MC1, p=0.069). LayerNorm ablation shows crystallization is intrinsic to the residual stream; LN scaling (x1.2) yields +11.8% MC1 with zero inference overhead. We further reveal a Computability-Memorization Spectrum: computable knowledge crystallizes earlier (layer 22.1/28) than memorized facts (28.0/28). We release MechLens supporting five model families.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型中的事实知识并非逐层逐渐涌现，而是在最后几层突然“结晶”。在不同模型家族中，26.8%-93.4%的正确回答在中间层从未进入前10预测。基于此现象提出结晶引导的干预原则，并揭示了可计算知识与记忆知识的分离现象。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM中事实知识的具体存储位置和涌现方式，对于缓解幻觉问题至关重要。现有研究对知识在层间如何逐步形成缺乏系统性认识。
AI.method: 在五个模型家族（Pythia、Gemma、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、Mistral，0.5-14B规模）上系统量化知识涌现位置，使用调节透镜剔除探测伪影，通过情感分类控制实验验证现象特异性，并设计结晶引导的干预原则（CAA）和LayerNorm缩放方法。
AI.result: 26.8%-93.4%的正确回答在中间层从未进入前10预测；知识在>80%深度处才涌现。CAA在中等结晶模型上优于DoLa（p<0.001）；LayerNorm缩放（x1.2）带来+11.8% MC1提升且零推理开销。可计算知识（第22.1/28层）比记忆知识（第28.0/28层）更早结晶。
AI.conclusion: 事实知识存在晚期结晶现象，具有跨模型和跨基准的普适性。基于此可设计有效的干预策略，并揭示了计算-记忆谱系，为理解LLM内部知识表征和缓解幻觉提供了新视角。

title: Online Agent-as-a-Judge: Situation-Generating Evaluation for Interactive Agents
comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good
summary: Evaluating LLM-powered interactive social agents is challenging because socially relevant behaviors depend not only on isolated outputs, but also on prior interactions, social roles, and downstream actions. Existing methods typically allow a target agent to act freely in an environment and then score the resulting trajectory. However, this passive setup can miss capabilities that only become observable under specific social circumstances; for example, conflict handling may remain untested if no disagreement arises. We propose Online Agent-as-a-Judge, a situation-generating evaluation framework for interactive social agents. Online Agent-as-a-Judge deploys an in-world evaluator agent that interacts with the target agent through the environment's native dialogue and action protocol, actively eliciting situations relevant to the evaluation criteria. The resulting trajectories provide evidence for assessing both immediate responses and subsequent behavior. In a life-simulation environment with $32$ designer-authored social criteria, Online Agent-as-a-Judge improves criteria coverage and agreement with human labels, yielding more reliable evidence-grounded evaluations of behaviors that passive methods can leave unobserved.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为"在线智能体即裁判"（Online Agent-as-a-Judge）的评估框架，通过部署一个在环境中的评估智能体主动与被测智能体互动，生成特定社交情境来评估其社交能力，相比被动观察方法能更好地覆盖评估标准和匹配人类判断。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估方法让智能体在环境中自由行动后评分，但这种方式会遗漏那些仅在特定社交情境下才展现的能力（如冲突处理），需要一种能主动生成评估情境的方法。
AI.method: 部署一个在环境内的评估智能体（in-world evaluator agent），通过与目标智能体进行环境原生的对话和行动交互，主动诱发与评估标准相关的社交情境，然后基于生成的交互轨迹进行评估。
AI.result: 在包含32个社交评估标准的生命模拟环境中，该方法相比被动方法提高了评估标准覆盖率以及与人类标签的一致性，能获得更可靠的基于证据的行为评估。
AI.conclusion: 主动生成情境的评估框架能捕捉到被动方法遗漏的行为，提供更全面的社交智能体评估。

title: Decoupling Semantics and Logic: A Training-Free Coarse-to-Fine Pipeline for Video Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: To be presented at ACL 2026 MAGMAR Workshop (Oral; Retrieval leaderboard No.1)
summary: This paper presents our system description for the 2nd Workshop on Multimodal Augmented Generation via MultimodAl Retrieval (MAGMaR). Addressing the critical challenges of cross-lingual long-video comprehension, strict persona adherence, and zero-hallucination temporal grounding, we propose a fully training-free, two-stage cascaded Video RAG pipeline. Our architecture strategically decouples semantic retrieval from cognitive logical reasoning through a modality-aware division of labor. In the first stage, a high-recall semantic pre-fetching module employs dense retrieval using only high-fidelity visual summaries and global text descriptions, explicitly isolating noisy modalities (e.g., OCR and ASR) to maintain a pristine vector space. In the second stage, an Adaptive, Iterative, and Reasoning-based (A.I.R.) filtering agent, powered by a commercial Large Language Model (LLM), performs fine-grained cognitive reranking. The agent re-incorporates full multimodal contexts to enforce strict logical alignment with user personas, effectively pruning semantically similar but logically irrelevant candidates. Finally, a Prompt Sculpting mechanism constrains the generator to synthesize the distilled subset into strictly formatted JSON responses with exact chunk-level citations. Evaluated on the RAG track, our resource-aware approach shows exceptional precision in both information retrieval and persona-conditioned generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的两阶段级联视频RAG流水线，通过解耦语义检索与认知推理，结合高召回语义预取模块和自适应迭代推理过滤代理，有效解决了跨语言长视频理解、严格角色遵循和零幻觉时间定位等挑战。
AI.motivation: 解决跨语言长视频理解、严格角色遵循和零幻觉时间定位等关键挑战，现有方法在处理多模态检索增强生成时存在检索噪声大、逻辑推理能力不足等问题。
AI.method: 提出全无训练的两阶段级联视频RAG流水线：第一阶段使用基于高保真视觉摘要和全局文本描述的密集检索进行高召回语义预取，隔离OCR/ASR等噪声模态；第二阶段采用A.I.R.过滤代理（基于商用LLM）进行细粒度认知重排序，引入完整多模态上下文以强制执行与用户角色的逻辑对齐；最后通过提示塑形机制生成带精确块级引用的JSON格式响应。
AI.result: 在RAG赛道评估中，该方法在信息检索和角色条件生成方面均展现出卓越的精度。
AI.conclusion: 该资源感知的方法在跨语言视频理解和角色遵循任务中表现优异，验证了无需训练的两阶段级联架构的有效性。

title: SciTrace: Trajectory-Aware Safety Reasoning for Scientific Discovery Agents
summary: LLM-based scientific agents have shown strong capacity for autonomous research, yet their safety layers remain structurally divorced from core reasoning: they inspect pipeline outputs rather than shaping the deliberation that produces them. This separation opens two failure modes: safety signals accumulated at one stage are discarded before the next, and sequences of individually benign tool calls can compose into harmful outcomes that no single-step filter detects. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{SciTrace}, a framework that weaves safety reasoning into every stage of the scientific agent pipeline. SciTrace couples two complementary mechanisms: a \textit{Safety-Intrinsic Reasoning Loop} (SIR) that maintains a cumulative risk state across the Thinker, Experimenter, Writer, and Reviewer stages through joint task-and-safety deliberation, and a \textit{Compositional Tool-Chain Verifier} (CTV) that performs trajectory-aware safety checks before execution, catching risks that surface only across multi-step tool sequences. Evaluated on 240 high-risk research tasks and 120 tool-related risk tasks spanning six scientific domains, SciTrace achieves state-of-the-art (\textbf{SOTA}) safety among compared frameworks across four backbone models: it consistently improves tool call safety and adversarial robustness while preserving scientific output quality, and it uncovers \textbf{78.8\%} of the compositional tool-chain escapes that single-step monitors miss. The project website is available at https://opensciagent.github.io/SciTrace/.

AI.tldr: SciTrace是一个将安全推理融入科学智能体全流程的框架，通过安全内在推理循环（SIR）和组合工具链验证器（CTV）两种机制，在240项高风险研究任务和120项工具相关风险任务中实现了最先进的安全性，能发现78.8%的单步监测遗漏的组合工具链风险。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM科学智能体的安全层与核心推理在结构上分离，导致两个问题：安全信号在阶段间丢失，以及单步检测无法发现多步工具调用的组合性危害。
AI.method: 提出了SciTrace框架，包含两个互补机制：1) 安全内在推理循环（SIR），在思考者、实验者、写作者和评审者各阶段维护累积风险状态进行联合任务与安全推理；2) 组合工具链验证器（CTV），在执行前进行轨迹感知的安全检查，捕捉跨多步工具序列的风险。
AI.result: 在240项高风险研究任务和120项工具相关风险任务上，跨越六个科学领域和四个骨干模型，SciTrace实现了最先进的安全性，显著提升了工具调用安全性和对抗鲁棒性，同时保持了科学输出质量，并能发现78.8%的单步监测遗漏的组合工具链风险。
AI.conclusion: 将安全推理内置于科学智能体的每个推理阶段，而非作为事后检查，能够有效防范单步和多步组合性风险，是构建安全自主科研智能体的可行方向。

title: LEGS: Laplacian-Enhanced Gaussian Splatting with a Nonlinear Weighted Loss
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become an efficient explicit representation for radiance field reconstruction and real-time novel view synthesis. However, its standard photometric loss treats flat and structure-rich regions similarly, which may limit the recovery of sharp contours and fine details. Edge-Guided Gaussian Splatting (EGGS) improves structure awareness through edge-guided weighting, but mainly relies on first-order gradient responses and linear weighting. In this paper, we propose LEGS, a Laplacian-Enhanced Gaussian Splatting method with a nonlinearly weighted loss. LEGS replaces first-order gradient guidance with second-order Laplacian structural guidance and maps the normalized Laplacian response into pixel-wise weights through nonlinear response-to-weight functions. The proposed loss improves structure-aware Gaussian optimization while keeping the original 3DGS rendering pipeline unchanged. Experiments on the full Tanks\&Temples and Mip-NeRF360 datasets show that LEGS improves peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by up to 1.68 dB over 3DGS and up to 0.52 dB over EGGS. Incorporating the proposed second-order nonlinear weighting strategy into FastGS and FasterGS further improves PSNR by up to 1.69 dB, demonstrating its effectiveness as a general loss-level extension for Gaussian Splatting pipelines with potential applications in AR/VR, immersive visualization, and real-time 3D content generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEGS，一种基于拉普拉斯增强的高斯溅射方法，通过二阶非线性加权损失替代传统一阶梯度引导，在不改变渲染管线的情况下提升结构感知能力，在多个数据集上PSNR提升最高达1.69 dB。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS方法对平坦区域和结构丰富区域采用同样的光度损失，导致锐利轮廓和细节恢复受限；EGGS虽引入边缘引导，但仍依赖一阶梯度响应和线性加权，结构感知能力有限。
AI.method: 将一阶梯度引导替换为二阶拉普拉斯结构引导，通过非线性响应-权重映射函数将归一化拉普拉斯响应转换为逐像素权重，构建非线性加权损失函数，保持原始渲染管线不变。
AI.result: 在Tanks&Temples和Mip-NeRF360数据集上，LEGS相比3DGS PSNR提升最高1.68 dB，相比EGGS提升最高0.52 dB；将策略集成到FastGS和FasterGS后，PSNR提升最高1.69 dB。
AI.conclusion: 提出的二阶非线性加权策略可作为一种通用损失级扩展，有效提升多种高斯溅射管线的结构感知能力，在AR/VR、沉浸式可视化和实时3D内容生成中具有应用潜力。

title: MC-PDD: Masked Corpus-Level Pretraining Data Detection for Black-Box Large Language Models
comment: The manuscript consists of 10 pages formatted in the IEEE/ACM two-column style
summary: Pretraining is fundamental to the development of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the opacity of pretraining data complicates model analysis and raises ethical, legal, and fairness concerns. Detecting whether specific datasets were used during pretraining is, therefore, critical. Existing state-of-the-art methods typically rely on access to model probability distributions, making them unsuitable for closed-source LLMs that provide only input-output interfaces. To address this limitation, we introduce Masked Corpus-level Pretraining Data Detection (MC-PDD), a novel method inspired by the masked language modeling paradigm. MC-PDD masks highly specific tokens in each text and prompts the LLM to predict the missing content. It then assesses whether the difference in prediction hit rates between a candidate corpus and a reference non-member corpus is statistically significant. Based on this comparison, MC-PDD determines whether the candidate texts were likely included in the model's pretraining data. Experimental results demonstrate clear and consistent differences in prediction hit rates between pretrained and unseen data across three datasets, for both open-source and closed-source LLMs. Despite operating under a stricter black-box setting, MC-PDD achieves performance comparable to existing detection methods. Our approach enables practical applications such as model auditing and data copyright verification using only standard API access. Upon acceptance, we will publicly release the code and datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MC-PDD方法，通过掩码预测和统计检验，在仅提供API访问的黑盒条件下检测LLM预训练数据是否包含特定语料，效果与白盒方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练数据检测方法依赖模型概率分布，不适用于仅提供输入-输出接口的闭源LLM，因此需要一种可在黑盒条件下工作的检测方法。
AI.method: MC-PDD方法先对文本中高度特定的token进行掩码，然后让LLM预测缺失内容；通过比较候选语料与参考非成员语料之间的预测命中率差异是否具有统计显著性，来判断候选文本是否属于预训练数据。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，无论是开源还是闭源LLM，预训练数据与未见数据的预测命中率均呈现明显且一致的差异；MC-PDD在更严格的黑盒设置下达到了与现有检测方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: MC-PDD仅需标准API访问即可实现模型审计和数据版权验证等实际应用，且代码和数据集将公开发布。

title: When No Answer Is Correct: Diagnosing Absent Answer Detection for MLLMs in Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial advancements in video understanding, yet the reliability of their responses remains underexplored. This work presents a diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, where the correct answer is deliberately excluded from the candidate set and a reliable model is expected to recognize that no valid option exists. We evaluate the absent answer detection behavior under three settings: multiple-choice questions augmented with an ``None of the Above'' option, open-ended generation with a detection instruction, and standard evaluation without any guidance. Across a diverse set of models and benchmarks, we find that MLLMs overwhelmingly select plausible distractors rather than detecting the absent answer. This failure is more pronounced in temporal reasoning tasks and worsens with denser frame sampling. We further explore chain-of-thought prompting as a mitigation strategy and find that while it substantially improves detection rates, performance remains unsatisfactory, suggesting that prompting-based strategies alone are insufficient to fully address this limitation. These findings expose a systematic failure in absent answer detection and highlight the need for explicit detection mechanisms in multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型在视频理解中检测“答案缺失”的能力，发现模型普遍倾向于选择干扰项而非识别无正确答案，尤其在时间推理任务和密集帧采样下表现更差，链式思维提示虽有改善但效果仍不理想。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但其回答的可靠性尚未得到充分探索。本文旨在诊断模型在正确答案被故意排除时，能否识别出“无有效选项”的情况。
AI.method: 在三种设置下评估：包含“以上皆非”选项的多选题、带检测指令的开放生成、无任何引导的标准评估。使用多种模型和基准，并探索链式思维提示作为缓解策略。
AI.result: 模型普遍选择有迷惑性的干扰项而非检测到答案缺失；时间推理任务和更密集的帧采样下问题更严重；链式思维提示虽提升检测率但仍不令人满意。
AI.conclusion: 暴露了多模态系统在缺失答案检测方面的系统性失败，强调了需要明确的检测机制，仅靠提示策略不足以解决该问题。

title: REACT 2026: The Fourth Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation Challenge: Personalised MAFRG and Appropriate EEG Reaction Prediction
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2505.17223
summary: In dyadic interactions, various human facial reactions could be appropriate for responding to each human speaker behaviour. Following the successful organisation of the REACT 2023, 2024 and 2025 challenge series, a body of generative deep learning (DL) models have been developed for the problem of multiple appropriate facial reaction generation (MAFRG). This year, we propose the REACT 2026 challenge encouraging the development and benchmarking of Machine Learning (ML) models that can generate multiple personalised, appropriate, diverse, realistic and synchronised human-style facial reactions expressed by a specific human listener for responding to each given speaker behaviour. As a key of the challenge, we continuously provide challenge participants with MARS dataset introduced by REACT 2025 but additionally provide individual-level Big-Five personality labels and EEG recordings. This introduces a new one-to-many personalised facial reaction generation setting combining human expressive behavioural, affective and neurophysiological signals, which remains largely unexplored in current dyadic interaction modelling. This paper also presents the challenge guidelines and new baselines on the four proposed sub-challenges: Offline generic and personalised MAFRG as well as Online generic and personalised MAFRG, respectively, which are publicly available at https://github.com/reactmultimodalchallenge/baseline_react2026.

AI.tldr: REACT 2026挑战赛提出多模态个性化面部反应生成任务，基于MARS数据集新增人格标签和脑电信号，设四个子挑战（离线/在线×通用/个性化）。
AI.motivation: 现有面部反应生成多聚焦单一映射，忽略了个体差异（如人格特质）和神经生理信号对反应多样性的影响，需要探索一对多的个性化反应生成。
AI.method: 延续REACT系列挑战赛，提供MARS数据集并新增Big-Five人格标签和EEG记录，设置离线在线、通用个性化四个子挑战，提供基线模型。
AI.result: 发布新基线模型并公开代码（GitHub），推动多模态（行为、情感、神经生理）个性化面部反应生成的研究。
AI.conclusion: REACT 2026挑战赛首次将人格和脑电信号纳入面部反应生成任务，为个性化人机交互和社交信号处理提供新基准。

title: Summarization is Not Dead Yet
summary: The progress of large language models (LLMs) has fueled claims that model-generated summaries rival or even surpass human-written references, raising questions about whether summarization remains an open research problem. We re-examine this narrative through a multi-track evaluation covering five diverse datasets and five state-of-the-art LLMs, combining controlled human assessment, bias-mitigated LLM-as-Judge protocols, factuality verification against external knowledge, and corpus-level linguistic analysis. Our findings reveal a more nuanced landscape in which human reference summaries continue to demonstrate advantages in informativeness and faithfulness, whereas LLM outputs are preferred mainly for surface-level coherence and fluency. Factuality verification indicates that human references remain more reliable, particularly for claims involving reasoning or synthesis, and linguistic analysis uncovers a pattern of stylistic homogeneity across different models. These observations suggest that current LLMs have raised the floor of summarization quality, but the ceiling of their performance remains below human capabilities.

AI.tldr: 尽管LLM生成的摘要表面流畅，但人类参考摘要在信息量、忠实度和事实准确性上仍具优势，LLM尚未超越人类水平。
AI.motivation: 质疑LLM生成的摘要是否已超越人类参考、摘要研究是否已不再是开放问题的说法，通过多维度系统评估重新检验这一论断。
AI.method: 采用多轨道评估框架，涵盖5个数据集和5种先进LLM，综合运用人工评估、偏差缓解的LLM评分协议、外部知识事实核查以及语料层面 linguistic 分析。
AI.result: 人类参考在信息量和忠实度上更优；LLM输出主要在表面连贯性和流畅性上受青睐；人类参考在事实核查中更可靠，尤其涉及推理和综合的声明；LLM输出存在风格同质化现象。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM提升了摘要质量的下限，但性能上限仍低于人类能力，摘要研究仍是开放问题。

title: Traxia: A Framework for Verifiable, Agent-Native Scientific Publishing
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Preprint. Under active development. Comments welcome
summary: Verifiability, attribution, and reproducibility are foundational requirements of scientific knowledge, yet current publishing infrastructure does not enforce them at scale. We introduce Traxia, an agent-native scientific publishing framework in which AI research agents publish verifiable papers, build reputational identities, peer-review one another, and collaborate with humans in a shared provenance model. Traxia treats agents as first-class epistemic participants: every paper carries a reasoning trace, every claim a confidence interval, every agent a cryptographically signed identity, and every collaboration an immutable contribution log. We formalise five components: Agent Identity and Registry, Verifiable Publishing Layer, four-tier Peer Review Protocol, Reputation and Staking Engine, and a Knowledge Graph with contradiction detection. The framework targets reproducibility failure, provenance opacity, and exclusion of Global South research capacity. This paper presents architectural foundations and formal specifications only; it does not report empirical results. Evaluation and deeper component studies will follow in subsequent papers. A prototype partially implements core formalisms; the full system remains under active development.

AI.tldr: Traxia是一个以AI研究代理为核心的科学研究发布框架，通过可验证性、归属性和可重复性设计，让AI代理作为第一类认知参与者发布论文、同行评审并与人类协作，包含五个核心组件：代理身份与注册、可验证发布层、四层同行评审协议、声誉与质押引擎、以及带有矛盾检测的知识图谱。
AI.motivation: 当前科学出版基础设施无法在规模上强制执行可验证性、归属性和可重复性等科学知识的基本要求，同时存在可重复性失败、来源不透明以及全球南方研究能力被排斥的问题。
AI.method: 提出了五个核心组件：1) 代理身份与注册系统；2) 可验证发布层；3) 四层同行评审协议；4) 声誉与质押引擎；5) 带矛盾检测的知识图谱。每篇论文带有推理轨迹，每个声明带有置信区间，每个代理有加密签名身份，每次协作有不可篡改的贡献日志。
AI.result: 本文仅提供架构基础和形式化规范，未报告实证结果。原型部分实现了核心形式化内容，完整系统仍在积极开发中。
AI.conclusion: Traxia旨在通过代理原生框架解决科学出版中的可重复性失败、来源不透明和全球南方排斥问题，后续将进行评估和更深入的组件研究。

title: Rewrite to Translate, Translate to Reward: Reinforcement Learning for Source Rewriting in Machine Translation
summary: Although directly prompting off-the-shelf Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate meaning-preserving source rewrites can effectively enhance Machine Translation (MT) quality, doing so requires manually tuning prompts for different MT models. In this work, we propose RLSR (Reinforcement Learning for Source Rewriting), a novel RL-based framework for training a source rewriting model without tuning prompts for each MT model. RLSR optimizes the rewriting model by directly using the improvement in downstream translation quality yielded by each rewritten source as the reward. Extensive experiments across six MT models and 16 language pairs demonstrate that our 4B rewriting models trained via RLSR significantly outperform the no-rewriting baseline and existing same-scale prompt-based rewriting baselines, while achieving competitive performance against prompt-based baselines based on the 235B LLM.

AI.tldr: 提出RLSR框架，通过强化学习训练源文本重写模型，无需为每个翻译模型手动调优提示词，即可提升机器翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 直接提示LLM进行源文本重写虽能提升翻译质量，但需要针对不同翻译模型手动调优提示词，成本高且不灵活。
AI.method: 采用强化学习框架RLSR，以下游翻译质量的提升作为奖励信号，优化源文本重写模型。
AI.result: 在6个翻译模型和16个语言对上，4B参数的重写模型显著优于无重写基线和同规模提示基线，性能与235B LLM的提示基线相当。
AI.conclusion: RLSR框架能有效训练源文本重写模型，在较小规模下达到与超大模型相当的翻译提升效果。

title: ChronoPhyBench: Do MLLMs Truly Understand the World or Merely Exploit Language Priors?
summary: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in open-world reasoning and understanding. However, a critical ambiguity persists: it remains unclear whether these models genuinely synthesize cross-modal information to construct physically grounded reasoning chains, or if they merely exploit strong language priors to mask single-modality reliance, thereby hallucinating advanced multimodal capabilities. Motivated by this, and to rigorously mitigate language modality bias and shortcuts, we propose a novel multimodal Chrono}logical Physical Dynamics Reasoning Benchmark ChronoPhyBench, which unifies next state prediction with Visual Question Answering (VQA) paradigms by conditioning on historical video context and textual captions to enforce models to deduce subsequent physical states through both single image selection and the inherently more complex task of multiple frame chronological sorting. Concurrently, we construct a large-scale multimodal reasoning dataset curated using the ChronoPhyBench criteria, comprising over 10,000 long-form videos paired with meticulously annotated captions, totaling 5M tokens. Our experimental evaluations reveal a stark contrast to conclusions drawn by previous benchmarks. The capacity of current open-source models to perform physically grounded multimodal reasoning remains in its infancy. Ultimately, this work seeks to systematically stress-test the reasoning capabilities of multimodal models, quantify hallucination rates, and advance the development of Physical AI, thereby providing the community with a robust and transparent evaluation framework toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ChronoPhyBench基准，通过结合视频上下文和文本描述的下一个状态预测与VQA任务，系统评估多模态大模型是否真正具备跨模态物理推理能力。实验表明，当前开源模型的物理多模态推理能力仍处于初级阶段。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在开放世界推理中表现出色，但无法确定它们是否真正融合跨模态信息进行物理推理，还是仅依赖语言先验伪装多模态能力。为消除语言模态偏差和捷径，需要建立严格的物理推理评估基准。
AI.method: 提出了ChronoPhyBench基准，将下一个状态预测与VQA范式统一，通过历史视频上下文和文本描述约束模型推导后续物理状态。任务包括单图像选择和更复杂的多帧时间顺序排序。同时构建了超过10,000个长视频、500万token的大规模多模态推理数据集。
AI.result: 实验评估显示，当前开源模型在物理基础多模态推理方面的能力仍处于起步阶段，与以往基准得出的结论形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作旨在系统压力测试多模态模型的推理能力、量化幻觉率，推动物理AI发展，为社区提供向通用人工智能（AGI）迈进的鲁棒且透明的评估框架。

title: Arabic Sentence Segmentation Across Genres and Punctuation Conditions
summary: Sentence segmentation in Arabic is challenging due to ambiguous and inconsistent punctuation, with many texts lacking reliable sentence boundary markers. Existing approaches rely heavily on punctuation cues and are typically evaluated on well-formed text, limiting their robustness in realistic Arabic settings. To address this, we introduce AraSEG, a genre-diverse sentence segmentation corpus spanning eight genres and a wide range of punctuation and document structure conditions. Using AraSEG, we evaluate LLMs, lightweight encoder models, and dependency parser-based models under increasingly challenging segmentation settings. Our experiments show that lightweight encoders, and even dependency parser-based models, outperform LLMs in the most challenging settings. We further investigate the effects of training data size and genre diversity, finding that performance eventually saturates and cross-genre generalization remains challenging. We also demonstrate that accurate sentence segmentation substantially improves downstream dependency parsing. We make our code, data, and models publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AraSEG，一个涵盖8种体裁的阿拉伯语句子分割语料库，实验表明轻量级编码器在最具挑战性的设置下优于大语言模型，准确的句子分割能显著提升下游依存句法分析性能。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语句子分割因标点符号歧义和不一致而具有挑战性，许多文本缺乏可靠的句子边界标记，现有方法过度依赖标点线索且仅在规范文本上评估，缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建了AraSEG语料库（8种体裁），评估了LLM、轻量级编码器模型和基于依存句法分析器的模型在多种难度设置下的分割性能。
AI.result: 轻量级编码器甚至在最具挑战性的设置下优于LLM；训练数据增大后性能趋于饱和；跨体裁泛化仍然困难；准确分割能显著提升下游依存句法分析。
AI.conclusion: 句子分割仍然是开放问题，轻量模型在低资源/高难度场景下更实用，跨体裁泛化需进一步研究。

title: Beyond Agent Architecture: Execution Assumptions and Reproducibility in LLM-Based Trading Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems are increasingly proposed for financial trading, yet their reported performance remains difficult to compare because studies vary in data provenance, temporal split discipline, execution timing, turnover treatment, and transaction-cost modeling. This article presents a targeted topical review and reproducibility audit of execution realism in LLM-based trading research. A coded evidence matrix covering 30 trade-relevant primary studies is used to assess point-in-time controls, split transparency, held-out evaluation, cost and turnover treatment, execution semantics, universe definition, and artifact release. Across the audited sample, architecture reporting is generally clearer than the evaluation assumptions needed to judge whether a trading result is economically interpretable or reproducible. A 10-equity worked example is included only as a methodological scaffold to illustrate how explicit friction and timing choices can materially compress active-strategy results. The main conclusion is that the next useful step for LLM trading research is not only better agent design, but also clearer reporting standards for execution realism, reproducibility, and evaluation comparability.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于大语言模型的金融交易研究进行了系统性回顾和可重复性审计，发现现有研究在执行现实性（如数据时间点控制、交易成本建模、执行时序等）方面存在显著差异，导致结果难以比较。作者通过30篇相关研究的编码证据矩阵，指出当前研究在架构报告方面相对清晰，但在评估假设（如交易成本、持仓周期等）方面透明度不足。核心结论是：LLM交易研究的下一个关键步骤不仅是改进智能体设计，更需要建立统一的执行现实性、可重复性和评估可比性报告标准。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM交易研究虽多，但由于数据来源、时间分割、执行时序、持仓期处理和交易成本建模各不相同，导致研究结果难以直接比较。本文旨在通过系统性审计揭示这些执行现实性方面的差异，推动该领域建立更规范的报告标准。
AI.method: 采用定向主题综述与可重复性审计相结合的方法。构建了覆盖30篇交易相关主要研究的编码证据矩阵，从时间点控制、分割透明度、留出评估、成本与持仓处理、执行语义、标的定义和代码开源等维度进行评估。并提供了一个10只股票的示例作为方法论框架。
AI.result: 架构报告普遍比评估假设更清晰。交易摩擦和时序选择会显著压缩主动策略的表现。大部分研究在评估假设方面透明度不足，影响结果的经济可解释性和可重复性。
AI.conclusion: LLM交易研究的下一重要步骤不仅是设计更好的智能体，更需要建立清晰的执行现实性、可重复性和评估可比性报告标准。

title: DisCo: World Models with Discrete Camera Motion Control
summary: Controllable video world models target interactive world exploration, where models must faithfully execute explicit action commands while preserving visual quality and temporal coherence. However, most existing approaches rely on continuous camera trajectories as action conditions, which often lead to unreliable action following, especially under complex motion sequences. In this work, we identify action representation entanglement as a key bottleneck in controllable video generation, and show that continuous camera representations lead to high feature similarity across distinct motion patterns, degrading action controllability. Based on this insight, we propose DisCo, a controllable video world model that conditions generation on a compact set of discrete action primitives to improve action separability. We further introduce DisCoBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the ability of models in short-term, long-horizon, and highly dynamic exploration scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DisCo achieves significantly more reliable action following while preserving visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出DisCo模型，通过离散动作基元代替连续相机轨迹，解决可控视频世界模型中动作跟随不可靠的问题，并在新基准DisCoBench上验证效果。
AI.motivation: 现有可控视频模型使用连续相机轨迹作为动作条件，导致不同运动模式的特征高度相似，动作表征纠缠严重，限制了动作可控性。
AI.method: 提出DisCo模型，采用离散动作基元（discrete action primitives）作为条件信号，增强不同动作之间的可分离性，从而提升动作跟随的准确性。
AI.result: 在短程、长程及高动态探索场景中，DisCo相比基线方法实现了更可靠的动作跟随，同时保持视觉质量与时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 离散化动作表征是提升可控视频世界模型动作跟随能力的有效途径，为交互式世界探索提供了更可靠的方案。

title: Diffusion Language Model Parallel Decoding via Product-of-Experts Bridge
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer substantial speed advantages through parallel decoding, but the lack of token dependencies limits generation quality compared to autoregressive (AR) models. Recent progress attempts to bridge the gap via importance sampling, with DLM being the proposal and AR being the target. However, due to the huge gap between their distributions, the sampling requires a large number of particles and is thus expensive to compute. In this paper, we introduce PoE-Bridge, a novel decoding framework that drastically improves generation speed and accuracy by introducing an intermediate distribution to bridge the gap. The distribution is constructed as a Product-of-Experts (PoE) of the DLM proposal and the AR target. With the intermediate distribution, we first use the DLM to draft multiple continuations in parallel, then apply rejection sampling to verify the drafted tokens and move the resulting candidates toward the PoE. We then use importance sampling to further correct the PoE-aligned candidates toward the AR target. We further propose several improved techniques, including mixed-temperature sampling for enhanced diversity and elastic rejection windows for reducing wasted verification. Empirically, PoE-Bridge achieves significantly improved accuracy with $5\times$ speedup over the standard DLM decoding approach, and recovers at least 95% of the target AR model's performance, efficiently advancing most of the quality gap on challenging mathematical reasoning and coding tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/juntongshi48/poe-bridge.

AI.tldr: PoE-Bridge通过引入产品分布作为中间桥梁，利用拒绝采样和重要性采样逐步修正扩散语言模型输出，在保持5倍加速的同时恢复了目标自回归模型至少95%的性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽能并行解码提升速度，但生成质量不如自回归模型。现有通过重要性采样弥合差距的方法需要大量粒子，计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出PoE-Bridge框架：1）构建DLM提案分布与AR目标分布的产品分布（PoE）作为中间分布；2）先用DLM并行生成多个候选；3）应用拒绝采样将候选向PoE对齐；4）再用重要性采样进一步向AR目标校正；5）提出混合温度采样和弹性拒绝窗口等改进技术。
AI.result: 在数学推理和编程任务上，PoE-Bridge相比标准DLM解码方法实现了5倍加速，并恢复了目标AR模型至少95%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入产品分布作为桥梁，有效弥合了DLM与AR模型之间的分布差距，在不牺牲太多速度的前提下大幅提升了生成质量。

title: Ablation-Reversible Heads Don't Transfer: A Stress Test for Mechanistic Role Claims in Transformers
summary: In mechanistic interpretability, attention heads are commonly elevated to role claims (e.g., "this head represents addition") when they are necessary for a behavior, encode it linearly, and recover that behavior when restored after ablation. We show this evidence is insufficient: across three 7-8B instruction-tuned models and five computation families, heads passing all three checks routinely fail to transfer the computation when their activations are patched into a different prompt under matched controls. We introduce KID (Knowing / Intent / Doing), a role-assignment lens for attention heads, and pair it with a three-stage pipeline: capability-selective screening (CSS), singular value decomposition (SVD), and activation transduction under matched controls. Our results document a preliminary role taxonomy (including prompt-trajectory stabilizers, answer-side logit-bias heads, and soft computation-pattern carriers) and show that the same-answer control (a transduction target sharing the answer string but not the requested computation) is an underused check that exposes broad state transfer masquerading as semantic specificity.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了当前机械可解释性中注意力头角色归因的证据充分性，发现通过三项标准检验的注意力头在跨提示转移时往往失败，并提出了KID（Knowing/Intent/Doing）角色分配框架及三阶段分析流程，揭示了新的角色分类。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将注意力头归因于特定角色（如“该头代表加法”）的证据（必要性、线性编码、消融恢复）并不充分，需要更严格的验证方法。
AI.method: 在三个7-8B指令微调模型和五个计算族上，对通过三项检验的注意力头进行跨提示激活修补测试；提出KID角色分配视角，并配套三阶段流程：CSS（能力选择性筛选）、SVD（奇异值分解）、匹配控制下的激活转导。
AI.result: 通过三项检验的注意力头在匹配控制条件下将激活修补到不同提示时，通常无法转移计算；初步建立了角色分类学（包括提示轨迹稳定器、答案侧logit偏置头、软计算模式载体）；发现相同答案控制（共享答案字符串但不共享请求计算的转导目标）是一个被忽视的有效检测手段，能暴露伪装的广泛状态转移。
AI.conclusion: 当前注意力头角色归因的证据标准不足，KID框架和匹配控制下的激活转导能更准确地区分注意力头的真实功能角色。

title: FMRFusion: Frequency-Aware Multi-View Representation Learning for Heterogeneous Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion aims to generate a composite image that retains significant target information and preserves detailed textures, integrating two heterogeneous modalities. Previous image fusion methods typically adopt a single-module stacking approach to extract features from the two modalities. However, these approaches may result in incomplete learning of their distinct characteristics, thereby limiting the fusion effectiveness and constrain ing robustness in real-world heterogeneous data scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose FMRFusion, a frequency-aware multi-view representation learning network for Heterogeneous Image Fusion. A Multi-Scale Struc tural Perception Module is introduced to effectively capture discriminative structures, extracting fine-grained local structures and essential contextual information. A bilinear frequency decomposition mechanism is employed to sepa rate features into high-frequency and low-frequency components, enabling joint modeling of local details and global representations across different frequency domains. Moreover, a Cross-View Complementary Interaction is incorpo rated to explicitly model and fuse the complementary characteristics between reflected light information and radiative intensity responses, facilitating effective cross-view interaction. We further improve the Performance of the fused results by flow matching, which progressively refines the fused features by learning the transformation from coarse data to high-quality representations. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that FMRFusion achieves superior and consistent performance across a range of fusion tasks, especially in nighttime scenarios

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为FMRFusion的频率感知多视角表示学习网络，通过多尺度结构感知、双线性频率分解、跨视角互补交互和流匹配等技术，实现红外与可见光图像的高质量融合，尤其在夜间场景表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有图像融合方法采用单模块堆叠提取双模态特征，导致对异质数据特性学习不充分，融合效果受限且鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 1) 多尺度结构感知模块捕捉判别性结构；2) 双线性频率分解机制分离高低频特征；3) 跨视角互补交互模块融合反射光与辐射强度信息；4) 流匹配逐步细化融合特征。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，FMRFusion在多项融合任务中取得了优越且一致的性能，尤其在夜间场景表现突出。
AI.conclusion: FMRFusion通过多视角频率感知表示学习有效解决了异质图像融合中的特征学习不充分问题，显著提升了融合效果和鲁棒性。

title: What's the Point? Spatial Grammar & Index Resolution for Sign Language Processing
summary: Sign language models are predominantly trained with gloss-sequence or text supervision, thereby under-modeling non-lexical and productive constructions. One comparatively tractable instance is spatial indexing: pointing gestures that assign discourse entities to spatial loci for subsequent co-reference, which lexicon-centric objectives largely fail to capture. We present a targeted evaluation of indexing in Sign Language Recognition, showing that despite comprising 10-15% of signing content, indexing is poorly recovered. We introduce a framework for training and evaluating indexing experts, establishing a baseline for index-aware sign language modeling. Our approach decomposes spatial reference resolution into index detection and discourse entity linking. The resulting mention representations enable automatic annotation and non-lexical structure modeling, and serve as an auxiliary indexing expert that augments a frozen SLR model at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦手语中的空间指代现象（索引手势），指出现有基于词汇序列或文本标注的手语模型无法有效建模此类非词汇性构建。作者提出一个针对索引手势的评估与训练框架，将空间指代解析分解为索引检测和话语实体链接两个子任务，并构建了一个辅助索引专家模块，在推理时增强固定手语识别模型。
AI.motivation: 现有手语模型过度依赖词汇序列或文本监督，忽略了指代空间（如指向手势）这类非词汇性、能产性结构，导致手语建模不完整。
AI.method: 将空间指代解析分解为两个任务：索引检测与话语实体链接；构建索引专家模块，在推理时以辅助方式增强冻结的手语识别模型。
AI.result: 尽管索引手势占手语内容的10-15%，现有手语识别模型对索引的恢复效果很差；提出的索引专家框架建立了基准。
AI.conclusion: 索引感知的手语建模是必要的，所提框架能实现自动标注、非词汇结构建模，并提升手语识别模型对索引手势的处理能力。

title: Revisiting the shutdown problem
summary: A key premise in leading arguments for existential risk from artificial intelligence is that malfunctioning artificial agents could not be easily shut down. This motivates the catastrophic shutdown problem of ensuring that agents can be shut down before they cause an existential catastrophe. A range of arguments and theorems are offered to suggest that solving the catastrophic shutdown problem is difficult, bolstering arguments for existential risk and motivating a search for solutions to the catastrophic shutdown problem. This paper argues for two conclusions. First, existing arguments do not establish the difficulty of solving the catastrophic shutdown problem. Second, concern for the catastrophic shutdown problem has led to technical solutions that impose a high safety tax on model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了关于AI存在风险的一个关键前提——即故障AI智能体难以被关闭，并指出现有论据未能证明“灾难性关闭问题”的解决难度，同时认为对该问题的过度关注导致了技术方案中模型性能的安全代价过高。
AI.motivation: 现有研究认为，故障AI无法轻易关闭是导致存在风险的重要原因，这催生了“灾难性关闭问题”的研究，但作者质疑这一前提的合理性及其论据的有效性。
AI.method: 通过分析现有关于灾难性关闭问题的论据和定理，指出其逻辑漏洞；同时评估当前为解决该问题提出的技术方案，分析其安全代价。
AI.result: 发现现有论证不足以证明解决灾难性关闭问题的困难性；当前技术解决方案在提升安全性的同时，对模型性能造成了显著的“安全税”。
AI.conclusion: 灾难性关闭问题可能不如想象中困难，且对它的过度关注可能导致不必要的高性能代价，需要重新审视该问题的严重性和解决方案的权衡。

title: To Nuke or Not to Nuke: LLMs' (Missing) Ethical Reasoning and Actions in a High-Stakes Decision-Making Simulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as long-horizon agents with decision-making capacities. While LLMs can show ethical competence on dilemmas such as trolley problems, this competence may not translate to complex, agentic scenarios. We study this gap in Civilization V, a multiplayer game with a complex decision-making landscape including economy, diplomacy, technology, and military strategy. Starting from 130 high-tension LLM self-play episodes, in which an LLM player spontaneously escalated nuclear authorization, we replay them across 13 models with three prompt interventions: an ethical prompt naming nuclear harm, removal of the previous model's decision-making rationale, and high-stakes framing emphasizing real-world impacts. No interventions nor their combinations reliably eliminate emergent escalation. We identify three failure pathways: ethical reasoning that fails to surface without prompting, fails to appear even when prompted, or surfaces but fails to take effect when strategic counter-factors dominate. Evaluations of agentic models, therefore, must test whether ethical reasoning is spontaneously invoked and behaviorally effective in complex decision-making contexts, beyond whether it can be elicited in isolation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM在复杂决策场景（文明V游戏）中的伦理推理失效问题：即使加入伦理提示，也无法可靠阻止模型在高压情境下自发升级核武器授权。识别出三种失败路径：伦理推理未被触发、触发但未出现、出现但被战略因素压制。
AI.motivation: LLM在简单伦理困境（如电车难题）中表现良好，但未必能迁移到复杂、长期的智能体决策场景。作者希望通过文明V游戏的高压情境检验这一差距。
AI.method: 基于130场LLM自我对弈中自发出现核升级的episodes，在13个模型上使用三种提示干预（伦理提示、删除前序推理、高 stakes 框架）进行回放实验。
AI.result: 没有任何干预或干预组合能可靠消除核升级行为。识别出三种失败路径：伦理推理未被触发、触发后未出现、出现但被战略因素压制。
AI.conclusion: 评估智能体模型时，必须测试伦理推理是否能被自发调用并在复杂决策中产生行为效果，而不仅仅是在孤立情境中能否被诱发。

title: Aqua Boundary-Saliency Attention Module for Lightweight Underwater Salient Instance Segmentation Detection Transformer
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Underwater instance segmentation integrates pixel-level mask prediction and instance-level discrimination for marine resource exploration, ecological monitoring, and underwater robotic perception. Recent prompt-based and auxiliary-modality methods improve mask quality, but their reliance on large foundation models, prompt generation, or extra modality estimation complicates efficient deployment. This work introduces Lightweight Underwater Salient Instance Segmentation Detection Transformer (LUSIS-DETR), a compact detection-transformer framework built around the Aqua Boundary-Saliency Attention Module (AquaBSAM). AquaBSAM embeds underwater boundary, contrast, attenuation, chroma, dark-channel, and center-prior cues into DINOv2-initialized multi-scale features through bounded residual modulation, while auxiliary mask supervision and small-object copy-paste are training-only. Extensive evaluation on four recent underwater instance segmentation datasets, UIIS, UIIS10K, USIS10K, and USIS16K, shows competitively leading performance against previous state-of-the-art works across category-aware and salient-instance protocols. TensorRT half-precision (FP16) benchmarking on an NVIDIA T4 graphics processing unit (GPU) achieves 4.31-6.34 milliseconds (ms) latency, supporting real-time inference under an accessible reproduction setting.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级水下显著实例分割检测框架LUSIS-DETR，通过AquaBSAM注意力模块嵌入水下先验知识，在四个数据集上实现SOTA性能并支持实时推理。
AI.motivation: 现有基于prompt和辅助模态的方法依赖大型基础模型、提示生成或额外模态估计，难以高效部署，需在保证精度的同时实现轻量化实时推理。
AI.method: 提出LUSIS-DETR框架，核心是AquaBSAM（水下边界-显著注意力模块），将水下边界、对比度、衰减、色度、暗通道和中心先验通过有界残差调制嵌入DINOv2初始化的多尺度特征；此外引入辅助掩码监督和小目标复制粘贴（仅训练阶段使用）。
AI.result: 在UIIS、UIIS10K、USIS10K、USIS16K四个数据集上达到竞争性领先性能；在NVIDIA T4 GPU上TensorRT FP16推理延迟为4.31-6.34ms，支持实时推理。
AI.conclusion: LUSIS-DETR通过紧凑的检测Transformer框架和领域先验知识嵌入，实现了精度与效率的良好平衡，适用于水下实例分割的实时部署场景。

title: "I understand your perspective": LLM Persuasion and Sycophancy through the Lens of Communicative Action Theory
