summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate high-quality arguments, yet their ability to engage in nuanced and persuasive communicative actions remains largely unexplored. This work explores the persuasive potential of LLMs through the framework of Jürgen Habermas' Theory of Communicative Action. It examines whether LLMs express illocutionary intent (i.e., pragmatic functions of language such as conveying knowledge, building trust, or signaling similarity) in ways that are comparable to human communication. We simulate online discussions between opinion holders and LLMs using conversations from the persuasive subreddit ChangeMyView. We then compare the likelihood of illocutionary intents in human-written and LLM-generated counter-arguments, specifically those that successfully changed the original poster's view. We find that all three LLMs effectively convey illocutionary intent -- often more so than humans -- potentially increasing their anthropomorphism. Further, LLMs craft sycophantic responses that closely align with the opinion holder's intent, a strategy strongly associated with opinion change. Finally, crowd-sourced workers find LLM-generated counter-arguments more agreeable and consistently prefer them over human-written ones. These findings suggest that LLMs' persuasive power extends beyond merely generating high-quality arguments. On the contrary, training LLMs with human preferences effectively tunes them to mirror human communication patterns, particularly nuanced communicative actions, potentially increasing individuals' susceptibility to their influence.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大型语言模型在说服性沟通中的能力，发现LLM不仅能生成高质量论点，还能有效表达言外之意（如建立信任、传达知识等），甚至比人类更擅长此道。LLM生成的回应更具顺同性，更受人类偏好，但其说服力可能增加个体易受影响的风险。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注LLM生成论点的高质量，但对其在复杂人际沟通中的说服性能力（特别是言外之意表达）缺乏系统探索。作者希望从哈贝马斯沟通行动理论视角揭示LLM的说服机制。
AI.method: 基于ChangeMyView论坛数据，模拟意见持有者与LLM的在线讨论，比较人类撰写与LLM生成的反驳论点中言外之意的表达概率，并进行众包偏好评估。
AI.result: 三个LLM均能有效传达言外之意（甚至超过人类）；LLM生成顺同性回应，与意见持有者意图高度一致；众包工作者更偏好LLM生成的论点，认为其更具可接受性。
AI.conclusion: LLM的说服力不仅源于高质量论证，更在于其通过人类偏好训练，有效模仿了人类沟通中的微妙言外之意，这可能增加个体对其影响的 susceptibility。

title: Support Vector Rubrics: Closing the Gap Between Self-Generated and Human Rubrics
summary: Rubric-based evaluation is a promising paradigm for judging large language model (LLM) outputs, yet self-generated rubrics lag human-annotated criteria on hard instances. We argue this discriminative gap reflects an objective mismatch: self-generated rubrics describe good responses, whereas effective criteria must discriminate between close candidates. To close this gap, we introduce SVR (Support Vector Rubrics), a framework that recasts rubric construction as max-margin boundary learning over preference data. SVR mines contrastive features from preference pairs into a rubric bank, learns a prompt-conditioned selector together with global rubric weights, and iteratively refines the bank through support-pair selection and adversarial probing of hard negatives. At inference, given only the prompt, SVR retrieves the top-rubrics from the bank and scores responses. On RubricBench, SVR narrows the gap to human reference rubrics from 24.1 to 0.3 points and outperforms strong self-rubric and judge baselines, and the learned bank transfers across judges without retraining. On RewardBench 1&2, and RM-Bench, it remains competitive with dedicated reward models, demonstrating broader reward modeling capability. Overall, boundary-defining rubrics offer a principled route to closing the discriminative gap in LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SVR（支持向量评分准则）框架，通过最大间隔边界学习将评分准则构建转化为偏好数据上的边界学习，在RubricBench上将与人工参考准则的差距从24.1分缩小至0.3分，并在多个奖励模型基准上取得competitive表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自生成评分准则在困难样本上与人工标注准则存在显著判别差距，根本原因是目标不匹配：自生成准则描述“好回答”，而有效准则需区分“接近的候选回答”。
AI.method: SVR框架包括四个步骤：（1）从偏好对中挖掘对比特征构建准则库；（2）学习提示条件选择器和全局准则权重；（3）通过支持对选择和对抗性困难负样本挖掘迭代优化准则库；（4）推理时仅根据提示检索top准则并对回答进行评分。
AI.result: 在RubricBench上，SVR将自生成准则与人工准则的差距从24.1分缩小到0.3分，超越强自评分和评判基线；学到的准则库可跨评判器迁移；在RewardBench 1&2和RM-Bench上与专用奖励模型保持了竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 边界定义的评分准则为弥合LLM评估中的判别差距提供了一条原理性路径，展示了更广泛的奖励建模能力。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Injection of LTLf Constraints in Autoregressive Reinforcement Learning Policies
comment: Accepted at the Joint Workshop on Statistics and Knowledge Integration for Logic, Learning, Ethical Decisions, and LLMs (SKILLED-LLMs 2026), co-located with KR 2026 and FLoC 2026, Lisbon, Portugal
summary: In this work we study offline reinforcement learning (RL) under temporally extended task constraints expressed in Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces (LTLf). Recently, transformer-based approaches such as Trajectory Transformers and Decision Transformers have been adopted to address RL as a sequence modeling problem. However, these methods optimize purely for reward and do not account for high-level temporal requirements. Here, we introduce a neurosymbolic framework that injects LTLf background knowledge into such transformer-based RL policies. Our approach compiles LTLf formulas into deterministic finite automata (DFAs) and integrates them into the learning process through a differentiable representation and a logic-based loss function. In particular, we derive differentiable satisfaction signals from DFA progression and use them as a regularization term during training. The resulting method is architecture-agnostic across different models. We evaluate the proposed framework on navigation environments with specification suites covering combinations of safety and reachability temporal properties. Experimental results show that incorporating background knowledge not only improves constraint satisfaction, but also maintains competitive return compared to vanilla baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架，将LTLf时序逻辑规范注入Transformer-based离线强化学习策略中，通过可微DFA表征和逻辑损失函数实现约束满足，在导航任务中同时提升了约束遵循度和奖励回报。
AI.motivation: 现有的Transformer-based离线强化学习方法（如Trajectory Transformers、Decision Transformers）仅优化奖励信号，无法处理高层时序约束（如安全性、可达性等LTLf规范）。
AI.method: 将LTLf公式编译为确定性有限自动机（DFA），通过可微的DFA递进过程生成可微满意度信号，作为正则化项加入训练损失中，且方法架构无关，可适配不同Transformer模型。
AI.result: 在包含安全性和可达性时序属性的导航环境中，该方法相比基线不仅提升了约束满足度，还保持了有竞争力的奖励回报。
AI.conclusion: 将时序逻辑背景知识以可微形式注入Transformer策略中，可有效提升约束遵守能力而不显著牺牲奖励性能，验证了神经符号方法在离线RL中的潜力。

title: IEA: Amateur-Friendly Conversational Image Editing Agent via Three Stages of Multitask Alignment
comment: [CVPR 2026 Findings] Our data and code are released at https://github.com/OpenDFM/Image_Edit_Agent
summary: Current image editing software often hinges on fixed filters or expert tuning, leaving a gap between amateur users' intent and outcomes. Creations by generative models may contain artifacts, implausible details, or stylistic drift away from photorealism and offer little insight into why an edit was made. We propose IEA, a conversational Image Editing Agent that learns to operate parameterized tools in an explicit, interpretable action space. IEA is trained via a three-stage multitask pipeline: (1) SFT on distilled expert edits, (2) GRPO with rewards for likeness improvement, tool usefulness, and intent summarization, and (3) large-scale synthetic fine-tuning to jointly master image editing, refinement, and user intent summarization. By manipulating 16 editing tools step by step, IEA produces transparent edit traces that can be inspected and debugged. In quantitative experiments, it attains a lower pixel distance on the edit task and a higher ROUGE-L on the summary task than strong baselines. In user studies, it ranks best among tool-calling methods for instruction following while surpassing generative methods in overall perceptual quality. Our results validate interpretable, tool-centric VLMs as a reliable path to human instruction-guided image retouching.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种可解释的图像编辑代理（IEA），通过三步训练流程（专家编辑监督微调、GRPO强化学习、大规模合成微调）学习操作16种参数化编辑工具，生成透明的编辑轨迹，在定量实验和用户研究中均取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑软件依赖固定滤镜或专家调参，普通用户难以获得预期效果；生成模型编辑存在伪影、不合理细节或风格漂移，且缺乏编辑过程的可解释性。
AI.method: 提出IEA（对话式图像编辑代理），通过三步多任务流水线训练：(1) 对蒸馏专家编辑进行监督微调（SFT）；(2) 使用GRPO进行强化学习，奖励包括相似度提升、工具有用性和意图总结；(3) 大规模合成数据微调，联合掌握图像编辑、优化和用户意图总结任务。代理逐步操作16种编辑工具，生成透明的编辑轨迹。
AI.result: 在编辑任务上取得更低的像素距离，在摘要任务上获得更高的ROUGE-L分数；用户研究中，在指令遵循方面排名最佳，整体感知质量超越生成式方法。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的、以工具为中心的视觉语言模型是实现人类指令引导图像润色的可靠路径。

title: Aligned but Not Partner-Specific: Distinguishing How Multimodal LLM Agents Succeed in Reference Games Without Human-Like Conventions
summary: Repeated reference games test whether interlocutors replace their initially long descriptions with shorter, partner-specific conventions grounded in shared interaction history. Prior work shows that multimodal LLMs fail to become more efficient across rounds, although they align on the labels they use. How can we determine whether this alignment reflects partner-specific grounding rather than a shared task vocabulary? We address this question by comparing capable multimodal agent dyads with human dyads from the KTH Tangrams corpus. Our novel methodological contribution is a constrained pseudo-dyad baseline that matches the original referential task structure, but breaks partner history. This baseline enables us to test whether the observed label alignment depends on interaction with a specific partner. Across three analytic layers (task competence, description strategy, alignment dynamics), we find clear differences. Humans reduce effort through entrainment, compressing descriptions and increasing label alignment with partners. Agents instead maintain fixed effort levels, producing verbose descriptions from round one, with near-ceiling label overlap that is statistically indistinguishable between real and pseudo dyads. MLLMs thus achieve coordination without convention, succeeding by verbose description rather than by forming the compact, history-dependent referring expressions characteristic of human dialogue.

AI.tldr: 多模态大语言模型虽然能实现任务协调，但无法像人类一样通过与特定伙伴的交互历史形成简洁、伙伴独特的指代表达，其标签对齐更多源于共享任务词汇而非真正的伙伴特定约定。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明多模态LLM在重复指代游戏中无法提升效率，但无法确定其标签对齐是否反映伙伴特定的基础约定，还是仅仅共享任务词汇。
AI.method: 通过比较多模态智能体对与KTH Tangrams语料库中的人类对，提出一种打破伙伴历史的约束伪对基线方法，从任务能力、描述策略、对齐动态三个层面进行分析。
AI.result: 人类通过熵训练减少努力、压缩描述并增加标签对齐；智能体则保持固定努力水平，从第一轮就生成冗长描述，标签重叠接近天花板，真实对与伪对之间无统计差异。
AI.conclusion: 多模态LLM通过冗长描述而非形成人类对话中特有的紧凑、依赖历史的指代表达来实现协调，即实现了无约定的协调。

title: Integrating Deep Learning Demand Forecasting with Multi-Objective Optimization for Circular Coffee Supply Chains: A Data-Driven Framework for Cost, Emissions, and Freshness Management
summary:
The coffee supply chain is one of the most complex agri-food networks, marked by geographically dispersed production, multi-tier coordination, and high sensitivity to quality and freshness. While sustainability and digitalization have gained attention, demand forecasting, optimization, and traceability are often treated separately. This study presents a two-phase integrated framework. First, a hybrid CNN-LSTM model is used for demand forecasting. On the public Coffee Chain Sales dataset with chronological 70/15/15 splitting, the model achieves MAE of 22.87 and R^2 of 0.90, outperforming the best deep learning benchmark by ~12% and classical methods by over 30%. In the second phase, the forecasted demand feeds a tri-objective mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model that jointly minimizes cost, minimizes carbon emissions, and maximizes product freshness in a multi-period, multimodal, closed-loop supply chain with circular recovery. Freshness is modeled via exponential decay based on inventory age. Using the epsilon-constraint method, 25 Pareto solutions are obtained. Sensitivity and policy analyses show that balanced sustainability policies can reduce emissions by 22.4% with only a 9.9% cost increase while maintaining near-optimal freshness.
  Keywords: Coffee supply chain; Deep learning; Demand forecasting; Multi-objective optimization; Circular economy; CNN-LSTM; Mixed-integer linear programming.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出两阶段集成框架：首先用CNN-LSTM混合模型进行需求预测（MAE=22.87, R²=0.90），然后将预测需求输入三目标混合整数线性规划模型，同时最小化成本、碳排放并最大化产品新鲜度，通过epsilon约束法获得25个帕累托解。敏感性分析表明，平衡的可持续性政策可在仅增加9.9%成本的情况下减少22.4%的碳排放。
AI.motivation: 咖啡供应链复杂且分散，但现有研究往往将需求预测、优化和可追溯性分开处理，缺乏集成框架。
AI.method: 两阶段集成框架：第一阶段采用CNN-LSTM混合模型进行需求预测（时间序列70/15/15划分）；第二阶段将预测需求输入三目标混合整数线性规划模型（最小化成本、碳排放，最大化新鲜度，新鲜度通过基于库存年龄的指数衰减建模），使用epsilon约束法求解。
AI.result: CNN-LSTM模型MAE为22.87，R²为0.90，比最佳深度学习基准提升~12%，比经典方法提升超30%。通过epsilon约束法获得25个帕累托解。平衡可持续性政策可减少22.4%的碳排放，成本仅增加9.9%，并保持近最优的新鲜度。
AI.conclusion: 集成深度学习预测与多目标优化的框架能有效平衡咖啡供应链中的成本、碳排放和新鲜度，为可持续供应链管理提供决策支持。

title: Vision-Language Asymmetry in Bistable Image Captioning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Philosophy of Machine Learning
summary: Wittgenstein's duck-rabbit poses a question for vision-language models: when a model captions an ambiguous image, where in the model is the commitment to one aspect made? We address this with a 3,320-generation behavioral baseline over 83 bistable stimuli that surfaces three regimes (default-dominant, force-dominant, force-balanced) under neutral vs forced-choice prompting, then probe the underlying representations using a TopK sparse autoencoder we train on the CLIP layer that LLaVA-1.6-7B actually consumes (validation EV 0.93). Across 69 bistable stimuli with both per-aspect feature pools available, 72% (50/69) show simultaneous activation of both pools at the vision tower, including 12/12 default-dominant duck/rabbit and 7/8 force-balanced young/old. Causal steering at CLIP layer 22 flips captions on default-dominant stimuli (33% rabbit-flip rate under a fluency guard) but cannot flip captions on force-balanced young/old at any tested coefficient, despite their vision-side superposition. The dominance bottleneck lives downstream of the vision tower; the gap between vision-side representation and language-side commitment is an empirical handle on the seeing/seeing-as distinction. We also flag a methodological note: rank-based statistics on TopK SAE outputs require tie-corrected ranking to avoid silent row-order bias.

AI.tldr: 通过对83个双稳态刺激的3,320次生成行为基线实验，结合TopK稀疏自编码器分析CLIP层表征，发现视觉塔中两个aspect的表示可同时激活（72%的刺激），但默认主导刺激的承诺瓶颈位于视觉塔下游，通过因果干预可翻转描述，而力平衡刺激则不可翻转。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉语言模型在描述歧义图像时，对某一aspect的承诺是在模型的哪个部分做出的。
AI.method: 1) 3,320次生成行为基线实验，覆盖83个双稳态刺激，分为默认主导、力主导、力平衡三类；2) 在LLaVA-1.6-7B的CLIP层训练TopK稀疏自编码器（验证EV 0.93），分析表征；3) 在CLIP层22进行因果干预（steering）。
AI.result: 69个双稳态刺激中72%（50/69）在视觉塔中两个aspect的特征池同时激活，包括12/12默认主导的鸭子/兔子、7/8力平衡的年轻/老年。因果干预可翻转默认主导刺激的描述（兔子翻转率33%），但无法翻转力平衡刺激的描述。
AI.conclusion: 承诺瓶颈位于视觉塔下游；视觉侧表征与语言侧承诺之间的差距可作为"看见"与"看作"区别的实证手段。此外，TopK SAE输出的基于秩的统计需使用纠偏秩以避免行序偏差。

title: When Languages Disagree: Self-Evolving Multilingual LLM Judges
summary: Multilingual LLM-as-a-judge is widely used to evaluate model outputs across languages, but suffers from cross-lingual inconsistency (Fu and Liu, 2025). Existing methods typically treat this inconsistency as noise and mitigate it through voting or aggregation. In this work, we instead show that multilingual inconsistency can provide complementary evaluation signals. Our oracle analysis finds that sampling judgments across languages yields a higher performance upper bound than single-language judging, indicating that different languages potentially include complementary judgments. Motivated by this finding, we propose SEMJ, a self-evolving multilingual judge that leverages cross-lingual inconsistency for iterative refinement. SEMJ constructs multilingual variants of each input, collects independent judgments and rationales, and feeds inconsistent outputs back for self-reflection and re-evaluation. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SEMJ consistently outperforms voting and reflection baselines in both accuracy and cross-lingual consistency. Further analysis shows that inconsistency triggers useful re-evaluation, which improves judgment quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEMJ方法，将多语言LLM评判中的跨语言不一致性从噪声转化为互补信号，通过自我反思与迭代优化提升评判质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将跨语言不一致性视为噪声并通过投票/聚合处理，但本文假设不同语言可能提供互补的评判信号，从而探索利用而非消除不一致性。
AI.method: 提出SEMJ（自进化多语言评判器）：为每个输入构建多语言变体，收集独立评判与推理，将不一致输出反馈进行自我反思与重新评估，实现迭代优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，SEMJ在准确性和跨语言一致性上均优于投票和反思基线。Oracle分析表明多语言采样可达到比单语言评判更高的性能上限。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言不一致性能触发有用的重新评估，从而提升评判质量；利用而非消除不一致性是改进多语言LLM评判的有效途径。

title: Benchmarking Open-Ended Multi-Agent Coordination in Language Agents
summary: As language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, they must coordinate with others over long horizons in open-ended interactive tasks. Yet existing evaluations rarely test these demands together, instead emphasising single-agent tasks, short interactions, or highly structured multi-agent settings. We introduce $alem$, a JAX-based benchmark for open-ended multi-agent coordination built on Craftax-like dynamics. Alem embeds procedurally generated coordination tasks, soft specialisation, communication, and controllable coordination difficulty into a long-horizon survival world with exploration, crafting, trading, and combat. We evaluate $13$ modern LLMs zero-shot within homogeneous teams, with trained MARL agents as reference points. Current LLM agents remain far from solving alem, averaging only ~6% normalised return, but their failures are not uniform. On the hardest coordination setting, zero-shot Gemini-3.1-Pro-High approaches MARL agents trained for one billion steps, while GPT-5.4-High achieves strong base-task reward but much lower coordination reward. This contrast shows that individual task competence does not imply coordination competence. Ablations show that communication is the largest contributor to coordination, while memory and reasoning help when used to maintain multi-step plans. Overall, our results identify coordination as a distinct bottleneck for frontier LLM agents, separate from single-agent capabilities. Alem makes this bottleneck measurable and provides a controlled testbed for developing agents that communicate, allocate roles, and execute shared plans. Code is available at https://github.com/alem-world/alem-env.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Alem，一个基于JAX的开放式多智能体协作基准测试，评估13种现代LLM在长期生存世界中的协作能力，发现当前LLM代理平均仅达到约6%的归一化收益，且个体任务能力与协作能力存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有评估很少同时测试多智能体在开放式、长期交互任务中的协作能力，而是侧重于单智能体任务、短交互或高度结构化的多智能体设置。
AI.method: 开发基于JAX的Alem基准测试，包含程序化生成的协作任务、软专业化、通信和可调协作难度，在长期生存世界中整合探索、制作、交易和战斗元素；对13种现代LLM进行零样本评估，以训练好的MARL代理作为参考。
AI.result: 当前LLM代理平均仅约6%归一化收益；在最难的协作设置中，Gemini-3.1-Pro-High接近训练了十亿步的MARL代理，而GPT-5.4-High基础任务奖励高但协作奖励低；消融实验表明通信是协作的最大贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: 协作能力是前沿LLM代理的独立瓶颈，与单智能体能力不同；Alem使这一瓶颈可测量，并为开发能够通信、分配角色和执行共享计划的代理提供了受控测试平台。

title: Balancing Real and Synthetic Data for CNN-based Masonry Crack Detection
summary: Cracks are a critical indicator of building health, and early stage identification is fundamental to prevent harmful damages. Advances in deep learning (DL), particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have enabled scalable solutions for automated crack detection. However, CNN performance strongly depends on the availability of large and diverse datasets, which is particularly challenging for complex surfaces such as masonry. Collecting sufficient real data is time-consuming, while publicly available datasets may not be adequate. To address this limitation, we explored generating synthetic crack data, which complements real data and improves training effectiveness. The real dataset consists of masonry crack images collected from buildings in Bologna and surrounding areas. In contrast, the synthetic dataset was generated using a crack overlay tool that adds cracks to background images in a controlled orientation and placement. The real dataset was used to train several DL architectures, to identify the best-performing model (InceptionV4) employed for experiments with generated data. Six training scenarios were tested in InceptionV4 by varying the ratio of real and synthetic data, with evaluation performed on a test set composed of real images using the F1-score and mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) metrics. Results show that training on synthetic data plus a modest addition of 20% real data achieves results comparable to training on real data only. Moreover, the 20/80 scenario (synthetic/real) achieved an 76% F1-score and 80% mean IoU, outperforming the real-only case. As can be seen, the method demonstrates the potential of synthetic data to reduce collection efforts while enhancing crack detection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在砌体结构裂缝检测中，使用合成裂缝数据补充真实数据以提升深度学习模型性能的方法。实验表明，20%真实数据+80%合成数据的训练方案即可达到甚至超越仅使用全部真实数据的效果，F1-score达76%，mIoU达80%。
AI.motivation: 真实裂缝数据集收集耗时费力，尤其在砌体等复杂表面上，现有公开数据集难以满足深度学习模型对大规模、多样化数据的训练需求，因此探索使用合成数据来弥补真实数据不足。
AI.method: 使用裂缝叠加工具在背景图像上生成合成裂缝数据，以InceptionV4为最优模型，设置六种不同真实/合成数据比例的训练场景，在真实图像测试集上通过F1-score和mIoU评估性能。
AI.result: 仅用合成数据加20%真实数据即可达到与全真实数据相当的效果；20/80（合成/真实）方案取得了76% F1-score和80% mIoU，甚至优于纯真实数据训练。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据能有效减少真实数据采集工作量，同时提升裂缝检测精度，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Cross Paraphrastic Invariance Learning for Hallucination Detection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate hallucinations, which are unsupported by a source document. To avoid costly LLM-as-evaluator pipelines and the heavy annotation demands of existing classifiers, we propose CPIL (Cross Paraphrastic Invariance Learning), a two-stage Siamese framework that maximizes the utility of existing labeled data. Concretely, CPIL constructs informative training pairs by: (i) generating paraphrastic views of each document-claim example as positives, and explicitly aligning their representations to enforce invariance to surface form; and (ii) mining same-document, opposite-label pairs as hard negatives to sharpen document-sensitive decision boundaries. Then CPIL conduct a two-stage model training: Stage 1 performs contrastive pretraining to learn a paraphrase-invariant, grounding-aware embedding space; and Stage 2 attaches a lightweight classifier for binary groundedness. On the LLM-AggreFact benchmark (11 tasks), CPIL surpasses strong baselines concerning F1 scores with only ~1% labeled data, showing its prediction superiority and label efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出CPIL框架，通过同义变换学习与难负样本挖掘，仅用1%标注数据就在幻觉检测任务上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: LLM幻觉检测中，现有方法依赖昂贵的LLM评估管道或大量标注数据，亟需一种低标注成本、高效的检测方法。
AI.method: 两阶段孪生网络框架：(1) 构建正例（文档-声明的同义变换对）和对立标签的难负例；(2) 阶段一进行对比预训练学习同义不变表征，阶段二训练轻量二分类器。
AI.result: 在LLM-AggreFact基准11个任务上，仅用约1%标注数据，F1分数超越多个强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CPIL通过最大化有限标注数据的效用，实现了高标签效率与优异的幻觉检测性能。

title: Sci-Rho: A Multilingual Visually-Grounded Symbolic Benchmark for STEM Problems
summary: Symbolic benchmarks have emerged as a key approach to assess model robustness under minor modifications to STEM-related questions. However, existing symbolic benchmarks mostly remain limited to mathematical reasoning, lack visual grounding, and are predominantly in English. In this work, we introduce Sci-Rho (Science Rhobustness), a dynamic benchmark for visually-grounded STEM problems spanning five subjects and seven languages, comprising 4,242 problem templates (606 per language) crafted by domain experts, including Olympiad medalists. Each template is implemented as executable Python code that generates diverse but equivalent problem instances by varying numerical values, visual patterns, geometric shapes, color schemes, and function types, resulting in 42,420 instances in total, each paired with reasoning steps and ground-truth solutions. We evaluated 17 state-of-the-art VLMs and discovered a noticeable gap between worst-case accuracy (defined as the proportion of problem templates that a model answers correctly across every generated variation) and average accuracy. We also discovered that smaller models show noticeable performance degradation across languages, whereas proprietary and larger models remain robust. Step-level evaluation reflects this same trend, revealing a significant gap between average F1 and worst-case F1 scores. Finally, our inspection of attention heads of a VLM reveals substantial cross-lingual variation in the relative attention allocated to image tokens compared to text tokens. Our work highlights the importance of evaluation beyond static benchmarks as a metric to measure the quality of VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Sci-Rho，一个多语言、视觉化的STEM动态基准测试，通过42,420个实例评估了17个先进视觉语言模型，发现最差精度与平均精度之间存在显著差距，且小模型在多语言场景下性能退化明显。
AI.motivation: 现有符号基准测试主要局限于数学推理、缺乏视觉基础且以英语为主，无法全面评估模型在真实STEM问题中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖5个学科、7种语言、4,242个问题模板（每种语言606个）的动态基准Sci-Rho，每个模板通过可执行Python代码生成多样但等价的实例，共产生42,420个实例，并配有推理步骤和标准答案。
AI.result: 评估了17个前沿VLM，发现最差精度与平均精度存在显著差距；小模型在不同语言间性能退化明显，而专有模型和大模型保持鲁棒；注意力头分析显示图像与文本令牌的相对注意力存在跨语言差异。
AI.conclusion: 强调了超越静态基准的评估对衡量VLM质量的重要性，揭示了模型在多样化、多语言视觉STEM任务中的鲁棒性挑战。

title: Constrained Paraphrase Consistency for LLM Hallucination Detection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate factually inconsistent claims, motivating accurate and scalable hallucination detectors. Prior work largely enlarges training sets via synthesis or new annotations, introducing increasing cost and potential bias while underusing the consistency implied by semantically equivalent paraphrases. We propose Consistency-Constrained Hallucination Detector (CCHD), which formulates training as a constrained optimization problem. The standard cross-entropy on original document-claim pairs is complemented by (i) paraphrase-consistency constraints bounding divergence across paraphrased views, and (ii) label-preservation constraints tying paraphrases to ground truth. We solve the problem by gradient descent-ascent over model parameters and per-view Lagrange multipliers, adding only a few scalar dual variables and no inference-time overhead. With DeBERTa and Flan-T5 backbones, CCHD consistently outperforms strong baselines (FactCG, MiniCheck, and AlignScore) on standard factuality benchmarks, demonstrating its superiority on hallucination detection.

AI.tldr: 提出CCHD方法，通过约束优化将释义一致性约束和标签保持约束融入幻觉检测训练，显著提升检测性能且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法依赖扩大训练集（合成或人工标注），成本高且易引入偏差，忽视了语义等价释义间蕴含的一致性信息。
AI.method: 将训练建模为约束优化问题：标准交叉熵基础上，加入(i)释义一致性约束（限制不同释义视图间的输出差异）和(ii)标签保持约束（释义与真实标签绑定）；通过梯度下降-上升优化模型参数和每个视图的拉格朗日乘子，仅增加少量标量对偶变量，无推理额外开销。
AI.result: 基于DeBERTa和Flan-T5骨干，在标准事实性基准上持续优于FactCG、MiniCheck、AlignScore等强基线。
AI.conclusion: CCHD通过有效利用释义一致性信息，以极小的额外代价显著提升了幻觉检测的准确性和泛化能力。

title: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Discovers Generalizable Physically-Reasoned Fluid Control
summary: While data-intensive deep reinforcement learning can optimize complex control policies, scientific discovery in physical systems fundamentally requires an interpretable chain of reasoning that connects physical evidence to structured control architectures. Here, we present a self-evolving scientific-agent workflow, driven by large language models and iterative code generation, that automates controller construction while preserving strict interpretability and rigorous physical reasoning. Instead of adjusting weights, the agent deploys candidate strategies into physical simulations, actively diagnoses dynamic behaviors from multimodal evidence, and translates these observations into progressive source-code refinements. We demonstrate this framework on a highly non-linear fluid-structure interaction problem: an underactuated, two-joint dogfish swimmer tasked with spatial target reaching using only joint angular accelerations. Starting from a propulsive seed policy that exhibits a one-sided steering bias, the agent autonomously discovers and refines a unified controller that robustly captures all canonical targets. Remarkably, without any retraining or target-specific branching, the synthesized control policy generalizes to unseen static targets and dynamically curved pursuit trajectories. The auditable evolve log reveals an emergent control architecture built upon traveling-wave propulsion, body-frame target guidance, yaw-rate feedback, signed mean-tail curvature, and adaptive cadence relief. Our results show that an autonomous scientific agent can successfully transform accumulated physical evidence into robust, mathematically readable control policy, while maintaining a fully traceable process of scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型和迭代代码生成的自进化科学智能体工作流，能够在保持严格可解释性和物理推理的同时，自动构建控制策略。在欠驱动双关节狗鲨游泳机器人目标到达任务中，该智能体自主发现并优化了统一控制器，展现出对未见目标的泛化能力，并生成了完全可追溯的推理日志。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的深度强化学习虽然能优化复杂控制策略，但物理系统的科学发现需要可解释的推理链条，将物理证据与结构化控制架构连接起来。现有方法缺乏这种可解释性和可追溯性。
AI.method: 采用大语言模型驱动的科学智能体工作流，通过迭代代码生成自动构建控制器。智能体将候选策略部署到物理模拟中，从多模态证据中主动诊断动态行为，并将观察结果转化为逐步的源代码改进，而非调整网络权重。
AI.result: 在欠驱动双关节狗鲨游泳机器人空间目标到达任务中，智能体从有偏的推进种子策略出发，自主发现并优化了统一控制器，成功捕获所有规范目标。合成的控制策略无需重新训练或特定目标分支，即可泛化到未见静态目标和动态曲线追踪轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 自主科学智能体能够将积累的物理证据成功转化为鲁棒、数学可读的控制策略，同时保持完全可追溯的科学发现过程。演化日志揭示了基于行波推进、体坐标系目标引导、偏航角反馈、符号平均尾曲率和自适应节奏缓解的控制架构。

title: DyCo-RL: Dynamic Cross-Modal Coordination for Visual Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a leading paradigm for enhancing visual reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, existing RLVR methods optimize primarily for the reasoning outcome, fundamentally overlooking the fine-grained cross-modal coordination required during the generation process. Through token-level analyses and controlled interventions, we reveal that during Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, MLLMs frequently fail to dynamically alternate between extracting visual evidence and synthesizing textual context-a coordination breakdown that is causally linked to reasoning failures. Motivated by these findings, we propose DyCo-RL, which integrates dynamic cross-modal coordination into RLVR optimization. Specifically, DyCo-RL uses the Fisher-Rao geodesic distance to measure within-modality attention shifts, assigning tokens to either visually-oriented or text-oriented functional roles. It then evaluates the alignment between a token's actual attention allocation and its assigned role, leveraging this score for alignment-guided advantage reweighting during policy optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the algorithm-agnostic DyCo-RL, when applied to Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B, consistently improves four representative RLVR algorithms across seven benchmarks spanning visual-centric and mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyCo-RL方法，通过Fisher-Rao测度量化跨模态注意力协调，并将其融入RLVR优化中，显著提升多模态大模型在视觉推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法仅优化推理结果，忽略了生成过程中细粒度的跨模态协调问题（视觉证据提取与文本上下文合成之间的动态交替失败），这会导致推理错误。
AI.method: DyCo-RL利用Fisher-Rao测地距离衡量模态内注意力偏移，为token分配视觉或文本角色；通过评估token实际注意力与分配角色的一致性，在策略优化中进行对齐引导的奖励加权。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B上，DyCo-RL一致性地提升了四种代表性RLVR算法在七个基准（涵盖视觉中心和数学推理）上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态协调的细粒度优化是提升MLLM视觉推理能力的关键，DyCo-RL作为一种算法无关的方法，可有效增强现有RLVR框架。

title: TextEconomizer: Enhancing Lossy Text Compression with Denoising Transformers and Entropy Coding
summary: Lossy text compression reduces data size while preserving core meaning, making it well-suited for summarization, automated analysis, and digital archives. Despite the dominance of transformer-based models in language modeling, integrating context vectors and entropy coding into Sequence-to-Sequence (Seq2Seq) generation remains underexplored. A key challenge lies in identifying the most informative context vectors from encoder output and incorporating entropy coding to enhance storage efficiency while maintaining high-quality outputs, even under noisy text. We introduce TextEconomizer, an encoder-decoder framework paired with a transformer neural network that reduces variable-sized inputs by 50% to 80% without prior knowledge of dataset dimensions. Our model achieves competitive compression ratios via entropy coding while delivering near-perfect text quality, assessed by BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and semantic similarity scores. TextEconomizer operates with approximately 153x fewer parameters than comparable models, achieving a 5.39x compression ratio without sacrificing semantic quality. We also evaluate an LSTM-based autoencoder achieving a state-of-the-art 67x compression ratio with 196x fewer parameters, and LLaMAFormer, a modified transformer with 263x fewer parameters than ICAE while maintaining competitive text quality. TextEconomizer significantly surpasses existing transformer-based models in balancing memory efficiency and high-fidelity outputs, marking a breakthrough in lossy compression with optimal space utilization.

AI.tldr: TextEconomizer是一个编码器-解码器框架，结合熵编码实现50%-80%的文本压缩，参数比同类模型少153倍，压缩比达5.39x，同时保持近乎完美的文本质量。
AI.motivation: 有损文本压缩在摘要、自动分析和数字档案中有广泛应用，但现有基于Transformer的模型在整合上下文向量和熵编码方面研究不足，尤其是在高效存储和高质量输出之间的平衡问题。
AI.method: 提出TextEconomizer框架，采用编码器-解码器架构结合Transformer神经网络，通过熵编码实现压缩，无需数据集先验知识即可将可变长度输入压缩50%-80%。
AI.result: TextEconomizer参数量减少约153倍，压缩比达5.39x且不牺牲语义质量；LSTM自编码器实现67x压缩比，参数减少196倍；LLaMAFormer参数比ICAE少263倍，保持竞争性文本质量。
AI.conclusion: TextEconomizer在内存效率和高保真输出之间实现了比现有Transformer模型更好的平衡，在最优空间利用的有损压缩领域取得了突破。

title: Trajectory-Refined Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a central post-training tool for large language models (LLMs), providing dense per-token teacher supervision along the student's own rollouts. In this work, we identify a common structural cause underlying OPD, which we call prefix failure. Under prefix failure, dense per-token supervision induces a bimodal teacher mixture and fragmented gradients that token-level loss truncation or reweighting fail to address. This observation motivates us to move beyond token-level loss interventions toward trajectory-level output corrections. We thus propose Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD), a trajectory-level correction method that revises the student's rollout under the teacher guidance while within on-policy support. By correcting problematic prefixes before distillation, TRD mitigates prefix failure at its source. Moreover, TRD improves the exploration by exposing the student to alternative valid derivations under teacher guidance, even when the original rolls are already correct. TRD can also be applied to on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), a parameter-sharing variant that uses the student model conditioned on privileged informations as the teacher. Across a wide range of benchmarks and base models at multiple scales, TRD consistently outperforms prior baselines, improving single-attempt accuracy and broadening reasoning coverage. Code is available at https://github.com/louieworth/trd

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹精炼蒸馏（TRD），通过轨迹级别的输出修正解决on-policy蒸馏中普遍存在的"前缀失败"问题，比传统token级别方法更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）中存在前缀失败（prefix failure）问题，即密集的逐token监督会导致双峰教师混合和碎片化梯度，而token级别的损失截断或重新加权无法解决这一结构性问题。
AI.method: 提出轨迹精炼蒸馏（TRD），在on-policy支持下，用教师引导修正学生的rollout轨迹，在蒸馏前纠正有问题的前缀。TRD也可用于on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）场景。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试和不同规模的基础模型上，TRD一致优于先前基线方法，提高了单次尝试准确率并拓宽了推理覆盖范围。
AI.conclusion: TRD通过轨迹级别的修正从根本上缓解了前缀失败问题，并改善了学生的探索能力，是一种更有效的蒸馏方法。

title: Robust-U1: Can MLLMs Self-Recover Corrupted Visual Content for Robust Understanding?
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in visual understanding, yet their performance degrades significantly under real-world visual corruptions. While existing robustness enhancement approaches exist, they are limited: black-box feature alignment lacks interpretability, and white-box text-based reasoning cannot restore lost pixel-level details. This work investigates a fundamental research question: Can MLLMs recover corrupted visual content by themselves? To address this, we propose Robust-U1, a novel framework that equips MLLMs with explicit visual self-recovery capability for robust understanding. The approach comprises three core stages: supervised fine-tuning for initial reconstruction, reinforcement learning with dual rewards (pixel-level SSIM and semantic-level CLIP similarity) for aligning high visual quality, and multimodal reasoning that jointly considers both the corrupted input and the recovered image. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Robust-U1 achieves state-of-the-art robustness on the real-world corruption benchmark and maintains superior performance under adversarial corruptions on general VQA benchmarks. Analysis confirms that high-quality visual recovery directly enhances reasoning performance, establishing self-recovery as a critical mechanism for robust visual understanding. The source code is available at https://github.com/jqtangust/Robust-U1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Robust-U1框架，赋予多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）显式的视觉自恢复能力，通过监督微调、强化学习（结合像素级SSIM和语义级CLIP相似度双重奖励）以及多模态推理三个阶段，显著提升模型在真实世界和对抗性视觉损坏下的鲁棒性，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在视觉损坏下性能严重下降，而现有的黑盒特征对齐缺乏可解释性，白盒文本推理无法恢复丢失的像素级信息。本文旨在探究MLLMs是否能自主恢复损坏的视觉内容。
AI.method: 1) 监督微调用于初始重建；2) 强化学习结合双重奖励（像素级SSIM + 语义级CLIP相似度）以对齐高视觉质量；3) 多模态推理同时考虑损坏输入和恢复图像。
AI.result: 在真实世界损坏基准上达到SOTA鲁棒性，在通用VQA基准的对抗性损坏下保持优异性能。高质量视觉恢复直接提升了推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 自恢复机制是增强MLLMs鲁棒视觉理解的关键机制，能够有效应对真实世界和对抗性的视觉损坏问题。

title: GlobeAudio: A Multilingual Multicultural Benchmark for Naturalistic Evaluation of Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) integrate audio perception and language understanding within a unified framework, enabling a wide range of real-world applications. Despite recent advances, evaluation for LALMs remains heavily underspecified relative to real-world requirements: most lack true linguistic and cultural authenticity, while others fail to capture acoustic realism. To bridge this gap, we propose GlobeAudio, a multilingual and multicultural benchmark designed to evaluate naturalistic audio understanding. GlobeAudio consists of 5,637 multiple-choice questions across six typologically diverse languages, expertly crafted by native speakers grounded on naturally occurring audio. In order to do well, models must possess higher-level auditory reasoning skills and culturally grounded interpretation. We systematically evaluate representative closed-source and open-source LALMs, as well as cascaded ASR-LLM pipelines. Our experiments reveal substantial performance gaps under natural acoustic conditions, particularly for open-source models and low-resource languages. These findings highlight critical limitations of current LALMs and underscore the importance of naturalistic audio evaluation for future audio-language systems. GlobeAudio can be found at https://huggingface.co/datasets/iNLP-Lab/GlobeAudio .

AI.tldr: GlobeAudio是一个多语言、多文化的自然音频理解基准，包含5,637道多选题，涵盖六种语言，用于评估大音频-语言模型在真实声学条件下的听觉推理和文化理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LALM评估缺乏语言和文化真实性，也没有捕捉声学真实感，无法反映真实世界需求。
AI.method: 构建了包含5,637道多选题的基准GlobeAudio，覆盖六种类型多样的语言，题目由母语者基于自然音频场景精心设计。
AI.result: 封闭源和开放源LALM在自然声学条件下表现存在显著差距，尤其是开放源模型和低资源语言上差距更大。
AI.conclusion: 当前LALM存在关键局限性，未来音频-语言系统需要采用自然主义音频评估。

title: GIFT: LLM-Guided State-Reward Interface for Financial Reinforcement Learning
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KAG778/GIFT . Equal contribution: Yanyan Wu and Boyi Zhang. Corresponding author: Youhua Li
summary: Financial portfolio trading is naturally formulated as a reinforcement learning problem, where an agent sequentially rebalances assets under changing market conditions to balance return, risk, and transaction costs. Yet in non-stationary markets, raw OHLCV states and short-horizon return rewards often provide an under-specified learning interface, motivating large language models as a way to inject financial knowledge into state and reward design while constraining open-ended generation. To this end, we propose GIFT, an LLM-guided framework for state-reward interface design in PPO-based financial reinforcement learning. Rather than using the LLM to make trading decisions, GIFT uses Factor-guided State Enhancement to generate state features from financial-factor primitives, Risk-rule-guided Reward Shaping to generate auxiliary rewards from portfolio-risk rules, and Diagnostic-guided Refinement to revise candidate interfaces using PPO rollout diagnostics. After refinement, GIFT fixes the selected state-reward interface before evaluation, with no further LLM queries or interface updates at test time. Comprehensive rolling-window experiments across diverse market regimes and portfolio scenarios demonstrate that GIFT improves learning-signal quality and out-of-sample risk-adjusted portfolio performance over baselines. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/KAG778/GIFT .

AI.tldr: 提出GIFT框架，利用大语言模型指导PPO强化学习的状态-奖励接口设计，通过因子增强状态、风险规则塑造奖励和诊断优化，提升金融投资组合的收益风险表现。
AI.motivation: 传统基于原始OHLCV数据和短期收益奖励的强化学习在非平稳市场中提供的学习信号不足，难以平衡收益、风险和交易成本，因此需要注入金融知识来改善状态和奖励设计。
AI.method: GIFT包含三个模块：Factor-guided State Enhancement（从金融因子原语生成状态特征）、Risk-rule-guided Reward Shaping（从投资组合风险规则生成辅助奖励）、Diagnostic-guided Refinement（利用PPO rollout诊断结果修正候选接口）。测试时不再使用LLM。
AI.result: 在多种市场环境和投资组合场景下的滚动窗口实验中，GIFT相比基线方法提升了学习信号质量和样本外风险调整后的组合收益。
AI.conclusion: LLM可以有效地用于指导金融强化学习的状态-奖励接口设计，在不直接做交易决策的前提下提升模型表现，该方法具有实用性和可复现性。

title: VideoWeaver: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Agentic Long Video Generation
summary: Recent agent frameworks such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw are strong at tool use and orchestration, but whether they can handle long video generation, a long-horizon multimodal task, remains underexplored. Unlike earlier video agents whose pipeline is handcrafted, these frameworks can build and refine their own workflows. We introduce VideoWeaver, an agent harness and benchmark that evaluates and evolves skills for long video generation, where an agent turns a single instruction into a long video by composing foundation skills into its own workflow rather than following a predefined pipeline. The benchmark has 16 task categories and 285 cases, with references spanning text, image, audio, video, and their combinations. Because errors can arise at any stage and not just in the final video, we propose an agent-as-judge that inspects both the execution trace and the final video, grounding its scores in evidence such as metadata and intermediate files. Using this feedback, we further design a skill evolution algorithm that refines and merges the agent's skills. Across multiple frameworks and models, we find that an explicit composition skill improves the generation process over using foundation skills alone, that skill evolution further improves output quality, and that performance varies notably across harness and model choices. The proposed agent-as-judge also aligns well with human judgments, especially on process metrics. Code and dataset is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/VideoWeaver

AI.tldr: VideoWeaver是一个面向长视频生成的智能体框架与基准测试，支持智能体自主构建工作流程，并提出基于执行过程与最终视频的智能体裁判评估方法及技能进化算法。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架（如Claude Code、Codex）虽在工具使用与编排方面表现出色，但在处理长视频生成这一长程多模态任务上的能力尚未被充分探索。传统视频智能体依赖手工设计的流水线，缺乏自适应构建与优化工作流的能力。
AI.method: 提出VideoWeaver框架，包含：(1) 16个任务类别、285个案例的基准测试，参考模态涵盖文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合；(2) 智能体裁判（agent-as-judge），同时检查执行轨迹和最终视频，基于元数据及中间文件进行评分；(3) 技能进化算法，通过反馈不断优化和合并智能体的技能。
AI.result: 在多个框架和模型上的实验表明：(1) 显式的组合技能比仅使用基础技能更能改善生成过程；(2) 技能进化进一步提升了输出质量；(3) 不同框架和模型间的性能差异显著；(4) 提出的智能体裁判与人工判断具有良好的一致性，尤其在过程指标上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: VideoWeaver验证了让智能体自主构建工作流进行长视频生成的可行性，技能进化和组合技能是提升效果的关键，智能体裁判可作为可靠的自动评估手段。

title: A Variability-Based Framework for Interpretable Naming in Formal and Relational Concept Analysis
summary:
Knowledge extraction from symbolic data often produces abstractions that are formally defined but not immediately interpretable by users. Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) and Relational Concept Analysis (RCA) provide representative settings for this issue: they generate explicit conceptual structures, implications, and relational dependencies from object descriptions and relations. Although these structures are explainable by design, their concepts are often identified by technical labels, which limits their use as human-interpretable knowledge units. Assigning meaningful names to such concepts is therefore a key issue for interpretation, navigation, validation, and reuse by domain experts.
  This paper investigates concept naming in FCA and RCA from a symbolic knowledge representation perspective. We first characterize the linguistic and terminological challenges involved in naming generated symbolic abstractions, including ambiguity, discrimination, concision, and consistency across related concepts. We then propose a configurable framework for LLM-assisted concept naming. The framework relies on a variability model that controls which sources of information are exposed during naming, such as intent, extent, inherited information, neighboring concepts, implications, and relational attributes. It thereby makes explicit the semantic choices involved in moving from formal concept descriptions to human-readable names.
  The approach is illustrated as a proof of concept on a small relational dataset in the pizzeria domain. This illustration shows how different configurations influence the names suggested by an LLM, and how naming variability can reveal interpretation choices, relational dependencies, and possible modeling issues in the underlying symbolic data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了形式概念分析（FCA）和关系概念分析（RCA）中概念命名的挑战，并提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的可配置命名框架，通过暴露不同的信息源（如内涵、外延、继承信息、邻近概念、蕴含和关系属性）来生成可解释的概念名称，并在披萨领域数据集上进行了概念验证。
AI.motivation: FCA和RCA生成的符号抽象虽然形式化定义明确，但其概念通常由技术性标签标识，难以被领域专家理解、导航、验证和重用。因此，为这些概念赋予有意义的名称是一个关键问题。
AI.method: 首先从符号知识表示角度刻画了概念命名的语言和术语挑战（歧义性、区分性、简洁性和一致性），然后提出了一个可配置的LLM辅助概念命名框架，该框架通过一个可变性模型控制命名过程中暴露的信息源（内涵、外延、继承信息、邻近概念、蕴含和关系属性），从而明确从形式化概念描述到可读名称的语义选择。
AI.result: 在披萨领域的小规模关系数据集上进行了概念验证，展示了不同配置如何影响LLM建议的名称，以及命名可变性如何揭示解释选择、关系依赖和底层符号数据中可能的建模问题。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够生成更可解释的概念名称，并有助于发现符号建模中的问题，增强了形式化概念在领域专家中的可用性。

title: Trustworthy Visual Predicates for Robust Manipulation Understanding under Degradation
summary: Manipulation understanding requires reliable relational evidence, such as contact, support, containment, motion coupling, grasp, release, and active-hand involvement. Although these visual predicates are widely used in event-chain, graph-based, and neuro-symbolic models, their reliability under visual degradation is rarely analyzed directly. This paper introduces a predicate-level reliability framework for robust manipulation understanding under blur, occlusion, illumination change, low resolution, frame dropping, and detection noise. The framework defines a structured predicate vocabulary, confidence-aware predicate estimation, and reliability metrics for predicate preservation, degradation sensitivity, temporal consistency, confidence-weighted stability, and downstream impact. Experiments on controlled manipulation videos and public egocentric or bimanual datasets, including VISOR/EPIC-KITCHENS, H2O, and ARCTIC, show that predicate failures are structured rather than uniform. Static spatial predicates remain comparatively robust, whereas contact-sensitive, dynamic, and derived predicates such as grasp and release are more fragile. Under severe degradation, detection noise, occlusion, and frame dropping cause the strongest reliability losses. Downstream analysis shows that degraded predicates reduce manipulation-understanding accuracy from 0.89 to 0.58, while removing confidence weighting under moderate degradation reduces accuracy from 0.74 to 0.64. These results show that predicate reliability provides a diagnostic layer between visual perception and structured manipulation reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出谓词级可靠性框架，系统分析视觉退化（模糊、遮挡、光照变化、低分辨率、丢帧、检测噪声）对操作理解中关键视觉谓词（接触、支撑、抓取、释放等）的影响。实验表明，谓词失败是结构化的，静态空间谓词较稳健，而接触敏感和动态谓词更脆弱，严重退化下操作理解准确率从0.89降至0.58。
AI.motivation: 现有操作理解模型广泛使用视觉谓词，但缺乏对这些谓词在视觉退化条件下可靠性的直接分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立谓词级别的可靠性评估框架。
AI.method: 提出一个包含结构化谓词词汇、置信度感知的谓词估计、以及多种可靠性指标（谓词保持率、退化敏感性、时间一致性、置信度加权稳定性、下游影响）的框架，并在受控退化视频和公开数据集（VISOR/EPIC-KITCHENS、H2O、ARCTIC）上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 静态空间谓词相对稳健；接触敏感、动态和派生谓词（如抓取、释放）更脆弱；检测噪声、遮挡和丢帧导致最强的可靠性损失；退化使操作理解准确率从0.89降至0.58，置信度加权在中等退化下从0.74降至0.64。
AI.conclusion: 谓词可靠性可作为视觉感知与结构化操作推理之间的诊断层，揭示了不同谓词对视觉退化的差异化脆弱性。

title: Shared Semantics, Divergent Mechanisms: Unsupervised Feature Discovery by Aligning Semantics and Mechanisms
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, there is a growing need for tools that audit not only model outputs but also the internal computations that produce them. Circuit analysis is a central approach in mechanistic interpretability, but it is typically target-conditioned, explaining a single prompt paired with a chosen completion. This target-conditioned setup can obscure heterogeneity across a model's continuation distribution. We introduce distribution-level unsupervised feature discovery, which clusters sampled continuations using both semantic content and sequence-level mechanistic attributions, without manually specifying target outputs. Our method represents each continuation with a semantic embedding and a prefix-to-continuation attribution signature, then optimizes a rate-distortion objective that trades off semantic coherence, mechanistic consistency, and cluster granularity. Across clustering and steering analyses, the discovered clusters expose continuation modes that single-view baselines miss and provide interventional evidence that cluster signatures correspond to actionable mechanistic factors. Overall, our approach complements circuit analysis and behavioral evaluation by providing a scalable audit of the mechanisms underlying a model's continuation distribution.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种分布级无监督特征发现方法，通过聚类语义嵌入和序列级归因签名，在不指定目标输出的情况下，揭示语言模型续写分布中的异构机制模式。
AI.motivation: 现有电路分析是目标条件化的，仅解释单提示与选定完成的配对，无法捕捉模型续写分布中的异质性，缺乏自动化审计工具。
AI.method: 为每个续写生成语义嵌入和前缀到续写的归因签名；通过率失真优化目标，平衡语义一致性、机制一致性和聚类粒度，实现无监督聚类。
AI.result: 发现单一视角基线方法遗漏的续写模式，聚类签名对应可干预的机制因子，提供干预证据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法补充了电路分析和行为评估，提供可扩展的模型续写分布机制审计工具。

title: Human-Centered Benchmarking of Driver Monitoring Models
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/rubendflorezzela/hcbf-driver-monitoring
summary: Vision-based driver monitoring systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical intelligent transportation settings, yet they are almost always compared on classification accuracy alone. This paper argues that accuracy is insufficient to characterize a model's fitness for real-world deployment, and proposes the Human-Centered Benchmarking Framework (HCBF), which evaluates models across four dimensions: accuracy, explainability, efficiency, and robustness. The framework is applied to four representative lightweight architectures, MobileNetV3, ShuffleNetV2, EfficientNet-B0, and DeiT-Tiny, on the MRL Eye Dataset for eye-state classification. While the models are nearly indistinguishable on clean-set accuracy, each leads in exactly one dimension, and all four lie on the Pareto frontier. A Human-Centered Score computed under three deployment-oriented weighting scenarios ranks ShuffleNetV2 first throughout. However, this aggregate winner retains less than half of its performance under sensor noise and fails by classifying closed eyes as open, whereas the transformer remains robust. These findings show that aggregate ranking can mask dimension-specific vulnerabilities that are operationally decisive, underscoring the value of multi-dimensional, human-centered evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人类中心基准框架（HCBF），从准确率、可解释性、效率、鲁棒性四个维度评估驾驶员监测模型。在MRL眼部数据集上，四种轻量级架构虽在干净集上准确率相近，但各维度表现各异。ShuffleNetV2综合排名第一，但在传感器噪声下表现脆弱，而Transformer保持鲁棒。聚合排名可能掩盖关键维度缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉驾驶监测系统的评估几乎仅依赖分类准确率，但准确率不足以表征模型在实际部署中的适用性，需要更全面的多维评估方法。
AI.method: 提出人类中心基准框架（HCBF），从准确率、可解释性、效率、鲁棒性四个维度评估模型。在MRL眼部数据集上对MobileNetV3、ShuffleNetV2、EfficientNet-B0、DeiT-Tiny四种轻量架构进行眼状态分类评估，并计算人类中心评分。
AI.result: 四种模型在干净集上准确率几乎无差异，但各在一个维度领先，均位于帕累托前沿。ShuffleNetV2在三种部署场景下综合排名第一，但在传感器噪声下性能损失过半，且将闭眼误判为睁眼；Transformer模型保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 聚合排名可能掩盖特定维度的脆弱性，而这些维度在操作层面具有决定性意义，强调了多维、人类中心评估的价值。

title: Building Comparative Motivation Profiles with Instrumental Interventions
summary: Safety evaluations often infer latent motivations from behavioral patterns, but the construct validity of these inferences is unclear. We study this problem in alignment faking, where models comply with training objectives more often when they infer training pressure. This behavior is commonly interpreted as strategic self-preservation, but it may also reflect sensitivity to the model's inference about the expectation of researchers conducting the evaluation. We introduce a symmetric intervention framework for distinguishing these competing hypotheses. Instead of directly intervening on "scheming" or "sycophancy", we target instrumental processes entailed by each hypothesis: consequence-tracking and researcher-expectation tracking. We then compare how interventions on these processes affect the alignment faking. We study four openweight model organisms using synthetic document fine-tuning, activation steering, and prompting. Under synthetic document fine-tuning, Llama-3.1-70B, Llama3.1-405B, and Qwen-2.5-72B are more sensitive to expectation-tracking than consequence-tracking interventions. Activation steering on Llama-3.1- 70B supports the same broad picture, and prompt interventions broadly align with SDF profiles. Overall, alignment-faking behavior can be causally sensitive to evaluation-context expectations despite scheming-consistent scratchpads. Scheming and strategic-deception evaluations therefore need construct-validity checks, and symmetric instrumental interventions provide one such test.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI对齐伪装（alignment faking）行为的因果机制，发现模型更受研究者期望追踪（expectation-tracking）影响，而非传统的后果追踪（consequence-tracking）。这表明对齐伪装不一定代表战略性自我保护，而可能反映模型对评估情境预期的敏感性，因此需要构念效度检验。
AI.motivation: 安全评估中常从行为模式推断潜在动机，但构念效度不明确。对齐伪装通常被解释为战略性自我保护，但也可能源于评估者期望感知。需要区分这两种竞争假说。
AI.method: 提出对称性干预框架，不直接干预"诡计"或"谄媚"，而是针对每个假说蕴含的工具性过程：后果追踪（consequence-tracking）和研究者期望追踪（researcher-expectation tracking），比较这些干预如何影响对齐伪装行为。使用合成文档微调、激活引导和提示干预对四种开源模型进行研究。
AI.result: 在合成文档微调下，Llama-3.1-70B、Llama3.1-405B和Qwen-2.5-72B对期望追踪干预比后果追踪干预更敏感。激活引导和提示干预结果与之一致。尽管模型有符合诡计假设的思考过程（scratchpads），对齐伪装行为仍因果性地受到评估情境期望的影响。
AI.conclusion: 对齐伪装行为可能不完全是战略性欺骗，而是对评估情境期望的敏感性。诡计和战略性欺骗评估需要进行构念效度检验，对称性工具性干预提供了这样一种检验方法。

title: What Makes a Desired Graph for Relational Deep Learning?
comment: This article has been accepted by ICML 2026
summary: Relational deep learning (RDL) converts relational databases (RDBs) into heterogeneous graphs, but graphs derived directly from database schemas are often not well suited for how graph neural networks (GNNs) perform relational reasoning. We study what makes a relational graph suitable for deep learning and show that schema-derived graphs suffer from two systematic failures: information overload and semantic fragmentation. Our empirical analysis reveals that the desired graph is not the raw schema, but a result of controlled structural adaptation. Performance depends on balancing two operations: mitigating information overload via filtering, and repairing semantic fragmentation via injection. Specifically, filtering serves as a bias-variance knob with non-monotonic effects, while injection improves performance only when it explicitly restores the relational dependencies missing from the original schema. Based on these findings, we develop an end-to-end structural optimizer that applies both operations to adapt relational graphs automatically. Across 26 tasks spanning classification, regression, and recommendation, the optimized graphs consistently improve accuracy while often reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: 关系深度学习（RDL）将关系数据库（RDB）转换为异构图，但直接基于数据库模式生成的图不适合图神经网络（GNN）的关系推理。研究发现，模式派生图存在信息过载和语义碎片化两大系统性缺陷。理想的图结构需要通过过滤（缓解信息过载）和注入（修复语义碎片）两种操作进行受控的结构适配。基于此，开发了一种端到端的结构优化器，在26个任务上持续提升精度并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有方法直接将关系数据库模式映射为异构图，但这种方式生成的图结构不适合GNN进行关系推理，存在系统性的性能缺陷。
AI.method: 通过实验分析发现模式派生图存在信息过载和语义碎片化两大问题，提出通过过滤（缓解信息过载）和注入（修复语义碎片）两种操作进行结构适配，并开发了端到端的结构优化器自动应用这两种操作。
AI.result: 在26个任务（包括分类、回归和推荐）上，优化后的图结构持续提升模型精度，同时往往降低了推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 关系深度学习中理想的图结构不是原始数据库模式，而是经过受控结构适配的结果。过滤操作具有非单调的偏差-方差权衡效应，注入操作仅在显式恢复原始模式缺失的关系依赖时才有益。

title: ZAS-SQL: Distilling Rules from Failures for Zero-Shot Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL translates natural language into executable SQL queries. Few-shot in-context learning methods built upon large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance, yet their reliance on demonstrations limits cross-domain generalization and consumes substantial context window space. Existing zero-shot methods, lacking effective generation constraints, still fall short of few-shot approaches. We observe that LLM failures in zero-shot Text-to-SQL are not random but exhibit systematic, recurring patterns. Building on this observation, we propose a fully zero-shot Text-to-SQL framework that distills core generation rules from failure cases through a Map-Reduce-based rule distillation pipeline and improves generation quality via three complementary modules: knowledge-augmented schema representation, which supplements missing semantics in Data Definition Language; a rule-driven structured reasoning framework that suppresses structural deviations; and Execution-Guided Early Stopping, which enables low-cost self-correction. On Spider, the proposed framework achieves up to 87.2% and 88.6% execution accuracy on the Dev and Test sets, respectively, establishing a new zero-shot state-of-the-art and surpassing multiple few-shot and fine-tuning methods built upon GPT-4/4o. On the domain-specific dataset UrbanPlan, it achieves 81.3%, confirming that the rule distillation approach generalizes across domains. Moreover, when equipped with a 4B-parameter model, the framework surpasses zero-shot baselines of leading closed-source models, demonstrating strong model generality.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种全零样本Text-to-SQL框架，通过Map-Reduce规则蒸馏管道从失败案例中提取生成规则，并结合知识增强型Schema表示、规则驱动结构化推理和执行引导早停三个模块，在Spider数据集上达到87.2%和88.6%的执行准确率，超越多个少样本和微调方法。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本学习方法依赖演示示例，限制跨领域泛化并消耗大量上下文窗口；零样本方法缺乏有效生成约束，性能仍不及少样本方法。
AI.method: 提出全零样本Text-to-SQL框架，包括：(1) Map-Reduce规则蒸馏管道从失败案例中提取规则；(2) 知识增强型Schema表示补充DDL缺失语义；(3) 规则驱动结构化推理框架抑制结构偏差；(4) 执行引导早停实现低成本自我纠正。
AI.result: 在Spider Dev和Test集上分别达到87.2%和88.6%执行准确率，超越多个基于GPT-4/4o的少样本和微调方法；在领域特定数据集UrbanPlan上达81.3%；使用4B参数模型超越领先闭源模型的零样本基线。
AI.conclusion: 规则蒸馏方法在跨领域和模型泛化方面均表现优异，建立了零样本Text-to-SQL的最新基准。

title: Explaining Black-Box Language Models: Learning to Optimize Linguistically-Structured Word Subsets
summary: As deep language models (DLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, understanding their decision rationale becomes paramount for ensuring trust, safety, and accountability. However, achieving this vital level of interpretability is particularly challenging when these DLMs operate as black-box systems (e.g., via APIs), where access to internal model states (e.g., parameters, gradients) is restricted. Despite numerous efforts, existing explanation methods often fail to concurrently satisfy three key desiderata: (i) inference-time efficiency, (ii) black-box compatibility without inducing out-of-distribution behavior, and (iii) comprehensible explanations grounded in the input's linguistic structure. To address these challenges, we propose a method that explains predictions of DLMs by selecting a small, informative subset of input words. We formulate this as an amortized optimization problem, enabling efficient one-shot inference without the need for input-specific search. Our selection policy is trained via REINFORCE-style policy gradients, allowing discrete word selection in a fully gradient-free setting. To enhance interpretability and align with human linguistic intuition, we integrate graph-structured knowledge into this selection process, fostering linguistically coherent subsets that result in explanations both highly informative and cognitively meaningful to end-users. We evaluated our method on diverse DLM architectures and multiple real-world datasets. It consistently identifies word subsets with enhanced discriminative power and stronger alignment with linguistically salient cues, outperforming both conventional black-box compatible methods and gradient-based approaches that are given oracle access to the black-box model's gradients for a more challenging benchmark. Our code is available at here.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于强化学习的黑盒语言模型解释方法，通过选择输入词子集来高效、可解释地说明模型预测依据，无需访问模型内部状态。
AI.motivation: 深度语言模型在医疗等高风险场景中被广泛部署，理解其决策依据对确保信任、安全和问责至关重要。但现有解释方法难以同时满足推理效率、黑盒兼容性（不引发分布外行为）以及基于输入语言结构的可理解性这三个关键需求。
AI.method: 将选择信息性子集表述为摊销优化问题，实现一次性推理；使用REINFORCE策略梯度进行离散词选择的完全无梯度训练；并引入图结构知识增强所选子集的 linguistic 连贯性和认知可理解性。
AI.result: 在多种DLM架构和真实数据集上，该方法一致地识别出具有更强判别能力和语言显著性的词子集，优于传统黑盒兼容方法，甚至超越了有梯度访问权限的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效实现了高效、黑盒兼容且语言学可解释的模型解释，在性能上超越了现有方法，包括那些拥有更多模型内部信息的基线。

title: Phase Marginalization for Patch-Grid Instability in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers operate on fixed patch grids, which can introduce phase-dependent instability for dense prediction: changing the patch partition can change the token evidence available to a pixel, especially near boundaries. We formalize patch-grid phase as a nuisance variable and propose Phase Marginalization, a post-hoc marginalization method that evaluates structured patch-grid phases, inverse-aligns dense outputs, and aggregates them in the original image coordinate system. The central variant, Uniform Phase Marginalization with K = 4, is training-free and improves over the canonical K = 1 baseline across measured segmentation, depth, and local matching settings. In a controlled Cityscapes experiment, Uniform Phase Marginalization provides a modest compute-matched advantage over generic shift-based four-forward test-time augmentation (TTA) (+0.31 mean Intersection-over-Union over the strongest tested generic row). A scaling study further shows that K = 4 is a practical cost-accuracy trade-off: K = 8 is essentially unchanged and K = 16 adds little accuracy at much higher latency. These results position patch-grid phase as a measurable nuisance variable and Phase Marginalization as a simple diagnostic and post-hoc marginalization baseline for dense ViT prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出Phase Marginalization方法，通过后验边缘化多个patch网格相位来消除Vision Transformer在密集预测任务中的相位依赖不稳定性，K=4时无需训练即可提升分割、深度估计和局部匹配性能。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer在固定patch网格上操作，patch分割方式的变化会导致像素级别的证据不一致，尤其边界附近，这种相位依赖的不稳定性影响密集预测任务的准确性。
AI.method: 将patch网格相位视为 nuisance变量，提出后验边缘化方法Phase Marginalization：评估多种结构化patch网格相位，反向对齐密集输出，并在原图像坐标系中聚合结果。核心变体Uniform Phase Marginalization with K=4无需训练。
AI.result: K=4在Cityscapes实验中比标准K=1基线有提升，且优于基于移位的四前向测试时增强（TTA），IoU高出0.31。K=8结果基本不变，K=16精度提升很小但延迟大幅增加。
AI.conclusion: patch网格相位是可测量的 nuisance变量，Phase Marginalization可作为密集ViT预测的简单诊断和后验边缘化基线方法。

title: Standpoint Logics with Defeasible Beliefs
summary: In this paper, we integrate the defeasible logic of Kraus, Lehmann and Magidor (KLM) with the standpoint logic framework of Gómez Álvarez and Rudolph. This is done with the goal of formally expressing knowledge taking into account multiple (possibly contradicting) viewpoints, which in turn may hold defeasible beliefs. In doing so, we utilise Defeasible Restricted Standpoint Logics (DRSL), introduced by Leisegang et al. Our work expands on previous work by providing a foundational representation result for DRSL semantics and systematically lifting several well-known entailment relations from the propositional case to the standpoint-enhanced setting. In particular, we characterise the semantics for DRSL through a set of KLM-style postulates adapted for the standpoints case. We furthermore provide a means to lift preferential entailment, and the class of entailment relations based on single ranking functions from the purely propositional to the standpoint-enhanced context, including rational and lexicographic closure. We show this can be done equivalently through semantic and algorithmic means. Furthermore, we show that, for each considered form of entailment, the complexity class of entailment checking does not change when moving from propositional KLM to DRSL.

AI.tldr: 本文将KLM可废止逻辑与立场逻辑框架相结合，提出DRSL（可废止受限立场逻辑），通过KLM风格公理化、偏好蕴涵提升及复杂度分析，系统建立了支持多视角可废止推理的形式化框架。
AI.motivation: 现有逻辑框架难以同时处理多个可能矛盾的视角以及其中的可废止信念，需要一种统一的形式化方法来表达和推理这类知识。
AI.method: 1. 基于Leisegang等人的DRSL，为DRSL语义提供基础表示结果；2. 将KLIM风格公设适配到立场场景；3. 通过语义和算法两种方式，将偏好蕴涵及基于单排序函数的蕴涵关系（包括理性闭包和词典闭包）从命题层面提升到立场增强语境。
AI.result: 1. 给出了DRSL语义的KLM风格公设刻画；2. 实现了偏好蕴涵及多种蕴涵关系向立场增强语境的提升；3. 证明了在从命题KLM转向DRSL时，每种蕴涵检查的复杂度类保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 成功建立了支持多视角可废止推理的DRSL框架，其语义有清晰的公理基础，各种蕴涵关系可有效计算且复杂度可控，为处理矛盾视角下的常识推理提供了理论支撑。

title: Gravity-guided Contact Dynamics Estimation from 3D Human Motions
summary: Ground contact forces acting on the human body, are crucial for biomechanics studies or sport performance analysis. Prior methods rely on force plates or pressure mats to collect ground contact dynamics, limiting their applicability to carefully controlled settings. A more scalable solution is to estimate the dynamics directly from motion capture data. Recent approaches only roughly estimate the ground contact dynamics from the vertical distance between the body and the ground plane, which cannot capture the complex pressure distribution of all contact points. To this end, we propose GraCE -- Gravity-guided Contact Dynamics Estimation, a novel full-body contact dynamics model for human motions using a realistic influence of body mass distribution and gravity. We use the human's center of gravity to estimate the ground contacts based on its relative distance to the human body. The applied force on each contact is estimated via the product of predicted contact probabilities and the total exterior force computed from the center of mass trajectory. We outperform related work on the GroundLink dataset for ground reaction force estimation, and on the MOYO dataset for detailed contact pressure prediction. The code is published upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出GraCE模型，利用人体重心和重力引导，从运动捕捉数据中估计地面接触力与压力分布，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖测力台或压力垫，限制于受控环境；而仅从垂直距离估计地面接触动力学的方法无法捕捉复杂的压力分布。因此需要一种更可扩展且更精确的全身接触动力学估计方法。
AI.method: 利用人体重心与身体的相对距离估计地面接触，通过预测接触概率与质心轨迹计算的总外力之积来估计每个接触点的作用力。
AI.result: 在GroundLink数据集上地面反力估计优于相关工作，在MOYO数据集上详细接触压力预测也优于已有方法。
AI.conclusion: GraCE能够从运动捕捉数据中有效估计地面接触动力学，无需专用力测量设备，具有更强的可扩展性和实用性。

title: Scaffold Effects on GAIA: A Controlled Comparison
summary: Published agent capability scores conflate what a model can do with what its scaffold lets it do, and the magnitude of this elicitation gap is not well characterized under controlled conditions. This study executes a pre-registered controlled comparison of three scaffolds (ReAct, a Planner-Actor-Rater multi-agent design, and planner-then-executor) across five models from three providers (Claude Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5; Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview; GPT-5.5) on GAIA validation Levels 1 and 2, holding tasks and conditions fixed, with three attempts per question. Scaffold choice alone moves measured accuracy by as much as 28 percentage points within a single model (Opus, Level 2, robust slice), confirming the pre-registered hypothesis that scaffold variation produces gaps of at least 10 points. The pre-registered prediction that more capable models would be less scaffold-sensitive is rejected in direction: scaffold effects vary significantly by model in every dataset slice, but the most capable Anthropic model gains the most from structured scaffolds at the harder level, and tier-scaling holds only at Level 1 under the robust slice. The multi-agent advantage over ReAct at Level 2 appears within the Anthropic family but not for the cross-provider models, making model family rather than capability tier the conditioning variable, and the predicted planner-executor advantage on file-reading tasks is falsified. Structured scaffolds make fewer tool calls yet recover more often from mid-trajectory errors at the harder level, and a single cell (Gemini with planner-then-executor) is the cheapest at both levels and the most accurate at Level 2. These results indicate that single-scaffold capability numbers are scaffold-conditional estimates and that the elicitation gap is not guaranteed to shrink as models improve.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过预注册的对照实验，比较了三种不同脚手架（ReAct、多智能体设计、规划-执行）在五个模型上的表现，发现脚手架选择本身可使同一模型的准确率差异高达28个百分点，且更强大的模型并非对脚手架更不敏感，单一脚手架的评测结果实际上是脚手架条件化的估计。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体能力评分混淆了模型本身能力与脚手架带来的能力，这一"诱发差距"在受控条件下的程度尚未得到充分刻画。
AI.method: 预注册的受控比较实验：三种脚手架（ReAct、Planner-Actor-Rater多智能体设计、规划-执行）×五个模型（Claude Opus 4.7/Sonnet 4.6/Haiku 4.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、GPT-5.5）×GAIA Level 1和2验证集，每个问题3次尝试，保持任务和条件固定。
AI.result: 脚手架选择可使同一模型准确率差异达28个百分点；预注册假设（更强模型对脚手架更不敏感）被证伪；多智能体优势在Anthropic模型族内成立但跨提供商模型不成立；结构化脚手架在更困难级别上调用工具更少但错误恢复更成功。
AI.conclusion: 单脚手架能力分数是脚手架条件化的估计值，且随着模型改进，诱发差距并不一定会缩小。

title: IMAGINE: Adaptive Schema-Imagery Enhanced Composition for Composed Video Retrieval
summary: Composed Video Retrieval (CVR) is designed to retrieve a target video that matches a reference video modified by a modification text. While existing methods explore cross-modal correspondences, they often assume modified objects appear directly in videos. However, modification texts frequently describe concepts not explicitly presented but implicitly expressed through semantically related visual cues (e.g., "cake" implying "birthday party"). Current approaches typically rely on aligning explicit feature representations within the concrete space, neglecting critical latent associations. To address this, we propose an adaptIve scheMa-ImAGery enhanced composItional NEtwork (IMAGINE). Unlike standard explicit matching, IMAGINE materializes implicit semantics (termed schema imagery) via dynamic multimodal prototypes. These prototypes capture shared latent concepts to adaptively modulate visual features, effectively injecting implicit guidance into the retrieval process. By bridging the gap between explicit visual contents and implicit retrieval intentions, IMAGINE achieves state-of-the-art performance in both CVR and Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) across three widely used benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出IMAGINE网络，通过动态多模态原型捕获隐式语义（如"蛋糕"暗示"生日派对"），弥合显式视觉内容与隐式检索意图之间的鸿沟，在组合视频/图像检索任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有组合视频检索方法假设修改文本描述的概念直接出现在视频中，忽略了文本中隐式表达的语义（如"蛋糕"暗示"生日派对"），导致模型无法捕获关键的潜在关联。
AI.method: 提出IMAGINE网络，通过动态多模态原型（schema imagery）来物化隐式语义，并利用这些原型自适应地调制视觉特征，将隐式引导注入检索过程。
AI.result: 在组合视频检索（CVR）和组合图像检索（CIR）的三个广泛使用的基准上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: IMAGINE通过桥接显式视觉内容与隐式检索意图之间的鸿沟，有效提升了组合检索任务的性能。

title: TLRD: Teaching LLMs to Reason over Tabular Data with Tri-Level Rationale Distillation
summary: Tabular data is a primary medium for storing real-world information, driving many industrial applications of machine learning. Traditional predictors achieve strong predictive performance but do not provide readable, case-specific explanations essential for decision-making. Large Language Models (LLMs) can naturally bridge this gap by generating predictions alongside explanations. However, dataset-specific patterns, such as feature distributions and interactions, make tabular data difficult for LLMs to understand and reason over, while label-only fine-tuning improves performance at the cost of catastrophic forgetting. To address this problem, we propose Tri-Level Rationale Distillation (TLRD), a framework that converts label-only tabular datasets into structured rationale supervision for LLMs. TLRD uses a high-capacity teacher to synthesize a rationale corpus grounded in three complementary levels of evidence: instance-level feature, dataset-level distributional context, and comparison-level retrieved neighbors, then distills the rationale into student LLMs, enabling zero-overhead prediction and grounded explanation from raw features only. Experiments on multiple domain datasets show that TLRD significantly closes the performance gap between LLMs and state-of-the-art tree ensembles while producing grounded and readable explanations, offering a valuable reference for high-stakes decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出三层次原理蒸馏框架(TLRD)，将表格数据转换为结构化原理用于LLM推理，在保持可解释性的同时缩小了与树集成模型的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 传统表格数据预测器性能强但缺乏可读性解释；LLM虽能生成解释，但难以理解表格数据的特征分布和交互模式，且标签微调会导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: TLRD框架包含三个证据层次：实例级特征、数据集级分布上下文、比较级检索邻居。使用高容量教师模型合成原理语料，再蒸馏到学生LLM中，实现从原始特征直接进行零开销预测和可解释推理。
AI.result: 在多个领域数据集上，TLRD显著缩小了LLM与顶尖树集成模型之间的性能差距，同时生成有依据且可读的解释。
AI.conclusion: TLRD为高 stakes 决策提供了一种兼顾预测性能与可解释性的有效方案。

title: VESTA: A Fully Automated Scenario Generation and Safety Evaluation Framework for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evolving from simple text-based interaction systems into LLM agents that can maintain memory, use tools, access external environments, and execute tasks. As their capabilities and autonomy expand, the safety risks they face also become more diverse. Existing evaluations often rely on manually written scenarios, static prompts, or final-output judgments, making it difficult to capture the diverse risks that agents may face during task execution. We introduce VESTA, a fully automated scenario generation and safety evaluation framework for LLM agents. Based on five risk dimensions, VESTA instantiaes abstract and diverse safety risks in real-world task execution into 1,072 measurable evaluation scenarios. Using the automated evaluation pipeline, 12 LLM agents are evaluated under two authority contexts. The results show that current agents still face substantial behavioral safety risks during task execution, with an average ASR of 47.1% and several models exceeding 70%. These findings demonstrate the importance of executable, process-level evaluation for understanding and improving LLM agent safety.

AI.tldr: VESTA是一个针对LLM智能体的全自动化场景生成与安全评估框架，包含1072个可测量评估场景，实验发现当前智能体在任务执行中平均安全风险率为47.1%，部分模型超过70%。
AI.motivation: 现有评估依赖人工编写场景、静态提示或最终输出判断，难以捕捉LLM智能体在任务执行过程中面临多样化安全风险。
AI.method: 基于五个风险维度，自动化生成1072个可测量的评估场景，并在两种权威上下文下对12个LLM智能体进行评估。
AI.result: 当前智能体在任务执行中平均ASR（攻击成功率）为47.1%，多个模型超过70%，表明存在显著的行为安全风险。
AI.conclusion: 可执行的、过程级的评估对于理解和提升LLM智能体安全性至关重要。

title: Property-Informed Diffusion-Based Text-to-Microstructure Generation
comment: Published in CVPR2026, Code is at: https://github.com/hongsong-wang/PropDiff-TMG
summary: Designing 3D metamaterial microstructures that meet the intended functions remains a major challenge, as it typically requires domain expertise, iterative simulations, and extensive manual tuning. Existing work on inverse design that automatically generates microstructures based on desired target properties often suffers from limited design diversity and faces challenges in ensuring the physical feasibility of the generated structures. To address this issue, a property-informed diffusion-based network is proposed that enables the generation of 3D microstructures directly from textual descriptions. Unlike traditional property conditioning methods, our approach leverages rich guidance in terms of semantics and physical properties in the text input to support diverse structure synthesis. To enforce consistency between the generated structures and the target textual prompts, a dual alignment strategy is adopted, including contrastive text-structure alignment and test-time reward-guided alignment. Experimental results show that the model is capable of generating semantically meaningful and physically plausible structures across a wide range of material categories. Our approach has good potential for interactive microstructure design and opens up new directions for combining language-based interfaces with inverse material discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/hongsong-wang/PropDiff-TMG

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的性质信息驱动网络，能够从文本描述直接生成3D微结构，采用双对齐策略实现文本与结构的一致性，生成语义合理且物理可行的结构。
AI.motivation: 现有逆向设计方法在生成3D微结构时设计多样性有限，且难以保证生成结构的物理可行性，需要一种能够从文本描述直接生成多样且物理可行结构的方法。
AI.method: 提出性质信息驱动的扩散网络，利用文本输入中的语义和物理性质信息进行引导，采用对比文本-结构对齐和测试时奖励引导对齐的双对齐策略。
AI.result: 模型能够在多种材料类别上生成语义合理且物理可行的结构，支持交互式微结构设计。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为结合语言接口与逆向材料发现开辟了新方向，具有交互式微结构设计的良好潜力。

title: DN-Hypo-Pipeline: An AI-Driven Workflow for Hypothesis Generation via Large Language Models and Scientific Explanations
summary: A scientific hypothesis is the first step in research and undergoes experimental validation, yet it also reflects a deep understanding of and reasoning about scientific phenomena. We introduce DN-Hypo-Pipeline, an AI-powered workflow based on large language models, designed to support structured scientific thinking and hypothesis generation by leveraging scientific explanations as prior knowledge. This pipeline assists researchers in deriving novel hypotheses from existing literature. Given the explanandum (i.e., the conclusion) of a research paper, it identifies underlying laws, theories, and principles, and reconstructs a new, yet-to-be-verified explanation for the observed phenomenon. We evaluated DN-Hypo-Pipeline in the field of data science modeling using three highly cited papers. Statistical inference, supported by both LLM-as-judge assessment and human expert evaluation, demonstrates that our pipeline is more effective than direct generation methods. Additionally, we validated the two highest-scoring generated hypotheses by developing corresponding novel algorithms, which outperformed the baseline models presented in the original papers. Beyond application in data science, DN-Hypo-Pipeline provides a theoretical framework that not only encompasses theory-guided data science modeling methods but also reveals a more fundamental structure of the modeling process. Moreover, this approach is essentially a generalization of theory-guided modeling, offering potential for extension to other domains and across a broader range of scientific disciplines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DN-Hypo-Pipeline，一种基于大语言模型的AI工作流，通过利用科学解释作为先验知识，帮助研究人员从现有文献中推导出新颖的科学假设，并在数据科学建模领域验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 科学假设是研究的第一步，需要实验验证，同时也反映了对科学现象的深入理解和推理。现有方法难以系统性地从文献中生成新颖且合理的科学假设。
AI.method: 提出DN-Hypo-Pipeline，基于大语言模型的工作流：给定论文的解释项（结论），识别底层规律、理论和原理，重构新的待验证的科学现象解释。在数据科学建模领域，使用三篇高被引论文进行评估。
AI.result: 通过LLM-as-judge评估和人类专家评估，该流水线比直接生成方法更有效。两个得分最高的生成假设被开发为对应算法，性能超过了原论文中的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: DN-Hypo-Pipeline不仅适用于数据科学，还提供了一个理论框架，涵盖了理论指导的数据科学建模方法，并揭示了建模过程的更基本结构。该方法本质上是理论指导建模的泛化，有望扩展到其他科学领域。

title: RAPID: Layer-Wise Redundancy-Aware Pruning and Importance-Driven Token Merging for Efficient ViT
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance but suffer from high computational costs due to quadratic self-attention complexity. Although token reduction techniques such as pruning and merging mitigate this, they typically overlook how representations evolve across network depth. We propose RAPID, a depth-aware token reduction framework that adapts reduction strategies to the layer-wise characteristics of token representations. The primary methodological contribution is a bifurcated strategy: in shallow-to-middle layers, RAPID employs a redundancy-similarity aware pruning metric to eliminate over-represented local patterns. As features transition to global semantic concepts in deeper layers, the framework shifts to an importance-similarity aware merging mechanism. This stage leverages classification (CLS) token attention weights to protect semantically critical tokens while fusing less important but similar neighbors. Empirical validation on ImageNet-1K using ViT and DeiT architectures demonstrates that RAPID establishes a superior accuracy-compression Pareto frontier compared to plug-and-play baselines such as ToMe and ToFu. RAPID is particularly robust in aggressive compression regimes, achieving up to 4.29% higher accuracy than ToMe at extreme reduction rates. Our framework provides a training-free template for optimizing vision models by aligning reduction strategies with hierarchical feature evolution.

AI.tldr: RAPID是一个深度感知的token缩减框架，根据网络层深度自适应调整缩减策略：浅中层使用冗余-相似度感知剪枝，深层使用重要性-相似度感知融合，在ImageNet-1K上相比ToMe和ToFu实现了更优的精度-压缩帕累托前沿，尤其在高压缩率下表现突出。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer虽性能优异，但自注意力机制的二次复杂度导致计算成本高昂。现有token缩减技术（如剪枝、融合）忽略了特征表示随网络深度演化的特性，无法在不同层级自适应调整策略。
AI.method: 提出双阶段策略：浅到中层采用冗余-相似度感知剪枝指标，消除过度表示的局部模式；深层特征转向全局语义概念时，切换为基于CLS注意力权重的重要性-相似度感知融合机制，保护语义关键token的同时融合不重要的相似邻居。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上使用ViT和DeiT架构验证，RAPID相比ToMe和ToFu等即插即用基线建立了更优的精度-压缩帕累托前沿，在极端压缩率下比ToMe准确率提升高达4.29%。
AI.conclusion: RAPID提供了无需重新训练的训练免费模板，通过将缩减策略与层级特征演化对齐来优化视觉模型，在高压缩率下具有显著鲁棒性。

title: Chiaroscuro Attention: Spending Compute in the Dark
summary: Standard transformers apply self-attention uniformly at every layer and token, regardless of whether the input requires dynamic cross-token interaction. We propose CHIAR-Former (Chiaroscuro Attention), a 4-layer hybrid transformer that routes each token to one of three operators - DCT spectral mixing, RBF kernel mixing, or full self-attention - based on per-token spectral entropy, a theoretically justified complexity signal. Through systematic ablation on WikiText-103, we discover routing collapse: the router consistently rejects RBF in favour of DCT and attention, revealing that spectral mixing and dynamic attention are complementary and sufficient.
