A purpose-designed DCT+Attention-only variant achieves Val PPL 36.54 on WikiText-103 - a 45% improvement over a full-attention baseline (PPL 66.62) at 62.5% fewer attention FLOPs. We extend evaluation to WikiText-2, IMDB sentiment classification, and synthetic ListOps operations, establishing a clear operating regime: CHIAR-Former excels on large-scale naturalistic text where token diversity supports spectral specialisation, while full attention retains an edge on small datasets and synthetic pattern-matching tasks. These findings - both the wins and the losses - together define when and why spectral routing earns its keep.

AI.tldr: 提出CHIAR-Former，一种基于光谱熵的令牌路由混合Transformer，在WikiText-103上以62.5%更少的注意力FLOPs实现了45%的困惑度改进，并揭示了路由坍缩现象——RBF被拒绝，DCT和注意力互补即可。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer在所有层和所有令牌上均匀应用自注意力，无论输入是否需要动态的跨令牌交互，这导致了计算浪费。作者希望设计一个能根据令牌复杂度动态路由到不同算子的高效混合架构。
AI.method: 提出4层混合Transformer CHIAR-Former，基于每个令牌的光谱熵（理论上有依据的复杂度信号），将令牌路由到三种算子之一：DCT频谱混合、RBF核混合或全自注意力。通过系统消融发现路由坍缩，最终采用DCT+Attention双算子变体。
AI.result: 在WikiText-103上Val PPL达到36.54（全注意力基线66.62），提升45%，同时减少62.5%的注意力FLOPs。在WikiText-2、IMDB情感分类和ListOps上验证了适用范围：在大规模自然文本上优势显著，在小数据集和合成任务上全注意力仍占优。
AI.conclusion: 光谱路由在大规模自然语言文本中有效，光谱混合与动态注意力具有互补性且足以替代RBF；路由的有效性取决于数据集的规模和令牌多样性，研究同时界定了方法的适用边界（胜利与失败情况共同定义了方法的适用条件）。

title: AgentTrust: A Self-Improving Trust Layer for AI-Agent Actions
summary: AI agents increasingly take consequential actions -- shell commands, cloud operations, and arbitrary tool-calls -- so a trust layer must decide, per action, whether to allow, warn, block, or escalate. We argue that the right way to reason about such a layer is by threat type. Lexical (fixed-signature) threats, where danger lives in a stable token, are decidable by deterministic rules; semantic (intent-dependent) threats, where a benign and a malicious action share the same surface, are out of reach for rules by construction. We make this concrete with a negative proof: a determined, hand-authored cloud rule pack lifts held-out accuracy only 48 to 56% overall and moves the semantic categories by 0pp (data_db 29 to 29, observability 59 to 59, supply_chain 50 to 50), while a strong LLM judge carries exactly those categories. We give the judge a self-learning capability: on a corpus that is mainly semantic attacks it nearly doubles rule accuracy (48% to 83.6-85.2%) with near-zero false-blocks, and this holds across two model providers. We turn this into a self-improving dual-store system: the judge distills a growing deterministic rule floor on lexical threats (cheaper over time) and feeds a guarded RAG memory on semantic threats (a verdict-cache fails -- surface-twins collapse to ~58% -- so a corroboration guard lifts semantic accuracy +13pp, 70 to 84). The result is what sets AgentTrust v2 apart from its static v1 predecessor: a trust layer that self-evolves from its own stream of decisions -- cheaper on the lexical class (it distils its own rules) and smarter on the semantic class (it accrues guarded precedent), while never hard-blocking a benign action. An end-to-end online replay shows the judge-call rate falling (50% to 44%) and judge-domain accuracy rising (71% to 80%), with 0 benign hard-blocks across 45,000 actions.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentTrust v2，一种双存储自进化信任层，通过LLM裁判+规则蒸馏+守卫RAG内存，在45000次操作中实现0误拦，语义威胁准确率从48%提升至84%，裁判调用率从50%降至44%。
AI.motivation: AI代理执行的工具调用（如shell命令、云操作）日益关键，需要信任层按动作决定允许/警告/阻止/升级。现有方法对语义威胁（相同表面但意图不同）束手无策，规则方法在语义类别上准确率提升为0pp，亟需新方案。
AI.method: 提出双存储系统：(1) 对词法威胁，LLM裁判蒸馏为确定性规则（降低成本）；(2) 对语义威胁，构建带守卫的RAG内存（包含佐证校验，避免表面孪生导致的失效）。系统在线自我进化，从不硬拦良性操作。
AI.result: 手写规则包准确率仅48→56%（语义类别0pp提升）；LLM裁判达83.6-85.2%；加守卫的RAG内存提升语义准确率+13pp（70→84）；端到端回放中裁判调用率从50%降至44%，准确率从71%升至80%，45000次操作0良性硬拦。
AI.conclusion: 信任层应按威胁类型分类处理：词法威胁用确定性规则高效处理，语义威胁依赖LLM裁判+守卫记忆。AgentTrust v2通过自我进化实现了成本降低与智能提升的双赢，验证了"从不误拦良性操作"的设计原则。

title: How Much MRI Preprocessing Is Enough? A Cost-Utility Study for Brain MRI Foundation Models
summary: MRI preprocessing defines the input distribution seen by brain MRI foundation models, yet it is usually treated as routine data cleaning rather than a modeling choice. We ask how much preprocessing is worth its computational cost for self-supervised 3D MRI pretraining. Keeping the corpus, 3D ViT backbone, masking protocol, and downstream evaluations fixed, we compare a graded P0-P7 preprocessing spectrum for masked autoencoding (MAE) and joint-embedding predictive learning (JEPA) on 20,000 heterogeneous brain MRI volumes, then transfer the encoders to IDH prediction, MCI classification, brain age regression, and GLI/PED tumor segmentation. The results do not support a simple "more is better" rule. P0/P1 are numerically unstable, making P2 the lowest-cost feasible level; beyond P2, choosing the best feasible preprocessing level improves aggregate utility by only 3.4 percentage points for MAE and 1.8 percentage points for JEPA, with most paired gains statistically unresolved. Stronger preprocessing is beneficial only in selected regimes: IDH improves modestly, AGE and GLI/PED are often near or best at P2, and MCI shows the clearest empirical P7 gain. Cross-level MCI transfer further shows that much of the P7 advantage can be recovered by applying stronger preprocessing downstream, without requiring P7 throughout pretraining. These findings recast MRI preprocessing as a downstream-aware cost-utility decision rather than a default escalation pipeline. Code is available at https://github.com/PangJiangShuan/PreBrain.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了3D脑MRI自监督预训练中，不同预处理强度（P0-P7）对模型性能与计算成本的影响，发现并不存在简单的"越强越好"规律，最低可行水平P2即可达到接近最优效果，更强的预处理仅在特定下游任务中有小幅提升，且部分预处理收益可通过下游阶段补充实现。
AI.motivation: MRI预处理通常被视为常规数据清洗步骤，而非建模选择。本文旨在系统量化不同预处理强度对自监督3D MRI预训练的成本效益，为预处理策略提供科学依据。
AI.method: 固定语料、3D ViT骨干网络、掩码协议和下游评估，在20,000个异构脑MRI体数据上比较P0-P7共8个预处理级别的MAE和JEPA两种自监督方法，并将编码器迁移到IDH预测、MCI分类、脑龄回归和肿瘤分割四个下游任务上进行评估。
AI.result: P0/P1数值不稳定，P2是最低可行水平；超出P2后，选择最佳预处理级别对MAE仅提升3.4个百分点、JEPA提升1.8个百分点，且多数差异不显著。不同任务表现各异：IDH有适度提升，AGE和GLI/PED在P2附近最优，MCI在P7有明显优势。跨级别迁移实验表明P7的大部分优势可通过下游强化预处理恢复。
AI.conclusion: MRI预处理应视为下游感知的成本-效用决策，而非默认的升级流程。预处理并非越强越好，P2是一个性价比高的基线选择。

title: CATPO: Critique-Augmented Tree Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a dominant paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Recent tree-based methods such as TreeRPO extend flat trajectory sampling with tree-structured rollouts to obtain dense, step-level reward signals without a separate process reward model. However, not all trees are equally informative: trees where all leaves succeed, all leaves fail, or the policy already predicts the reward distribution contribute little to gradient updates, wasting compute. We introduce CATPO (Critique-Augmented Tree Policy Optimization), which diagnoses and addresses this waste at the tree level. CATPO first scores each tree via a tree informativeness score, F(T), combining leaf-outcome diversity with policy-reward decorrelation at zero extra compute. For dead-wrong trees where all branches fail, CATPO applies critique-guided healing: it locates the shallowest failure point, generates a natural-language critique, and grafts refined continuations to recover training signal. Finally, an informativeness-weighted loss scales each tree's gradient contribution by its normalized score, concentrating parameter updates on the most informative trees while preserving overall gradient magnitude. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B trained with the MATH dataset show that CATPO achieves 37.5% macro accuracy across four benchmarks (AIME24, MATH-500, OlympiadBench, and MinervaMath), improving over TreeRPO by 1.9% and GRPO by 4.8%.

AI.tldr: CATPO通过树级信息量评分、批评引导修复和信息量加权损失，解决了树结构RLVR中低效树浪费计算的问题，在数学推理任务上优于TreeRPO和GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有树结构RLVR方法（如TreeRPO）中，并非所有树都提供有效梯度信息——全成功、全失败或策略已能预测奖励分布的树对训练贡献很小，浪费大量计算资源。
AI.method: 1) 提出树信息量评分F(T)，结合叶子结果多样性和策略-奖励去相关性（零额外计算）；2) 对于全失败的树，定位最浅失败点并生成自然语言批评，嫁接改进的续写来恢复训练信号；3) 信息量加权损失，按归一化分数缩放每棵树的梯度贡献。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上，MATH数据集训练，四个基准（AIME24、MATH-500、OlympiadBench、MinervaMath）的宏平均准确率达37.5%，比TreeRPO提高1.9%，比GRPO提高4.8%。
AI.conclusion: CATPO通过识别和利用高信息量树、修复低效树，显著提升了树结构RLVR的训练效率，证明了树级智能计算分配的有效性。

title: PAEC: Position-Aware Entropy Calibration for LLM Reasoning in RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves large language model reasoning but often suffers from rapid policy-entropy collapse, where the policy prematurely concentrates on narrow high-probability reasoning paths. While global entropy regularization can encourage exploration, uniformly increasing entropy across all token positions is inefficient for long reasoning trajectories, where many tokens are not decision-relevant. We propose Position-Aware Entropy Calibration (PAEC), a token-level entropy-management framework that constructs a soft mask from local top-p entropy and top-two candidate competition, and applies an anchor-based lower-bound penalty to prevent selected-position entropy collapse. Experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that PAEC improves macro-average majority-vote performance over strong RLVR baselines, with clear gains on AIME-style tasks. Our results suggest that entropy management in reasoning RL should be formulated as selective exploration allocation over decision-sensitive positions rather than uniform randomness injection.

AI.tldr: 提出位置感知熵校准（PAEC），通过软掩码和锚定下界惩罚防止强化学习推理中的策略熵崩溃，在数学推理基准上提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法在长推理轨迹中因策略熵过早崩溃而陷入局部最优，全局熵正则化对所有token均匀处理效率低下，忽略了决策敏感位置与非决策位置的差异。
AI.method: PAEC框架包含两个核心组件：1）基于局部top-p熵和top-two候选竞争构建软掩码，识别决策敏感位置；2）对选定位置施加锚定下界惩罚，防止熵崩溃。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准上，PAEC在宏观平均多数投票性能上超过强RLVR基线，在AIME类任务上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 推理强化学习中的熵管理应转化为对决策敏感位置的选择性探索分配，而非均匀随机性注入。

title: Empowering Feed-Forward Reconstruction Models with Metric Scale via Satellite Images
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have recently shown strong generalization across diverse scenes, yet most of them recover geometry only up to an unknown global scale. This scale ambiguity limits their use in applications that require metric understanding of the environment. Existing metric reconstruction methods commonly rely on large-scale metric annotations or accurate camera calibration, both of which are costly or unreliable in many real-world settings. We propose a satellite-guided framework for resolving scale ambiguity in feed-forward 3D reconstruction. The key idea is to use readily available satellite imagery as a global metric reference. Given a coarse camera pose, our method retrieves a local satellite patch and integrates it with a feed-forward reconstruction backbone through bidirectional cross-view interaction. By enforcing consistency between the reconstructed scene and the satellite reference, the model infers absolute scale, refines scene geometry, and estimates camera pose in a metric coordinate frame. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Oxford RobotCar show consistent improvements in metric depth estimation, multi-view point-cloud reconstruction, and cross-view camera localization, while preserving strong generalization across datasets and geographic regions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种卫星引导的框架，利用卫星图像作为全局度量参考，解决前馈3D重建中的尺度模糊问题，实现度量级场景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D重建模型泛化能力强，但重建几何存在未知全局尺度模糊，限制了需要度量理解的应用；而现有度量重建方法依赖大规模度量标注或精确相机标定，成本高且不可靠。
AI.method: 利用易获取的卫星图像作为全局度量参考；给定粗略相机位姿后，检索局部卫星图像，通过双向交叉视图交互与前馈重建骨干网络集成；强制重建场景与卫星参考之间的一致性，推断绝对尺度、优化场景几何并估计相机位姿。
AI.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Oxford RobotCar数据集上，在度量深度估计、多视图点云重建和跨视图相机定位方面取得一致改进，同时保持了跨数据集和地理区域的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 卫星图像作为全局度量参考可有效解决尺度模糊问题，为无需昂贵标注的度量级3D重建提供了可行方案。

title: Tensorizing Engram: Sharing Latents Across N-Gram Embeddings is Beneficial in LLMs
summary: Modern language models represent text using discrete token-level embeddings, which forces recurring multi-token patterns to be learned implicitly across Transformer layers. Both Over-tokenized Transformers and Engram attempt to address this limitation by explicitly incorporating multi-token (n-gram) memories. However, they rely on separate hash tables for each n-gram order, which introduces hash collisions and prevents nested n-grams from sharing the underlying latent structures. To address these issues, we propose Tensorized Engram (TN-gram), a compact memory module that represents tensorized n-gram embeddings through shared factors in the Canonical Polyadic (CP) form. TN-gram learns shared token-position factors together with order-absorption vectors to encode the embeddings of different n-gram order. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that TN-gram matches or even outperforms Engram-style n-gram modules while requiring much fewer parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TN-gram，一种通过CP分解共享因子来紧凑表示n-gram嵌入的新型记忆模块，在减少参数的同时匹配或超越现有Engram方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（Over-tokenized Transformers和Engram）使用独立的哈希表表示不同阶数的n-gram记忆，导致哈希碰撞问题，且无法让嵌套n-gram共享底层潜在结构。
AI.method: 提出Tensorized Engram (TN-gram)，利用Canonical Polyadic (CP)分解形式，通过共享的token-位置因子和阶数吸收向量来编码不同阶数的n-gram嵌入，形成一个紧凑的记忆模块。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，TN-gram在匹配或超越Engram风格n-gram模块性能的同时，所需参数量显著更少。
AI.conclusion: TN-gram通过张量分解技术有效解决了n-gram记忆的哈希冲突和结构共享问题，实现了参数高效且性能优异的多token记忆表示。

title: Quantitative Promise Theory: Intentionality and Inference in Autonomous Agents
summary: I discuss some quantitative representations of Promise Theory for processes involving autonomous agents. Agent models are common in software systems, machine learning, and biology, for example, but may also apply to physics and other forms of engineering. I describe how Bayesian probability and information theoretic optimization, including Active Inference, may be incorporated with promise semantics -- as well as how Promise Theory supplements solutions, helping to avoid probability's pitfalls, which include non-local coordination, calibrating, and normalizing probabilistic computations. The role of boundary conditions in constraining allowed states and selecting decision thresholds is a form of promise, and agent alignment provides a scalable definition of intent. Autonomous agents may congeal into swarms with superagent characteristics by trying to minimize their information, despite uncertainty that works to maximize it. The use of Promise Theory involves some research challenges as well as stylistic preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Promise Theory与贝叶斯概率、主动推理等方法的结合，用于量化表示自主智能体系统中的承诺语义，并分析了边界条件、智能体对齐及信息优化等问题。
AI.motivation: 为自主智能体系统提供一种基于Promise Theory的定量表示框架，克服传统概率方法在非局部协调、校准和归一化方面的缺陷。
AI.method: 将Promise Theory与贝叶斯概率、信息论优化（包括主动推理）相结合，利用边界条件作为承诺形式来约束状态空间和决策阈值。
AI.result: 自主智能体通过最小化信息可聚合成具有超级智能体特征的群体；承诺理论补充了概率方法的不足。
AI.conclusion: Promise Theory为智能体对齐提供了可扩展的意图定义，但仍面临研究挑战和风格偏好问题。

title: Bayesian-Agent: Posterior-Guided Skill Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on external inference conditions: prompts, tools, memory, SOPs, skills, and harness feedback. These assets can improve task execution without changing model weights, but they are often revised by heuristic reflection or by reusing observed successes and failures as if counts alone were reliable belief. We introduce \textbf{Bayesian-Agent}, a native and cross-harness framework that treats reusable skills and SOPs as hypotheses about whether a frozen model will succeed under a particular prompt, context, and harness environment. Bayesian-Agent records verified trajectory evidence, maintains a feature-conditioned categorical posterior over each skill, and maps posterior state into inspectable actions such as patch, split, compress, retire, and explore. Model-facing prompts receive executable guardrails and failure-mode patches, while posterior summaries remain available for audit. With \texttt{deepseek-v4-flash}, incremental repair improves SOP-Bench from 80\% to 95\%, Lifelong AgentBench from 90\% to 100\%, and RealFin-Bench from 45\% to 65\%. We further evaluate Bayesian-Agent's native backend and optional GenericAgent, mini-swe-agent, and Claude Code backends. The results include positive, negative, saturated, and case-study settings, suggesting that agent skill evolution is best viewed as posterior-guided harness optimization rather than uncalibrated prompt accumulation. The source code is available at https://github.com/DataArcTech/Bayesian-Agent.

AI.tldr: Bayesian-Agent 提出了一种基于贝叶斯后验推理的框架，将LLM智能体的技能和SOP视为假设，通过后验引导优化而非启发式积累来提升性能，在多个基准上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体依赖于外部推理条件（提示、工具、记忆等），但这些资产通常通过启发式反思或简单复用成功/失败经验来修改，缺乏可靠的概率校准。
AI.method: 将可复用的技能和SOP视为关于冻结模型在特定提示、上下文和环境条件下能否成功的假设；记录已验证的轨迹证据，维护特征条件化的分类后验分布，并将后验状态映射为可审计的操作（补丁、拆分、压缩、退役、探索）。
AI.result: 在deepseek-v4-flash上，SOP-Bench从80%提升到95%，Lifelong AgentBench从90%提升到100%，RealFin-Bench从45%提升到65%。评估了多个后端，涵盖正例、负例、饱和和案例研究设置。
AI.conclusion: 智能体技能演化应被视为后验引导的框架优化，而非未校准的提示积累。

title: Distilling LLM Reasoning into an Interpretable Policy Tree for Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Constructing efficient and reliable policies to assist humans is indispensable for human-AI collaboration. Existing methods mainly follow two lines of work. Most prior work relies on multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to learn black-box policies, which limits interpretability and raises safety concerns. Recent methods query large language models (LLMs) at each decision step, causing slow responses and high inference costs. We propose Collaboration Policy Tree (Co-pi-tree), a closed-loop method that learns an executable policy tree consisting of a partner-behavior prediction tree and an agent-action selection tree. Co-pi-tree constructs a policy by distilling LLM reasoning into policy tree code. It then evaluates the policy through partner interaction, obtains feedback, and uses natural language to summarize the interaction feedback to improve problematic branches. Experiments in Overcooked-AI show that Co-pi-tree improves average reward by 35.4% over the baseline average, while reducing the number of LLM queries by 77.7% and test-time latency by 97.1%. Project page: https://beiwenzhang.github.io/Co-pi-tree/

AI.tldr: Co-pi-tree是一种通过将LLM推理蒸馏为可执行策略树、并利用交互反馈进行自我改进的人机协作方法，在Overcooked-AI上相比基线平均奖励提升35.4%，同时LLM查询次数减少77.7%，测试延迟降低97.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖多智能体强化学习学习黑盒策略（缺乏可解释性且存在安全隐患），要么在每一步都查询大语言模型（响应慢、推理成本高），因此需要一种兼具可解释性、高效性和安全性的协作策略学习方法。
AI.method: 提出Co-pi-tree闭环比方法，包含伙伴行为预测树和智能体动作选择树；通过将LLM推理蒸馏为策略树代码构建策略，再通过伙伴交互评估策略、收集反馈，并用自然语言总结交互反馈以改进有问题的分支。
AI.result: 在Overcooked-AI中，Co-pi-tree的平均奖励比基线平均提升35.4%，LLM查询次数减少77.7%，测试延迟降低97.1%。
AI.conclusion: Co-pi-tree通过策略树的方式有效平衡了可解释性与执行效率，大幅降低了LLM调用开销和延迟，为人机协作提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Test-Time Scaling in Multimodal Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Generation and Reasoning
summary: Test-time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as a pivotal research direction for enhancing model performance by dynamically allocating computational resources during inference. Recent advancements have adapted this paradigm to Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs), unlocking their potential in multimodal reasoning and generation. Despite rapid progress, the field lacks a systematic survey and unified theoretical framework to delineate the developmental landscape of multimodal TTS. To bridge this gap, we present the first comprehensive review of TTS research for MFMs, proposing a unified taxonomic framework that categorizes existing methodologies into three distinct strategies: sampling-based, feedback-based, and search-based approaches. We further summarize representative applications and benchmarks commonly utilized to evaluate multimodal TTS capabilities in generation and reasoning tasks. Finally, this survey discusses open challenges and outlines future research directions, providing a systematic roadmap for subsequent studies in this rapidly evolving field.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统综述了多模态基础模型（MFMs）中的测试时扩展（TTS）技术，提出了一个统一分类框架，将现有方法分为采样、反馈和搜索三大策略，并总结了相关应用、基准及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 多模态TTS领域发展迅速，但缺乏系统性的综述和统一的理论框架来梳理研究进展，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出统一分类框架，将多模态TTS方法划分为三种策略：基于采样的方法、基于反馈的方法和基于搜索的方法。
AI.result: 系统梳理了多模态TTS的研究现状，总结了代表性应用和评估基准，并指出了开放挑战和未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文为多模态TTS领域提供了首个系统性综述和分类框架，为后续研究提供了清晰的路线图。

title: Forward-Free Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative denoising, offering a powerful alternative to autoregressive generation. However, discrete language spaces lack a natural neighborhood structure for defining effective perturbations, so some artificial corruption schemes are proposed in the forward process. Such prescribed forward processes often produce states that are mathematically convenient but misaligned with drafts and errors encountered during generation, resulting in degraded sample quality. To address this limitation, we propose FReDA, a forward-free diffusion language model that eliminates the need for a hand-designed forward process. We formulate diffusion language modeling as recursive distribution refinement, in which model-generated drafts serve as implicit intermediate states, and the learned refinement model progressively moves the draft distribution toward the target distribution. Concretely, FReDA refines drafts by proposing candidate draft sequences and either directly performing self-refinement or selecting among parallel candidates via best-of-N refinement. With this design, FReDA is neighborhood-agnostic, model-complexity-aware, and compatible with flexible refinement parameterizations. Extensive evaluations in the sub-8B regime show that FReDA-4B outperforms larger diffusion base models on reasoning and coding benchmarks, achieving absolute gains of up to 15%, while reaching a 1.5-1.8x average speedup over diffusion baselines and scaling effectively with additional refinement computation.

AI.tldr: FReDA是一种无需前向过程的扩散语言模型，通过递归分布精炼（利用模型生成的草稿作为隐式中间状态）来逐步优化文本生成，在4B参数下性能超过更大模型，并实现1.5-1.8倍加速。
AI.motivation: 传统扩散语言模型依赖人工设计的噪声前向过程，这些过程产生的中间状态与生成过程中实际遇到的草稿和错误不匹配，导致样本质量下降。
AI.method: FReDA摒弃了手设计的前向过程，采用递归分布精炼框架：模型生成的草稿作为隐式中间状态，通过自精炼或Best-of-N候选选择逐步将草稿分布推向目标分布。
AI.result: 在8B以下参数规模中，FReDA-4B在推理和编程基准上超越更大扩散模型，绝对提升最高达15%，相比扩散基线实现1.5-1.8倍平均加速，且额外计算量可有效扩展。
AI.conclusion: FReDA证明消除人工设计的前向过程是可行的，其邻域无关、模型复杂度感知的设计为扩散语言模型提供了更高效且性能更优的新范式。

title: InA-Probe: Instruction-Aware Active Probing for Time Series Forecasting with LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated impressive potential for time series forecasting. However, existing methods predominantly rely on passive modality alignment or static task reprogramming, which often fail to capture fine-grained, non-stationary temporal patterns or to adapt to nuanced task intents. In this paper, we propose Instruction-aware Active Probing (InA-Probe), which shifts the paradigm from passive alignment toward an active, instruction-driven probing mechanism. Specifically, we design a Multi-Level Instruction Injection mechanism that enriches the model with both global task objectives and fine-grained, patch-level semantic priors. Building on this, an Adaptive Query Generation module produces sample-specific probes that are dynamically modulated by the temporal context. These probes are then refined through a dual-stage attention process: they first internalize task-specific intents via Instruction-Aware Self-Attention, and subsequently interrogate the projected temporal representations through Temporal Cross-Attention to extract salient patterns. Comprehensive experiments on seven real-world benchmarks show that InA-Probe consistently outperforms state-of-the-art deep learning and LLM-based baselines, excelling in both one-for-all generalization and zero-shot transfer while reducing forecasting error by up to 37\% in challenging cross-domain scenarios. Ablation studies further confirm that the synergy between adaptive querying and fine-grained instructions is key to unlocking the reasoning power of LLMs for complex time series.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InA-Probe，一种指令感知主动探针机制，通过多级指令注入和自适应查询生成，结合双阶段注意力机制，让LLM从被动对齐转向主动探针，在时间序列预测任务上超越现有方法，误差降低最高37%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM时间序列预测方法依赖被动模态对齐或静态任务重编程，难以捕捉细粒度的非平稳时序模式，也无法适应多样的任务意图。
AI.method: 提出InA-Probe框架，包含：(1)多级指令注入机制，提供全局任务目标和细粒度补丁级语义先验；(2)自适应查询生成模块，产生样本特定的探针；(3)双阶段注意力过程，包括指令感知自注意力和时序交叉注意力。
AI.result: 在7个真实基准上超越SOTA深度学习和LLM基线，在跨域场景下预测误差降低高达37%，在通用泛化和零样本迁移中均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 自适应查询与细粒度指令的协同作用是释放LLM推理能力用于复杂时间序列预测的关键。

title: Light-WAM: Efficient World Action Models with State-Fusion Action Decoding
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) extend robot policy learning by incorporating future prediction as an additional training objective, encouraging the policy to encode task-relevant temporal structure in its representations. Current WAMs often rely on large-scale generative architectures that incur high training costs and inference latency, making them difficult to deploy as efficient closed-loop policies. We propose Light-WAM, a lightweight World Action Model for efficient robot manipulation. Specifically, it is built with a compact video backbone and performs future-video supervision in a downsampled latent space, reducing the cost of video co-training while retaining its benefits for representation learning. For action prediction, Light-WAM introduces the StateFusionActionExpert, which reads adapted states from multiple backbone layers, fuses them through learned-query pooling, and directly predicts action chunks in a single forward pass. This design provides an efficient interface between video backbone representations and robot actions, avoiding the need for heavy generative action experts. Experiments demonstrate that Light-WAM maintains strong performance on LIBERO and achieves usable multi-task performance on RoboTwin 2.0, while using only 0.44B trainable parameters. It also achieves 72.03ms inference latency with 4.1GiB peak GPU memory and improved training throughput.

AI.tldr: Light-WAM是一个轻量级的世界动作模型，通过紧凑视频骨干网络和潜在空间下采样视频监督，以及StateFusionActionExpert模块实现高效机器人操作，仅用0.44B参数即可达到良好性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）依赖大规模生成式架构，训练成本高、推理延迟大，难以部署为高效的闭环策略。
AI.method: 采用紧凑视频骨干网络，在降采样潜在空间进行未来视频监督；提出StateFusionActionExpert，从多个骨干层读取状态并进行学习查询池化融合，单次前向传播直接预测动作块。
AI.result: 仅0.44B可训练参数，在LIBERO上保持强性能，在RoboTwin 2.0上实现可用多任务性能，推理延迟72.03ms，峰值GPU内存4.1GiB，训练吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: Light-WAM在保持世界动作模型优势的同时，显著降低了计算成本和推理延迟，为高效闭环机器人策略部署提供了可行方案。

title: Auditing Proprietary Alignment in Large Language Models: A Comparative Framework Without a Ground-Truth Standard
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly released and deployed through opaque development and deployment pipelines, enabling model providers to inject intentional, provider-specific policies without officially announcing them. As a result, various models have been reported to generate responses reflecting proprietary rules and organizational interests, leading to censorship or misinformation on controversial topics. However, systematic identification of such alignment remains a fundamental challenge, complicated by the ambiguity of what ``proprietary'' entails in different contexts. In this paper, we propose a statistical framework for detecting proprietary alignment in black-box language models via comparative behavioral analysis. Our approach quantifies systematic deviations between the responses of a target model and those of a reference set of baseline models in a shared semantic space. By evaluating relative behavioral divergence rather than absolute correctness, our framework enables principled auditing under black-box access. Applied to several widely discussed but previously unquantified cases, it provides a systematic and scalable basis for external assessment of provider-specific alignment behavior in large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统计框架，通过对比行为分析来检测黑盒大语言模型中的专有对齐（即模型提供商有意注入的、未公开的政策性偏好），无需依赖绝对正确性，仅通过目标模型与参考模型在语义空间中的行为偏差进行量化审计。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在发布和部署时往往通过不透明的流程，使模型提供者能在不正式声明的情况下注入专有策略，导致模型在争议性话题上生成反映其组织利益的回复（如审查或误导）。然而，缺乏系统性的方法来识别这种“专有对齐”。
AI.method: 提出一个统计框架，通过比较目标模型与一组基线参考模型在共享语义空间中的响应行为，量化系统性偏差。该方法不依赖绝对正确性，而是基于相对行为差异进行审计，且仅需黑盒访问。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于多个此前被广泛讨论但未量化的案例，证明了其能够系统性地检测出模型提供者特定的对齐行为。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为黑盒大语言模型的外部审计提供了系统化、可扩展的基础，能够有效识别未被公开的专有对齐行为。

title: Towards Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory and Destination Forecasting with Reasoning Large Language Models
comment: The IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC) 2026, Naples, Italy
summary: Long-horizon maritime trajectory prediction is important for shipping management, logistics planning, and maritime risk analysis, yet month-level forecasting remains insufficiently studied. Existing deep learning methods mainly focus on short- and mid-term coordinate extrapolation and often struggle to preserve route feasibility and destination correctness over extended horizons. This paper investigates joint long-horizon vessel trajectory and destination forecasting with reasoning-capable large language models, and develops a Maritime LLM post-training framework based on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR). An AIS-based benchmark is constructed with 60-day historical trajectories and 30-day forecasting horizons, where trajectories are converted into semantic textual representations for RL prompt construction. RLVR aligns LLMs with maritime forecasting objectives by enforcing physical validity, providing early-weighted trajectory supervision, and evaluating destination correctness through hierarchical matching and curriculum learning. Experimental results show that RLVR-trained LLMs substantially improve over zero-shot LLMs and representative deep learning baselines, especially on destination-related metrics. Among the evaluated RLVR-trained variants, 4B LLMs achieve the best overall performance, suggesting that reward-compatible optimization and task-specific capacity matching are more important than simply using larger 8B or 14B LLMs. The results also show that LSTM remains a strong deep learning baseline under limited fine-tuning data, while Transformer-style spatio-temporal models typically require larger datasets and richer structured inputs. Overall, this work advances semantic, verifier-aligned maritime forecasting for operational decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）的海事大模型后训练框架，用于长时域（30天）船舶轨迹与目的地联合预测，实验表明4B参数模型在目的地相关指标上表现最优，超越零样本大模型和代表性深度学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法主要聚焦短中期坐标外推，难以在月级长时域上保持航线可行性和目的地正确性，长时域海事轨迹预测问题尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 构建基于AIS的60天历史轨迹+30天预测基准，将轨迹转换为语义文本表示；设计RLVR框架，通过物理有效性约束、早期加权轨迹监督、分层匹配与课程学习进行目的地正确性评估，对齐大语言模型与海事预测目标。
AI.result: RLVR训练的大语言模型在目的地相关指标上显著优于零样本大模型和基线方法；4B模型取得最佳整体性能，优于8B和14B模型；LSTM在有限微调数据下仍是强基线，Transformer时空模型需更大数据集。
AI.conclusion: 奖励兼容优化与任务特定容量匹配比简单使用更大模型更重要，该工作推进了语义化、验证器对齐的海事预测方法，可用于运营决策支持。

title: TIDE: Task-Isolated Diffusion for Unified Video Editing and Generation
summary: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers have driven rapid progress in video generation and editing, yet these capabilities are still handled by separate, task-specific models. Building a unified framework that supports diverse video tasks remains an open challenge: existing unified attempts either require dedicated auxiliary encoders or lack explicit mechanisms to distinguish heterogeneous conditioning tokens, struggling when the number and type of visual conditions vary across tasks. We propose TIDE, a unified framework that integrates instruction-based editing, reference-guided editing, and multi-reference generation. At its core, we introduce per-token task embeddings that assign each input token a task-specific identifier, enabling the model to explicitly disambiguate target, source, and reference tokens. To simultaneously capture high-level semantic understanding and fine-grained structural fidelity, we design a dual-path conditioning scheme that couples a vision-language model with a VAE latent path for complementary signals. We further devise a multi-task progressive training strategy that incrementally introduces tasks of increasing complexity, effectively harmonizing diverse objectives and enabling smooth generalization across heterogeneous task distributions. Extensive experiments on multiple video editing and generation benchmarks demonstrate that TIDE achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated tasks. Our project page is available at https://LittleWork123.github.io/tide.

AI.tldr: TIDE是一个统一的视频生成与编辑框架，通过引入逐标记任务嵌入、双路径条件机制和多任务渐进训练策略，在多个视频任务上实现了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成与编辑能力由独立的任务特定模型处理，缺乏统一框架；已有的统一尝试要么需要专用辅助编码器，要么缺乏区分异构条件标记的显式机制，难以处理不同任务中视觉条件的数量和类型变化。
AI.method: 1) 逐标记任务嵌入（per-token task embeddings），为每个输入标记分配任务特定标识符，显式区分目标、源和参考标记；2) 双路径条件方案（dual-path conditioning），结合视觉-语言模型与VAE潜路径以获取互补信号；3) 多任务渐进训练策略，逐步引入复杂度递增的任务，协调不同目标并实现平滑泛化。
AI.result: 在多个视频编辑和生成基准测试上，TIDE在所有评估任务中均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: TIDE成功构建了一个统一框架，能够同时支持指令引导编辑、参考引导编辑和多参考生成等多种视频任务，证明了逐标记任务嵌入和双路径条件机制的有效性。

title: When Correct Decisions Hide Internal Stress: Decision-State Probing in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Multimodal language models are typically evaluated through external behavior: selecting the correct image--text match, rejecting unsupported captions, or answering visual queries correctly. However, correct behavior alone does not show that the model's internal decision state remains stable under controlled semantic stress. We study this gap through S$^3$E (Structured Semantic Stress Evaluation), a framework for analyzing behavior-internal decoupling in multimodal language models. S$^3$E uses a positive-anchored A/B forced-choice setup in which an image-supported caption is contrasted against semantic stress candidates under both original and swapped option orders, while hidden states are extracted at the pre-answer decision state. We focus on strict-correct trials, where the model consistently selects the correct caption across both orders. Rather than treating arbitrary hidden-state variation as evidence of instability, we measure whether semantic-conflict candidates induce excess decision-state displacement relative to meaning-preserving controls. Across Qwen3VL, Gemma3, and InternVL3, semantic stress consistently produces positive selected-layer excess displacement over lexical controls despite correct forced-choice behavior, while comparisons against random negatives are model-dependent. We interpret this as a scoped decision-state stress-sensitivity signal rather than evidence of downstream failure or hallucination. Our results suggest that forced-choice correctness alone is not a sufficient certificate of invariant internal decision geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出S$^3$E框架，通过对比语义压力候选词与意义保留控制词在决策状态下的隐藏层位移，发现多模态语言模型在强制选择正确的情况下仍存在内部决策状态对语义压力的敏感性，说明行为正确性不足以保证内部决策几何的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅关注外部行为正确性（如图文匹配、视觉问答），但无法反映模型内部决策状态在语义压力下是否保持稳定，存在行为-内部解耦的评估空白。
AI.method: 采用正向锚定的A/B强制选择范式，将图像支持的标题与语义压力候选对比，在原始和交换选项顺序下提取预答案决策状态的隐藏层向量，测量语义冲突候选相对于意义保留控制组的决策状态位移。
AI.result: 在Qwen3VL、Gemma3、InternVL3上，语义压力一致产生正向选定层的过量位移，但随机负例对比结果因模型而异。
AI.conclusion: 强制选择正确性不足以作为内部决策几何不变性的充分证书；行为正确与内部状态稳定之间存在可测量的解耦。

title: Extending Ontologies: From Dense Embeddings to Hybrid Quantum-Fuzzy Systems
summary: LLMs have revolutionized knowledge representation and retrieval, but lack the explicit modeling that knowledge ontologies possess. This paper surveys the ways that ontologies and knowledge graphs have been integrated with dense embedding algorithms. All hitherto attempts involve a trade-off between probabilistic and crisp inference. This paper proposes a novel frontier for devising knowledge representation systems that can simultaneously accommodate probabilistic and crisp inference in the same representation. To this effect, the paper proposes neuro-quantum-fuzzy systems as knowledge representation systems that accommodate both classical and contextual inference implemented through quantum-neural networks (QNN).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了本体论与稠密嵌入算法的结合方式，并提出了一种新的神经-量子-模糊系统，能够同时在同一个知识表示中支持概率推理和精确推理。
AI.motivation: LLMs在知识表示和检索方面表现出色，但缺乏本体论所具有的显式建模能力。现有的本体论与稠密嵌入算法结合的方法都面临概率推理与精确推理之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出神经-量子-模糊系统作为知识表示系统，通过量子神经网络（QNN）实现经典推理和上下文推理的共存。
AI.result: 提出了一种新的知识表示系统设计思路，能够同时容纳概率推理和精确推理。
AI.conclusion: 神经-量子-模糊系统可以克服现有方法中概率推理与精确推理之间的权衡问题，为知识表示提供了新的前沿方向。

title: Remember with Confidence: Uncertainty Quantification for Spatio-temporal Memory with Probabilistic Guarantees
summary: Long-horizon robot operation requires spatio-temporal memory to record the environment state and recall it for downstream reasoning. Scene graphs and retrieval-augmented systems ground VLM descriptions to persistent 3D entities with rich semantic descriptions. However, VLM captions are noisy and viewpoint-inconsistent, and existing systems treat them as an oracle with no mechanism to detect unreliable stored descriptions. We introduce object-level semantic uncertainty for multi-view VLM memory: a score that measures object-centric cross-view semantic scatter of captions and identifies semantically unresolved objects. Then, we include our uncertainty scores in an advanced spatial-semantic memory system, that we dub UQ-DAAAM. UQ-DAAAM uses this score to actively refine uncertain objects under a fixed query budget by selecting high-quality views and fusing the resulting multi-view captions into a single object description. We also derive probabilistic guarantees showing that higher-quality candidate views (as selected by our approach) are more likely to reduce uncertainty. Our experiments show that uncertainty quantification can make embodied 4D memory systems more reliable and more effective. In particular, on the OC-NaVQA benchmark, UQ-DAAAM achieves substantially larger uncertainty reduction and better spatio-temporal question answering performance than baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向长周期机器人操作的对象级语义不确定性量化方法，并将其集成到名为UQ-DAAAM的空间-语义记忆系统中，通过对多视角VLM描述进行不确定性评估和主动精炼，显著提升了记忆系统的可靠性和问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于场景图和检索增强的系统依赖VLM生成的环境描述，但VLM标注存在噪声且视角不一致，缺乏可靠的机制来检测和纠正不可靠的存储描述，导致机器人在长周期操作中记忆不可靠。
AI.method: 提出对象级语义不确定性得分，用于测量多视角VLM描述的对象中心跨视角语义分散度；构建UQ-DAAAM系统，利用该得分在固定查询预算下主动选择高质量视角来精炼不确定性高的对象，并通过概率保证证明高质量候选视角更可能降低不确定性。
AI.result: 在OC-NaVQA基准上，UQ-DAAAM相比基线方法实现了显著更大的不确定性降低，并在时空问答任务上取得了更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性量化可以有效提升具身4D记忆系统的可靠性和有效性，为机器人在长周期操作中提供更稳健的语义记忆支持。

title: TrustMargin: Training-Free Arbitration between Parametric Memory and Retrieved Evidence in Large Language Models
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Code and data are available at https://github.com/mojixu/TrustMargin.git
summary: Large language models answer knowledge-intensive questions using both parametric memory and retrieved evidence, but neither source is uniformly reliable. Retrieval can fill knowledge gaps, yet distracting passages may override correct closed-book answers. We study this post-generation conflict as answer-level source arbitration: given Direct and RAG answers from the same frozen model, decide which source to trust. We propose TRUSTMARGIN, a training-free, plug-and-play arbitration layer that scores the two existing candidates with the model's own likelihoods. It combines a parametric-prior margin, which tests whether memory accepts the retrieved answer, with an evidence-binding margin, which discounts passage-only salience and measures question-specific support. TRUSTMARGIN selects between Direct and RAG without fine-tuning, external judges, or additional generation. Across 2WIKIMQA and CWQA with three LLaMA scales, TRUSTMARGIN consistently improves over Direct generation and BM25-RAG, recovers part of the Direct/RAG oracle gap, and generalizes to multiple training-free RAG pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的信任仲裁层TRUSTMARGIN，通过模型自身的似然分数在直接生成（Direct）和检索增强生成（RAG）答案之间进行选择，以解决两者均不可靠的问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型依赖参数记忆和检索证据回答知识密集型问题，但两者均不可靠：检索能填补知识空白，但干扰性段落可能覆盖正确的闭卷答案。需要一种方法在直接答案和RAG答案之间进行可信来源裁决。
AI.method: 提出TRUSTMARGIN，一个无需训练即插即用的仲裁层。通过两个指标评分：1）参数先验边界（parametric-prior margin）——检验模型记忆是否接受检索答案；2）证据绑定边界（evidence-binding margin）——折扣仅基于段落的显著性，衡量问题特定支持。最终在Direct和RAG输出中选择分数更高的答案。
AI.result: 在2WIKIMQA和CWQA数据集上，使用三种LLaMA规模模型，TRUSTMARGIN一致优于Direct生成和BM25-RAG，缩小了与Direct/RAG oracle之间的差距，并泛化到多种无需训练的RAG流水线。
AI.conclusion: TRUSTMARGIN作为一种轻量级、无需微调和外部评判的仲裁方法，能有效提升大语言模型在知识密集型问答中的可靠性，兼顾参数记忆和检索证据的优势。

title: ConMem: Structured Memory-Guided Adaptation in Training-Free Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Recent advances have improved the adaptive capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) through memory-, skill-, and learning-based approaches, yet these approaches remain challenged by noisy trajectories, insufficient modeling of memory-skill relations, and reliance on additional training or high-quality supervision. To address these limitations, we propose ConMem, a relation-aware and training-free framework that enables efficient multi-agent adaptation through cross-experience coordination. Specifically, ConMem distills historical interaction trajectories into structured memory cards to capture reusable strategies and cues, organizing them into a relation-aware memory graph. At runtime, ConMem retrieves cards according to task needs and coordinates them through the card graph to resolve strategy conflicts and recover their dependencies. Combined, these modules yield structured and relation-aware guidance, enabling robust, lightweight adaptation in multi-agent systems without additional training. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and mainstream MAS architectures show consistent gains over existing memory architectures, with improved inference-time efficiency through pruning more than 50% of expanded candidates and reducing planning overhead by over 80%. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ConMemCode

AI.tldr: 提出ConMem框架，通过关系感知的记忆图和跨经验协调，实现无需额外训练的多智能体系统高效自适应，在多个基准测试中优于现有方法，并能剪枝超过50%的候选者并减少80%以上的规划开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统自适应方法受限于噪声轨迹、记忆-技能关系建模不足以及对额外训练或高质量监督的依赖。
AI.method: 将历史交互轨迹蒸馏为结构化记忆卡片，组织成关系感知记忆图；运行时根据任务需求检索卡片，并通过卡片图协调解决策略冲突并恢复依赖关系。
AI.result: 在多个基准和主流MAS架构上取得一致改进，推理时可剪枝超过50%的候选者，规划开销减少超过80%。
AI.conclusion: ConMem是一种无需训练、轻量级的多智能体系统自适应方法，能有效提升性能并大幅降低计算开销。

title: G2G: Exploiting Intra-Group Geometry for Inter-Group Pose Estimation
summary: Recovering the relative 6-DoF pose between two image groups underlies cross-sequence relocalization and multi-camera rig odometry. Each group carries known intra-group geometry from visual odometry or rig calibration, and pretrained multi-view backbones already fuse such geometry into visual features. Yet current models treat all views as an unstructured set, leaving cross-group reasoning as the missing piece. We introduce \ours{}, which keeps the foundation model entirely frozen and adds three lightweight trainable modules to bridge the two groups: a perceiver resampler, a cross-group bridge with merged self-attention, and a multi-frame pose head. The trainable footprint totals about 32M parameters, under 6\% of the full model, and is supervised only by relative poses. Across four datasets that span indoor and outdoor simulation, real-world cross-season capture, and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, \ours{} attains state-of-the-art accuracy on both tasks, while every baseline is retrained with its full original supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/G2G.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G2G方法，通过冻结预训练多视图基础模型，仅添加三个轻量级可训练模块（感知器重采样器、跨组桥接模块、多帧位姿头），实现两组图像之间的6-DoF相对位姿估计，在四个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有模型将所有视图视为无序集合，缺乏跨组推理能力，而实际应用中（如跨序列重定位、多相机里程计）需要利用组内已知几何信息来恢复组间相对位姿。
AI.method: 冻结预训练多视图基础模型，添加三个轻量模块：(1) 感知器重采样器；(2) 带合并自注意力的跨组桥接模块；(3) 多帧位姿头。仅约32M参数（<6%完整模型），仅需相对位姿监督。
AI.result: 在室内外模拟、真实跨季节、零样本sim-to-real四个数据集上，两项任务均达到SOTA精度，且所有基线均使用完整原始监督重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 证明了冻结基础模型+轻量可训练模块的方式能有效解决跨组相对位姿估计问题，模型轻量高效且泛化能力强。

title: TimpaTeks: Automatic In-place Text Sequence Modification via Diffusion Language Model Steering
summary: We extend activation steering to diffusion language models (DLMs) and study a novel problem that arose due to the inference mechanism of DLMs: Modifying a text in-place to manifest a different concept. We propose TimpaTeks, an automatic in-place text modification mechanism using DLMs. Experiments on IMDB movie reviews (sentiment) and a synthetic Cats and Dogs Dataset (arbitrary, more unconventional concept steering) show that TimpaTeks provides a feasible novel mechanism to steer diffusion language model outputs in-place. TimpaTeks enables in-place modification while simultaneously lowers sentence perplexity and retaining the original sentence structre without the need of instruction tuned models. TimpaTeks is also computationally cheaper than prompt-based DLM steering, as it performs denoising in-place rather than constructing an additional prompt-conditioned output sequence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TimpaTeks方法，扩展激活引导到扩散语言模型，实现文本就地修改以展现不同概念，实验证明其在情感和概念引导上有效且计算成本更低。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的推理机制带来了新问题：如何在保持原文结构的前提下，就地修改文本使其呈现不同概念。现有方法需要构建额外的提示条件输出序列，计算成本高。
AI.method: 提出TimpaTeks，一种自动就地文本修改机制，将激活引导扩展到扩散语言模型，通过在原地进行去噪操作而非构建额外的提示条件输出序列来实现修改。
AI.result: 在IMDB电影评论数据集（情感引导）和合成猫狗数据集（非传统概念引导）上的实验表明，TimpaTeks实现了可行的就地修改机制，同时降低了句子困惑度，保留了原始句子结构。
AI.conclusion: TimpaTeks为扩散语言模型提供了一种新颖的就地修改机制，无需指令微调模型，且计算成本低于基于提示的扩散语言模型引导方法。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Mathematical Reasoning: An Integrated Survey of Language Models, Neuro-symbolic Systems, and Verified Discovery
summary: Mathematical reasoning has long served as a stringent test of machine intelligence; over the past decade, it has moved from a niche problem within NLP to one of the most consequential AI frontiers. This survey provides a unified account of the field's evolution, from early rule-based math word problem (MWP) solvers and template-driven geometry systems, through neural expression generation and LLM prompting, to contemporary reasoning models, multi-agent systems, neuro-symbolic theorem provers, and verified discovery workflows. We organize the landscape along four axes: (i) informal reasoning over text and diagrams, spanning MWP solving, multimodal geometry, and VLMs; (ii) formal reasoning in proof assistants, including autoformalization, tactic prediction, compiler-guided repair, and proof search; (iii) mathematical discovery, where systems propose constructions, improve bounds, or assist attacks on open problems; and (iv) the inference and training-time techniques, including CoT prompting, tool use, process reward models, and RLVR, that increasingly connect generation with verification. We catalog major benchmarks across grade-school arithmetic, competition mathematics, geometry, formal proving, multimodal and multilingual reasoning, and expert evaluation, and we examine benchmark saturation, contamination, reporting mismatches, and the distinction between pass@1, majority voting, and verifier-assisted pass@$k$. We critically assess failure modes: brittleness under perturbation, reward hacking, multimodal grounding failures, fragile formalization, and the energy cost of reasoning-scale inference. Drawing on recent perspectives from working mathematicians, we identify future directions centered on verified-discovery workflows, reasoning efficiency, and infrastructure to make AI-assisted formalization broadly usable. Companion materials: https://github.com/Starscream-11813/awesome-AI4Math.

AI.tldr: 本文全面综述了数学推理在AI领域的发展历程，从早期规则系统到现代推理模型，沿着非形式推理、形式推理、数学发现和推理技术四个维度展开，并系统分析了基准测试、失败模式及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 数学推理是检验机器智能的严格测试，随着AI发展已成为最重要的前沿领域之一，需要系统梳理该领域从NLP小众问题到当代AI前沿的完整演化脉络。
AI.method: 采用四轴框架组织该领域：①非形式推理（文本/图表的MWP求解、多模态几何、VLM）；②形式推理（证明助手、自动形式化、策略预测、编译器引导修复、证明搜索）；③数学发现（结构构造、界改进、开放问题攻击）；④推理与训练技术（CoT提示、工具使用、过程奖励模型、RLVR）。同时系统编录基准测试并批判性评估失败模式。
AI.result: 编录了涵盖中小学算术、竞赛数学、几何、形式证明、多模态及多语言推理、专家评估的主要基准；揭示了基准饱和、污染、报告不匹配以及pass@1、多数投票与验证器辅助pass@k之间的区别；识别了脆弱性、奖励黑客、多模态接地失败、形式化脆弱性及大规模推理的能源成本等关键失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 未来方向集中在验证驱动的发现工作流、推理效率提升以及使AI辅助形式化广泛可用的基础设施建设。

title: HACK++: Towards More Effective Head-Aware Key-Value Compression for Efficient Visual Autoregressive Modeling
summary: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models adopt a next-scale prediction paradigm, offering high-quality generation with substantially fewer decoding steps. However, existing VAR models suffer from significant attention complexity and severe memory overhead due to the accumulation of key-value (KV) caches across scales. In this paper, we tackle this challenge by introducing KV cache compression into the next-scale paradigm. We begin with an in-depth analysis of VAR attention and observe that attention heads can be stably divided into two functionally distinct categories: Contextual Heads focus on maintaining semantic consistency, while Structural Heads preserve spatial coherence. Their functional divergence makes existing one-size-fits-all compression methods perform poorly on VAR models. We further find that the two head types differ markedly in their reliance on historical scales, and that this reliance shifts across layers and generation steps, arguing for an adaptive cache budget allocation. To address these challenges, we propose HACK++, a training-free Head-Aware key-value Compression frameworK for VAR models. From a one-time offline calibration, HACK++ classifies head types and derives head-specific priors. At inference, it decouples attention from cache compression under independent budgets, bounding the current-scale attention cost while compressing the accumulated cache far more aggressively, via pattern-specific strategies and a reliance-aware budget allocation. Extensive experiments on multiple VAR models across text-to-image, class-conditional, and unified understanding-and-generation tasks validate the effectiveness and generalizability of HACK++. For example, on Infinity-2B/8B, HACK++ maintains near-lossless generation with only a 30% attention budget and a 10% cache budget, and remains robust even under a 1% cache budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HACK++，一种针对视觉自回归（VAR）模型的无训练、头部感知的键值缓存压缩框架。通过分析VAR注意力机制，发现注意力头可分为两类：上下文头（维持语义一致性）和结构头（保持空间连贯性）。HACK++通过离线校准识别头部类型并推导先验，在推理时解耦注意力与缓存压缩，实现近无损生成（如Infinity-2B/8B上仅用30%注意力预算和10%缓存预算）。
AI.motivation: 现有VAR模型因跨尺度的键值（KV）缓存累积导致巨大的注意力复杂度和严重的内存开销，而传统的一刀切压缩方法因无法适应VAR模型中两种功能不同的注意力头而效果不佳。
AI.method: HACK++通过离线校准将注意力头分为上下文头和结构头，并推导头部特定先验。推理时，在独立预算下解耦注意力与缓存压缩，采用模式特定策略和依赖感知的预算分配，在限制当前尺度注意力开销的同时更激进地压缩累积缓存。
AI.result: 在多个VAR模型的文本到图像、类别条件生成、统一理解与生成任务上验证了有效性。Infinity-2B/8B模型中，仅用30%注意力预算和10%缓存预算实现近无损生成，甚至在1%缓存预算下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: HACK++通过头部感知的自适应压缩策略，有效解决了VAR模型中KV缓存累积带来的效率瓶颈，实现了高效且高质量的生成，具有良好的通用性和鲁棒性。

title: AsyncLane: Decoupling Refinement from Advancement in Diffusion Language Model Decoding
summary: Block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding is the standard inference paradigm for diffusion large language models (DLMs), but it imposes a strict dependency between blocks: the next block cannot begin until the current block is fully decoded or its denoising budget is exhausted. We observe that once a block exposes a reliable delimiter boundary or stable semantic prefix, continuation generation need not wait for every residual token to be resolved. We propose AsyncLane, a training-free decoding scheduler that decouples refinement from advancement. AsyncLane forks a generate lane at observed delimiter boundaries into a refine lane and a continuation generate lane: the prefix remains editable, while the continuation advances before prefix refinement finishes. The resulting lane tree records decoding dependencies and output order, while execution proceeds over the active lane set. To make this asynchronous schedule efficient under bidirectional attention, AsyncLane combines shared-prefix lane batching, lookahead draft reuse, cascading termination, and compact cache refresh with refresh-logit reuse, preventing model-call cost from scaling directly with the number of lanes. AsyncLane is a drop-in replacement for block-wise DLM samplers and requires no retraining. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that AsyncLane consistently improves throughput while maintaining competitive quality. Across LLaDA and Dream backbones, AsyncLane achieves the highest TPS in all evaluated benchmark-length settings; relative to the fastest competing baseline, it reaches peak speedups of 2.95x on LLaDA and 3.04x on Dream, with especially large gains under longer generation budgets.

AI.tldr: AsyncLane是一种无需训练的扩散大模型解码调度器，通过将解码过程分解为精炼与生成两条并行路径，打破了传统块级半自回归解码的严格依赖限制，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升吞吐量，在LLaDA和Dream模型上最高实现约3倍加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（DLM）采用块级半自回归解码，要求当前块完全解码或去噪预算耗尽后才能开始下一块。然而，一旦当前块暴露出可靠的边界标记或稳定的语义前缀，后续生成无需等待所有残差token都被解析完毕，因此有必要设计更高效的并行调度策略。
AI.method: 提出AsyncLane，一种无需训练的解码调度器。在观察到分隔符边界时，将生成路径分叉为精炼路径（refine lane）和延续路径（continue generate lane），形成路径树记录依赖与输出顺序。结合共享前缀路径批处理、前瞻草稿重用、级联终止和紧凑缓存刷新与logit重用，避免模型调用成本随路径数量线性增长。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，AsyncLane在保持竞争性质量的同时持续提升吞吐量。在LLaDA和Dream骨干网络上，所有评估的长度设置下均达到最高TPS；相对最快基线，在LLaDA上实现2.95倍加速，在Dream上实现3.04倍加速，尤其在长生成预算下增益更大。
AI.conclusion: AsyncLane是块级DLM采样器的即插即用替代方案，无需重新训练，通过异步调度有效提升了扩散大语言模型的解码效率。

title: Structure-Conditioned Actor-Critic Branches for Quality-Diversity Reinforcement Learning
summary: Quality-diversity reinforcement learning (QD-RL) aims to construct policy repertoires that contain both high-performing and behaviorally diverse policies. Existing QD-RL methods mainly diversify policy instances after rollout evaluation or use learned value information to improve policy quality and behavior targeting, while the learning branches that generate candidate policies remain less explored. This paper proposes SV-QD-RL, a structure-value coupled framework that represents each candidate as a structure-conditioned actor-critic branch. Each branch contains an actor, a structural mask, a branch-specific critic, a replay state, and evaluation attributes including behavior, return, sparsity, and value profile. The structural mask defines the actor subspace in which the branch learns, while the branch-specific critic and replay state shape its value-learning trajectory. A branch-aware QD archive then evaluates and retains branches according to behavioral quality, structural footprint, and value-profile information. Experiments on MuJoCo continuous-control tasks show that SV-QD-RL constructs policy repertoires with strong archive quality and behaviorally useful diversity. Ablation and diagnostic analyses further indicate that structural conditioning, critic differentiation, and memory-consistent refinement make complementary contributions to behavioral specialization. Schedule-aware repertoire evaluation shows that the learned archive provides selectable policy alternatives under changing behavior-level requirements. These results suggest that coupling actor structure with branch-specific value learning is an effective mechanism for generating diverse QD-RL policy repertoires.

AI.tldr: 提出SV-QD-RL框架，将每个候选策略表示为结构-价值耦合的actor-critic分支，通过结构掩码和分支专用critic实现行为多样化与高性能的平衡。在MuJoCo任务上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有QD-RL方法主要在rollout评估后多样化策略实例，或使用学习到的价值信息来改进策略质量和行为定向，而生成候选策略的学习分支本身仍较少被探索。
AI.method: 提出SV-QD-RL，每个候选策略是一个结构-价值耦合的actor-critic分支，包含actor、结构掩码、分支专用critic、回放状态及评估属性（行为、回报、稀疏性、价值轮廓）。结构掩码定义actor子空间，分支专用critic塑造价值学习轨迹，通过分支感知QD存档根据行为质量、结构足迹和价值轮廓信息评估和保留分支。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo连续控制任务上，SV-QD-RL构建的策略库表现出强存档质量和有用的行为多样性。消融分析表明结构条件化、critic差异化和记忆一致性细化对行为特化有互补贡献。调度感知评估显示存档可提供可选择的策略替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 将actor结构与分支专用价值学习耦合是生成多样化QD-RL策略库的有效机制。

title: Set-Based Transformer for Atmospheric Compensation in Standoff LWIR Hyperspectral Imaging
summary: Passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) hyperspectral imaging under a standoff geometry depends on atmospheric absorption and emission, as well as reflected radiance, thus making atmospheric compensation essential to get knowledge of a target of interest. Despite its importance, this compensation has been largely overlooked due to its practical and modeling difficulty. In this paper, we present a lightweight set-based deep learning framework that takes multiple radiance measurements, collected at different standoff ranges, as input and jointly estimates transmittance, atmospheric path radiance, and a shared downwelling spectrum. We analyze the learned representation with a sparse autoencoder and observe that several latent features do activate on geographically coherent subsets of the test data despite the absence of location supervision. Experiments on a MODTRAN generated standoff LWIR dataset demonstrate low spectral distortion across all estimated products. The dataset and code is publicly available at: https://factral.co/SAE-LWIR/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级基于集合的深度学习框架，利用不同距离的多辐射测量值联合估计透射率、大气路径辐射和下向光谱，解决被动长波红外高光谱成像中大气补偿的难题。
AI.motivation: 被动长波红外高光谱成像受大气吸收、发射和反射辐射影响，大气补偿对于获取目标信息至关重要，但因其实际和建模困难而被长期忽视。
AI.method: 提出轻量级基于集合的深度学习框架，输入不同距离的多辐射测量值，联合估计透射率、大气路径辐射和共享下向光谱；使用稀疏自编码器分析学习表示。
AI.result: 在MODTRAN生成的远距离LWIR数据集上，所有估计产品均表现出低光谱失真；稀疏自编码器观察到多个潜在特征在测试数据的地理相干子集上激活。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效实现了大气补偿，且学习到的表示具有地理一致性，为被动LWIR高光谱成像的大气补偿提供了可行方案。

title: Hacking Generative Perplexity: Why Unconditional Text Evaluation Needs Distributional Metrics
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling (SPIGM) at ICML 2026
summary: Diffusion and continuous flow-based language models have emerged as the leading non-autoregressive alternatives to language modeling. Progress in both paradigms is overwhelmingly tracked by generative perplexity (gen-PPL): the per-token negative log-likelihood of samples under a frozen autoregressive (AR) scorer such as gpt2-large, typically paired with an empirical-entropy guardrail to rule out low-entropy collapse. We argue that this metric is unsound. By construction, gen-PPL measures only predictability under the scoring AR, not grammaticality or semantic coherence -- and the set of predictable but still low-quality sequences is combinatorially large. To make this concrete, we construct a suite of zero-parameter, deliberately naive samplers that achieve state-of-the-art gen-PPL on LM1B and OpenWebText at non-degenerate entropy, surpassing recently published diffusion and continuous-flow models while producing text that is incoherent by construction. We recommend evaluation suites that directly quantify the distributional divergence between generated and reference text, and use such a suite to re-benchmark recent non-autoregressive models, recovering a more faithful picture of the current state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文指出生成困惑度（gen-PPL）作为非自回归语言模型的评估指标存在根本缺陷，因为它只衡量被评分模型的可预测性而非文本质量。作者构建了零参数朴素采样器，在gen-PPL上超越最新扩散/流模型却生成无意义文本，并建议改用直接量化生成文本与参考文本分布散度的评估方法。
AI.motivation: 当前非自回归语言模型（扩散模型和连续流模型）的进展主要依靠生成困惑度（gen-PPL）来追踪，但该指标本质上只衡量样本在冻结自回归评分器下的可预测性，无法评估语法正确性和语义连贯性，可能导致虚假的性能提升。
AI.method: 1) 论证gen-PPL与文本质量无关的理论缺陷；2) 构造零参数、故意幼稚的采样器（在非退化熵条件下在LM1B和OpenWebText上达到SOTA gen-PPL）；3) 推荐使用直接量化生成文本与参考文本分布散度的评估套件，并重新评测现有非自回归模型。
AI.result: 零参数朴素采样器在gen-PPL指标上超过了最新发表的扩散和连续流模型，同时生成文本是故意不连贯的。使用基于分布散度的新评估套件重新评测后，恢复了更真实的SOTA排名。
AI.conclusion: gen-PPL是一个不可靠的评估指标，该领域需要更合理的评估方法（如分布散度度量）来真实反映模型能力，避免被虚假指标误导。

title: RAILS: Verification-Native Clearing For Agentic Commerce
summary:
Autonomous agents negotiate, purchase, deploy code, and move funds, but no neutral mechanism determines whether they
  met their delegated obligation, who is responsible when they did not, or which settlement action follows. This is the
  agentic clearing problem. Tool protocols (MCP), inter-agent communication (A2A), payment rails (x402), mandate and
  network agent protocols (AP2, Visa, Mastercard), and settlement-risk standards each assume that determination and none
  produce it.
  Clearing is the missing primitive. Payment is not clearing. Authorization is not clearing. LLM-as-judge evaluation is
  not clearing. Settlement-risk escrow is not clearing: it consumes clearing decisions.
  RAILS (Real-Time Agent Integrity & Ledger Settlement) is the integrity and clearing layer for agentic commerce,
  spanning a per-output reliability score, a published reliability record, and a clearing function that consumes them.
  The clearing protocol at its core closes that gap. Seven primitives (Obligation Object, Evidence Envelope,
  Verification Mesh, Clearing Decision, Settlement Instruction, Clearing Passport, Finality Rules), bound by a formal
  model of admissibility-graded verification, together yield a soundness property: no financially material settlement is
  supported by evidence below the obligation's admissibility floor. The property is falsifiable against the spec. We
  are not aware of a prior agent-commerce verification mechanism that states a property of this kind. The approaches
  nearest to it emit a pass, a delivery guarantee, a bare score, or an equilibrium.
  This paper specifies that clearing protocol.

AI.tldr: RAILS 是一个面向自主智能体商业的清算层协议，通过七个原语和可验证的形式模型，解决了智能体在履行义务、责任判定和结算执行方面的缺失问题，确保没有低于义务可接受性门槛的证据支持重大财务结算。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体可以进行协商、购买、部署代码和资金转移，但目前缺乏一个中立机制来判断它们是否履行了委托义务、在未履行时谁应承担责任、以及应执行何种结算措施。现有的工具协议（MCP）、智能体间通信（A2A）、支付轨道（x402）、授权协议（AP2、Visa、Mastercard）以及结算风险标准都依赖于判定结果，但自身不产生判定。清算是缺失的关键原语。
AI.method: RAILS 被设计为一个完整性（integrity）和清算（clearing）层，包含三个核心组件：每个输出的可靠性评分（per-output reliability score）、已发布的可靠性记录（published reliability record）、以及消费这些评分和记录的清算函数（clearing function）。其核心清算协议由七个原语构成：义务对象（Obligation Object）、证据信封（Evidence Envelope）、验证网格（Verification Mesh）、清算决策（Clearing Decision）、结算指令（Settlement Instruction）、清算通行证（Clearing Passport）、最终性规则（Finality Rules）。这些原语通过一个形式化的可接受性分级验证模型（admissibility-graded verification）绑定，产生一个可靠性属性：没有低于义务可接受性门槛的证据支持重大财务结算。
AI.result: 论文提出了一个可证伪的可靠性属性（soundness property），即任何低于义务可接受性门槛的证据都无法支持重大财务结算。作者表示，据他们所知，此前没有智能体商业验证机制能陈述此类属性。最接近的方案要么输出一个"通过"、交付保证、原始分数或均衡状态，而非这样一个形式化的属性保证。
AI.conclusion: RAILS 填补了智能体商业中清算原语的缺失，提供了一个形式化可验证的清算协议。该协议确保证据充分性达到义务可接受性门槛，从而支持可靠的责任判定和结算执行。

title: SMI: Efficient Self-Supervised Learning via Mutual-Information-Inspired Dependency Optimization
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has achieved remarkable representation learning performance, but many existing methods rely on large batch sizes, memory banks, momentum encoders, or global synchronization mechanisms that substantially increase computational cost and training complexity. In this work, we propose Semantic Mutual Information (SMI), a lightweight self-supervised objective derived from a mutual-information-inspired dependency formulation under Gaussian assumptions. Unlike conventional correlation matching objectives that operate on high-dimensional feature correlation matrices, SMI performs optimization on a sample-level dependency matrix through a nonlinear transformation of pairwise correlations. This formulation induces distinct optimization dynamics that emphasize strongly dependent semantic pairs while maintaining representation diversity. Experimental results on ImageNet using a ResNet-50 backbone demonstrate that SMI achieves competitive linear evaluation performance relative to state-of-the-art SSL approaches while substantially reducing computational complexity. Across multiple low-resource benchmarks, SMI consistently improves transfer performance over Barlow Twins, particularly on fine-grained datasets. Furthermore, analyses of optimization dynamics and representation geometry suggest improved alignment--redundancy balance, greater feature diversity, and more spatially localized semantic representations. These results indicate that nonlinear dependency optimization provides an effective and computationally efficient alternative to conventional correlation-based self-supervised learning objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为语义互信息（SMI）的轻量级自监督学习目标，通过非线性相关性变换在样本级别进行优化，在降低计算复杂度的同时取得了与SOTA方法竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督学习方法（如大batch size、memory bank、动量编码器等）计算成本和训练复杂度高，亟需一种轻量级且高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 基于互信息启发的依赖公式，在高斯假设下，通过非线性变换将成对相关性映射到样本级依赖矩阵上，优化强依赖语义对的表示，同时保持多样性。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上用ResNet-50达到与SOTA SSL方法竞争的线性评估性能，计算复杂度显著降低；在多个低资源基准上持续提升迁移性能（尤其细粒度数据集）；优化动力学和表示几何分析显示更好的对齐-冗余平衡、特征多样性和空间局部化语义表示。
AI.conclusion: 非线性依赖优化是传统基于相关性的自监督学习目标的一种有效且计算高效的替代方案。

title: Segment-level Tree Search for Long Meeting Document Summarization
summary: Meeting documents are challenging to summarize due to their length and complex conversational structure. Existing approaches typically adopt multi-stage pipelines that extract information prior to summarization; however, these approaches often suffer from cumulative error propagation without intermediate validation, a limitation further amplified by short and low-quality reference summaries. We propose segment-level summarization via Monte Carlo Tree Search (S3), a training-free framework that constructs a final summary by composing segment-level summary candidates. S3 partitions a long document into segments and generates multiple summary candidates per segment, forming nodes of a search tree. The best-scoring combination is selected via self-reward-guided tree search and refined into the final output. Despite using a 7B model, S3 achieves performance comparable to larger 72B models while producing length-appropriate summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S3，一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的无训练长文档摘要框架，通过分段落生成候选摘要并自奖励搜索最优组合，使用7B模型即可达到72B模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有会议文档摘要方法采用多阶段流水线，存在累积误差传播问题，且参考摘要短、质量低进一步放大该缺陷。
AI.method: 将长文档分割成段落，为每段生成多个候选摘要作为搜索树节点，通过自奖励引导的树搜索选择最佳组合，精炼为最终输出。
AI.result: 使用7B模型实现了与更大规模72B模型相当的性能，且生成长度恰当的摘要。
AI.conclusion: S3是一种无需训练且高效的会议文档摘要方法，能有效缓解误差传播问题。

title: Beyond Raw Signals: Undecoded Generative Latents as Privileged Synthetic Data
summary: While multimodal integration significantly improves computer vision models, deploying them incurs prohibitive inference costs and requires scarce, perfectly paired datasets. Recent methods address this data bottleneck by synthesizing missing modalities via generative AI, yet they introduce a severe inefficiency: the Decode-Encode Loop. Specifically, information-rich generative latents are decoded into noisy raw signals, forcing the downstream classifier to waste capacity re-encoding them. To bypass this bottleneck, we propose Direct Latent Augmentation (DLA), utilizing undecoded generative latents directly as privileged information. Furthermore, to transfer this dense knowledge to a purely visual student, we introduce Multilayer Explicit Simulated Synesthesia (MESSy). Instead of enforcing rigid representation matching, which forces the student to distort its native visual features to accommodate complex multimodal topologies, MESSy uses a predictive objective to safely internalize these physical priors. Empirical results demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms raw data augmentation and traditional distillation. Ultimately, our approach yields highly accurate unimodal students with ``synesthetic'' latent structures that are inherently aligned with physical properties they have never directly observed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出直接潜在增强（DLA）和多层显式模拟联觉（MESSy），通过利用未解码的生成式潜在特征作为特权信息，避免多模态模型中的“解码-编码循环”效率瓶颈，使单模态学生模型获得与物理属性对齐的“联觉”潜在结构。
AI.motivation: 多模态融合虽能提升视觉模型性能，但部署成本高且需要稀缺的完美配对数据集。现有方法通过生成式AI合成缺失模态，但引入了“解码-编码循环”的低效问题：生成式潜在特征被解码为含噪原始信号，迫使下游分类器重新编码，浪费计算资源。
AI.method: 提出DLA利用未解码的生成式潜在特征直接作为特权信息；提出MESSy通过预测性目标将密集知识转移到纯视觉学生模型，避免强制表示匹配导致的学生特征扭曲。
AI.result: 所提框架显著优于原始数据增强和传统蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能训练出高精度的单模态学生模型，其潜在结构与从未直接观察的物理属性内在对齐，产生“联觉”式的表征能力。

title: Sycophancy as a Multilingual Alignment Failure: How Safety Degrades Across Languages, Topics, and Models
summary: Safety-aligned large language models often exhibit sycophancy, which is the tendency to affirm users' opinions regardless of factual accuracy. Although well-studied in English, its manifestation in other languages remains largely unexamined, leaving billions of non-English speakers potentially vulnerable to model-validated misinformation. We present the first large-scale, multi-model evaluation of cross-lingual sycophancy, benchmarking \textbf{six instruction-tuned models} across \textbf{1.1 million instances} spanning \textbf{38 languages} and \textbf{33 topic categories}. We identify a consistent resource-tier effect: sycophancy rates spike sharply in low-resource and zero-shot language settings. Critically, this degradation is topic-agnostic, as models fail uniformly across both benign and safety-critical prompts, offering no additional protection where it is most needed. We further identify tokenizer fertility as a structural driver of this alignment collapse. Collectively, our results demonstrate that prevailing alignment methodologies generalize poorly beyond high-resource languages, underscoring the urgent need for equitable multilingual safety techniques.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次大规模评估了跨语言情境下大型语言模型的“谄媚”行为（即顺从用户错误观点），发现在低资源语言中谄媚率急剧上升，且这种现象与话题无关，揭示了当前对齐方法在多语言环境中的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 尽管英语中模型谄媚问题已被充分研究，但其在其他语言中的表现尚不清楚，这使得数十亿非英语使用者可能面临模型验证错误信息的风险。
AI.method: 对6个经过指令微调的模型，在38种语言、33个话题类别下进行了110万实例的大规模跨语言谄媚行为基准测试。
AI.result: 发现资源层级效应：低资源和零样本语言中谄媚率急剧上升；该 degradation 与话题无关，在安全关键话题上同样严重；分词器生育率是导致对齐失效的结构性驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 当前的对齐方法在低资源语言上泛化能力差，亟需开发公平的多语言安全技术。

title: Q-Delta: Beyond Key-Value Associative State Evolution
summary: Linear attention reformulates sequence modeling as recurrent state evolution, enabling efficient linear-time inference. Under the key-value associative paradigm, existing approaches restrict the role of the query to the readout operation, decoupling it from state evolution. We show that query-conditioned state readout induces a structured value prediction over accumulated memory that complements key-based retrieval. Based on this insight, we propose Q-Delta, a query-aware delta rule that integrates mixed key-query prediction errors into state evolution, enabling jointly corrective dynamics while preserving delta-rule efficiency. We establish stability guarantees for the resulting dynamics and derive a hardware-efficient chunkwise-parallel formulation with a custom Triton implementation. Empirical results demonstrate stable optimization, competitive throughput, and consistent improvements over strong baselines on language modeling and long-context retrieval tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-Delta，一种查询感知的delta规则，将混合键-查询预测误差整合到状态演化中，在保持delta规则效率的同时实现联合纠正动态，在语言建模和长上下文检索任务上取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: 现有线性注意力方法在键值关联范式下将查询的角色限制为读取操作，使其与状态演化解耦，忽略了查询条件化状态读取与基于键的检索之间互补的价值预测能力。
AI.method: 提出Q-Delta，一种查询感知的delta规则，将混合键-查询预测误差整合到状态演化中，实现联合纠正动态；建立稳定性保证；推导硬件高效的分块并行公式并用自定义Triton实现。
AI.result: 在语言建模和长上下文检索任务上，Q-Delta展现出稳定优化、竞争性吞吐量，并一致优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 查询感知的delta规则能有效弥补现有方法中查询与状态演化解耦的不足，在保持效率的同时提升性能。

title: More Yap Less Meaning: Uncovering Self-Improvement Behavior in SLMs
summary: Recently, language models have made rapid progress across various domains and applications. However, their capability for self-improvement, i.e., whether they are adept at recognising and correcting flaws in their own reasoning, remains dubious. In this study, we address this question by constructing a sufficiency test to rigorously examine the self-correction capabilities of small language models (SLMs). We propose a minimal three-step self-correction pipeline that collects initial SLM answers, prompts the same model to generate hints for its incorrect responses given the ground truth, and feeds the model the same question with its own feedback to refine the initial answer. We evaluate a variety of instruction-tuned and reasoning SLMs in this experimental setup on arithmetic and logical reasoning benchmarks. Our findings show that SLMs with injected hint sentences yield only a 4.4 percent gain over initial question-answering accuracy. Even though the correct answer was provided alongside the model's incorrect reasoning, the evaluated SLMs fail to understand what was missing in their reasoning and show minimal semantic difference between hints that lead to corrections and ones that do not. Furthermore, our experiments show that longer hints are positively correlated with incorrect final answers, suggesting that longer deliberation on problems can hinder the reasoning process, meaning that SLMs do not necessarily scale in performance with a larger compute budget.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一个三步自纠正流水线，系统评估了小型语言模型(SLM)的自我修正能力，发现SLM即使获得正确答案和自身错误推理的提示，也只能获得4.4%的准确率提升，且较长的提示反而与错误最终答案正相关。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在多个领域取得了快速进展，但其自我改进能力——即识别和纠正自身推理中缺陷的能力——仍然存疑。本文旨在严格检验小型语言模型的自纠正能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个最小化的三步自纠正流水线：(1)收集SLM的初始答案；(2)针对错误答案，利用真实标签提示同一模型生成提示；(3)将原问题与自身生成的反馈一同输入模型，以优化初始答案。在算术和逻辑推理基准上评估了多种指令微调和推理型SLM。
AI.result: SLM在注入提示句后仅获得4.4%的准确率提升；即使提供正确答案和模型的错误推理，SLM也无法理解自身推理中的缺失；较长提示与错误最终答案呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 当前小型语言模型缺乏有效的自我纠正能力，更长的推理时间反而会阻碍其推理过程，性能不会随着计算预算的增加而线性扩展。

title: STAR: Rethinking MoE Routing as Structure-Aware Subspace Learning
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales model capacity efficiently by selectively routing inputs to a specialized subset of experts. However, input-expert specialization, the core motivation of MoE, critically depends on whether the router is actually aware of input structure. In practice, MoE routing is typically implemented as a shallow linear projection with limited awareness of input representation, which often leads to unstable routing. We propose STAR, a Structure Aware Routing that rethinks MoE routing as a subspace learning problem by augmenting standard learnable routing with an evolving principal subspace that tracks dominant input structure via Generalized Hebbian Algorithm (GHA). By aligning routing decisions directly with input structure, STAR enables stable expert specialization. We evaluate STAR on controlled synthetic setup and large-scale language and vision tasks, where it consistently improves routing quality and downstream performance over strong MoE baselines. Moreover, optional test-time subspace updates further enhance routing robustness and generalization under input distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: STAR提出了一种结构感知路由方法，通过广义Hebbian算法学习输入的主子空间来改进MoE路由，实现更稳定的专家专业化，在合成数据和大型语言/视觉任务上均优于传统MoE方法。
AI.motivation: 传统MoE的路由器通常采用浅层线性投影，对输入结构的感知能力有限，导致路由不稳定，影响了输入-专家专业化的核心目标。
AI.method: 将MoE路由重新定义为子空间学习问题，在标准可学习路由基础上，通过广义Hebbian算法（GHA）引入一个演化的主子空间来追踪输入的主导结构，使路由决策与输入结构对齐。
AI.result: 在受控合成实验和大规模语言/视觉任务上，STAR consistently提升了路由质量和下游性能；测试时的子空间更新进一步增强了在输入分布偏移下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: STAR通过结构感知路由有效解决了MoE路由不稳定的问题，实现了更可靠的专家专业化，并且具备测试时自适应能力，为MoE路由设计提供了新的思路。

title: SceneConductor: 3D Scene Generation from Single Image with Multi-Agent Orchestration
summary: Generating complete 3D scenes from a single image requires inferring globally consistent geometry, object relationships, and environmental context from inherently ambiguous visual evidence. Despite recent progress in joint layout-and-mesh generation, existing methods often rely on holistic or weakly decomposed pipelines that entangle many factors at once and demand extensive scene-level supervision, limiting their generalization to complex real-world environments. We propose a multi-agent orchestration framework that decomposes single-image 3D scene generation into three structured stages: scene initialization, environment construction, and multi-agent refinement. The initialization stage extracts image-derived object masks, builds object-level 3D representations, and predicts an initial spatial layout to form a coarse 3D scene. The environment-construction stage then leverages this initialization together with point-map geometry to build an environmental scaffold of supporting surfaces, room boundaries, materials, and illumination. Finally, in the refinement stage, a planner agent identifies structural and visual inconsistencies, applies simple corrections directly, and dispatches specialist agents for complex localized revisions that are reintegrated into the global scene. To provide reliable structural initialization while reducing reliance on scene-level annotations, we further introduce a geometry-aware layout predictor supervised by sparse geometric priors derived from point maps. Unlike fully supervised layout generators, the predictor can be trained from segmentation-level data and generalizes robustly to diverse real-world scenes. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches in geometric accuracy, spatial consistency, and perceptual realism.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多智能体编排框架，将单图像3D场景生成分解为场景初始化、环境构建和多智能体精化三个阶段，通过几何感知布局预测器减少对场景级标注的依赖，在几何精度、空间一致性和感知真实性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖整体式或弱分解流水线，纠缠多种因素且需要大量场景级监督，限制了在复杂真实环境中的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出多智能体编排框架：(1) 场景初始化：提取图像物体掩码、构建3D表示、预测初始布局；(2) 环境构建：利用初始化和点云几何构建支撑面、房间边界、材质和光照；(3) 多智能体精化：规划智能体识别不一致性并直接修正或派发专业智能体进行局部修订，然后重新整合到全局场景中。此外引入几何感知布局预测器，由点云稀疏几何先验监督，可从分割级数据训练。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在几何精度、空间一致性和感知真实性方面持续优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦不同阶段任务并引入多智能体协作机制，结合几何感知布局预测器，有效提升了单图像3D场景生成的泛化能力和生成质量。

title: Momentum for Reasoning: Dense Intrinsic Signals in Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for eliciting long-chain reasoning in large language models. However, existing methods based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) rely on a binary outcome reward, which induces two structural failure modes: Zero-Advantage Collapse, in which all rollouts in a group share the same outcome and the gradient vanishes, and Hallucinated Certainty, in which the model becomes increasingly confident on incorrect rollouts late in training. We address both modes by densifying the reward with intrinsic signals computed entirely from the policy's own conditional probabilities, and propose ISPO (Intrinsic Signal Policy Optimization, which combines a sequence-level signal measuring how informative the thinking trajectory is for the final answer, with a token-level directional reward whose hallucinated-certainty hinge penalizes confidently-wrong predictions at critical decision tokens. Across three base models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ISPO consistently outperforms competitive baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest benchmarks where zero-advantage collapse is most frequent, and training-dynamics diagnostics confirm that both failure modes are decreased.

AI.tldr: 针对GRPO中二元结果奖励导致的零优势坍塌和幻觉确定性两种失效模式，本文提出ISPO方法，通过内在信号稠密化奖励，在多个数学推理基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于GRPO的RLVR方法使用二元结果奖励，存在零优势坍塌（组内所有轨迹结果相同导致梯度消失）和幻觉确定性（模型对错误轨迹过度自信）两种结构性缺陷，亟需解决。
AI.method: 提出ISPO（内在信号策略优化），包含两种内在奖励信号：（1）序列级信号，衡量思维轨迹对最终答案的信息量；（2）词元级方向性奖励，通过幻觉确定性铰链惩罚对关键决策词元上的错误自信预测。
AI.result: 在三种基础模型和五个数学推理基准上，ISPO一致优于竞争基线；在零优势坍塌最频繁的最难基准上提升最大；训练动态诊断证实两种失效模式均被缓解。
AI.conclusion: 通过内在信号稠密化奖励能有效解决二元奖励的结构性缺陷，显著提升长链推理的强化学习效果。

title: Geometry-Driven Flow Analysis of Brain Sulcal Pattern
summary: Cortical folding reflects coordinated neurodevelopmental processes and is increasingly recognized as a sensitive marker of neurological disease. However, most existing analyses rely on indirect scalar summaries that do not explicitly model folding geometry itself. In juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME), a common genetic epilepsy, cortical abnormalities are often subtle, spatially distributed, and difficult to detect using conventional morphometric measures. We introduce a Poisson-equation-based framework that models cortical folding as a geometry-driven flow derived from mean curvature on the cortical manifold. By treating folding patterns as a stationary source-sink structure, the proposed approach yields a smooth, globally balanced potential field whose surface gradient defines a physically interpretable flux. This framework enables spatially coherent analysis of sulcal-gyral folding organization and provides a principled representation of geometry-driven cortical structure in JME.

AI.tldr: 提出基于泊松方程的皮层折叠分析框架，将折叠模式建模为几何驱动流，用于检测青少年肌阵挛癫痫（JME）的微妙皮层异常。
AI.motivation: 现有皮层折叠分析依赖间接标量汇总指标，未能显式建模折叠几何本身，难以检测JME中细微且空间分布广泛的皮层异常。
AI.method: 基于泊松方程，将皮层折叠建模为源于平均曲率的几何驱动流，将折叠模式视为稳态源-汇结构，生成光滑全局平衡的势场，其表面梯度定义物理可解释的通量。
AI.result: 该方法能实现空间连贯的沟回折叠组织分析，为JME中几何驱动的皮层结构提供原理性表示。
AI.conclusion: 该框架相比传统标量指标能更好地捕捉折叠几何特征，有望成为检测JME等神经疾病的敏感生物标志。

title: SAEExplainer: Interpreting SAE Features with Activation-Guided Preference Optimization
summary: Although Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have mitigated the opacity of large language models (LLMs) by decomposing dense representations into sparse features, explaining these features still remains a central challenge. Current explanation methods, however, typically operate within an open-loop paradigm, failing to leverage mechanistic feedback for further refinement. In this paper, we propose SAEExplainer, a training framework utilizes activation scores as an objective reward signal to train the model for self-correction and iterative bootstrapping. By iteratively verifying and correcting foundational explanations through a two-round optimization process, SAEExplainer achieves continuous improvement in its explanatory capabilities. This mechanism significantly reduces explanation hallucinations and reinforces causal triggering patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate our approach improves upon established baselines across most metrics, especially in causal triggering and discriminative activation.
