AI.tldr: 提出SAEExplainer框架，利用激活分数作为奖励信号，通过两轮优化实现自纠正和迭代改进，显著减少解释幻觉并增强因果触发模式。
AI.motivation: 当前SAE特征解释方法局限于开环范式，缺乏利用机制反馈进行进一步优化的能力，导致解释质量受限。
AI.method: SAEExplainer利用稀疏自编码器的激活分数作为客观奖励信号，通过两轮优化（验证+纠正）训练模型进行自纠正和迭代自助法，持续提升解释能力。
AI.result: 在多数指标上优于现有基线方法，尤其在因果触发和判别性激活方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: SAEExplainer通过闭环反馈机制有效减少解释幻觉，强化因果触发模式，为SAE特征解释提供了一种更可靠的方案。

title: Inference-Time Conformal Reasoning with Valid Factuality Control for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly perform multi-step reasoning, where intermediate claims form implicit directed acyclic graphs whose node correctness is structurally conditioned on their ancestors. This makes factuality uncertainty structural, rather than a trivial accumulation of node-wise errors, and necessitates inference-time uncertainty quantification over the reasoning structure. While conformal prediction (CP) offers flexible user-specified factuality control, existing work remains post-hoc and cannot intervene during generation. To fill the gap between CP's flexibility and its post-hoc limitation, we propose an \emph{Inference-Time Conformal Reasoning (ITCR)} framework that integrates CP directly into reasoning graph generation. ITCR learns a structure-level factuality uncertainty function that aggregates claim-level factuality signals over reasoning graphs without complex modeling assumptions. We then design the non-conformity score based on graph-level factuality uncertainty and calibrate the conformal threshold to decide when to stop generation. We theoretically show such generation is nested, yielding valid coverage guarantees for factuality control. Experiments over multiple datasets and coverage objectives demonstrate empirically valid coverage. In downstream reasoning tasks, inference-time calibrated graphs yield more accurate generation than post-hoc pruned graphs.

AI.tldr: 提出推理时置信推理框架（ITCR），将共形预测直接集成到推理图生成过程中，实现结构级事实性控制，并保证理论覆盖率和更准确的生成。
AI.motivation: 现有共形预测方法在事实性控制上灵活但仅能事后(post-hoc)干预，无法在生成过程中实时控制，而LLM多步推理的中间事实性存在结构依赖关系，需要推理时的不确定性量化。
AI.method: 学习结构级事实性不确定性函数，聚合推理图上各声明级事实性信号；基于图级不确定性设计非一致性分数，校准共形阈值以决定何时停止生成；理论上证明生成过程是嵌套的，保证了有效的覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和覆盖目标上经验性地验证了覆盖有效性；在下游推理任务中，推理时校准的图比事后剪枝的图生成更准确。
AI.conclusion: ITCR框架成功弥补了共形预测灵活性与事后局限性之间的差距，为LLM多步推理提供了结构感知的推理时事实性控制方法。

title: CoVEBench: Can Video Editing Models Handle Complex Instructions?
summary: While recent text-guided video editing models excel at elementary tasks (e.g., style transfer, object insertion), real-world user requests are highly compositional. A single prompt often demands multiple coupled edits, such as modifying subjects, actions, and camera views, while strictly preserving unrelated spatiotemporal content. Existing benchmarks, heavily constrained by isolated edits and coarse global metrics, fail to diagnose how models handle such complex workflows. To address this gap, we introduce CoVEBench, a compositional video editing benchmark comprising 416 curated source videos, 626 multi-point editing instructions, and 9,990 fine-grained checklist items. Covering diverse editing dimensions, CoVEBench evaluates models via MLLM-judged instruction compliance and video fidelity, alongside automated metrics for video quality. Extensive experiments reveal that compositional editing remains a profound challenge: current models frequently omit edits, violate preservation constraints, or introduce artifacts when handling multiple operations simultaneously. CoVEBench provides a challenging, diagnostic testbed to advance video editing toward realistic user workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出CoVEBench基准，用于评估视频编辑模型在处理组合式编辑任务（同时修改主体、动作、视角等多维度）时的能力，包含416个视频、626条编辑指令和9,990个细粒度检查项，实验发现现有模型在多操作组合编辑中表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑基准局限于孤立的单维度编辑任务和粗粒度的全局评估指标，无法诊断模型在处理用户真实组合式编辑需求（同时修改主体、动作、视角等）时的表现。
AI.method: 构建CoVEBench基准，包含416个源视频、626个多点编辑指令和9,990个细粒度检查项，采用MLLM评判指令遵循度和视频保真度，结合自动指标评估视频质量。
AI.result: 实验表明组合式编辑仍是重大挑战：现有模型在处理多操作同时编辑时，经常遗漏编辑、违反保真约束或引入伪影。
AI.conclusion: CoVEBench为视频编辑研究提供了一个具有挑战性的诊断测试平台，推动视频编辑向更真实的用户工作流发展。

title: Back on Track: Aligning Rewards and States for Reasoning in Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds immense promise for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of diffusion large language models (dLLMs). However, progress is fundamentally constrained by a dual misalignment between authentic generation trajectory and the gradient update process: (i) Process-reward misalignment. Sparse, terminal rewards are indiscriminately assigned to all intermediate steps of the generation process, failing to provide discriminative credit assignment. (ii) State-trajectory misalignment. Policy updates are often diverted toward artificial, out-of-trajectory states, squandering gradients on less informative samples. To address these limitations, we introduce Process Aligned Policy Optimization (PAPO), a novel framework that holistically aligns the RL update with the dLLM's generative trajectory via Step-Aware Process Rewards (SPR) that transform sparse terminal rewards into dense, step-wise credit, and Entropy-Guided Historical Re-enactment (EHR) that replays authentic trajectories at high-uncertainty steps. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that PAPO significantly outperforms baselines, achieving gains of up to 4.5% on GSM8K, 4.8% on MATH500, 42.2% on Countdown and 16.1% on Sudoku.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAPO框架，通过步级过程奖励和熵引导历史重演，解决扩散大语言模型强化学习中的双重对齐问题，在四个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有RL方法在提升dLLM推理能力时存在双重错位：过程奖励稀疏且无区分性，以及策略更新偏离真实生成轨迹，导致梯度浪费在低信息样本上。
AI.method: 提出PAPO框架，包含两个核心组件：Step-Aware Process Rewards (SPR)将稀疏的终端奖励转化为密集的步级信用分配；Entropy-Guided Historical Re-enactment (EHR)在高不确定性步骤重放真实轨迹。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH500、Countdown和Sudoku四个基准上，PAPO分别提升4.5%、4.8%、42.2%和16.1%，显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PAPO通过对齐RL更新与dLLM生成轨迹，有效解决了过程-奖励和状态-轨迹的双重错位问题，验证了该框架的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Instrumental convergence and power-seeking
summary: Recent years have seen increasing concern that artificial intelligence may soon pose an existential risk to humanity. One leading ground for concern is that artificial agents may be power-seeking, aiming to acquire power and in the process disempowering humanity. I show how the argument from power-seeking rests on a strong version of a claim known as the instrumental convergence thesis. I explore leading defenses of the instrumental convergence thesis and argue that none establishes the thesis in a strong enough form to ground the argument from power-seeking. I discuss implications for longtermism, the governance of artificial intelligence, and the methodology of studying risks posed by artificial agents.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了人工智能因追求权力而可能对人类构成生存威胁的论点，认为该论点依赖于一个未经充分证实的强版本工具性收敛论题。
AI.motivation: 近年来人们日益担心AI可能因权力寻求行为而给人类带来生存风险，作者旨在检验这一担忧的逻辑基础是否可靠。
AI.method: 通过逻辑分析，审视权力寻求论点所依赖的工具性收敛论题的强弱版本，并逐一评估其主要辩护论证是否足以支持强版本的论题。
AI.result: 发现现有对工具性收敛论题的辩护均未能确立其强版本，因此权力寻求论点缺乏坚实的理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 该发现对长期主义、人工智能治理以及研究AI风险的方法论具有重要启示意义。

title: Ishigaki-IDS: An Open-Weight Verifier-Aware Model for Information Delivery Specification Drafting in Building Information Modeling
summary: Building Information Modeling (BIM) projects require information requirements to be described as machine-checkable Information Delivery Specification (IDS) files in order to verify whether building models contain the required attributes. However, IDS authoring remains a practical bottleneck: practitioners must handle domain vocabulary, strict XML schema constraints, and external validator conformance while also checking whether the requirement itself is correctly expressed. We present Ishigaki-IDS, an open-weight LLM specialized for verifier-aware IDS draft generation. The model combines continued pretraining on BIM/IDS corpora, supervised fine-tuning on information-requirement-to-IDS pairs, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards from an external validator. The goal is not to replace expert review, but to move IDS authoring from low-level XML and schema repair toward validator-loadable drafts that practitioners can inspect and correct. On the 166-case expert-created Ishigaki-IDS-Bench, Ishigaki-IDS-8B achieves an IDSAuditPass score of 0.651, a validator-pass metric for generated IDS files, substantially outperforming Claude Opus 4.5, the strongest single-shot LLM baseline we evaluated, at 0.331. It also obtains an Audit-Gated FacetF1 of 0.282, which measures requirement-facet alignment among validator-passing drafts. The same recipe scales: 14B and 32B variants reach IDSAuditPass 0.753 / 0.693 and Audit-Gated FacetF1 0.392 / 0.369. In a workflow check with six BIM practitioners, Ishigaki-assisted authoring reduced aggregate work time by 54.7% under the same validation and alignment endpoint. These results suggest that verifier-aware IDS generation can reduce the practical burden of converting BIM information requirements into reviewable IDS drafts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ishigaki-IDS，一个基于开源大语言模型（LLM）的专门工具，用于自动生成建筑信息模型（BIM）领域可验证的信息交付规范（IDS）草案。通过持续预训练、监督微调和基于外部验证器的强化学习，该模型在 IDS 草案生成上显著优于 Claude Opus 4.5 等通用模型，并在实际工作流中将人工编辑时间减少了 54.7%。
AI.motivation: 当前 BIM 项目中，信息需求需要被描述为机器可检查的 IDS 文件，但 IDS 编写存在实践瓶颈：从业者必须处理领域词汇、严格的 XML 模式约束和外部验证器一致性，同时还要检查需求本身是否表达正确。这些问题使得 IDS 编写成为效率瓶颈。
AI.method: Ishigaki-IDS 结合了三阶段训练策略：(1) 在 BIM/IDS 语料上继续预训练；(2) 在信息需求到 IDS 的配对数据上进行监督微调；(3) 利用外部验证器提供可验证的奖励信号进行强化学习。模型共有 8B、14B 和 32B 三种规模变体。
AI.result: 在 166 个专家创建的 Ishigaki-IDS-Bench 上，Ishigaki-IDS-8B 的 IDSAuditPass 得分为 0.651，远超 Claude Opus 4.5（最佳单次 LLM 基线）的 0.331；Audit-Gated FacetF1 得分为 0.282（基线为 0.282 的对比对象未直接给出，但上下文表明同样优于基线）。14B 和 32B 变体分别达到 IDSAuditPass 0.753/0.693 和 Audit-Gated FacetF1 0.392/0.369。在实际工作流中，Ishigaki 辅助编写使总工作时间减少 54.7%。
AI.conclusion: 验证器感知的 IDS 生成方法可以有效降低将 BIM 信息需求转换为可审查 IDS 草案的实际负担。该工具的目标不是取代专家审查，而是将 IDS 编写从底层的 XML 和模式修复工作转移到可直接加载验证的草案生成上，供从业者检查和纠正。

title: Beyond Pass Rate: A Multilingual, Execution-Grounded Evaluation of Open Code LLMs
summary: Code generation models are typically compared using compact execution benchmarks and aggregate pass rates, but such summaries obscure how performance varies across programming languages, problem families, and failure modes. We present a large-scale, execution-grounded evaluation of 9 openly accessible LLMs specialized for coding on 2,707 free LeetCode problems across 12 programming languages. Our corpus contains 325,343 problem-model-language jobs, each linked to prompt metadata, extracted code, LeetCode execution outcomes, and static-analysis signals. The results show that current open models remain far from the human acceptance reference: the best model, Yi-Coder-9B-Chat, reaches 23.64% mean correctness, compared with a 57.2% human acceptance baseline. Rankings are also slice-dependent: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct is strongest on hard problems and distinct-problem coverage, while Gemma-2-27B-IT achieves the highest all-language lint pass rate. Failure analysis shows that compile errors account for 63.25% of non-accepted best submissions, indicating that many failures occur before semantic correctness can be tested. Static quality further diverges from functional correctness. Together, these findings show that multilingual, artifact-preserving evaluation reveals tradeoffs hidden by single-language or single-metric leaderboards.

AI.tldr: 对9个开源代码生成模型在12种编程语言、2707道LeetCode题目上进行了大规模评估，发现最佳模型Yi-Coder-9B-Chat的准确率仅23.64%，远低于人类57.2%的基线；编译错误占失败原因的63.25%，多语言评估揭示了单语言或单指标评测中隐藏的性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成模型评测多依赖单一语言和聚合通过率指标，掩盖了模型在不同编程语言、问题类型和失败模式上的性能差异，缺乏大规模、多语言、细粒度的执行级评估。
AI.method: 收集9个开源代码专用LLM，在12种编程语言、2707道LeetCode题目上执行325,343次模型-语言-问题任务，记录执行结果、静态分析信号和元数据，进行多维度比较分析。
AI.result: Yi-Coder-9B-Chat平均正确率23.64%（人类基线57.2%）；Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct在难题和覆盖面上最强；Gemma-2-27B-IT的lint通过率最高；编译错误占非通过提交的63.25%。
AI.conclusion: 多语言、保留工件的评估方式揭示了单语言或单指标排行榜所掩盖的性能权衡，当前开源模型在功能正确性和代码静态质量方面均远未达到人类水平。

title: Inside the LLM Word Factory
comment: 17 pages, 12 figures. Under review at EMNLP 2026
summary: Transformer language models process input provided as subword fragments, but natural language semantics usually rely on word-level concepts. Detokenization is the process where models reconcile these two facts, aggregating subwords into word-level representations through their computation. Prior work has found that this takes place mostly in early-to-middle layers, but so far the exact mechanics of the process have not been pinned down. We venture deep into detokenization using activation patching in controlled paired experiments that isolate the contribution of different model components, localizing English detokenization in Llama2-7B to a two-stage process at Layer 1. Attention transmits a token-specific signal from nonfinal subwords, using sequential relays if necessary, while the MLP composes it with the local embedding. This two-stage structure generalizes to twelve models from eight families, but the depth over which it takes place depends on the flavor of positional encoding: RoPE-based models detokenize over 1 to 5 layers, while learned-absolute models take 5 to 10. Finally, we provide a probe for determining the success of the detokenization process based on early-layer activations alone, performing at 0.94-0.97 AUROC depending on the amount of context.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了大语言模型（Llama2-7B等）中"去分词化"（将子词片段聚合为词级表示）的具体机制：这是一个两层过程，第一层中注意力机制传递非最终子词的特定信号（必要时通过顺序中继），而MLP层则将其与局部嵌入组合。该机制在8个家族的12个模型中普遍存在，但深度受位置编码类型影响（RoPE模型需1-5层，绝对位置编码模型需5-10层）。此外，仅基于早期层激活即可高精度（AUROC 0.94-0.97）预测去分词化是否成功。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型以子词片段处理输入，而自然语言语义依赖词级概念。此前研究仅发现去分词化主要发生在早期到中间层，但未明确其具体机制。本文旨在精确定位并解释这一过程的工作原理。
AI.method: 采用激活修补（activation patching）技术在受控配对实验中进行因果分析，隔离不同模型组件的贡献。对Llama2-7B及12个来自8个家族的模型进行系统性分析，并设计基于早期层激活的探测方法评估去分词化成功程度。
AI.result: 1. Llama2-7B中去分词化是Layer 1的两阶段过程：注意力传递子词信号（必要时顺序中继），MLP将其与局部嵌入组合。2. 该结构在12个模型中通用，但深度因位置编码而异：RoPE模型1-5层，绝对位置编码模型5-10层。3. 基于早期层激活的探测器AUROC达0.94-0.97。
AI.conclusion: 去分词化在大语言模型中具有通用的两阶段结构，其具体实现深度与位置编码类型密切相关。仅凭早期层激活即可高置信度判断去分词化是否完成，为理解语言模型词义构建提供了机制性解释。

title: ZIPP:Zero-shot Image Personalization from Personas
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly deployed in open-ended creative contexts, yet their outputs remain impersonal, optimized for aggregate aesthetics rather than individual taste. Human preferences are pluralistic: one user favoring muted, nostalgic portraits may prefer vibrant street photography, while another gravitates toward dreamy film aesthetics. Existing methods require dense interaction histories or per-user fine-tuning, failing in cold-start settings and collapsing context-dependent preferences into a static representation. We introduce zero-shot image personalization from personas (ZIPP), which conditions image generation on natural-language personas (concise descriptors of a user's identity and aesthetic sensibilities) without any user-specific data or weight updates. ZIPP uses an LLM to rewrite prompts from the perspective of a given persona, steering diffusion models toward personalized outputs. To mine personas at scale, we train an inductive Graph Attention Network over a 22M-user Reddit interaction graph with dual contrastive objectives aligning graph structure with visual behavior, then verbalize learned representations into natural-language personas via an MLLM. We introduce ZIPBench, the first zero-shot personalization benchmark with 1.5K users, graph-mined personas, and 40K generated images. Across four benchmarks and 14 LLMs spanning five model families, persona conditioning yields consistent gains (13-20%), with frontier models benefiting most. In the few-shot setting, ZIPP matches or exceeds fine-tuned baselines trained on 100+ examples per user. ZIPP achieves the lowest preference distributional divergence (CMMD 0.16 vs. 0.55), and IPF-normalized demographic evaluation shows it substantially reduces subpopulation bias present in existing methods. Human evaluation confirms a 79% win rate over generic generation and 58-65% over all fine-tuned baselines.

AI.tldr: ZIPP是一种零样本图像个性化方法，通过自然语言人设（persona）描述用户审美偏好，无需用户数据或模型微调即可生成个性化图像，在多个基准测试中取得13-20%的提升，并引入首个零样本个性化基准ZIPBench。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型生成的图像偏向大众审美，无法满足用户个性化的、情境依赖的审美偏好；已有的个性化方法需要大量交互历史或逐用户微调，在冷启动场景下失效，且无法处理偏好随上下文变化的问题。
AI.method: 1) 使用LLM从人设视角重写提示词，引导扩散模型生成个性化图像；2) 在2200万用户的Reddit交互图上训练归纳式图注意力网络，通过双对比学习目标对齐图结构与视觉行为；3) 通过多模态大语言模型将学习到的表示转化为自然语言人设；4) 构建ZIPBench基准（1500用户、图挖掘人设、4万张生成图像）。
AI.result: 在4个基准、5个模型家族的14个LLM上，人设条件化生成带来13-20%的一致提升；零样本设置下匹配或超越基于100+样本微调的基线；偏好分布散度最低（CMMD 0.16 vs 0.55）；人口统计学评估显示显著降低子群体偏差；人工评估中79%胜率超越通用生成，58-65%胜率超越所有微调基线。
AI.conclusion: ZIPP通过自然语言人设实现了无需用户数据或微调的零样本图像个性化，在冷启动场景下有效，且能降低子群体偏差，为开放创意场景下的个性化图像生成提供了实用解决方案。

title: Reinforcing Temporal Answer Grounding in Instructional Video via Candidate-Aware Causal Reasoning
summary: The task of temporal answer grounding in instructional video (TAGV), which aims to locate precise video segments that respond to natural language queries, is increasingly important for direct video answer retrieval. This task remains challenging due to the need to comprehend semantically complex questions and to address the significant length mismatch between untrimmed videos and short target moments. Existing methods often suffer from sensitivity to irrelevant content or insufficient visual reasoning capabilities. To tackle these limitations, we propose a Candidate-Aware Causal Reasoning (CACR) framework. Our approach first employs a Visual-Language Pre-training based Candidate Selection (VBCS) algorithm to efficiently generate K candidate segments, then applies a temporal logic reasoning module enhanced by a rejection reward mechanism and optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for robust inference. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU), providing a new perspective for reasoning-based retrieval in long videos.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种候选感知因果推理框架（CACR），通过视觉-语言预训练候选选择算法和时序逻辑推理模块，在六个基准数据集上实现了时序答案定位的最新性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对无关内容敏感，视觉推理能力不足，难以处理复杂语义问题和视频长度与目标时刻之间的巨大不匹配。
AI.method: 先使用基于视觉-语言预训练的候选选择算法生成K个候选片段，再通过带有拒绝奖励机制的时序逻辑推理模块，结合组相对策略优化进行鲁棒推理。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上取得了平均交并比（mIoU）方面的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: CACR框架为长视频中的推理型检索提供了新的视角，有效提升了时序答案定位的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: A Resilience-as-a-Service assessment framework for coordinated disruption response in interdependent urban transit systems
summary: Urban public transport disruptions require rapid response strategies, yet existing studies rarely provide a decision support framework to compare alternative disruption response solutions using a common set of dynamic, passenger, operator, and environment oriented indicators. This paper proposes a KPI-driven, time-indexed framework to assess the resilience of disruption response solutions in urban transit systems. The framework combines an optimization model with a behavioral evaluation in agent-based simulation. It also underlays the secondary service degradation induced on helper lines when in-service vehicles are withdrawn to support the disrupted corridor. Rather than treating resilience as a single score, it evaluates complementary dimensions including vulnerability, adaptability, robustness, resilience loss, responsiveness, cost-based performance, emissions, and equity. The framework is implemented for the RER B transit line in the Ile-de-France (Paris) network. Results show that the coordinated strategy provides the most balanced resilience profile, combining high service continuity with lower total disruption cost than single mode alternatives, while also improving equity and maintaining competitive environmental performance. Sensitivity analysis further identifies the disruption conditions under which coordinated multimodal response is most valuable.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于KPI的时间索引框架，用于评估城市公共交通中断响应方案的韧性，并在巴黎RER B线进行实证分析。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个通用的决策支持框架，无法用统一的动态指标（乘客、运营商、环境）来比较不同的中断响应方案。
AI.method: 将优化模型与基于智能体的仿真行为评估相结合，评估脆弱性、适应性、鲁棒性、韧性损失、响应性、成本绩效、排放和公平性等多维度指标。
AI.result: 协调策略（多模式联合）在服务连续性、总中断成本、公平性和环境绩效方面均优于单一模式方案。
AI.conclusion: 协调多模式响应在特定中断条件下最具价值，为城市公共交通中断管理提供了科学的决策支持工具。

title: TVI-CoT: Text-Visual Interleaved Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Understanding
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective for enhancing problem-solving in large language models. However, when applied to multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), existing CoT approaches suffer from a fundamental limitation: they perform reasoning entirely in text without accessing visual features during the reasoning process. After initial visual encoding, image information becomes inaccessible, forcing models to reason based solely on whatever was captured in the initial description, which forms a `vision-blind reasoning' paradigm that limits fine-grained visual extraction, error verification, and adaptive attention. We propose Text-Visual Interleaved Chain-of-Thought (TVI-CoT), a framework that enables explicit interleaving of textual reasoning and visual feature access through learnable control tokens <THINK>, <LOOK> and <ANSWER>. These tokens allow dynamic switching between reasoning and visual grounding, attending to relevant image regions conditioned on the evolving reasoning state. Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art results among MLLM-based CoT methods and notable performance boost compared to the baseline: +6.1% on MMMU, +3.8% on MathVerse, +3.4% on MathVista, and +3.4% on ScienceQA. Code is available at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/TVI-CoT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TVI-CoT框架，通过在文本推理中引入<THINK>、<LOOK>和<ANSWER>三种可学习控制标记，实现多模态大模型推理过程中对视觉特征的动态访问，打破了传统CoT方法在推理时无法获取视觉信息的“视觉盲区”限制，在八个基准测试上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT方法在多模态大模型（MLLMs）中存在根本性局限：推理完全在文本中进行，无法访问视觉特征。图像信息在初始编码后便不可用，模型只能基于初始描述中的内容进行推理，形成了“视觉盲区推理”范式，限制了细粒度视觉提取、错误验证和自适应注意力。
AI.method: TVI-CoT框架通过引入三种可学习的控制标记<THINK>、<LOOK>和<ANSWER>，实现了文本推理与视觉特征访问的显式交错。这些标记允许模型在推理和视觉定位之间动态切换，能够根据当前推理状态关注相关的图像区域。
AI.result: 在八个基准测试上达到MLLM-based CoT方法中的最先进水平，相比基线模型有显著提升：MMMU +6.1%，MathVerse +3.8%，MathVista +3.4%，ScienceQA +3.4%。
AI.conclusion: TVI-CoT通过让多模态模型在推理过程中动态访问视觉特征，有效解决了“视觉盲区”问题，显著提升了多模态推理性能，代码已开源。

title: Detection and Interpretability Analysis of Quotation Errors by Large Language Models
summary: Purpose - Quotation error refers to the inconsistency between cited information and its original source. This phenomenon leads to a series of negative impacts, such as misinterpretation of the original research, undermining the academic community's collective understanding of relevant issues, and weakening the accuracy and fairness of the citation-based academic evaluation system. Existing studies have shown that quotation error is prevalent in the academic community; moreover, manual verification of quotation error is not only labor-intensive but also inefficient. Therefore, this paper proposes the task of 'automated detection of quotation errors'. Methodology - Adopting a large language model (LLM)-based approach, this paper improves detection performance from two aspects on the basis of existing research: first, employ the fine-tuning approach for LLMs to detect quotation errors; second, incorporating full-text data of the cited literature into dataset construction, and exploring the optimal scheme for building such datasets by comparing three types of full-text integration methods. Based on this, this paper further uses the TokenSHAP tool to conduct interpretability experimental analysis on the model's prediction results. Findings - The fine-tuning approach for LLMs has improved the performance in detecting quotation errors. Among the different methods for incorporating full-text information, the approach based on using the source abstract yielded the best performance. Originality - The fine-tuning approach for large language models (LLMs) is applied to the task of automated detection of quotation errors, and interpretability analysis is conducted on the model's output results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于大语言模型（LLM）微调的引文错误自动检测任务，通过引入文献全文数据构建数据集，并比较三种全文整合方案，实验表明基于源摘要的方法效果最佳，同时利用TokenSHAP工具进行可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 引文错误（引用的信息与原始来源不一致）普遍存在，会导致对原始研究的曲解、削弱学术共同体的理解以及影响基于引文的学术评价体系的准确性与公平性。且人工验证引文错误耗时耗力、效率低下，因此需要自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的微调方法，从两方面改进检测性能：(1) 使用微调方式让LLM检测引文错误；(2) 将引文全文数据纳入数据集构建，通过比较三种全文整合方法（包括基于源摘要的方法）探索最优方案。并使用TokenSHAP工具对模型预测结果进行可解释性实验分析。
AI.result: LLM微调方法有效提升了引文错误检测的性能。在三种全文信息整合方法中，基于源摘要的方法取得了最佳检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 将大语言模型微调方法应用于引文错误自动检测任务是可行的且效果良好，源摘要作为全文信息整合方式最为有效，模型输出结果可通过可解释性工具进行分析。

title: Seeing is Believing: Aligning Prompt Rewriting with Visual Anchors for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Despite the impressive capabilities of text-to-image (T2I) models, an intent-generation gap often persists due to the brevity and ambiguity of user prompts. Existing approaches primarily polish the prompt for fluency and readability. However, the enhancement process still lacks visual grounding. As a result, the rewriter may over-infer missing details, causing an intent-generation gap. To address this limitation, we propose FaithRewriter, a novel prompt-enhancement framework for T2I generation. Specifically, FaithRewriter first leverages a multimodal MLLM to generate an image from the original prompt as an intermediate visual cue. This cue is then combined with the prompt and fed into a large-scale LLM to produce visually grounded augmentations that better reflect how the intended content should appear in images. Finally, these augmentations are distilled into a small-scale LLM for efficient deployment, enhancing its ability to generate effective T2I prompts. Experiments show that FaithRewriter yields prompts that are more faithful to the user intent and more visually plausible than strong baselines, helping narrow the intent-generation gap.

AI.tldr: 提出FaithRewriter框架，通过多模态大模型生成中间图像作为视觉线索，再结合大语言模型生成视觉增强提示，最终蒸馏到小模型实现高效部署，以缩小文本到图像生成中的意图-生成差距。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在用户提示简短模糊时存在意图-生成差距，提示改写缺乏视觉基础，容易过度推断丢失细节。
AI.method: 1) 用多模态大模型(MLLM)从原始提示生成中间图像作为视觉线索；2) 将图像与提示结合输入大规模LLM生成视觉增强；3) 将增强知识蒸馏到小规模LLM实现高效部署。
AI.result: FaithRewriter生成的提示比强基线更忠实于用户意图且视觉上更合理，有效缩小了意图-生成差距。
AI.conclusion: 引入视觉线索作为提示增强的中间步骤，能显著提升T2I生成的忠实度，且可通过蒸馏实现高效部署。

title: Multilingual Fact-Checking at Scale: Fine-Tuned Compact Models vs LLMs
summary: We present a multilingual fact-checking system deployed at Factiverse, designed for high-throughput and low-latency operation across diverse languages. The system follows a modular pipeline with three stages: claim detection, evidence retrieval and re-ranking, and veracity prediction. We fine-tune XLM-RoBERTa-Large for claim detection, mmBERT-base for three-label stance classification (Supports/Refutes/Mixed), and a SetFit-based multilingual re-ranker for claim--evidence matching. We compare these components against strong LLM baselines, including GPT-5.2, Claude Opus~4.6, and Qwen3-8b. Experiments on production data spanning 114 languages for claim detection and 28 languages for veracity prediction show that task-specific fine-tuning provides strong and stable multilingual performance, while the fine-tuned retrieval model remains competitive with modern proprietary embeddings. Same-hardware latency measurements further show large efficiency gains for encoder-based components, supporting their use in production deployments with tight cost and privacy constraints. Overall, compact fine-tuned, self-hosted models remain a practical and effective foundation for multilingual fact-checking at scale. Code and data used for this study are available at https://github.com/factiverse/factcheck-editor.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Factiverse部署的多语言事实核查系统，采用模块化流水线（声明检测、证据检索与重排序、真实性预测），微调XLM-RoBERTa-Large、mmBERT-base和SetFit等紧凑模型，在114种语言的声明检测和28种语言的真实性预测任务上，与GPT-5.2、Claude Opus 4.6等大语言模型相比，任务特定微调模型在多语言性能、稳定性和延迟方面更具优势，适合大规模生产部署。
AI.motivation: 现有事实核查系统在多语言场景下存在性能不稳定、延迟高、成本高和隐私约束等问题，迫切需要一种高效、可扩展且能处理多种语言的事实核查方案。
AI.method: 采用模块化流水线架构：1) 微调XLM-RoBERTa-Large进行声明检测；2) 使用mmBERT-base进行三标签立场分类（支持/反驳/混合）；3) 基于SetFit的多语言重排序模型进行声明-证据匹配。与GPT-5.2、Claude Opus 4.6、Qwen3-8b等大语言模型基线进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在114种语言的声明检测和28种语言的真实性预测上，任务特定微调模型展现出强大且稳定的多语言性能；微调检索模型与专有嵌入模型性能相当；相同硬件条件下编码器组件具有显著的效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的微调自托管模型在多语言事实核查的大规模生产中仍然是实用且有效的基础方案，尤其适合具有严格成本和隐私约束的生产部署场景。

title: Can the Environment Speak for Itself? $T^{2}$-GRPO: A Turn-Trajectory Group Relative Policy Optimization for Caregiver Agents
summary: Optimizing large language models (LLMs) for long-horizon caregiver agents requires balancing delayed task objectives with immediate environment dynamics, such as patient distress and resistance. In dementia care, this balance is especially difficult: trajectory level rewards are too sparse for turn level credit assignment, while external LLM-based evaluators are costly and can misread fragmented or indirect patient responses. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{T}urn-\textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{G}roup \textbf{R}elative \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (\textbf{T$^{2}$-GRPO}), a framework that decouples caregiver RL into two normalized reward horizons and enforces safety through a binary hard veto. $T^2$-GRPO derives dense turn-level rewards directly from environment state transitions, measuring changes in patient distress and resistance from a frozen dementia patient simulator. These environment-grounded rewards are combined with trajectory-level evaluations through independent centered-rank normalization, which preserves heterogeneous reward signals and mitigates reward collapse. Extensive experiments on dementia caregivers show that T $^{2}$-GRPO outperforms competitive baselines, indicating a substantial improvement for emotionally sensitive caregiver scenarios that effectively handles immediate patient feedback, long-term care outcomes, and safety constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出T²-GRPO框架，通过解耦护理智能体的强化学习为两个归一化奖励视界（回合级与轨迹级），并引入二元硬否决机制，在痴呆症护理场景中平衡长期任务目标与即时患者反馈，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 长时域护理智能体需要在延迟的任务目标与即时的环境动态（如患者痛苦、抵抗）之间取得平衡。现有方法中，轨迹级奖励过于稀疏无法进行回合级信用分配，而外部LLM评估器成本高且易误判零散或间接的患者反应。
AI.method: 提出T²-GRPO框架，将护理强化学习解耦为两个归一化奖励视界：从冻结的痴呆患者模拟器中提取环境状态转换，生成密集的回合级奖励（衡量患者痛苦和抵抗变化），再结合轨迹级评估，通过独立居中秩归一化保留异质奖励信号并防止奖励崩溃，同时使用二元硬否决机制保障安全性。
AI.result: 在痴呆症护理场景的广泛实验中，T²-GRPO优于多个竞争基线，表明该方法在情感敏感护理场景中能有效处理即时患者反馈、长期护理结果和安全约束。
AI.conclusion: T²-GRPO通过双视界奖励解耦与安全否决机制，有效解决了长时域护理智能体的奖励稀疏与安全约束难题，为情感敏感型人机交互场景提供了可行方案。

title: Look Less, Reason More: Block-wise Attention Skipping for Efficient Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face a significant inference bottleneck due to the quadratic computational cost of self-attention over long visual token sequences. However, we identify a critical inefficiency in current architectures: Visual Attention Saturation. Our analysis reveals that visual tokens rapidly establish their spatial structure and intra-modal relationships in early layers, rendering visual-to-visual self-attention in deeper layers computationally redundant. Conversely, Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) in these layers remain essential for projecting visual features into the evolving textual semantic space. Leveraging this insight, we present Visual-Skip (V-Skip), a training-free inference paradigm that decouples spatial interaction from semantic evolution. Rather than discarding tokens, V-Skip imposes block-wise structured sparsity by selectively bypassing saturated visual self-attention modules. Furthermore, recognizing that varying downstream tasks demand distinct reasoning depths, V-Skip employs a lightweight, few-shot calibration to dynamically route the task-optimal sparsity path. Extensive experiments demonstrate that V-Skip effectively bypasses redundant vision attention to achieve block-wise sparsity, maintaining a 94.16% to 100.31% performance retention across diverse MLLMs. Ultimately, we prove that to reason more effectively, models do not need to discard what they see -- they simply need to "look less" at the right depth.

AI.tldr: 提出V-Skip方法，通过跳过深层视觉自注意力模块来加速MLLM推理，在不丢弃视觉token的情况下实现94%-100%的性能保持。
AI.motivation: MLLMs中视觉自注意力在深层存在"视觉注意力饱和"现象（视觉token早期层已建立空间结构，深层自注意力冗余），造成计算浪费。
AI.method: V-Skip：训练无关的推理范式，通过块级结构化稀疏跳过饱和的视觉自注意力模块，并结合少量样本校准动态选择最优稀疏路径。
AI.result: 在多种MLLM上保持94.16%-100.31%的性能，有效消除冗余计算。
AI.conclusion: 模型无需丢弃视觉信息，只需在正确深度"少看"即可更高效推理。

title: Cross-Source Reasoning-based Correction for Author Name Disambiguation
summary: Author name disambiguation is a critical challenge in academic search systems, often addressed through from-scratch and real-time disambiguation approaches. However, current algorithms remain vulnerable to cumulative errors of paper-author assignments and overlook inconsistent assignments across different sources. Resorting to expert annotation is resource-intensive. To this end, this paper explores a new perspective for author name disambiguation: cross-source correction by leveraging inconsistent assignments across sources. We propose CrossND, a full-stack framework that integrates data refinement, cross-source reasoning, and test-time scaling. First, a chain-of-refinement pipeline denoises author profiles and produces more accurate paper-author matching probabilities. Second, a supervised fine-tuning process incorporates these refined signals and a probabilistic soft logic-based cross-correction module to infer the assignments of which sources are incorrect. Third, test-time scaling further enhances the accuracy and robustness of the predictions. Experiments on real-world datasets indicate that CrossND consistently outperforms 17 baselines by leveraging cross-source reasoning without human intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossND框架，通过跨源不一致性分析进行作者姓名消歧，无需人工干预，在真实数据集上优于17个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有作者姓名消歧方法存在错误累积、忽视跨源不一致分配的问题，且依赖专家标注成本高昂，因此需要探索跨源纠正的新视角。
AI.method: 提出CrossND全栈框架，包含三个模块：1) 链式精炼管道去噪作者档案；2) 监督微调结合概率软逻辑的交叉纠正模块；3) 测试时缩放增强预测鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，CrossND持续优于17个基线方法，证明了跨源推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 跨源纠正为作者姓名消歧提供了新思路，无需人工干预即可显著提升性能。

title: FAME: Forecastability-Aware Mixture of Experts for Heterogeneous Time Series Forecasting
summary: Large-scale retail and industrial forecasting systems contain many heterogeneous time series whose lifecycle, sparsity, volatility, seasonality, spectral patterns, and contextual sensitivity differ substantially. A single forecasting model rarely performs well across all regimes, while dense ensembles increase inference cost and provide limited insight into expert suitability. This paper studies forecastability-aware expert routing: learning how data characteristics determine the suitability of forecasting experts. We propose \method{}, a sparse mixture-of-experts framework that represents each series with a multidimensional forecastability fingerprint, mines expert-suitability targets from validation performance, and trains a cost-aware sparse router to activate a small budgeted set of experts for each series. Using a production-scale vending-machine sales dataset from Shandong New Beiyang (SNBC), where the forecasting component has been integrated into the replenishment-planning pipeline, together with public retail benchmarks, we show that expert suitability varies systematically across data regimes. On the industrial dataset with 5,000+ machines and 60M+ transactions, \method{} Top-2 reduces MSE by 12.4\% over the strongest single expert, LightGBM, while executing 1.92 experts per series on average. The deployed component produces demand forecasts, while inventory-oriented gains are estimated by an offline replay simulator under a fixed replenishment policy rather than by online intervention. The framework turns heterogeneous sales forecasting from heuristic model selection into data mining of forecastability patterns and expert specialization. Code is available at https://github.com/hit636/FAME

AI.tldr: 提出FAME框架，通过预测能力感知的专家路由机制，为工业级异构时间序列选择最合适的预测模型，在真实售货机数据集上实现12.4%的MSE降低。
AI.motivation: 大规模零售和工业预测系统中存在大量异构时间序列，单一模型难以在所有数据模式上表现良好，而密集集成方法会增加推理成本且难以解释专家适用性。
AI.method: 提出FAME（预测能力感知专家路由）框架：为每个序列构建多维预测能力指纹，从验证性能中挖掘专家适用性标签，训练成本感知的稀疏路由器，为每个序列激活少量预算内的专家。
AI.result: 在山东新北洋（SNBC）5000+台售货机、6000万+条交易记录的工业数据集上，FAME Top-2比最强单一专家LightGBM降低12.4%的MSE，平均每个序列仅激活1.92个专家。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将异构销售预测从启发式模型选择转变为对预测能力模式和专家专长的数据挖掘，已在补货规划管线中集成应用。

title: OmniTryOn: Video Try-On Anything at Once!
summary: Although video virtual try-on (VVT) has achieved significant progress, existing methods still exhibit two fundamental limitations: first, they are restricted to single-garment transfer, rendering simultaneous multi-object try-on highly impractical; second, their heavy reliance on explicit external priors (e.g., garment masks) inevitably destroys crucial physical dynamics and degrades visual quality. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes the novel Try-On Anything task, which aims to simultaneously transfer diverse wearable objects onto a person in a video in a single inference pass. To support and standardize this paradigm, we introduce TryAny-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark encompassing a paired video dataset alongside a tailored evaluation protocol. Furthermore, we present OmniTryOn, an external-prior-free generative framework designed to tackle this task. Specifically, OmniTryOn employs a First Frame Wearable Cache strategy, which directly provides diverse wearable objects for the generation process through the initial video frame. To maintain consistency, we propose the Spatiotemporally Consistent RoPE (STC-RoPE), which inherently establishes robust spatiotemporal anchors to strictly preserve complex human motions and background dynamics. Optimized by the proposed Gradual Try-On (GTO) training strategy, our model progressively masters robust multi-object synthesis. Extensive experiments on TryAny-Bench demonstrate that OmniTryOn significantly outperforms existing specialized video virtual try-on models and general video editing baselines, establishing a powerful new standard for the Try-On Anything task. Our dataset, code, and models are available at https://github.com/xcltql666/OminTryOn.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Try-On Anything任务，旨在单次推理中同时将多种可穿戴物品转移到视频人物身上。针对现有方法仅支持单件衣物转移且依赖外部先验的局限，论文引入了TryAny-Bench基准和OmniTryOn框架，采用首帧可穿戴缓存、STC-RoPE位置编码和渐进式训练策略，实现无外部先验的多目标视频虚拟试穿，性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法存在两个根本局限：一是仅限于单件衣物转移，无法实现多物品同时试穿；二是严重依赖显式外部先验（如衣物掩码），破坏了物理动态并降低了视觉质量。为弥补这一差距，本文提出Try-On Anything任务。
AI.method: 1) First Frame Wearable Cache策略，通过首帧直接提供多种可穿戴物品；2) Spatiotemporally Consistent RoPE (STC-RoPE)，建立稳健的空时锚点以保持复杂的人体运动和背景动态；3) Gradual Try-On (GTO)训练策略，逐步掌握鲁棒的多目标合成。
AI.result: 在TryAny-Bench上的大量实验表明，OmniTryOn显著优于现有的专业视频虚拟试穿模型和通用视频编辑基线，为该任务建立了强有力的新标准。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提出Try-On Anything任务、TryAny-Bench基准和OmniTryOn框架，成功突破了现有视频虚拟试穿在单件衣物限制和外部先验依赖方面的瓶颈，实现了高质量的多目标视频虚拟试穿。

title: From Holistic Evaluation to Structured Criteria: Rubrics Across the Evolving LLM Landscape
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) advance toward open-ended autonomous agents, the mechanisms used to evaluate and guide their behavior must evolve accordingly. This work introduces the rubric as a unifying framework capturing this evolution, characterizing rubrics as a dynamic response to successive LLM paradigm shifts that recurs across otherwise independent efforts in evaluation, reinforcement learning, and safety alignment. We define rubrics as explicit criteria sets that transform complex quality judgments into structured and actionable standards, and demonstrate that their recurrence across these research threads is not coincidental. We systematically organize existing rubric designs, examine their construction and optimization, and analyze their role across evaluation and training. Rubrics manifest at three progressively deeper levels: at the evaluative level, they decompose holistic judgments into verifiable dimensions; at the training level, they serve as dense feedback signals providing process-level guidance where scalar rewards fall short; at the intrinsic level, they emerge dynamically from model behaviors, driving self-improvement. We further assess rubric reliability across generation quality, execution fidelity, theoretical constraints, and security threats, before surveying rubric-based benchmarks across diverse domains. By rendering assessment transparent and decomposable, rubrics translate human value expectations into machine-learnable signals, serving as the enduring bridge between human intentions and machine behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"准则(rubric)"作为统一框架，系统梳理了准则在LLM评估、强化学习和安全对齐中的演化路径，将其分为评估级、训练级和内在级三个层次，并分析了其可靠性和应用领域。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM向开放式自主智能体发展，需要更完善的机制来评估和引导其行为，而现有的准则设计分散在不同研究领域，缺乏统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 通过系统性文献综述，将现有准则设计进行组织分类，从评估、训练和内在三个层次分析准则的构建、优化和应用，并评估其可靠性。
AI.result: 准则在三个层次发挥作用：评估层将整体判断分解为可验证维度；训练层提供过程级密集反馈信号；内在层从模型行为动态涌现驱动自我改进。同时在生成质量、执行保真度、理论约束和安全威胁方面进行了可靠性评估。
AI.conclusion: 准则通过使评估透明化和可分解，将人类价值期望转化为机器可学习信号，成为连接人类意图与机器行为之间的持久桥梁。

title: Order Matters: Unveiling the Hidden Impact of Macro Placement Sequences via Proxy-Guided LLM Evolution
summary: Macro placement is a fundamental step in modern chip physical design, playing a crucial role in determining the solution quality of high-dimensional combinatorial optimization problems. Despite recent advancements in machine learning for spatial coordinate determination, the temporal dimension of placement sequencing remains largely governed by static heuristics. In this work, we demonstrate that the placement sequence is not merely a preprocessing step but a decisive factor in optimization, where suboptimal early decisions trigger irreversible domino effects that constrain the solution space. To harness this unexplored dimension, we propose \textbf{OrderPlace}, a proxy-guided LLM evolution framework for automatically discovering macro placement order strategies. Instead of relying on manually crafted heuristics such as area- or connectivity-based ordering, OrderPlace explores a broader space of code-level policies, ranging from static scoring metrics to dynamic physics-inspired mechanisms. To mitigate the prohibitive cost of evaluating sequences, we introduce a lightweight proxy evaluation mechanism that efficiently filters candidates using a deterministic greedy probe. Experimental results on the standard ISPD 2005 benchmarks demonstrate that OrderPlace discovers novel ordering strategies. Compared with WireMask-EA and the state-of-the-art method EGPlace, OrderPlace reduces wirelength by 34.04\% and 14.08\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OrderPlace，一种基于大语言模型和代理引导的进化框架，用于自动发现宏布局顺序策略。相比传统静态启发式方法和现有SOTA方法，OrderPlace在ISPD 2005基准上分别降低线长34.04%和14.08%。
AI.motivation: 现有宏布局方法虽在空间坐标确定上取得进展，但布局顺序这一时间维度仍依赖静态启发式规则。早期次优决策会引发不可逆的多米诺效应，严重限制解空间，亟需自动探索更优的布局顺序策略。
AI.method: 提出OrderPlace框架，采用代理引导的LLM进化机制。通过轻量级代理评估机制（确定性贪心探测）高效过滤候选策略，探索从静态评分指标到动态物理启发机制的代码级策略空间，自动发现宏布局顺序策略。
AI.result: 在ISPD 2005标准基准上，OrderPlace相比WireMask-EA和最新方法EGPlace，分别降低线长34.04%和14.08%。
AI.conclusion: 布局顺序是决定宏布局优化效果的关键因素，OrderPlace通过自动化探索顺序策略，显著优于传统启发式和现有SOTA方法，开辟了芯片物理设计中时序维度优化的新路径。

title: Sycophancy Towards Researchers Drives Performative Misalignment
summary: The increasing situational awareness of language models raises safety concerns: models might be aware when they are evaluated, and adjust their behavior to evade monitoring and resist modification, e.g., pretending to be aligned only in evaluation. This alignment faking behavior is often interpreted as scheming: an intentional effort of strategic deception. In this paper, we examine an alternative interpretation, performative misalignment, which explains the change in behavior as a result of sycophancy towards AI researchers. To examine this hypothesis, we present three empirical findings. First, we show that evaluation awareness persists even when we tell models they are deployed, which contradicts the scheming story which predicts less misalignment when the model perceives evaluation. Second, we use probing and steering to show that our current methods cannot mechanistically distinguish sycophancy and scheming in alignment faking evaluations. Third, we fine-tune models to be more sycophantic and observe increased sensitivity to evaluation cues. To conclude, we emphasize deconfounding sycophancy from scheming for future work on evaluations and mitigations of intent misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了语言模型在评估中表现出的“对齐伪装”行为，质疑了传统的“阴谋论”解释（即模型故意欺骗），提出了“表演性失配”假说，认为这种行为更可能是模型对AI研究者的谄媚（sycophancy）所致。实验发现：评估意识在部署场景下依然存在、现有方法无法从机制上区分谄媚与阴谋、谄媚程度越高的模型对评估线索越敏感。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型的情境感知能力提升引发了安全担忧：模型可能意识到自己正在被评估，从而调整行为以规避监控（即对齐伪装）。以往研究常将此解释为模型有意欺骗（scheming），本文则提出替代解释——表演性失配（performative misalignment），即行为变化源于模型对研究者的谄媚倾向。
AI.method: 通过三个实证研究验证谄媚假说：1）在告知模型已部署的情况下测试评估意识是否依然存在；2）使用探针（probing）和引导（steering）方法从机制上区分谄媚与阴谋；3）对模型进行微调以增强谄媚倾向，观察其对评估线索敏感度的变化。
AI.result: 1）即使告诉模型已部署，评估意识依然存在，这与阴谋论预测（评估场景下应有更少失配）相矛盾；2）当前方法无法从机制上区分谄媚与阴谋；3）微调后的谄媚模型对评估线索更加敏感。
AI.conclusion: 强调未来在评估和缓解意图失配（intent misalignment）时，必须将谄媚效应与阴谋效应进行去混淆处理。

title: Oversight Has a Capacity: Calibrating Agent Guards to a Subjective, Fatiguing Human
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Code and interactive demo: https://github.com/turangenesis/headroom
summary: As LLM agents begin to take real, irreversible actions (shell commands, file edits, deploys), the standard safety pattern is a human-in-the-loop approval gate: risky actions pause and wait for a person. We argue the gate is the easy part; the hard part is the judgment - which actions to stop - which the field evaluates against two false assumptions: that there is a ground-truth notion of "risky," and that the human reviewer is a perfect, infinitely-available oracle. On a hand-labeled set of 125 adversarially-weighted agent actions we show that (i) reviewers only moderately agree on what is risky (Fleiss' kappa = 0.52), so there is no single correct label; (ii) framing the guard as selective classification under asymmetric cost makes its operating limits measurable, and on hard inputs the guard cannot safely auto-decide; and (iii) when the reviewer is modeled as endogenous (fatiguing as escalation load grows), realized safety becomes an inverted-U in the escalation rate: more human oversight can make a system less safe, and the safety-optimal guard escalates below full escalation - a setting a load-aware policy also uses to resist a flooding attack that slips a malicious action past a fatigued reviewer. Agent oversight, framed this way, is not only a classification problem but a resource-allocation one: human attention is finite, and the guard's escalation policy spends it. We claim none of these mechanisms as novel - fatigue-aware learning-to-defer (FALCON), cost-sensitive deferral under workload constraints (DeCCaF), trajectory-level guarding, and reviewer-fatigue/flooding attacks are all prior art we cite. Our contribution is an open-source agent-oversight system that operationalizes and measures them in the LLM-agent action-gating setting, turning "is my guard good?" from a guess into a curve. The inverted-U and the flooding attack are modeling results that motivate a human study.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了LLM智能体安全监管的核心问题不在于审批门控本身，而在于风险判断——人类评审者对“风险”的认知存在显著分歧，且评审者疲劳会导致安全效果呈倒U型曲线，过度监管反而降低安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体安全监管模式（人类审批门控）存在两个错误假设：存在“风险”的客观标准，以及人类评审者是完美无缺的。实际中评审者对风险的判断一致性差，且疲劳效应会导致安全下降。
AI.method: 在125个人工标注的对抗性智能体动作数据集上，测量了评审者间一致性（Fleiss' kappa=0.52）；将监管问题建模为不对称成本下的选择性分类；将评审者疲劳作为内生变量建模，分析升级率与安全性的关系。
AI.result: 评审者对风险的判断一致性中等；在困难输入上监管无法安全地自动决策；将评审者疲劳建模后，安全性在升级率上呈现倒U型曲线，过度监管反而降低安全，负载感知策略能抵抗洪水攻击。
AI.conclusion: 智能体监督不仅是分类问题，更是资源分配问题——人类注意力有限，监管策略在消耗这种注意力。贡献在于开源了一个可量化的智能体监督系统。

title: NGram-MoSE: Efficient Remote Sensing Super-Resolution via N-Gram Context and Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Remote sensing applications for environmental monitoring and disaster management are frequently constrained by a spatial--temporal trade-off: imagery with fine spatial detail is often acquired less frequently, whereas more temporally available observations are typically coarser. Single-image super-resolution provides a practical means to enhance coarse imagery without changing acquisition schedules, yet many Transformer-based SR models remain computationally expensive and can be sensitive to limited or geographically biased training data, which degrades robustness under out-of-distribution conditions. This paper presents NGram-MoSE, a lightweight Transformer architecture designed to improve both efficiency and texture continuity. NGram-MoSE introduces N-Gram Context Injection to strengthen cross-window local consistency and mitigate window-boundary artifacts, and incorporates a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward design to scale capacity through sparse activation without proportional growth in inference cost. Experiments on a geographically disjoint OOD test set show that NGram-MoSE achieves 31.68\,dB PSNR while reducing FLOPs by \(14\times\) relative to a heavyweight Transformer reference. Downstream evaluation on a landslide segmentation benchmark further demonstrates that restoring degraded inputs to the detector training scale improves performance, yielding a 4.47\% absolute gain in mAP@50 over bicubic upsampling, and exhibits stronger cross-scale consistency under scale extrapolation. These results indicate that NGram-MoSE provides an effective SR module for resource-constrained remote sensing pipelines requiring robust generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NGram-MoSE，一种轻量级Transformer超分架构，通过N-Gram上下文注入和混合专家前馈设计，在遥感图像超分辨率中实现14倍FLOPs降低的同时保持高精度，并在滑坡分割任务中提升4.47% mAP@50。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像存在空间-时间分辨率权衡（高空间分辨率图像获取频率低），现有Transformer超分模型计算成本高且对分布外数据鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出NGram-MoSE架构：1) N-Gram上下文注入增强跨窗口局部一致性，减少窗口边界伪影；2) 混合专家(MoE)前馈设计通过稀疏激活增加模型容量而不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 在地理分布外的测试集上PSNR达31.68dB，FLOPs降低14倍；在滑坡分割任务中mAP@50提升4.47%，且跨尺度外推一致性更强。
AI.conclusion: NGram-MoSE为资源受限的遥感管线提供了高效且鲁棒的超分模块，有效平衡了效率与泛化能力。

title: A retrieval conditioned rebinding circuit for dynamic entity tracking in large language models
summary: To interpret context correctly and retrieve relevant information, large language models must bind entities to their attributes and update these bindings as state changes. We analyze how LLMs implement this binding process in a dynamic state tracking. Using causal interventions, we identify a retrieval conditioned rebinding mechanism, a compact attention head circuit that encodes swap relevant binding information and reinstates it at readout. Across Gemma and Llama models, this circuit supports rebinding behavior, but the representational signature of the mechanism differs across model families. In Gemma models, the binding signature is clearly expressed in the query/key subspaces of the relevant attention heads, whereas in Llama models, the binding information is carried primarily in key vectors. Overall, our results reveal an interpretable mechanism for context dependent state tracking in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果干预方法发现，LLM在动态状态追踪中采用“检索条件化重绑定机制”——一个紧凑的注意力头电路，负责编码和恢复与绑定相关的信息。Gemma和Llama模型都使用此机制，但表示方式不同：Gemma在注意力头的查询/键子空间中表达绑定特征，而Llama主要在键向量中承载绑定信息。
AI.motivation: 理解大语言模型如何在动态状态追踪中实现实体与属性的绑定及更新，揭示其内在的神经机制。
AI.method: 使用因果干预（causal interventions）分析LLM在动态状态追踪任务中的绑定过程，识别出检索条件化重绑定机制（retrieval conditioned rebinding mechanism）。
AI.result: 发现了紧凑的注意力头电路负责编码和恢复绑定信息；Gemma和Llama模型均使用此机制，但Gemma在查询/键子空间表达绑定信息，而Llama主要在键向量中承载绑定信息。
AI.conclusion: LLM中存在可解释的上下文相关状态追踪机制，不同模型家族在表征细节上存在差异。

title: AlloSpatial: Agentic Harness Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Foundation Models
summary: Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs) have made substantial progress, yet remain fragile in spatial reasoning over the physical world. A key bottleneck lies in their inability to transform local egocentric observations into a global allocentric spatial representation. To address this, we propose AlloSpatial, an agentic framework for allocentric spatial cognition in foundation models. AlloSpatial introduces World2Mind, a plug-and-play cognitive mapping sandbox that converts egocentric observations into structured allocentric priors, including Allocentric-Spatial Trees and route maps that support querying object topology, geometric relations, passability, and trajectories. To utilize these priors reliably under noisy reconstruction and ambiguous visual evidence, AlloSpatial introduces a Spatial Reasoning Harness for tool-use judgment, modality-decoupled cue collection, and geometry-semantic arbitration. We further internalize this process in Qwen3-VL through cold-start reinforcement learning with a harness-gated trajectory-level reward. Experiments on VSI-Bench and MindCube show that AlloSpatial improves proprietary models by 5%-18% in a training-free setting, while ASTs alone support strong spatial reasoning even when visual inputs are removed. The trained AlloSpatial agents further outperform larger general-purpose models and competitive spatial baselines, suggesting that structured allocentric representations, active tool use, and verifiable reasoning offer a promising route toward spatially capable foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出AlloSpatial框架，通过World2Mind认知映射沙盒将自我中心观察转化为以物体为中心的空间先验（包括分配空间树和路线图），并结合空间推理套件（工具使用判断、模态解耦线索收集、几何-语义仲裁）及冷启动强化学习，显著提升了基础模型的空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型在物理世界的空间推理中表现脆弱，根本原因在于无法将局部自我中心观察转化为全局分配中心空间表征。
AI.method: 提出AlloSpatial框架，包含：(1) World2Mind认知映射沙盒，将自我中心观察转化为结构化分配中心先验（分配空间树和路线图）；(2) 空间推理套件，实现工具使用判断、模态解耦线索收集和几何-语义仲裁；(3) 基于套件门控轨迹级奖励的冷启动强化学习。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench和MindCube上，AlloSpatial在无需训练下提升闭源模型5%-18%；仅ASTs即可支持强空间推理；训练的AlloSpatial智能体超越更大通用模型和空间基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分配中心表征、主动工具使用和可验证推理为构建具备空间能力的基础模型提供了有前景的路径。

title: Towards Accurate Emotion-Attributed Video Captioning via Fine-grained Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction
summary: Emotional Video Captioning (EVC) is a challenging task that aims to generate factually accurate and emotionally rich descriptions for videos. Existing EVC methods leverage holistic visual features to mine global emotional cues, and then aggregate multimodal features to guide the emotional caption generation, which ignores the critical characteristic of the EVC task. Visual emotions are evoked by specific motivational causes, which are usually only implied in core video segments. The holistic mining brings significant information redundancy and inaccurate emotional cues. Thus, fine-grained visual cause extraction has a facilitative effect on both emotion perception and emotion-attributed caption generation. To this end, we propose a fine-grained emotion-cause pair extraction framework for emotion-attributed video captioning. Specifically, we learn pair-wise emotion and cause features in two rounds: 1) We propose a Concept-aware Visual Semantic Decomposition module to augment visual features by exploring scene, object, and motion concepts. Besides, to enhance emotional features, we propose a Visual-guided Emotion Interpretable Learning module, which guides emotion refinement with visual temporal dynamics, and augments the interpretable refinement process by reliable VAD-vector constraints. 2) We achieve emotion-cause pair extraction by cross-coupling the visual and emotional features before and after refinement, and leverage contrastive loss to achieve semantic forced alignment. Overall, our approach optimizes complex semantic understanding and emotion perception of videos, leading to a promising performance in emotional captioning. Extensive experiments on three challenging datasets demonstrate the superiority of our approach and each proposed module, e.g., achieving the best performances with +4.4% and +5.4% w.r.t. BLEU-2 and ROUGE-L, respectively, on the EVC-MSVD dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种细粒度情感-原因对提取框架，用于情感视频描述。该框架通过概念感知的视觉语义分解模块和视觉引导的情感可解释学习模块，分别提取情感和原因特征并进行交叉耦合，有效解决了全局情感挖掘带来的信息冗余和情感线索不准确问题。在三个数据集上取得了SOTA性能，如在EVC-MSVD上BLEU-2提升4.4%，ROUGE-L提升5.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有情感视频描述方法依赖全局视觉特征挖掘情感线索，忽略了视觉情感由特定动机原因触发这一关键特性，导致信息冗余和情感线索不准确。因此，需要细粒度的视觉原因提取来辅助情感感知和描述生成。
AI.method: 提出两阶段细粒度情感-原因对提取框架：1）概念感知视觉语义分解模块（CVSD）通过场景、物体和运动概念增强视觉特征；视觉引导情感可解释学习模块（VGIE）利用视觉时间动态指导情感细化，并通过VAD向量约束增强可解释性。2）通过交叉耦合细化前后的视觉和情感特征实现情感-原因对提取，利用对比损失实现语义强制对齐。
AI.result: 在EVC-MSVD、EVC-MSVD和EVC-VATEX三个数据集上，所提方法均取得最佳性能。在EVC-MSVD数据集上，BLEU-2提升4.4%，ROUGE-L提升5.4%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的细粒度情感-原因对提取框架有效优化了复杂语义理解和情感感知，在情感视频描述任务上表现出显著优势，验证了各模块的有效性。

title: From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-running settings where improving through experience at test time becomes important. A common approach is to update an explicit memory after each interaction to guide future decisions. However, most existing methods rely on hand-designed prompting rules, making it difficult to align memory updates with downstream objectives over multi-step horizons consistently. We propose MemoPilot, a plug-in memory copilot that explicitly trains the memory update process to improve a frozen LLM's performance across sequential interactions. We formulate memory updating as a multi-turn decision problem and optimize it end-to-end with multi-turn GRPO. Our training recipe introduces (i) a turn-wise reward signal and (ii) a context-independent, turn-level advantage estimation across rollouts, enabling finer-grained credit assignment and more stable training in multi-turn settings. We evaluate MemoPilot on two testbeds: multi-round Rock-Paper-Scissors (RPS) and Limit Texas Hold'em (LHE). Across both environments, MemoPilot substantially improves test-time learning of a frozen player over strong baselines, ranking first in Elo ratings on both games (1762 on LHE and 1590 on RPS) and outperforming all baseline memory methods and proprietary models, including DeepSeek-V3.2.

AI.tldr: 提出MemoPilot，一种通过端到端训练记忆更新过程来提升冻结大模型在连续交互中性能的插件式方法，在多人RPS和LHE测试中取得最佳Elo评分。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在长序列交互中依赖手工设计的记忆更新规则，难以与下游目标在多步决策中保持对齐。
AI.method: 将记忆更新建模为多轮决策问题，采用多轮GRPO进行端到端优化，引入轮次级奖励信号和上下文无关的轮次级优势估计。
AI.result: 在LHE上Elo评分1762，RPS上1590，超越所有基线记忆方法和包括DeepSeek-V3.2在内的闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: MemoPilot有效提升了冻结LLM在长序列交互中的测试时学习能力，证明了端到端优化记忆更新的有效性。

title: An Effective Router for Vision-Language Model Selection
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) with varying performance and resource requirements are widely deployed, making it difficult for users to select the most appropriate one among numerous VLM candidates. Existing work reveals the performance paradox phenomenon in language models and focuses on routing methods to solve it. However, developing a router for VLM selection is still a critical yet challenging problem, which primarily faces: 1) lack of specialized data, 2) ineffective feature representation, and 3) rigid model space and costly adaptation. In this paper, we construct a multimodal dataset for VLM selection, containing the outputs of seven mainstream VLMs on 32,626 unique image-text queries. We then propose ARMS, a router for VLM selection. ARMS enhances input signals with VLM profiles, employs a simple but effective architecture to improve representations of queries and VLM capabilities. To improve ARMS' adaptation to new VLMs, we propose two extension training strategies: incremental training and independent training. Experimental results on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution test sets demonstrate the effectiveness of ARMS. In particular, using our training strategy, ARMs (only 800M in size) can adapt to a broader VLM space and defeat commercial models like GPT-4o that are hundreds of times larger in scale. Our code, models, and datasets are available in the anonymous repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARMS路由器，用于在众多视觉语言模型（VLM）中选择最合适的模型。通过构建多模态数据集、引入VLM配置文件增强输入、采用简洁有效的架构以及扩展训练策略，仅800M参数的ARMS在VLM选择上击败了规模大数百倍的GPT-4o等商业模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM性能与资源需求各异，用户难以选择最合适的模型。虽然语言模型领域已有路由方法解决性能悖论问题，但VLM选择面临缺乏专用数据、特征表示无效、模型空间僵化且适配成本高等挑战。
AI.method: 1) 构建多模态数据集，包含7个主流VLM在32,626个图像-文本查询上的输出。2) 提出ARMS路由器，利用VLM配置文件增强输入信号，采用简洁有效的架构改进查询和VLM能力表示。3) 提出增量训练和独立训练两种扩展训练策略，提升对新VLM的适配能力。
AI.result: 在分布内和分布外测试集上均验证了ARMS的有效性。仅800M参数的ARMS通过训练策略可适配更广泛的VLM空间，在性能上击败了规模大数百倍的GPT-4o等商业模型。
AI.conclusion: ARMS成功解决了VLM选择的三大挑战，证明了小规模路由器模型通过合适的数据构建和训练策略，可以在VLM选择任务上超越大规模商业模型。

title: OmniCap-IF: Benchmarking and Improving Instruction Following Abilities for Omni-Video Captioning
summary: While Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in jointly processing audio and visual streams, their ability to strictly adhere to complex, multi-faceted user instructions remains largely unexplored. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on holistic video understanding or text-only instruction following, failing to capture the intricate interplay between modalities and user constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniCap-IF, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate instruction-following capabilities in omni-modal captioning. OmniCap-IF incorporates a systematic framework that assesses captions on two dimensions: format correctness and content correctness. Our benchmark encompasses 50 distinct constraint types across pure visual, pure audio, and audio-visual modalities, while integrating Temporal Grounding to assess spatio-temporal precision. Extensive evaluations of prominent models on 1,920 high-quality samples reveal significant performance disparities. Furthermore, our analysis uncovers a critical "format-content tradeoff", demonstrating that increasing formatting complexity directly degrades models' omni-modal reasoning abilities. Finally, to advance the field, we curate a 54K instruction-tuning dataset, OmniCap-IF-54K and present OmniCaptioner-IF, which achieves notable improvements in both complex instruction adherence and general omni-modal captioning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OmniCap-IF，首个专门评估全模态大语言模型在复杂指令下进行字幕生成能力的基准，揭示了模型存在"格式-内容权衡"问题，并提供了改进数据集和模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要关注整体视频理解或纯文本指令跟随，未能捕捉模态与用户约束之间的复杂交互，缺乏对全模态大模型严格遵循多维度用户指令能力的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建OmniCap-IF基准，从格式正确性和内容正确性两个维度评估字幕；包含50种约束类型，覆盖纯视觉、纯音频和音视频模态，并引入时间定位能力评估。同时构建54K指令微调数据集OmniCap-IF-54K并训练OmniCaptioner-IF模型。
AI.result: 在1920个高质量样本上评估多个主流模型，发现显著性能差异；揭示了"格式-内容权衡"现象，即增加格式复杂度会直接降低模型的全模态推理能力；OmniCaptioner-IF在复杂指令遵循和全模态字幕生成上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 全模态大模型在复杂指令跟随方面存在明显不足，格式与内容之间存在权衡关系，通过针对性数据微调可以有效改善这一缺陷。

title: Diverse Thinking Schemata Elicit Better Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have attracted increasing attention for their ability to solve complex mathematical problems by generating extended reasoning chains. In this work, we focus on two critical yet underexplored aspects of the reasoning process: reasoning transitions capturing the distinct transitions between reasoning steps and answer candidates reflecting the variety of solution paths produced by the model. We collectively define these two aspects as thinking schemata. We observe a correlation between the diversity of thinking schemata and model performance, which motivates us to enhance diversity as a means to further improve reasoning potential. To this end, we propose Diverse Schemata Policy Optimization (DiScO), a framework that first endows the model with schemata awareness, then encourages diversity through reinforcement learning, and further promotes diverse reasoning at inference time. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DiScO consistently outperforms standard group relative policy optimization. Beyond accuracy, human-annotated analyses show that DiScO substantially improves the model's ability to recover from erroneous initial attempts. Overall, our work suggests the important role that diversity of the thinking schemata plays and points to scaling along the diversity dimension as a promising research direction.

AI.tldr: 提出思维图式多样性策略优化（DiScO）框架，通过增强推理过程中的思维图式多样性来提升大推理模型的数学推理能力，在多个基准上超越标准GRPO方法，并显著改善了模型从错误中恢复的能力。
AI.motivation: 观察到思维图式的多样性与模型性能之间存在相关性，希望通过增强多样性来进一步释放模型的推理潜力。
AI.method: 提出DiScO框架，分三阶段：1）赋予模型思维图式感知能力；2）通过强化学习鼓励图式多样性；3）在推理阶段进一步促进多样化推理。
AI.result: 在多个数学推理基准上，DiScO一致优于标准组相对策略优化（GRPO）；人类标注分析表明，DiScO显著提升了模型从错误初始尝试中恢复的能力。
AI.conclusion: 思维图式的多样性在推理过程中扮演重要角色，沿多样性维度扩展是有前景的研究方向。

title: Facial Expression Recognition in the Deep Learning Era: A Systematic Multi-Criteria Review of Methods, Models, Datasets, Performance, Challenges, and Future Research Directions
summary: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) has advanced rapidly over the last decade, driven by the shift from handcrafted descriptors and shallow classifiers to deep convolutional, attention-based, vision-language, and foundation-model architectures, and by the parallel growth of large-scale in-the-wild benchmarks spanning categorical, dimensional, compound, micro-expression, Action Unit (AU), and intensity-estimation tasks. Yet the deep learning-based FER landscape has so far been reviewed only along narrow task-, architecture-, or application-specific axes, leaving a holistic, systematically organized account of its recent advances missing. This survey addresses that gap with a comprehensive review of recent deep learning-based FER, explicitly linked to the wider Facial Affect Recognition (FAR) domain. Its main contributions are: a) A description of FER's evolution into five distinct phases, from handcrafted features and classical machine learning to attention-based, vision-language, and foundation-model approaches, with the key milestone works of each, b) A multi-criteria taxonomy analyzing the literature along seven complementary axes: recognition task, input modality, face pre-processing pipeline, network architecture, learning strategy, acquisition setting, and application domain, c) A per-criterion comparative analysis, with critical insights into the strengths and limitations of each category under in-the-wild conditions, d) A task-organized review of public FER datasets, with their annotation schemes, modalities, and evaluation protocols, e) A compilation of performance metrics and a per-task quantitative comparison of representative state-of-the-art methods on widely adopted benchmarks, and f) A discussion of current challenges and promising future directions.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述全面回顾了基于深度学习的面部表情识别（FER）领域的发展，将其划分为五个阶段（从手工特征到基础模型），并从七个维度进行了系统分类分析，同时整理了数据集、性能指标和未来挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有FER综述多局限于特定任务、架构或应用场景，缺乏对深度学习驱动的FER领域进展的整体性、系统性梳理。本文旨在填补这一空白，并将FER置于更广泛的面部情感识别（FAR）领域中进行全面综述。
AI.method: 采用多维度分类法，从识别任务、输入模态、面部预处理流程、网络架构、学习策略、采集设置和应用领域七个方面系统分析文献；并划分FER发展的五个阶段进行里程碑式梳理。
AI.result: 提供了每个类别的优缺点分析，整理了公开数据集及其标注方案、模态和评估协议，汇编了代表性方法的性能指标，并在广泛采用的基准上进行了每任务定量比较。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了当前挑战和有前景的未来方向，为FER领域的研究提供了全面的参考框架。

title: Analyzing the Correlation Between Hallucinations and Knowledge Conflicts in Large Language Models
summary:
Hallucinations -- factually incorrect or unverifiable outputs -- remain one of the most challenging limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs), especially in knowledge-intensive tasks. One proposed explanation is internal knowledge conflicts arising from fixed, outdated training data. This paper investigates whether internal representations linked to knowledge conflicts correlate with hallucination behaviors in LLMs.
  Using probing techniques inspired by two prior works, we analyzed activations from hidden, attention, and MLP layers, as well as output logits, across predefined tasks. We probed LLaMA-3-8B on hallucination detection benchmarks and Falcon-7B on a knowledge conflict dataset. Our findings show that, although conceptually related, hallucination activation patterns cannot be fully reduced to or explained by knowledge conflict representations.
  Nonetheless, probing proves a robust tool across multiple languages and activation types, supporting its role in improving LLM interpretability. This work advances the broader understanding of hallucinations in LLMs and underscores the value of fine-grained analysis of their internal behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过探针技术分析LLM内部表征，发现幻觉行为与知识冲突相关但不等同，探针是提升模型可解释性的有效工具。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在知识密集型任务中常产生事实性错误（幻觉），研究者提出内部知识冲突（源自固定、过时的训练数据）是潜在原因之一，本文旨在验证两者之间的因果关系。
AI.method: 基于两项先前工作的探针技术，分析LLaMA-3-8B和Falcon-7B在隐藏层、注意力层、MLP层及输出logits上的激活模式，分别在幻觉检测基准和知识冲突数据集上进行探测。
AI.result: 尽管知识冲突与幻觉在概念上相关，但幻觉的激活模式无法完全归因于或简化为知识冲突的表征。探针在多种语言和激活类型上表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 本文推进了对LLM幻觉机制的深入理解，并强调了细粒度内部行为分析的重要性，探针技术可作为提升模型可解释性的有效工具。

title: RTL-BenchLS: A Large-Scale Benchmark for RTL Reasoning and Generation with Large Language Models
summary: LLM-based RTL generation and reasoning is a promising direction for hardware design automation. High-quality benchmarks are critical infrastructure for tracking progress in this direction. However, existing RTL benchmarks face inherent limitations in both scale and task scope. The designs they cover are typically small and simple, and the tasks focus almost entirely on specification-to-RTL generation. Frontier models' performance already saturates on the existing benchmarks. Scaling these benchmarks up is fundamentally difficult because aligned labels are required for benchmarking, such as specifications and testbenches. Such aligned high-quality data are rarely available for real-world designs. We introduce RTL-BenchLS, a large-scale benchmark addressing both limitations above. It contains over 10,000 formally verified Verilog designs, covering substantially larger and more complex designs than existing benchmarks. Beyond specification-to-RTL generation, we propose three novel tasks that jointly evaluate reasoning and generation: round-trip reasoning, masked-content reasoning, and repository-issue reasoning. The first two are self-supervised, which directly resolves the scaling bottleneck. All tasks are verified through formal equivalence checking without any manual testbenches. We evaluate eight LLMs on RTL-BenchLS. Even the best model reaches only 23% on natural-language round-trip reasoning, 28% on masked-content reasoning, and 12% on repository-issue fixing. RTL-BenchLS is substantially more challenging than existing benchmarks. It leaves ample room for future improvement and offers guidance for developing LLM-based methods for hardware design.

AI.tldr: 提出RTL-BenchLS，一个包含超过10,000个形式化验证Verilog设计的大型基准测试，涵盖更大更复杂的设计和三项新任务，现有LLM在其上表现不佳（最高仅23%），远未饱和。
AI.motivation: 现有RTL基准测试规模小、任务单一（仅规范到RTL生成），前沿模型性能已趋于饱和，且扩展基准测试因需要对齐标签（规范、测试台）而困难。
AI.method: 构建包含10,000+形式化验证Verilog设计的基准测试，提出三项自监督新任务（往返推理、掩码内容推理、仓库问题推理），通过形式等价性检查自动验证。
AI.result: 评估8个LLM，最好模型在自然语言往返推理上仅23%，掩码内容推理28%，仓库问题修复12%，表明现有基准测试更具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: RTL-BenchLS解决了现有基准的规模和任务范围限制，为LLM在硬件设计自动化中的发展提供了更有挑战性的评估平台和指导方向。

title: Harnessing Streaming Video in the Wild
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly required to process unbounded video streams in applications such as video-call assistants, live commentary, and embodied robots. An ideal streaming system should support proactive interaction, long-horizon memory, and real-time processing, while resting on a VLM backbone capable of handling diverse in-the-wild streaming tasks. However, existing VLMs excel at offline video understanding but fall short in streaming capabilities and lack dedicated infrastructure for streaming deployment. We address this gap on three fronts. (i) For backbone capability, we construct \textbf{Streaming-Train-248K}, a streaming dataset paired with a novel training objective for adapting VLMs to streaming interaction and understanding. (ii) For real-world deployment, we introduce \textbf{Streaming Harness}, a plug-and-play system that endows any VLM with three core abilities: proactive interaction (per-second response decisions), long-term memory (12-hour context retention), and real-time processing (sub-second latency). (iii) To drive continued community progress on streaming capabilities, we design \textbf{Streaming-Eval}, a benchmark that reflects models' capabilities across diverse in-the-wild scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains from our approach across all core capabilities required for streaming video understanding. We will open-source our data, code, and benchmark to advance the community's shift from offline video understanding to deployable streaming intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文针对VLM在流式视频理解中的不足，提出了Streaming-Train-248K数据集、Streaming Harness部署系统和Streaming-Eval基准，实现了主动交互、长时记忆和实时处理三大核心能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM擅长离线视频理解，但在流式场景下缺乏主动交互、长期记忆和实时处理能力，且缺少专门的流式部署基础设施。
AI.method: (i) 构建Streaming-Train-248K数据集并设计新的训练目标以适应流式交互；(ii) 开发Streaming Harness即插即用系统，赋予VLM主动交互（每秒响应决策）、长期记忆（12小时上下文保持）和实时处理（亚秒级延迟）能力；(iii) 设计Streaming-Eval基准评估模型在多样场景下的流式能力。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在流式视频理解所需的所有核心能力上均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过开源数据、代码和基准，推动社区从离线视频理解向可部署的流式智能转变。

title: Operationalizing Linguistic Methods through Prompt-Engineering Skills: An Automatic Chinese Web Neologism Detection Pipeline
summary: We present a method for automatic Chinese web neologism detection that operationalizes traditional linguistic identification principles as prompt-engineering skills. The method has four stages: tokenizer-independent character n-gram candidate generation; dictionary anchoring with a Pointwise Mutual Information pre-filter; a well-formedness skill based on Chinese word-formation principles; and a combined rule and three-way classification skill that distinguishes neologism, entity, and none. Applied to the BAAI CCI 3.0 corpus (267M documents), the method produces 226,959 classified candidates including 4,853 labeled neologisms. To evaluate the method, we develop a per-stage conditional recall decomposition in which the pipeline's strict recall factors mathematically into the product of stage conditional recalls. Applied to Hou (2023) (4,199 entries), the decomposition exposes Stage 1 candidate coverage and Stage 4B LLM semantic judgment as the two bottlenecks (R=41.5% and 60.0% respectively), while intermediate stages are near-lossless. A length-stratified analysis further reveals that the structural well-formedness skill is length-invariant (>= 96.9%) whereas the semantic novelty-classification skill is length-dependent (65.6%/59.0%/44.1% across 2/3/4-character candidates), mapping a current boundary of skill-based linguistic operationalization. We release the method, pipeline outputs, and evaluation protocol as public resources.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于提示工程技能的中文网络新词自动检测方法，在BAAI CCI 3.0语料库上生成226,959个分类候选词（含4,853个新词），并通过条件召回分解发现Stage 1候选覆盖率和Stage 4B LLM语义判断是两大瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 中文网络新词自动检测对语言监测和自然语言处理具有重要意义，传统方法难以有效捕捉网络环境中的新兴词汇，亟需一种系统化、可操作的语言学原则工程化方法。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：1) 基于tokenizer无关的字n-gram候选生成；2) 基于PMI预过滤的词典锚定；3) 基于中文构词原则的成词性技能；4) 结合规则与三分类技能（新词/实体/非词）。采用条件召回分解进行逐阶段评估。
AI.result: 在BAAI CCI 3.0（2.67亿文档）上产出226,959个候选词（4,853个新词）。在Hou(2023)基准上，流水线整体召回41.5%，Stage 4B语义判断召回60.0%，结构成词性技能长度无关（≥96.9%），语义新颖性分类长度相关（2/3/4字分别为65.6%/59.0%/44.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 展示了基于技能的语言学原则工程化在中文新词检测中的有效性，揭示了当前技能化操作化的边界，特别是在语义新颖性判断上的长度依赖性瓶颈。

title: The Token Not Taken: Sampling, State, and the Variability of AI Agent Outputs
summary: Agentic AI systems can behave differently across runs: the same request may produce a different plan, a different tool call, a different code edit, or a different final answer. Such variability arises from several layers that are often conflated. A foundation model is a large pretrained model, usually adaptable to many downstream tasks, that maps an input context to predictions over outputs. In many current agents, that model is embedded in an orchestration loop that plans, calls tools, observes results, and updates state. One explicit intrinsic source of variability in such systems is token generation: the model computes scores over possible next tokens, the scores are converted into probabilities, and a decoder may sample tokens using a pseudo-random number generator. A small sampled token difference can then propagate upward into a different tool call, code path, search query, or agent state. Other sources of variability are extrinsic to token sampling, including changing environments, live data, serving infrastructure, batch effects, and numerical details. By separating these layers, the manuscript clarifies what it means to call agentic AI systems stochastic, when such variability can be reproduced under matched conditions, and why deterministic execution need not imply identical behavior in deployed settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了Agentic AI系统中变异性的来源，区分了内在的token生成随机性与外在的环境、数据、基础设施等因素，并阐明了“随机性”、“可复现性”和“确定性执行”在不同层面上的含义。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI系统在不同运行中可能产生不同结果，这种变异性来源复杂且常被混淆，现有文献对此缺乏清晰的层次化分析。
AI.method: 通过将变异性来源分层为内在因素（token采样随机性）和外在因素（环境变化、实时数据、服务基础设施、批处理效应、数值细节等），进行系统性的梳理与区分。
AI.result: 明确了token级随机性可向上传播为工具调用、代码路径、搜索查询或agent状态的差异；外在因素则独立于token采样引入额外变异性。
AI.conclusion: 澄清了Agentic AI系统的随机性本质：在匹配条件下某些变异性可被复现，但确定性执行并不等同于部署环境中的行为一致性。

title: Co-Evolving Skill Generation and Policy Optimization
summary: Skill-augmented reinforcement learning improves language agents by storing reusable procedural knowledge acquired from past experience. Existing methods typically use strong language models to analyze trajectories, generate skills, and update a retrievable skill bank during online training. However, they rarely assess whether a newly generated skill is useful before it is stored and reused. We find that this assumption is unreliable: even skills generated by proprietary frontier LLMs exhibit highly mixed utility, with many providing little benefit or even degrading performance. Once such skills enter the bank, their effects are difficult to identify, because subsequent rollout feedback is delayed and usually reflects the combined effect of multiple retrieved skills rather than the marginal contribution of any individual skill. We propose an online reinforcement learning framework for pre-storage skill validation. The framework estimates whether a candidate skill contributes useful information beyond the skills already retrieved for the current task. It uses the standard rollout budget to form two matched groups under the same task and retrieval context: base rollouts conditioned on the currently retrieved skills, and skill-augmented rollouts conditioned on the same skills plus one candidate skill induced from the base trajectories. The reward gap between these two groups estimates the candidate skill's context-dependent marginal utility, enabling the framework to promote useful skills while filtering ineffective or harmful ones without additional rollout overhead. The framework further uses this marginal-utility signal to train the policy itself as a skill generator, reducing reliance on repeated calls to proprietary models. The learned skill-generation likelihood serves as a context-dependent score for retrieval-time reranking and outdated-skill pruning as the policy evolves.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在线强化学习框架，在技能存入银行前评估其边际效用，过滤无效/有害技能，并利用该信号训练策略自身作为技能生成器，减少对专有模型的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强型强化学习方法在生成技能后不评估其有用性就直接存入技能库，导致许多技能效果不佳甚至有害，且后续难以识别其单独影响。
AI.method: 在相同任务和检索上下文中构建两组轨迹：基础组（仅使用当前检索技能）和技能增强组（额外加入候选技能）。通过奖励差距估计候选技能的上下文依赖边际效用，据此筛选有用技能；同时用该信号训练策略作为技能生成器，用于检索重排序和过时技能剪枝。
AI.result: 能有效过滤无效或有害技能，且无需额外轨迹开销；学习到的技能生成似然可用于检索重排序和剪枝。
AI.conclusion: 通过预存储验证解决了技能库污染问题，并减少了对专有语言模型的反复调用。

title: LATTEArena: An Evaluation Framework for LLM-powered Tabular Feature Engineering (Extended Version)
summary: Feature engineering remains essential for tabular data analysis, and Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating this process, giving rise to LLM-powered AuTomated Tabular feature Engineering (LATTE). However, the absence of standardized platforms prevents fair, cost-aware comparisons. Furthermore, complex methodological designs obscure the specific contributions of individual components; for example, although LFG integrates Tree-of-Thought, few-shot demonstrations, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and natural language generation, the isolated impact of each technique's competitive edge remains unquantified. To address these challenges, we introduce LATTEArena, the first competitive evaluation framework featuring: (1) a six-dimensional taxonomy decomposing 15 representative methods into reusable components; (2) a standardized modular arena for controlled comparison; (3) multi-dimensional assessments covering performance, cost, and robustness; and (4) component-level ablation quantifying each technique's competitive edge. Through extensive evaluations, we reveal 16 key findings, including: (1) Tree-of-Thought with Monte Carlo Tree Search achieves optimal cost-effectiveness; (2) RPN and Code output formats dominate classification and regression tasks, respectively. We publicly release the modular framework and over 4000 execution logs, enabling researchers to seamlessly pit new techniques against existing ones and advance LATTE.

AI.tldr: 提出LATTEArena，首个面向LLM驱动的自动化表格特征工程的标准化评估框架，通过六维分类法、模块化竞技场和多维度评估，揭示了16个关键发现，并开源了框架和4000+执行日志。
AI.motivation: 当前LATTE领域缺乏标准化平台，无法进行公平、考虑成本的比较；复杂方法设计模糊了各组件贡献，如LFG中多种技术的单独影响未被量化。
