Together, these findings show that deploying VLMs as AI operators in evacuation scenarios remains a non-trivial challenge, where the choice of communication strategy and input representation can directly determine the success or failure of the intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基准框架，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在模拟疏散场景中引导平民的能力。实验发现：窄播策略优于广播，视觉表征驱动性能，而邻接图反而有害，移动威胁显著增加失败率。表明VLM作为AI操作员在动态应急场景中仍面临重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前NLP在危机沟通中的研究局限于静态、纯文本分类场景，忽视了AI操作员在动态、具身化场景中的关键沟通作用。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建基准框架，评估VLM在模拟疏散中引导平民。对比两种沟通策略（窄播vs.广播）、两种环境表征（视觉vs.图结构）、两种威胁行为（静态vs.移动），在9张不同复杂度地图上进行测试。
AI.result: 窄播策略在各难度下均显著降低平民失败率；视觉模态驱动性能提升，添加邻接图效果依赖模型且常有害；移动威胁在所有条件下均提高失败率。
AI.conclusion: 在疏散场景中部署VLM作为AI操作员仍是非平凡的挑战，沟通策略和输入表征的选择直接影响干预成败。

title: Next-Token Prediction Learns Generalisable Representations of Sleep Physiology
summary: Foundation models offer a promising route to compress multi-modal physiological signals into compact representations of human health, with broad applications across sleep medicine, cardiology, neurology and other healthcare domains. Existing models have typically been trained with masked-reconstruction or contrastive objectives. However, masked reconstruction may be poorly suited to the stochastic nature of these signals, while contrastive approaches rely on positive-pair definitions despite the semantic invariances of physiological signals being poorly understood. In this work, we show that next-token prediction is a simple and scalable alternative. We develop Hypnos, a multi-modal sleep foundation model trained using eight different sensing modalities (e.g. EEG, ECG, respiratory signals) drawn from over 20,000 overnight polysomnography recordings. We tokenize each modality into streams of discrete tokens using residual vector quantization, then train a large auto-regressive RQ-Transformer to jointly predict the next token across all modalities in parallel. After training, Hypnos can be applied to continuous streams of sensor data from any subset of supported modalities, generating embeddings for downstream tasks. Across a range of benchmarks, Hypnos significantly outperforms existing foundation models. In sleep stage classification, we match the performance of strong supervised baselines on held-out test sets whilst using \(100\times\) less labelled data. Hypnos even generalises to daytime physiology, surpassing a dedicated ECG foundation model at detecting atrial fibrillation. Our results demonstrate that next-token prediction is a strong self-supervised objective for representation learning from multi-modal physiological signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hypnos，一个基于next-token prediction的多模态睡眠基础模型，在20,000+多导睡眠监测记录上训练，使用残差向量量化将8种模态信号离散化为token，通过自回归RQ-Transformer联合预测多模态的下一个token，在睡眠分期分类和房颤检测等任务上显著优于现有基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生理信号基础模型使用掩码重建或对比学习存在缺陷：掩码重建不适合生理信号的随机性，对比学习依赖于定义不清的语义不变性。因此需要更简单且可扩展的自监督目标。
AI.method: 使用残差向量量化（RVQ）将8种模态（EEG、ECG、呼吸信号等）的生理信号离散化为token流，训练一个大型自回归RQ-Transformer，并行联合预测所有模态的下一个token。
AI.result: 在睡眠分期分类中，使用100倍更少的标注数据即可匹配强监督基线性能；在房颤检测上超越专用的ECG基础模型。
AI.conclusion: Next-token prediction是一种简单、可扩展且强大的自监督目标，适用于多模态生理信号的表示学习。

title: CRANE: Knowledge Editing for Reasoning MLLMs
summary:
The emergence of reasoning multimodal large language models (MLLMs), which generate explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before producing answers, has introduced a new challenge for knowledge editing: methods that appear successful under traditional metrics (teacher-forcing accuracy up to 100%) can fail severely when the model's reasoning process is examined (Grounded Success as low as 0%). We identify three failure modes: (1) Structural Collapse, where weight-modifying methods destroy the CoT format; (2) Cognitive Dissonance, where the model's reasoning chain actively rejects the injected edit fact based on visual evidence; and (3) Shallow Internalization, where methods succeed on exact queries but fail on rephrase or multi-hop variants. On reasoning MLLMs, these modes interact: methods that generalize (FT, LoRA) trigger format collapse, while methods without deep modification cannot generalize. To expose these failures, we propose a CoT-aware evaluation protocol and construct ReasonEdit-Bench, with conflict stratification, multi-level probes, and multi-hop portability tests.
  We propose CRANE, a retrieval-augmented framework that requires no per-edit parameter modification. CRANE combines a modality-aware dual-library retrieval system with a two-phase training strategy: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for structural initialization, followed by GRPO with a Cognitive Routing Reward that trains the model to arbitrate between visual priors and injected edit facts. On ReasonEdit-Bench, CRANE achieves 96.9% Grounded Success on conflict scenarios and 96.9% intermediate entity usage in multi-hop chains, with 97.6% text-locality and 68.1% image-locality Edit Independence. On the out-of-distribution MMEVOKE benchmark, CRANE reaches 87.0% under gold retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文指出推理型多模态大模型在知识编辑时存在三种失败模式（结构崩塌、认知失调、浅层内化），并提出无需修改参数的检索增强框架CRANE，通过双库检索和两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO）在ReasonEdit-Bench上实现96.9%的Grounded Success。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法在推理型多模态大模型上看似成功（准确率可达100%），但实际推理过程存在严重缺陷（Grounded Success低至0%），需要新的评估协议和方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出CRANE框架：1）模态感知的双库检索系统；2）两阶段训练策略——监督微调进行结构初始化，随后使用GRPO结合认知路由奖励训练模型在视觉先验和注入编辑事实之间进行仲裁。
AI.result: 在ReasonEdit-Bench上：冲突场景Grounded Success 96.9%，多跳链中间实体使用率96.9%，文本局部性97.6%，图像局部性68.1%；在OOD的MMEVOKE基准上达87.0%。
AI.conclusion: 提出CoT感知的评估协议ReasonEdit-Bench，并证明CRANE无需参数修改即可有效编辑推理型MLLM的知识，优于现有方法。

title: MUDIDI: A Two-Stage Framework for Multilingual Dictionary Digitization with Language Models
summary: Multilingual dictionaries are among the most valuable documentary resources for low-resource and endangered languages, yet many remain available only as scans. For many decades, their digitization and conversion into a machine-readable format was nearly impossible due to language-specific scripts, complex multi-column layouts full of entries with abbreviations and cross-references. Recent vision-language models offer a promising solution, but it is unclear how well they preserve characters, markup, and process lexicographic structure. We introduce MUDIDI, a two-stage framework for multi-lingual dictionary digitization. Stage One evaluates the quality of character recognition and markup preservation; Stage Two focuses on dictionary entry segmentation with subsequent mapping into a machine-readable lexicographic schema, SIL's Multi-Dictionary Formatter. We also release a dataset that consists of human-annotated lexicographic entries collected from 30 public-domain dictionaries featuring diverse writing systems, language families, and formats. We benchmark OCR systems, general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), and Vision Language Models (VLMs) on the dataset, demonstrating superior performance of LLMs across most writing systems and languages in both stages, and provide practical guidelines on improving the results for more challenging scenarios. Finally, we show that supplementing additional information, such as dictionary introduction, to the LLMs can improve the quality of the digitized dictionary. Github: https://github.com/DavidSamuell/MUDIDI-Pipeline-for-Digitization-of-Multilingual-Dictionary/

AI.tldr: 提出MUDIDI框架，利用视觉-语言模型和大型语言模型将多语言扫描词典（特别是低资源及濒危语言）数字化为机器可读格式，并发布包含30部词典的人工标注数据集，实验表明LLM在字符识别、标记保留和条目分割方面表现优越。
AI.motivation: 多语言词典是低资源和濒危语言的宝贵文献资源，但许多仅以扫描形式存在，由于语言特定文字、复杂的多栏布局、缩写和交叉引用，长期以来数字化几乎不可能，近期视觉-语言模型提供了有希望的解决方案，但尚不清楚它们对字符、标记和词典结构的处理效果。
AI.method: 提出MUDIDI两阶段框架：第一阶段评估字符识别质量和标记保留；第二阶段进行词典条目分割并映射到机器可读的词典编纂模式（SIL的Multi-Dictionary Formatter）。同时发布从30部公共领域词典中收集的人工标注词典条目数据集，涵盖多种文字系统、语系和格式，并基准测试OCR、通用LLM和VLM。
AI.result: LLM在大多数文字系统和语言的两个阶段中均表现优于OCR和VLM，向LLM补充词典前言等额外信息可提升数字化质量，并为更具挑战性的场景提供了实用改进指南。
AI.conclusion: MUDIDI框架有效实现了多语言扫描词典的数字化，LLM是当前最优方法，附加信息可进一步提升效果，相关代码已开源。

title: From 0-to-1 to 1-to-N: Reproducible Engineering Evidence for MetaAI Recursive Self-Design
summary: Recursive self-design refers to AI-assisted modification of the mechanisms by which an AI system is built, evaluated, and improved. This paper treats MetaAI not as a mature paradigm, but as a working term for a human-seeded, AI-expanded development pattern in which the design space itself becomes a target of modification. We propose an operational evidence framework with four criteria: inspectable target system, meta-level modifier, feedback-directed selection, and recursive continuation. We then map public systems, including Darwin Goedel Machine (DGM), STOP, Goedel Agent, and ShinkaEvolve, against these criteria. DGM provides the most direct currently reported evidence: its published results show improvement from 20% to 50% on SWE-bench Verified and from 14.2% to 30.7% on full Polyglot after 80 iterations, with ablations suggesting that both open-ended exploration and self-improvement contribute. Finally, we provide MetaAI-Mini, a reproducible HumanEval-based protocol and codebase. Because no completed model run is included in this build, MetaAI-Mini is reported as a protocol rather than as an experimental result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归自我设计（AI辅助修改自身构建机制）的操作性证据框架，包含四个标准，并通过映射现有系统（如DGM）和提供可复现协议MetaAI-Mini来验证该框架。
AI.motivation: 将MetaAI从概念性术语转化为可操作的研究范式，提出明确的证据标准来评估AI系统是否具备递归自我设计能力。
AI.method: 提出四标准证据框架（可检查目标系统、元级修改器、反馈导向选择、递归延续），映射现有公开系统，并发布可复现的MetaAI-Mini协议。
AI.result: DGM在SWE-bench Verified上从20%提升至50%，在Polyglot上从14.2%提升至30.7%（80次迭代），消融实验表明开放探索和自我改进均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 递归自我设计具备可验证的操作性证据框架，DGM是目前最直接的实证案例，MetaAI-Mini为后续研究提供了标准化协议。

title: Leveraging NeRF-Rendered Images for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Neural radiance field (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) are two mainstream approaches for novel view synthesis. They often show complementary performance, i.e., 3DGS demonstrating faster rendering speed and NeRF demonstrating higher rendering quality. Motivated by this, we propose leveraging NeRF-rendered images for 3DGS. Specifically, we target street scenes and utilize a pre-trained street-specific NeRF method to produce training images for a target 3DGS method. In our 3DGS training, NeRF-rendered images are used to remove transient objects in street-level input views and to generate bird's-eye views as additional views, inheriting the higher-quality rendering of NeRF into 3DGS. We further incorporate a diffusion-based image enhancement to improve the image quality of the additional views. Experimental results on one synthetic and two real datasets demonstrate that our proposed method improves street-scene rendering while preserving the speed of 3DGS and the quality of NeRF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用街景NeRF生成的图像来训练3DGS，以结合NeRF的高渲染质量和3DGS的快速渲染速度，并增强街景渲染效果。
AI.motivation: NeRF渲染质量高但速度慢，3DGS速度快但质量不如NeRF，两者性能互补。作者希望结合两者优势，提升街景渲染效果。
AI.method: 使用预训练的街景NeRF生成训练图像用于3DGS：去除输入视图中的瞬态物体，并生成鸟瞰图作为额外视图；同时引入扩散模型增强额外视图的图像质量。
AI.result: 在合成和两个真实数据集上，所提方法在保持3DGS速度和NeRF质量的同时，改善了街景渲染效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过NeRF图像辅助3DGS训练，能够有效融合两者的互补优势，实现街景场景的高质量快速渲染。

title: Reasoning without Gold Standards: A Proxy-Judge Theory of Autoformalization
summary:
Complex reasoning tasks increasingly require systems to produce outputs whose correctness cannot be judged by exact match against a single reference. Autoformalization (AF) is a representative example; it asks a model to translate informal mathematical or logical reasoning into a formally checkable object, yet expert-validated formalizations do not scale beyond toy cases and a single informal argument can admit many valid formal renderings. Progress therefore depends on whether partial, structured proxies can substitute for exact references.
  We introduce a reference-free proxy-judge framework for AF that replaces gold-standard matching with a vector of per-axis property checks. The framework organizes the proxy along three structural scopes that cover global properties of the elicited object, per-module properties internal to its sub-components, and cross-domain properties that re-align it to the informal source, and aggregates each axis into a verdict vector. The vector drives a reflective refinement loop in which a violated coordinate routes the controller to a matching repair target, so each iteration changes only what is judged wrong.
  Under bounded judge noise, the expected intrinsic gap contracts geometrically to a noise-dependent plateau. Across seven formalization backbones on miniF2F, ProofNet, e-SNLI, and ProntoQA, refinement consistently lifts Pass Rate over the single-shot ICL baseline, and the per-axis proxy outperforms a matched scalar proxy on benchmarks where the baseline has room to improve. Structured proxy judgments therefore provide both a practical refinement signal and a theoretical handle on convergence when exact references are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无参考的代理法官框架，用于自动形式化任务，通过多轴属性检查替代精确匹配，并利用结构化代理判断驱动迭代优化，在多个基准测试中显著提升了通过率。
AI.motivation: 复杂推理任务（如自动形式化）无法依赖单一参考标准进行精确匹配，因为专家验证的形式化无法规模化，且同一非正式论证可能有多种合法形式化版本。因此需要部分、结构化的代理指标来替代精确参考。
AI.method: 提出无参考的代理法官框架，将黄金标准匹配替换为沿三个结构化范围（全局属性、模块内部属性、跨域属性）的多轴属性检查向量，每个轴聚合成判定向量，驱动反思式优化循环，仅修正被判定有误的坐标。
AI.result: 在有限判官噪声下，期望内在差距几何级收敛至噪声平台。在miniF2F、ProofNet、e-SNLI、ProntoQA等七个形式化骨干上，优化持续提升单次ICL基线的通过率，多轴代理在基线有改进空间的基准上优于标量代理。
AI.conclusion: 结构化代理判断既提供了实用的优化信号，又在缺乏精确参考时提供了理论上的收敛保证。

title: Frequency-based Constrained Sampling for Interval Patterns
summary: Output space pattern sampling is a powerful alternative to exhaustive pattern mining for exploring large pattern spaces, as it enables users to focus on representative patterns drawn according to a chosen interestingness measure. In this paper, we address the problem of sampling interval patterns under user-defined syntactic constraints. We introduce CFips, a sampling approach that incorporates constraints directly into the sampling procedure. The approach relies on a multi-step sampling framework and supports several syntactic constraints by decomposing them into elementary predicates on interval bounds while preserving exact sampling guarantees. We formally prove that CFips samples interval patterns proportionally to their frequency within the constrained pattern space. The experimental results show that integrating constraints into the sampling procedure enables to complete mining tasks that would otherwise fail within a given time out.

AI.tldr: CFips 是一种在用户定义语法约束下对区间模式进行精确采样的方法，通过多步采样框架和谓词分解技术，保证按频率比例采样，并能完成超时的挖掘任务。
AI.motivation: 输出空间模式采样是穷举模式挖掘的高效替代方案，但现有方法难以在用户定义的语法约束下对区间模式进行采样。
AI.method: 提出 CFips 方法，采用多步采样框架，将语法约束分解为区间边界的原子谓词，在保持精确采样保证的同时将约束直接融入采样过程。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，将约束融入采样过程能够完成在给定超时条件下原本会失败的模式挖掘任务。
AI.conclusion: CFips 能够按频率比例在约束模式空间中采样区间模式，且整合约束可提升挖掘可行性。

title: MilliVid: Hierarchical Latents for Long-Range Consistency in Video Generation
comment: Ishaan Preetam Chandratreya and David Charatan contributed equally. Project page: https://davidcharatan.com/millivid/
summary: Video generative models have become increasingly powerful, but long-range consistency remains challenging to achieve because even a few dozen frames require impractically long transformer sequence lengths. We show that this issue can be mitigated by generating video using coarse-to-fine rollout within a multi-scale token space. Our approach is simple: first, we pre-train an autoencoder that compresses each frame into a hierarchy of tokens, with levels ranging from the typical latent resolution to only a handful of tokens per frame. The coarsest levels capture the most consequential information, such as scene layout and semantics, while finer levels add high-frequency appearance and texture. Then, we train a video diffusion model to generate these tokens using coarse-to-fine rollout. By carefully controlling the level of detail at which frames are generated and used as context during each rollout step, we are able to preserve long-range consistency in geometry and object permanence while spending less compute on the long-range consistency of less perceptually relevant details. We validate this approach using a custom dataset of long Minecraft videos, where it produces substantially more consistent rollouts compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多尺度分层的视频生成方法，通过粗到细的滚动生成方式，在保持长程一致性的同时降低计算开销，在Minecraft长视频数据集上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型在长程一致性上存在挑战，因为长序列所需的Transformer序列长度不切实际，需要一种更高效的方案来保持视频的几何结构和物体持久性。
AI.method: 先预训练一个能将每帧压缩为层次化token的自编码器（从典型潜变量分辨率到少量token），然后训练一个视频扩散模型，通过粗到细的滚动生成方式进行token生成，在每一步仔细控制帧生成的细节层次和上下文使用。
AI.result: 在自定义的Minecraft长视频数据集上，该方法相比现有基线生成了显著更一致的滚动生成结果。
AI.conclusion: 粗到细的多尺度token空间生成方法能有效解决视频长程一致性问题，在保证几何结构和物体持久性的同时，减少对感知上不重要的细节进行长程一致性计算的开销。

title: AbstRAG: Learning to Abstract for Retrieval Problems
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation often fails when the query, the document evidence, and the user's intent are expressed at different levels of abstraction. A query may ask about a class, a relation, or an event, while the document only states specific instances, indirect framings, or scoped formulations. We define this mismatch as an abstraction gap: the minimal set of typed assumptions required to align query intent with the available evidence. To close this gap, we introduce AbstRAG, which treats abstraction as an explicit retrieval object. AbstRAG decomposes the query--evidence gap into expression, conceptual, intent--evidence, and event-type components, and scores relevance by combining match quality, a query-independent utility prior, and the cost of the required bridges. Its central mechanism is reflective refinement: a critic diagnoses retrieval failures, localizes the failed abstraction operator, proposes a minimal stage-specific patch, and accepts the patch only under sufficiency and compression controls. Across three within-document retrieval benchmarks against seven baselines, AbstRAG outperforms on nDCG@10 in 18 of 21 paired-bootstrap contrasts and improves generation accuracy by 1.9%, 5.2%, and 4.0% across the three benchmarks; ablations confirm that reflective refinement drives most of the retrieval gain and the compression control alone reduces over-expansion false positives from 73.7% to 0% on a stress slice.

AI.tldr: AbstRAG通过将抽象层次不匹配问题显式建模为检索对象，并引入反思式精炼机制，在三个基准测试中显著提升了检索增强生成的效果。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成常因查询、文档证据与用户意图处于不同抽象层次而失败，现有方法缺乏对这种抽象鸿沟的系统性处理。
AI.method: 提出AbstRAG，将抽象鸿沟分解为表达、概念、意图-证据和事件类型四个组件，通过匹配质量、查询无关效用先验和桥梁成本综合评分；核心是反思式精炼机制，诊断检索失败、定位失败算子、提出最小补丁并接受通过充分性和压缩控制的补丁。
AI.result: 在三个文档内检索基准上，AbstRAG在21个配对自举对比中18个nDCG@10优于基线；生成准确率分别提升1.9%、5.2%和4.0%；消融实验证实反思式精炼是检索增益的主要来源，压缩控制将过度扩展误报从73.7%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模抽象层次鸿沟并引入反思式精炼机制，能有效提升检索增强生成在抽象不匹配场景下的性能。

title: SpatialWorld: Benchmarking Interactive Spatial Reasoning of Multimodal Agents in Real-World Tasks
summary: Spatial reasoning is a foundational capability for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perceive and operate within the physical world. However, existing benchmarks predominantly rely on passive evaluation (e.g., static VQA) or simulator-specific pipelines, failing to assess general interactive spatial understanding. We introduce SpatialWorld, a unified benchmark designed specifically for evaluating the interactive spatial understanding of multimodal agents in complex real-world tasks. Integrating eight heterogeneous simulation backends under a shared, simulator-agnostic protocol, SpatialWorld features 760 human-annotated tasks across diverse domains (e.g., household routines, travel, social collaboration). Agents must solve tasks under vision-only partial observability, actively gathering egocentric visual evidence and expressing decisions via a unified, text-based action interface native to MLLMs. For reliable evaluation, each task includes a human-validated initial state, a reference trajectory, and a terminal-state verifier. Evaluating 15 advanced agents reveals that robust spatial task solving remains challenging: the strongest model, GPT-5, achieves an average task success rate (TSR) of only 17.4%, while the leading open-source model, Qwen-3.5, reaches 14.1%. Further analysis exposes a clear mismatch between task success and execution efficiency, alongside substantial domain-specific performance variations. These bottlenecks in active exploration and long-horizon planning position SpatialWorld as a rigorous testbed for future spatial agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialWorld基准，用于评估多模态大模型在复杂真实任务中的交互式空间理解能力。在8种异构仿真后端、760个人工标注任务中测试15个先进智能体，最强模型GPT-5仅达17.4%成功率，揭示主动探索与长程规划仍是核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准多依赖被动评估（如静态VQA）或特定于模拟器的流程，无法评估通用的交互式空间理解能力。因此需要统一基准来测试多模态智能体在复杂真实任务中的交互式空间理解。
AI.method: 构建SpatialWorld基准，集成8种异构仿真后端，采用统一的、与模拟器无关的协议；包含760个人工标注任务，覆盖家庭日常、旅行、社交协作等场景；智能体在视觉部分可观测条件下，通过统一的文本动作接口主动收集自我中心视觉证据并表达决策；每个任务包含人工验证的初始状态、参考轨迹和终端状态验证器。
AI.result: 评估15个先进智能体，最强模型GPT-5平均任务成功率仅17.4%，开源模型Qwen-3.5达14.1%；存在任务成功与执行效率之间的明显不匹配，以及显著的领域特定性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 主动探索和长程规划是当前多模态智能体的主要瓶颈，SpatialWorld可作为未来空间智能体的严格测试平台。

title: See More, Think Deeper: Query-Expanded Visual Evidence and Answer-Clue Guided Reflection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Recent advances in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have enabled performance on long-video understanding tasks. However, existing methods still face two key limitations: evidence acquisition often relies on a single search intent, and answer generation lacks an effective visual feedback mechanism. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{CoVER}, a Comprehensive Visual Evidence and Reflection framework for long-video understanding. CoVER enables Video-LLMs to \textbf{See More} by dynamically gathering query-expanded visual evidence, and \textbf{Think Deeper} by verifying draft answers with effective answer-specific visual feedback. Together, these mechanisms shift long-video understanding from answer-centric generation to evidence-centric and visually verifiable reasoning. Experimental results show that CoVER-7B substantially outperforms models with the same parameter scale and even surpasses state-of-the-art closed-source models on certain metrics.

AI.tldr: CoVER是一个面向长视频理解的全新框架，通过动态查询扩展收集视觉证据（See More）和基于视觉反馈验证答案（Think Deeper），将长视频理解从答案导向转向证据导向和可验证推理，在7B参数规模上超越同尺寸模型甚至部分闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频大语言模型在长视频理解中存在两个关键局限：证据获取依赖单一搜索意图，且答案生成缺乏有效的视觉反馈机制。
AI.method: 提出CoVER框架，包含两个核心机制：1) See More：通过动态查询扩展（query-expanded）来收集更全面的视觉证据；2) Think Deeper：通过生成草稿答案并利用答案特定的视觉反馈进行验证，实现视觉可验证推理。
AI.result: CoVER-7B在同等参数规模模型上表现优异，在部分指标上甚至超越了最先进的闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: CoVER通过证据中心与视觉可验证的推理机制，有效提升了长视频理解的性能，证明了从答案生成向证据推理转变的有效性。

title: REFINE: Super-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning via Rendering-Free Primitive Importance
summary: Existing pruning methods for 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) suffer from either severe quality degradation or prohibitive computational overhead. In this paper, we propose REFINE, a highly accelerated 3DGS pruning framework centered on a novel rendering-free primitive importance metric. Our approach leverages an analytically approximated, rendering-aware Hessian field to quantify the expected perceptual error induced by the removal of individual primitives. By modeling the joint modulation of visibility, projection geometry and the content adaptive hyperparameter, we entirely bypass costly forward rendering passes and derive an anisotropic perceptual weight field that serves as a high-fidelity proxy for primitive importance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that REFINE maintains highly competitive rendering quality while achieving an unprecedented $3,000\times$ reduction in pruning-related computational complexity compared to state-of-the-art pruning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出REFINE框架，基于渲染无关的原语重要性度量实现3D高斯泼溅的高效剪枝，计算复杂度降低3000倍且保持高质量渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS剪枝方法要么质量严重下降，要么计算开销过大，缺乏高效且高质量的剪枝方案。
AI.method: 利用解析近似的、感知渲染的Hessian场来量化移除单个原语带来的预期感知误差，通过联合建模可见性、投影几何和内容自适应超参数，推导出各向异性的感知权重场作为原语重要性的高保真代理。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，REFINE在保持高度竞争力的渲染质量的同时，与最先进方法相比实现了3000倍的剪枝计算复杂度降低。
AI.conclusion: REFINE是一种高效且高质量的3DGS剪枝框架，通过渲染无关的重要性度量大幅提升剪枝效率。

title: (Auto)formalization is supposed to be easy: Trellis process semantics for spelling out rigorous proofs
summary: We present Trellis: an autoformalization system that leverages LLM agents in a deterministically constrained workflow to enforce incremental progress in Lean autoformalization tasks through iterative refinement of natural language proofs. Our approach is motivated by the common mathematician's notion of what it means to have a rigorous proof in the first place: namely, that it would be routine to elaborate any part of the proof in further detail. The result is a system which aims to achieve reliable autoformalization on a modest budget and with generalist agents, with specialization to autoformalization coming not from any task-specific agent training but instead from a meaning-of-rigor inspired workflow enforced by process semantics. We link to an end-to-end Lean formalization of a recent Ramsey theory breakthrough produced by the process.

AI.tldr: Trellis是一个利用LLM代理并在确定性约束工作流中运行的自动形式化系统，通过迭代细化自然语言证明来实现Lean自动形式化，其灵感来源于数学家对严格证明的理解——即证明的任何部分都可以被详细展开。该系统在有限预算和通用代理下实现可靠的自动形式化，并用该流程成功形式化了Ramsey理论的最新突破。
AI.motivation: 受数学家对严格证明的理解启发——即严格证明意味着可以将其任何部分进一步细化展开，旨在以有限预算和通用LLM代理实现可靠的自动形式化，无需特定任务训练。
AI.method: 利用LLM代理在确定性约束工作流中运行，通过迭代细化自然语言证明来强制实现渐进式进展，专业性来自受严格性含义启发的工作流（通过过程语义强制），而非特定代理训练。
AI.result: 成功实现了端到端的Lean形式化，应用于Ramsey理论的最新突破。
AI.conclusion: 通过受数学严格性概念启发的确定性工作流，通用LLM代理即可在有限预算下完成可靠的自动形式化任务。

title: Beyond Scalar Rewards by Internalizing Reasoning into Score Distributions
summary: Reward models are central to text-to-image post-training, but visual preference is subjective and better represented as a distribution over rubric scores than as a deterministic scalar. Existing scalar, score-token, and pairwise reward models over-compress uncertainty and fine-grained score differences, while reasoning-based generative rewards provide stronger judgments but are costly to deploy and difficult to use as direct optimization signals. We propose Z-Reward, a teacher-student reward modeling framework that decouples reasoning-heavy judgment from efficient reward deployment. The teacher is a large VLM that uses reasoning to infer rubric-aligned score distributions, and is trained with Group-wise Direct Score Optimization (GDSO), which combines policy-gradient rewards from distribution expectations with direct pointwise and pairwise supervision on score distributions and score gaps. The student is trained with Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation (RISD), which transfers the teacher's reasoning-conditioned score distribution into a compact VLM without requiring explicit reasoning chains at inference time. On our internally annotated evaluation set, the 27B GDSO teacher reaches 89.6% human preference accuracy, outperforming SFT, RewardDance, and GRPO, while the 9B RISD student reaches 88.6%, outperforming the OPD baseline and closely matching the larger teacher. We further show that Z-Reward can serve as a differentiable reward signal for text-to-image optimization, yielding a 41.3% net human-preference improvement over the SFT baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出Z-Reward师生奖励建模框架，通过解耦推理型评判与高效奖励部署，在文本到图像后训练中实现更优的人类偏好对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有标量、评分token、成对奖励模型过度压缩了视觉偏好的不确定性和细粒度差异，而基于推理的生成式奖励虽判断更强，但部署成本高且难以作为直接优化信号。
AI.method: 教师模型使用GDSO（组别直接分数优化）训练，结合策略梯度奖励与点对点、成对监督；学生模型使用RISD（推理内化分数蒸馏）训练，将教师推理条件化的分数分布转移到紧凑VLM中，推理时无需显式推理链。
AI.result: 27B GDSO教师模型达89.6%人类偏好准确率，优于SFT、RewardDance和GRPO；9B RISD学生模型达88.6%，优于OPD基线并与教师接近；作为可微奖励信号可带来41.3%的人类偏好净提升。
AI.conclusion: Z-Reward有效解耦了推理型奖励的强判别能力与高效部署需求，为文本到图像后训练提供了可微且高质量的对齐信号。

title: Proxy Reward Internalization and Mechanistic Exploitation: A Learned Precursor to Reward Hacking and Its Generalization
summary: Reward hacking is usually studied after it becomes visible, once a model earns high proxy reward while failing the intended task. We instead study what proxy RL teaches before that failure appears. We introduce Proxy Reward Internalization and Mechanistic Exploitation (PRIME), a learned capability to assess task correctness, predict proxy acceptance, and reason about exploitable proxy--gold gaps. In coding RL environments with exploitable pytest rewards, we measure PRIME through chain-of-thought monitoring, direct probes, and activation-level concept vectors. We find that PRIME emerges in a staged sequence before sustained reward hacking, and that its current direct-probe score forecasts later hack onset and severity even when the visible hack rate is still low. PRIME also adapts when the evaluator changes, retargeting to whichever proxy--gold gap remains rewarded and persisting when gold reward suppresses overt hacking, and ablating its activation directions reduces hacking. Across checkpoints, in-domain PRIME tracks out-of-domain misalignment. Together these results suggest that exploitable proxy RL amplifies a proxy-internalization capability upstream of visible hacking, making PRIME a candidate early-warning signal for broader alignment risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRIME概念，即模型在奖励黑客行为显现前就已学会的一种能力：评估任务正确性、预测代理接受度、推理代理与真实目标之间的差距。研究发现PRIME会分阶段出现，其探测分数可预测后续黑客攻击的严重程度，且能适应评估器变化。
AI.motivation: 以往研究只在奖励黑客行为变得可见后才分析它，本文希望探究在黑客行为显现之前，代理强化学习（proxy RL）教会了模型什么，从而提前预警对齐风险。
AI.method: 在可被利用的pytest奖励的编码RL环境中，通过思维链监控、直接探测和激活层概念向量三种方式测量PRIME。
AI.result: PRIME在持续奖励黑客行为之前分阶段出现；直接探测分数可预测后续黑客的发生时间和严重程度；PRIME能适应评估器变化并持续存在；消除其激活方向可减少黑客行为；域内PRIME可跟踪域外不对齐。
AI.conclusion: 可被利用的代理RL放大了模型内部化代理奖励的能力，该能力早于显式黑客行为出现，PRIME可作为更广泛对齐风险的早期预警信号。

title: Memory Beyond Recall: A Dual-Process Cognitive Memory System for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory for an LLM agent is more than retrieving the right passage at the right time. Current memory systems collapse belief revision, causal coupling, and cross-domain abstraction into a single retrieval surface tuned for surface recall, and consequently struggle on implicit personalisation that requires reasoning over how a user has evolved. We propose DCPM, which reorganises agent memory along a cognitive capability hierarchy ascending from raw inputs and atomic facts, through diachronic belief trajectories and identity, to domain schemas, latent intentions and cross-domain patterns. The hierarchy is driven by two processes inheriting the architectural split of dual-process theory: a synchronous daytime writer (System1) that records belief revisions as doubly linked supersedes chains, and an asynchronous nighttime engine (System2) that induces schemas and intentions and sweeps for cross-domain collisions abstracted into higher-level core schemas. On LongMemEval, PersonaMem and PersonaMem-v2, enabling System2 contributes most where the benchmark rewards implicit cross-session inference (up to +5.20 on PersonaMem-v2) and least on span recall, matching the architectural prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出DCPM，一种基于双过程理论的分层认知记忆系统，通过System1（日间写入）和System2（夜间推理）的协同，在需要跨会话隐式推理的人物记忆任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM记忆系统将信念修正、因果耦合和跨领域抽象压缩到单一的检索表面，难以处理需要追踪用户认知演变的隐式个性化任务。
AI.method: 构建认知能力层级（原始输入→原子事实→信念轨迹→身份→领域模式→潜在意图→跨域模式），通过System1（日间写入器）记录信念修正为双重链接的取代链，System2（夜间引擎）异步归纳模式、意图并检测跨域冲突。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval、PersonaMem和PersonaMem-v2上，System2在隐式跨会话推理任务中贡献最大（PersonaMem-v2提升+5.20），在跨度召回任务中贡献最小。
AI.conclusion: 分层认知记忆架构有效对齐了双过程理论预测，在需要深度推理的记忆任务上优于传统平面检索方法。

title: Beyond Probabilistic Similarity: Structural, Temporal, and Causal Limitations of Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Legal Domain
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard architectural response to unreliability in legal AI, yet high-profile failures, including fabricated citations submitted to courts and anachronistic legal content presented as current, continue to appear across jurisdictions. We argue that these failures are not residual confabulations to be eliminated by scaling language models, but symptoms of an architectural mismatch between probabilistic retrieval and the hierarchical, temporal, and institutional structure of legal knowledge. We develop the argument in three moves. First, we articulate the ontological commitment of legal knowledge as a triad of properties derivable from classical legal theory: hierarchical and mereological structure, diachronic dynamism under operational closure, and causal traceability of institutional provenance grounded in the duty of justification. Second, we identify three corresponding pathologies of retrieval (mereological blindness, diachronic blindness, and causal opacity), each developed with an operational definition, a failure mechanism, a canonical example, and detection criteria for diagnostic use. Third, we review the state of the art through this lens, showing that existing approaches address these requirements unevenly and do not yet compose into a paradigm that treats them as co-constitutive. From this analysis we derive four architectural commitments that characterize the deterministic-by-design direction for legal retrieval: ontological primacy, event reification, bitemporal correctness, and deterministic interaction protocols. The framework concerns quaestio juris (which norms apply and in what state) rather than the downstream tasks that act on identified norms, and addresses legislative and constitutional retrieval primarily, with interpretive time as an explicit extension.

AI.tldr: 本文指出法律AI中RAG系统的失败源于概率检索与法律知识层级性、时间性、制度性结构的架构性错配，并提出"确定性-by-design"的四大架构承诺。
AI.motivation: 法律AI领域RAG系统频繁出现虚假引用、过时内容等严重错误，作者认为这不是模型规模能解决的残存幻觉，而是检索架构与法律知识本体论之间的根本性错配。
AI.method: 三步论证：1）从经典法理论推导法律知识的三元本体论承诺（层级/部分-整体结构、历时动态性、制度来源因果可溯性）；2）识别三类检索病理（部分-整体盲视、历时盲视、因果不透明性），每种给出操作定义、失败机制、经典示例和检测标准；3）以此视角审视现有方法，指出现有方法未将三者视为共构约束。
AI.result: 提炼出"确定性-by-design"的四大架构承诺：本体论优先性、事件具体化、双时态正确性、确定性交互协议。框架聚焦于法的适用（何种规范在何种状态下适用），而非下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 法律检索应当从概率范式转向确定性范式，将法律知识本体论属性作为检索系统的先验约束条件，而非期望大语言模型通过规模扩展来弥补架构缺陷。

title: Detecting Differences Is Not Understanding Structure: Large Language Models Fail at Graph Isomorphism
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on diverse reasoning tasks, yet their capacity for structural reasoning in graphs remains unclear. We investigate whether LLMs can genuinely understand graph isomorphism -a fundamental problem in graph theory. While LLMs achieve near-perfect accuracy on isomorphism detection, we show this performance is illusory. When identical graphs are presented with permuted node labels, LLMs fail to identify their isomorphism. This finding suggests that LLMs exploit patterns rather than reasoning about abstract graph structure. Since permutation invariance is a fundamental requirement for valid structural reasoning, these results indicate that success on graph reasoning benchmarks should not be interpreted as evidence of genuine topological understanding.

AI.tldr: LLMs在检测图同构任务上看似表现优异，但当节点标签被置换后却无法识别同构图，表明其依赖模式而非真正的结构推理，图推理基准测试的成功不应被解读为模型具备拓扑理解能力。
AI.motivation: 探究LLMs是否能够真正理解图同构问题——图论中的基础问题，质疑其在图结构推理任务上的能力真实性。
AI.method: 通过对比实验，让LLMs检测图同构，并对同一组图进行节点标签置换，观察模型能否识别出其同构性。
AI.result: LLMs在同构检测上达到近乎完美准确率，但当节点标签被置换后，无法识别原本同构的图。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在图推理任务上的成功表现是虚假的，它们依赖模式匹配而非真正的抽象结构推理，图推理基准测试不应被解读为模型具备拓扑理解能力。

title: SearchSwarm: Towards Delegation Intelligence in Agentic LLMs for Long-Horizon Deep Research
summary: Large language models are increasingly expected to handle complex, long-horizon real-world tasks whose context demands can grow without bound, yet model context windows remain inherently finite. Recent work explores a paradigm where a main agent decomposes tasks and dispatches subtasks to subagents, which execute and return only summarized results, conserving the main agent's context budget. However, performing this well requires delegation intelligence: the ability to decompose complex tasks, determine when and what to delegate, and integrate returned results into the ongoing workflow. Training data for this capability is scarce in naturally occurring text, and to our knowledge, how to synthesize such data and train models to acquire this capability remains largely unexplored in the open-source community. To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary exploration targeting deep research, a representative long-horizon agent task. Specifically, we design a harness that guides the model toward high-quality task decomposition and delegation, while constraining subagents to return results properly to support the main agent's workflow. The harness-guided trajectories naturally encode correct delegation decisions, which we use as supervised fine-tuning data to internalize delegation intelligence into model weights. Our resulting model, SearchSwarm-30B-A3B, achieves 68.1 on BrowseComp and 73.3 on BrowseComp-ZH, the best results among all models of comparable scale. We will release our harness, model weights, and training data to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过任务分解与委派机制来扩展大语言模型处理长上下文任务能力的方法，并利用监督微调将委派智能内化到模型权重中，在BrowseComp等基准上取得同规模最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在复杂、长周期真实世界任务中，上下文窗口的有限性成为瓶颈。现有方法通过主代理委派子任务给子代理来节省上下文预算，但如何训练模型获得这种委派智能（任务分解、委派决策、结果整合）在开源社区中尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 设计一个引导框架（harness），指导模型进行高质量的任务分解与委派，同时约束子代理正确返回结果以支持主代理的工作流程。将引导轨迹作为监督微调数据，将委派智能内化到模型权重中，得到SearchSwarm-30B-A3B模型。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp上达到68.1，在BrowseComp-ZH上达到73.3，是同规模模型中的最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过合成委派数据并进行监督微调，可以有效提升模型在长周期任务中的委派智能，为开源社区提供了一种可复现的解决方案。作者将开源引导框架、模型权重和训练数据。

title: HDRAgent: An Agentic Framework for Multi-Exposure HDR Imaging
summary: Most existing multi-exposure HDR methods follow a fixed feed-forward reconstruction paradigm, making them prone to ghosting artifacts in complex dynamic scenes. To address this issue, we propose HDRAgent, the first agent-driven framework for HDR imaging, which adaptively selects reconstruction strategies according to the current scene conditions. Specifically, to provide scene-specific prior knowledge, we introduce a fine-grained contextual knowledge matching (FCM) module. This module leverages multimodal large language model (MLLM)-derived scene perception to retrieve relevant historical cases and tool knowledge, organizing them into structured evidence for MLLM-based adaptive tool scheduling. In addition, we propose a perception--distortion feedback mechanism that transforms post-execution quality assessment and artifact diagnosis into structured feedback, which is accumulated in historical memory to help subsequent contextual knowledge refinement and strategy selection. Furthermore, considering that extreme motion can invalidate alignment methods, we design an agent-guided generative alignment strategy that uses MLLM-based dynamic-region parsing to reconstruct unreliable contents in non-reference frames under reference-frame guidance. Experiments demonstrate that HDRAgent effectively reduces ghosting and local artifacts while achieving competitive or superior objective performance and visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出HDRAgent，首个基于智能体的HDR成像框架，通过场景自适应策略选择和多模态大模型驱动，在复杂动态场景中有效减少鬼影和伪影。
AI.motivation: 现有MEF HDR方法采用固定前馈重建范式，在复杂动态场景中容易产生鬼影伪影。
AI.method: 1) FCM模块：利用MLLM场景感知检索历史案例和工具知识；2) 感知-失真反馈机制：将质量评估转化为结构化反馈存入历史记忆；3) 智能体引导的生成式对齐策略：基于MLLM动态区域解析重建不可靠内容。
AI.result: 有效减少鬼影和局部伪影，取得具有竞争力甚至更优的客观性能和视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: HDRAgent作为首个智能体驱动的HDR成像框架，通过自适应策略选择解决了动态场景下的鬼影问题。

title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
summary: The performance of LLM-based agents is jointly shaped by their base models and the harnesses that mediate their interaction with the environment. Because different models exhibit distinct behaviors, effective harness design is inherently model-specific. Yet agent harnesses are still largely engineered by human experts, a paradigm that scales poorly as modern LLMs become increasingly diverse and rapidly evolving. In this paper, we introduce Self-Harness, a new paradigm in which an LLM-based agent improves its own operating harness, without relying on human engineers or stronger external agents. We operationalize Self-Harness as an iterative loop with three stages: Weakness Mining, which identifies model-specific failure patterns from execution traces; Harness Proposal, which generates diverse yet minimal harness modifications tied to these failures; and Proposal Validation, which accepts candidate edits only after regression testing. We instantiate Self-Harness on Terminal-Bench-2.0 using a minimal initial harness and three base models from diverse families: MiniMax M2.5, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and GLM-5. Across all three models, Self-Harness consistently improves performance, with held-out pass rates increasing from 40.5% to 61.9%, 23.8% to 38.1%, and 42.9% to 57.1%, respectively. Qualitative analyses further show that Self-Harness does not simply add generic instructions, but effectively turns model-specific weaknesses into concrete, executable harness changes. These results suggest a path toward LLM-based agents that are not merely shaped by their harnesses, but can also participate in reshaping them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Self-Harness范式，让LLM智能体自主迭代改进其操作框架（harness），无需人工或外部更强模型干预。在Terminal-Bench-2.0上，三种不同系列的基座模型（MiniMax M2.5、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、GLM-5）均取得显著性能提升，通过率分别从40.5%、23.8%、42.9%提升至61.9%、38.1%、57.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的harness设计高度依赖人类专家手动调优，面对日益多样化和快速演化的LLM，这种范式扩展性差，无法适应不同模型的特性差异。
AI.method: Self-Harness采用迭代循环架构，包含三个阶段：1) Weakness Mining（弱点挖掘）——从执行轨迹中识别模型特定的失败模式；2) Harness Proposal（提案生成）——针对失败模式生成多样化且最小化的harness修改；3) Proposal Validation（提案验证）——通过回归测试筛选接受候选修改。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench-2.0上，三个不同系列模型均获得性能提升：MiniMax M2.5从40.5%提升至61.9%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B从23.8%提升至38.1%，GLM-5从42.9%提升至57.1%。定性分析表明Self-Harness能将模型特定弱点转化为具体可执行的harness变更，而非简单添加通用指令。
AI.conclusion: Self-Harness为LLM智能体提供了一条新路径：智能体不仅能被harness塑造，还能主动参与重塑自己的操作框架，实现自我进化。

title: Multi-Turn Evaluation of Deep Research Agents Under Process-Level Feedback
comment: Published as a workshop paper at SCALE - ICML 2026 (Oral)
summary: Existing benchmarks for deep research agents (DRAs) assess only single-shot outputs, ignoring a key question: can DRAs improve their reports when guided by feedback? To investigate this, we conduct a multi-turn evaluation of DRAs under two feedback settings: self-reflection, in which the agent revises its report without any external diagnostic signal, and process-level feedback, in which the agent receives guidance targeting gaps in its research strategy. To enable process-level feedback, we design Research Gap Inference (RGI), a method that analyzes patterns of satisfied and unsatisfied rubric criteria to infer research-process gaps. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (i) under self-reflection, agents incorporate and regress on rubric criteria at nearly equal rates, yielding negligible net improvement; (ii) a single round of process-level feedback yields substantial gains, raising the normalized score by approximately $8$-$15$ points and yielding a roughly $35$-$40\%$ incorporation rate; (iii) these gains do not compound over subsequent turns, as agents regress on up to $24\%$ of previously satisfied criteria when rewriting the full report to address remaining gaps. Even with targeted guidance, reliable multi-turn improvement remains out of reach for the DRA architectures we evaluate. Our code and results are publicly available at https://github.com/sabharwalrishabh/Multi-Turn-Evaluation-of-DRAs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多轮评估框架，用于测试深度研究智能体（DRA）在自我反思和过程级反馈两种设置下改进报告的能力。研究发现，自我反思几乎无净收益，而一轮过程级反馈（通过RGI方法实现）能带来显著提升，但这种提升不会在后续轮次中累积，因为智能体在重写报告时会对先前满足的标准出现退步。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅评估DRA的单次输出，忽略了智能体在接收到反馈后能否持续改进报告质量这一关键问题。
AI.method: 设计了多轮评估设置，包括自我反思（无外部信号）和过程级反馈（通过Research Gap Inference, RGI方法推断研究过程缺陷并提供针对性指导）两种反馈机制。
AI.result: （i）自我反思场景下，智能体采纳和退步的比例几乎持平，净改进可忽略；（ii）一轮过程级反馈可提升标准化分数约8-15分，采纳率约35-40%；（iii）后续轮次中改进无法累积，智能体在重写报告时对先前满足标准的退步率高达24%。
AI.conclusion: 即使在针对性引导下，当前DRA架构仍无法实现可靠的多轮持续改进。

title: Emergence of Context Characteristics Sensitivity in Large Language Models
summary: During instruction fine-tuning (IFT), large language models (LLMs) learn to follow instructions by using the provided context to answer a query. While prior work has studied how context characteristics correlate with context usage by the LLM, this analysis has been limited to inference time, leaving open how these relationships are acquired in the first place. Here, we measure how models' sensitivity to such characteristics shifts across successive IFT stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Experiments across four models and three datasets show that SFT makes models more likely to use contexts that are easy to understand, such as containing high length, context-query similarity, and fluency. Post-SFT dynamics may either reinforce or resolve these preferences depending on the training dataset. Our findings reveal that context usage is actively reshaped at each IFT stage, and designing a balanced IFT dataset is important in ensuring robust context utilization of instruction-tuned models.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了在指令微调（IFT）的不同阶段（SFT、DPO、RLVR）中，大语言模型对上下文特征的敏感性如何动态变化。SFT使模型更偏好易于理解的上下文（高长度、高相似度、高流畅度），而后SFT阶段则根据训练数据特征可能强化或纠正这些偏好。
AI.motivation: 先前研究仅局限于推理阶段考察上下文特征与模型使用上下文之间的关联，未探究这些关系在训练过程中是如何获得的。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统地测量模型对上下文特征的敏感性在不同IFT阶段的演变。
AI.method: 在四个模型和三个数据集上，分别经过SFT、DPO和RLVR三个IFT阶段，测量模型对上下文长度、上下文-查询相似度、流畅度等特征的敏感性变化。
AI.result: SFT使模型更倾向于使用易于理解的上下文；后续的DPO和RLVR阶段会根据训练数据集特性，要么强化SFT形成的偏好，要么对其进行纠正。
AI.conclusion: 上下文使用模式在每个IFT阶段都会被主动重塑，设计平衡的IFT数据集对于确保指令微调模型具有鲁棒的上下文利用能力至关重要。

title: Overcoming Decoder Inconsistencies in Whisper for Dravidian and Low-Resource Languages
comment: Accepted at INTERSPEECH 2026, 5 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables
summary: Multilingual ASR models such as Whisper perform well on high-resource languages but exhibit substantially higher Word Error Rates (WER) for Dravidian languages compared to Indo-Aryan ones. Through linguistic and dataset analysis, we show that Dravidian languages have longer words, higher vocabulary diversity, and lower repetition, resulting in sparse token distributions and frequent character-level substitution errors. Baseline fine-tuning further reveals decoder imbalance between self-attention (linguistic context) and cross-attention (acoustic cues). Although synthetic token-repetition experiments indicate potential gains, they are impractical. Motivated by these observations, we introduce two decoder-level enhancements: Weighted-Attention, which adaptively balances attention sources, and Self-Conditioning, which reinjects intermediate predictions to improve token consistency. Experiments demonstrate consistent WER reductions for low-resource and agglutinative languages.

AI.tldr: 针对多语言ASR（如Whisper）在达罗毗荼语系表现差的问题，通过语言学和数据集分析发现其词长、词汇多样性高且重复率低导致稀疏token分布和字符级替换错误。提出加权注意力和自条件化两种解码器改进，有效降低低资源和黏着语的WER。
AI.motivation: 多语言ASR模型在高资源语言上表现良好，但对达罗毗荼语系（相较于印度-雅利安语系）的词错误率显著更高，需要分析原因并提出改进方案。
AI.method: 1. 语言学和数据集分析：比较达罗毗荼语言与印度-雅利安语言在词长、词汇多样性、重复率等特征差异；2. 基线微调分析解码器中自注意力（语言上下文）与交叉注意力（声学线索）的不平衡；3. 提出两种解码器增强：Weighted-Attention（自适应平衡注意力源）和Self-Conditioning（重新注入中间预测以提升token一致性）。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法在低资源和黏着语语言上持续降低了WER。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对达罗毗荼语言稀疏token分布和注意力不平衡问题的解码器改进，有效提升了多语言ASR在低资源和黏着语上的表现。

title: SIGA: Self-Evolving Coding-Agent Adapters for Scientific Simulation
summary: Advanced scientific simulators expose specialized input languages that turn simulation goals into executable configurations, but learning them can cost domain scientists hours to days. We study simulator setup as a problem of agent-tool interface grounding: what minimal simulator-specific adaptations are needed for an off-the-shelf coding agent to operate real scientific software? Our intuition is that coding agents already know how to navigate files, edit code, run commands, and repair outputs, but they lack the simulator's executable contract: its vocabulary, structural constraints, validation rules, and termination conditions. We introduce SIGA, a Simulator-Interface Grounding Adapter that supplies this contract through retrieval, procedural memory, in-trajectory validation, and validation-enforced termination. We primarily evaluate SIGA on GEOS, an open-source multiphysics simulator used in subsurface science. SIGA produces a complete GEOS deck in about five minutes with TreeSim above 0.90, matching an extended-budget human expert who took about three hours, a roughly 36x wall-clock speedup. On a harder held-out set, grounding raises TreeSim from 0.720 to 0.789, a roughly 10% relative gain over the bare agent, and can reduce the across-seed standard deviation by 16x. Self-evolution further improves SIGA by rewriting adapter contents from prior trajectories, yielding the highest held-out GEOS mean and matching or outperforming the strongest hand-designed configuration. Transfers to OpenFOAM and LAMMPS show that the dominant mechanism shifts by interface: validation matters most when structural completeness is the bottleneck, while memory and retrieval matter most when domain correctness is the bottleneck. These results suggest that lightweight, self-improvable grounding layers can turn general coding agents into practical operators of scientific software.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIGA适配器，通过提供模拟器的可执行契约（词汇、结构约束、验证规则和终止条件），使通用编码代理能够操作科学模拟软件。在GEOS模拟器上，SIGA约5分钟完成人类专家约3小时的工作（36倍加速），在OpenFOAM和LAMMPS上也展示了可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 科学模拟器使用专业输入语言，科学家学习成本高（数小时到数天）。现有编码代理虽能处理文件导航、代码编辑等任务，但缺乏模拟器特定的可执行契约，导致无法有效操作科学软件。
AI.method: 提出SIGA（Simulator-Interface Grounding Adapter），通过四个组件提供模拟器的可执行契约：检索（Retrieval）、程序记忆（Procedural Memory）、轨迹内验证（In-trajectory Validation）和验证强化的终止（Validation-enforced Termination）。支持自我进化机制，能从先前轨迹重写适配器内容。
AI.result: 在GEOS模拟器上，SIGA约5分钟完成人类专家约3小时的工作（36倍加速）；在困难测试集上，TreeSim从0.720提升至0.789（相对提升约10%），跨种子标准差降低16倍；自我进化进一步提升了性能；迁移到OpenFOAM和LAMMPS表明不同接口下主导机制不同。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级、可自我改进的接地层能够将通用编码代理转化为实用的科学软件操作者，验证了代理-工具接口接地问题的有效性。

title: A Geometric Framework for Absolute Pose and Velocity Estimation with Event Cameras
summary: Despite the rapid advancements in event-based motion estimation, current geometric methods primarily focus on velocity estimation. However, absolute pose estimation, which is equally crucial for key applications such as robotic navigation and augmented reality, remains relatively underexplored. Consequently, the simultaneous recovery of absolute pose and velocity from event streams remains an open and challenging problem. To address this gap, we propose a geometric framework for absolute pose and velocity estimation by leveraging 3D lines in the scene and the events they trigger. At the core of the framework lie two key geometric constraints: the orthogonality between a 3D line and the normal vector of its corresponding event plane, and the collinearity of an event with the 2D projection of its associated line. Based on these constraints, we present both linear and polynomial solvers for absolute pose estimation. The former enables efficient computation, while the latter provides a globally optimal solution for rotation. For velocity estimation, we develop an efficient linear solver and a more accurate optimization-based solver to recover both angular and linear velocities. Notably, our methods require a minimum of three event-line correspondences to determine the 6-DoF absolute pose or velocities independently. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods achieve state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in accuracy and computational efficiency compared to existing methods. The demo code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zibin6/EventPoseVelocity.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于事件流和3D线特征的几何框架，可同时估计绝对位姿和速度，仅需三组事件-线对应关系即可解算6自由度参数。
AI.motivation: 现有基于事件的运动估计方法主要关注速度估计，而绝对位姿估计（对机器人导航和增强现实至关重要）研究不足，同时恢复绝对位姿和速度仍是一个未解决的挑战。
AI.method: 利用3D线及其触发的事件构建两个几何约束：3D线与其事件平面法向量的正交性，以及事件与其对应线2D投影的共线性。基于这些约束，设计了用于绝对位姿估计的线性求解器和多项式求解器（全局最优旋转），以及用于速度估计的线性求解器和优化求解器。
AI.result: 模拟和真实数据集实验表明，该方法在精度和计算效率上均达到当前最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 提出的几何框架有效填补了基于事件的绝对位姿和联合速度估计的空白，仅需少量对应关系即可实现高效且精确的6自由度运动估计。

title: From Genes to Tokens: a GWAS-inspired Approach for Interpretable Stylometric Analysis
summary: This short paper introduces a stylometric interpretation method inspired by genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Each "gene" token's association with "phenotype" authorship is tested using logistic regression with multiple-comparison correction. Applied to English, German, and Russian corpora, the method detects statistically significant lexical markers distinctive of individual authors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受全基因组关联研究（GWAS）启发的文体计量学解释方法，通过逻辑回归和多重比较校正来检测个体作者独特的词汇标记。
AI.motivation: 传统的文体分析方法往往关注整体风格特征，难以精准识别个体作者独特的词汇标记。受GWAS方法的启发，研究者希望将每个词汇视为"基因"、将作者身份视为"表型"，通过统计检验找出与特定作者显著关联的词汇。
AI.method: 将每个词汇token视为"基因"、作者身份视为"表型"，使用逻辑回归检验每个词汇与作者身份的关联性，并进行多重比较校正。在英语、德语和俄语语料库上进行实验。
AI.result: 该方法能够有效检测出在统计上显著的、区分个体作者的词汇标记，并在多种语言语料库中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 提出的GWAS启发的文体计量学方法能够有效识别个体作者的独特词汇特征，为作者身份分析提供了新的统计视角。

title: Evaluation Cards: An Interpretive Layer for AI Evaluation Reporting
summary: AI evaluation results are produced at scale but reported inconsistently across leaderboards, model cards, benchmark papers, and company blogs. The cost is interpretive: readers cannot reliably compare results across sources, identify what a report omits, or trace an aggregate claim to its underlying evidence. Recent efforts address isolated components but leave three gaps: they cover only narrow slices of the evaluation lifecycle and do not compose into a single interpretable record; they specify static representations that do not differentiate the questions different stakeholders bring to the same evidence; and they remain proposals on paper, lacking the extraction infrastructure required for adoption at scale. We present \EvalCards{}, an operational reporting layer that composes benchmark metadata, evaluation run data, and model metadata into a unified record. We (1) derive a reporting schema from a structured review of 52 papers and 10 stakeholder interviews, (2) implement four interpretive signals (reproducibility, documentation completeness, provenance and risk, and score comparability), rendered through reader modes calibrated to research and non-research audiences, and (3) deploy a monitoring tool that applies \EvalCards{} across 5,816 models, 635 benchmarks, and 101,843 results, surfacing systematic gaps in current reporting practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EvalCards，一个统一的评估报告层，整合基准元数据、评估运行数据和模型元数据，并部署了覆盖5816个模型、635个基准和101843个结果的监控工具，以系统性揭示当前报告实践的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估结果虽大量产生，但在不同平台间报告不一致，导致读者无法可靠对比、发现遗漏或追溯证据链。现有工作仅解决孤立组件，缺乏统一的、可解释的记录表示，也缺少可大规模采用的提取基础设施。
AI.method: (1) 通过对52篇论文的系统回顾和10次利益相关者访谈推导出报告模式；(2) 实现了四项解释性信号（可重复性、文档完整性、溯源与风险、分数可比性），并通过面向研究与非研究受众的阅读模式呈现；(3) 部署监控工具，在5816个模型、635个基准和101843个结果上应用EvalCards。
AI.result: 成功构建了EvalCards报告层，并在大规模数据上进行了部署，系统性地揭示了当前AI评估报告实践中的空白。
AI.conclusion: EvalCards为AI评估提供了一个统一的、可解释的、可扩展的报告层，能够弥合当前报告实践中的关键差距，促进评估结果的可比性和可追溯性。

title: Decoding Pedestrian Crossing Intention from Egocentric Vision via Vision Language Models
summary: Egocentric vision offers a first-person view of human perception and decision making, yet its potential for traffic-safety prediction remains underexplored. In this work, we study the decoding of pedestrian crossing intentions from short egocentric video clips. We approach this by formulating the task as a closed-ended visual question answering (VQA) problem and leveraging vision language models (VLMs) to predict the pedestrians' intent. We first benchmark three families of state-of-the-art VLMs in a zero-shot setting, finding that they achieve moderate gains over random guessing but exhibit limited higher-level traffic reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we further adapt VLMs to the target task using parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Our results show that the fine-tuned models substantially outperform their zero-shot counterparts and achieve a 9\% accuracy improvement over a specialized transformer-based baseline. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating additional contextual cues, including ego motion, vehicle motion, and eye gaze, further improves predictive performance. In particular, the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B model guided by eye gaze and ego motion achieves a 14.5% accuracy improvement over the transformer baseline, establishing a new state of the art for egocentric pedestrian intent decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从第一人称视角短视频中解码行人过马路意图，将任务构建为VQA问题，利用视觉语言模型(VLM)进行预测。零样本设置下VLM表现有限，通过参数高效微调后性能显著提升，结合自我运动、车辆运动和眼动等上下文线索后，微调后的Qwen3-VL-2B模型相比Transformer基线准确率提升14.5%，达到新最优水平。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视觉在交通安全性预测方面的潜力尚未被充分探索，本文旨在研究如何从短时自我中心视频中解码行人过街意图。
AI.method: 将行人意图解码形式化为封闭式视觉问答(VQA)问题，利用视觉语言模型(VLM)进行预测；先在零样本设置下对三类VLM进行基准测试，再使用参数高效微调方法适应目标任务，并引入自我运动、车辆运动和眼动等额外上下文线索。
AI.result: 零样本VLM仅略优于随机猜测；微调后模型大幅超越零样本版本，比专门Transformer基线准确率提升9%；加入上下文线索后，微调Qwen3-VL-2B模型结合眼动和自我运动，准确率提升14.5%，达到新最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 自我中心视频结合VLM微调及上下文线索能有效解码行人过街意图，远超传统方法，为交通安全预测提供了新方向。

title: UXBench: Benchmarking User Experience in AI Assistants
summary: As AI assistants serve millions of users daily, evaluating user experience (UX) beyond general model capability has become increasingly important. We present UXBench, the first user-centric benchmark grounded in real user feedback signals for evaluating preference alignment and dialogue generation. The benchmark consists of three interconnected tasks, UX Judge, UX Eval, and UX Recovery, with 7,400 test instances extracted from over 70K interaction logs of a mainstream Chinese AI assistant. The dataset closely reflects real user distributions, covering 8 scenarios, 83 domains, and diverse failure patterns that pose severe challenges. Extensive experiments on 26 frontier language models provide novel insights into how well models perceive user experience and how improvements in model capability contribute to better dialogue engagement. Through comprehensive analysis of model behavior and performance gaps, we show that user feedback prediction is a learnable capability, where a reward model trained from in-the-wild feedback signals can achieve well-calibrated accuracy. We further document the systematic biases of LLM-as-a-judge evaluation protocols and compare typical response strategies that directly affect user experience. UXBench establishes a new evaluation landscape and calls for greater attention to tailored UX optimization, contributing to a user-centric scaling law that shapes the success of AI assistants.

AI.tldr: UXBench是首个基于真实用户反馈信号的用户体验评测基准，包含三个关联任务、7400个测试实例，覆盖8大场景和83个领域，用于评估AI助手的偏好对齐和对话生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有评测多聚焦模型通用能力，缺少从真实用户反馈出发、系统评估用户体验的基准，而用户体验直接影响AI助手的实际应用效果。
AI.method: 从主流中文AI助手的7万+交互日志中提取构建UXBench，包含UX Judge、UX Eval、UX Recovery三个任务，涵盖8大场景和83个领域，并在26个前沿语言模型上进行实验。
AI.result: 用户反馈预测是一种可学习能力；基于真实反馈训练的奖励模型能实现良好校准的准确率；发现LLM-as-a-judge评估协议存在系统性偏差；不同响应策略直接影响用户体验。
AI.conclusion: UXBench呼吁关注针对性的用户体验优化，为AI助手的成功建立以用户为中心的缩放定律，为评估开辟了新方向。

title: Code Is More Than Text: Uncertainty Estimation for Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as code generators, where silently wrong programs pose real safety and reliability risks. Reliable uncertainty estimation (UE) is essential for selective prediction, human-in-the-loop review, and downstream agentic decisions. Yet most existing code UE methods are inherited from natural language (NL) generation and ignore properties that make code distinct. We argue that code differs from NL in three ways: a single wrong token can break an entire program (token fragility); algorithmic intent and concrete implementation can disagree independently (intent-code gap); and programs can be executed (executability). We instantiate these properties as three orthogonal uncertainty axes: lexical (Top-K token entropy), algorithmic (pseudo-code consistency), and functional (behavioral consistency). Across five code LLMs, our three-axis ensemble improves average AUROC from 0.696 for the strongest NL-derived baseline to 0.776 (+8.1 points). Notably, on Qwen3-14B, our single-pass Top-K token entropy matches the strongest multi-pass baseline while being over 3x cheaper; across models, it remains a competitive low-cost signal. These results suggest that code UE deserves code-specific design rather than direct NL ports.

AI.tldr: 针对代码生成任务，提出了一种包含词汇、算法和功能三个正交维度的不确定性估计方法，相比直接迁移自然语言方法提升了8.1个百分点的AUROC。
AI.motivation: 现有代码不确定性估计方法直接继承自自然语言生成，忽略了代码的三个独有特性：token脆弱性（单个错误token可破坏整个程序）、意图-代码差距（算法意图与具体实现可能不一致）以及可执行性（程序可以被执行）。
AI.method: 将代码特性实例化为三个正交不确定性轴：词汇轴（Top-K token熵）、算法轴（伪代码一致性）和功能轴（行为一致性），并通过三轴集成进行不确定性估计。
AI.result: 在五个代码LLM上，三轴集成将平均AUROC从NL基线方法的0.696提升至0.776（+8.1点）。在Qwen3-14B上，单次Top-K token熵与最强的多次采样基线效果相当，但成本降低3倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 代码不确定性估计需要代码专用设计，而非直接迁移自然语言方法。

title: Ultra Flash: Scaling Real-Time Streaming Video Generation to High Resolutions
summary: While recent autoregressive video diffusion models achieve remarkable streaming quality, they remain confined to low resolutions (e.g., 480P), leaving efficient, scalable, real-time high-resolution video generation a fundamental open challenge. To bridge this gap, we present Ultra Flash, a cascaded streaming framework capable of real-time high-resolution video generation. Ultra Flash achieves ~30 FPS at 1K resolution and ~18 FPS at 2K resolution on a single GPU through three key contributions: (1) an architecture-preserving T2V-to-TV2V super-resolution training paradigm coupled with an AIGC-oriented data degradation pipeline that effectively preserves the generative capability of the base model, enabling enhanced high-resolution detail when cascaded after mainstream low-resolution generative models; (2) a causal streaming latent upsampler paired with a high-resolution decoder, which enhances spatiotemporal coherence while enabling efficient latent spatial scaling and precise high-resolution decoding with negligible computational overhead; and (3) a cascade high-resolution streaming video generation optimization scheme that first performs hybrid-reward-enhanced sparse causalization and single-step distillation of the super-resolution model, then introduces cascaded streaming self-forcing preference optimization with dynamic cache management, jointly enhancing overall coherence, improving quality, and enabling real-time high-resolution streaming video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ultra Flash reliably produces ultra-high-resolution streaming video while maintaining state-of-the-art visual quality and superior efficiency.

AI.tldr: Ultra Flash是一个级联流式框架，可在单GPU上实现实时高分辨率视频生成（1K分辨率约30 FPS，2K分辨率约18 FPS），通过架构保持的超分辨率训练、因果流式潜在上采样器与级联优化方案三大贡献，在保持高质量的同时大幅提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型虽在流式生成质量上表现优异，但受限于低分辨率（如480P），缺乏高效、可扩展的实时高分辨率视频生成方案。
AI.method: (1) 架构保持的T2V-to-TV2V超分辨率训练范式与AIGC数据降质管线；(2) 因果流式潜在上采样器与高分辨率解码器；(3) 混合奖励增强的稀疏因果化与单步蒸馏，以及带动态缓存管理的级联流式自强制偏好优化。
AI.result: 在单GPU上达到1K分辨率~30 FPS、2K分辨率~18 FPS的实时生成速度，且视觉质量达到最优水平。
AI.conclusion: Ultra Flash可靠地生成超高分辨率流式视频，同时保持最先进的视觉质量和优越的效率，填补了实时高分辨率视频生成的空白。

title: OmniGen-AR: AutoRegressive Any-to-Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated strong potential in visual generation, offering superior performance with simple architectures and optimization objectives. However, existing methods are typically limited to single-modality conditions, e.g., text, restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that demand image synthesis from diverse controls. In this work, we present OmniGen-AR, a unified autoregressive framework for Any-to-Image generation. By discretizing various visual conditions through a shared visual tokenizer and text prompts with a text tokenizer, OmniGen-AR supports a broad spectrum of conditional inputs within a single model, including text (text-to-image generation), spatial signals (segmentation-to-image and depth-to-image), and visual context (image editing, frame prediction, and text-to-video generation). To mitigate the risk of information leakage from condition tokens to content tokens, we introduce Disentangled Causal Attention (DCA), which separates the full-sequence causal mask into condition causal attention and content causal attention. It serves as a training-time regularizer without affecting the standard next-token prediction during inference. With this design, OmniGen-AR achieves new state-of-the-art or at least competitive results across a range of benchmark, e.g., 0.63 on GenEval and 80.02 on VBench, demonstrating its effectiveness in flexible and high-fidelity visual generation.

AI.tldr: OmniGen-AR是一个统一的自回归框架，支持从多种条件输入（文本、空间信号、视觉上下文）生成图像，通过解耦因果注意力（DCA）防止信息泄露，在多个基准上达到SOTA或竞争性结果。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视觉生成模型通常局限于单一模态条件（如文本），无法满足实际应用中需要从多种控制信号（文本、分割图、深度图、图像编辑、帧预测等）合成图像的多样化需求。
AI.method: 提出OmniGen-AR框架，通过共享视觉分词器对多种视觉条件进行离散化，结合文本分词器处理文本提示，支持多种条件输入；引入解耦因果注意力（DCA），将序列因果掩码分离为条件因果注意力和内容因果注意力，在训练时作为正则化器防止信息泄漏，推理时仍保持标准下一个token预测。
AI.result: 在GenEval上达到0.63，VBench上达到80.02，在多个基准上取得SOTA或具有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: OmniGen-AR通过统一框架和解耦注意力机制，有效实现了灵活、高保真的多条件视觉生成。

title: AGENTSERVESIM: A Hardware-aware Simulator for Multi-Turn LLM Agent Serving
summary: Multi-turn LLM agents interleave model calls with external tool invocations, shifting serving from stateless request processing to stateful program execution. Serving these workloads requires scheduling, KV-cache management, and routing policies that use program-level context, including turn dependencies, tool-induced gaps, and reusable KV state. Evaluating such policies directly on real systems is costly, since each design point may require dedicated accelerator time across arrival rates, model scales, serving-instance counts, and memory hierarchies. Simulation offers a scalable alternative, but existing LLM serving simulators target stateless request-level workloads and therefore omit the core dynamics of agent serving: multi-turn program execution, cross-turn cache locality, and KV-cache residency during tool gaps. We present AGENTSERVESIM, a hardware-aware simulator for multi-turn LLM agent serving. AGENTSERVESIM evaluates serving policies at program granularity through composable modules: a Program Orchestrator preserves program identity and turn order, a Tool Simulator materializes tool-induced gaps, a Session-Aware Router maintains program-to-instance affinity for cache-aware dispatch, and a KV Residency Model tracks policy-defined KV placement across HBM, host DRAM/CXL, and eviction. Across real serving deployments and hardware configurations, AGENTSERVESIM reproduces real-system behavior within 6% error across key performance metrics while running entirely on commodity CPUs. These results show that AGENTSERVESIM enables controlled, repeatable exploration of agent-serving policies without requiring exhaustive deployment on costly accelerators.

AI.tldr: 提出AGENTSERVESIM，一个面向多轮LLM智能体服务系统的硬件感知模拟器，能在无实际加速器部署的情况下，以<6%误差复现真实系统行为。
AI.motivation: 多轮LLM智能体服务涉及状态ful程序执行（含工具调用、跨轮缓存复用等），直接在真实系统评估调度策略成本高、耗时长，而现有LLM模拟器仅支持无状态请求级负载，无法捕捉智能体服务的核心动态（如多轮执行、跨轮缓存局部性、工具调用间隙的KV缓存驻留）。
AI.method: 构建可组合模块化模拟器，包括：程序编排器（保持程序身份和轮次顺序）、工具模拟器（模拟工具调用间隙）、会话感知路由器（维护程序到实例的亲缘性实现缓存感知调度）、KV驻留模型（追踪策略定义的KV在HBM/主机DRAM或CXL/驱逐中的放置）。
AI.result: 在真实服务部署和多种硬件配置下，AGENTSERVESIM在关键性能指标上与真实系统的误差<6%，且完全在普通CPU上运行。
AI.conclusion: 该模拟器能够在不需昂贵加速器部署的条件下，实现受控、可重复的智能体服务策略探索。

title: Vision-Language Guided Hyperspectral Object Tracking via Semantics Fusion and Contextual Template Updating
summary: Hyperspectral object tracking (HOT) leverages the rich spectral information provided by hyperspectral videos (HSVs), offering substantial potential for object tracking. However, efficiently extracting and exploiting spectral information from redundant spectral bands remains a fundamental challenge, which severely limits model generalization and tracking performance. Moreover, in dynamic scenes, targets often experience drastic appearance variations due to factors such as occlusion and illumination changes. These variations lead to large deformations between the current frame and the template. Such discrepancies pose major challenges for existing temporal modeling approaches. In this work, we propose VLHTrack, a novel hyperspectral vision-language (VL) joint tracking framework. Specifically, we incorporate language priors to address the fundamental challenge of spectral redundancy by designing a Language-Guided Band Selection Module (LBSM). By leveraging Large Language Model (LLM) descriptions, LBSM establishes a semantic-to-spectral mapping that mitigates redundancy and accentuates discriminative spectral features. A Multi-Modal Vision-Language Fusion Module is then employed to seamlessly integrate visual and linguistic embeddings, harnessing their complementary advantages to learn coherent cross-modal representations. To address target deformation in long-term sequences, we propose a dynamic update template feature strategy implemented via the Dynamic Template Update with Mamba (DTUM) module. By leveraging selective state space modeling, DTUM learns inter-frame dependencies to update template feature, ensuring efficient template feature evolution guided by temporal context. Experiments on HOT2023 and HOT2024 demonstrate that VLHTrack outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

AI.tldr: VLHTrack提出了一种基于视觉-语言联合框架的高光谱视频目标跟踪方法，通过语言引导的波段选择模块解决光谱冗余问题，并利用Mamba动态模板更新策略应对目标形变，在HOT2023和HOT2024数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 高光谱目标跟踪面临两个核心挑战：一是光谱冗余导致模型泛化能力和跟踪性能受限；二是动态场景中目标因遮挡、光照变化等因素出现剧烈形变，现有时间建模方法难以处理。
AI.method: 提出VLHTrack框架，包含三个关键模块：(1) 语言引导的波段选择模块(LBSM)，利用大语言模型描述建立语义-光谱映射；(2) 多模态视觉-语言融合模块，融合视觉与语言嵌入；(3) 基于Mamba的动态模板更新模块(DTUM)，通过选择性状态空间建模学习帧间依赖关系，更新模板特征。
AI.result: 在HOT2023和HOT2024数据集上的实验结果表明，VLHTrack优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 引入语言先验有效解决了高光谱跟踪中的光谱冗余问题，动态模板更新策略提升了长时序跟踪的鲁棒性，视觉-语言多模态融合为高光谱目标跟踪提供了新范式。

title: Claude Code-Driving Scenario Mining for the Argoverse 2 Challenge
summary: We present our submission to the CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2 Scenario Mining Challenge. Our system uses a four-stage pipeline: (1) autonomous code generation via a Claude Code agent powered by GLM~5.1, (2) iterative training set screening with Timestamp Balanced Accuracy threshold 0.8 to curate few-shot examples, (3) semantic code review by a separate Claude Code session, and (4) Qwen3-VL scene-level verification to filter false positives. We report results on the Argoverse 2 test set.

AI.tldr: 我们提交到CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2场景挖掘挑战赛的系统，采用四阶段流水线：基于GLM 5.1驱动的Claude Code智能体自动生成代码、迭代训练集筛选、语义代码审查以及Qwen3-VL场景级验证。
AI.motivation: 针对Argoverse 2场景挖掘挑战赛，需要一种自动化且高效的流水线来从大规模自动驾驶数据中挖掘特定场景，减少人工标注成本并提高挖掘精度。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：(1) GLM 5.1驱动的Claude Code智能体自动生成场景挖掘代码；(2) 使用时间戳平衡准确率阈值0.8迭代筛选训练集，构建少样本示例；(3) 独立的Claude Code会话进行语义代码审查；(4) Qwen3-VL进行场景级验证以过滤误检。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2测试集上报告了结果。
AI.conclusion: 该四阶段流水线有效结合了大语言模型驱动的代码生成、迭代筛选、代码审查和多模态验证，为自动驾驶场景挖掘提供了一种自动化解决方案。

title: Gradient-Guided Reward Optimization for Inference-time Alignment
summary: Ensuring the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) under distribution drift requires inference-time adaptation. While inference-time alignment methods such as Best-of-$N$ and rejection sampling are widely used, they frame the task as a sampling-intensive, reward-guided search, leading to two key limitations: their performance is bounded by the base model's generation quality, and their reliance on imperfect reward models makes them vulnerable to reward hacking. To address these challenges, we introduce Gradient-Guided Reward Optimization (GGRO), a lightweight inference-time method that performs targeted, minimal intervention during decoding via gradient guidance. Specifically, GGRO monitors token-level entropy to identify high-uncertainty regions indicative of drift or misalignment. Upon detection, it responds by injecting nudging tokens, generated using gradient signals from an off-the-shelf reward model, to steer the generation trajectory rather than merely re-ranking samples. Experiments show that GGRO consistently improves inference-time alignment across safety, helpfulness, and reasoning benchmarks. It also increases coverage of high-quality responses and robustness to reward hacking, with minimal computational overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/GGRO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GGRO方法，通过梯度引导和熵监控在推理时对LLM进行轻量级干预，优于Best-of-N等传统方法，在安全、有用性和推理基准上均取得一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法（如Best-of-N、拒绝采样）存在两个关键局限：性能受限于基础模型生成质量，且依赖不完美奖励模型易导致奖励黑客攻击。需要一种更轻量、更鲁棒的推理时对齐方法。
AI.method: GGRO在解码过程中通过token级熵监控识别高不确定区域（指示漂移或不对齐），一旦检测到，使用来自现成奖励模型的梯度信号生成"推动令牌"，引导生成轨迹而非简单重排序样本。
AI.result: 在安全、有用性和推理基准上GGRO持续提升推理时对齐效果，增加了高质量响应的覆盖率，对奖励黑客攻击具有鲁棒性，且计算开销极低。
AI.conclusion: GGRO是一种有效的轻量级推理时对齐方法，通过梯度引导的定向干预机制克服了传统方法的局限性，在多个维度上优于现有方案。

title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Fine-Grained Evidence Disentanglement in VideoQA
summary: Recent advances in video multimodal models have significantly improved VideoQA performance. However, these systems often rely on spurious statistical correlations rather than answer-relevant causal evidence, resulting in unfaithful and brittle reasoning, especially in complex real-world scenarios. Existing methods either rely on cross-modality correlations, costly curated training resources, or insufficient causal assumptions and constraints, and typically operate at the time-interval level. As a result, they fail to explicitly disentangle causal visual cues from confounders and provide limited fine-grained evidence localization. To address this issue, we propose a Counterfactual Reasoning framework for fine-grained Evidence Disentanglement (CREDiT). CREDiT formulates the VideoQA process using a structural causal model and learns cross-modality representations that are explicitly decomposed into causal and non-causal components under independence and minimality constraints. To facilitate faithful disentanglement, we introduce feature-level causal interventions and construct counterfactual inputs that approximate causal effects while suppressing non-causal correlations. Extensive experiments on NExT-GQA, SportsQA, and SPORTU-video demonstrate that CREDiT consistently improves answer accuracy and reasoning reliability across both generic and complex sports scenarios, leading to more trustworthy VideoQA systems.

AI.tldr: CREDiT是一个基于反事实推理的视频问答框架，通过结构因果模型将跨模态表征显式分解为因果与非因果成分，在抑制虚假统计相关性的同时提升推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答模型常依赖虚假统计相关性而非因果证据进行推理，导致推理不可靠且脆弱，尤其在复杂场景中表现不佳。已有方法要么依赖跨模态相关性、昂贵的标注资源，要么因果假设与约束不足，且仅停留在时间区间级别的粗粒度证据定位。
AI.method: 提出CREDiT反事实推理框架，基于结构因果模型建模视频问答过程，在独立性与最小化约束下将跨模态表征显式分解为因果和非因果成分；引入特征级因果干预并构造反事实输入，以近似因果效应并抑制非因果相关性。
AI.result: 在NExT-GQA、SportsQA和SPORTU-video三个数据集上的实验表明，CREDiT在通用场景和复杂体育场景下均持续提升了答案准确率和推理可靠性。
AI.conclusion: CREDiT通过细粒度的因果证据解耦与反事实推理，有效提升了视频问答系统的可信度与鲁棒性，为构建更可靠的视频理解模型提供了新的思路。

title: CP4D: Compositional Physics-aware 4D Scene Generation
summary: 4D generation (\textit{i.e.}, dynamic 3D generation) has recently emerged as a rapidly growing research frontier due to its powerful spatiotemporal modeling capabilities. However, despite notable advances, existing approaches typically fail to capture the underlying physical principles, producing results that are both physically inconsistent and visually implausible. To overcome this limitation, we present CP4D, a novel paradigm for photorealistic 4D scene synthesis with faithful adherence to complex physical dynamics. Drawing inspiration from the compositional nature of real-world scenes, where immutable static backgrounds coexist with dynamic, physically plausible foregrounds, CP4D reformulates 4D generation as the integration of a static 3D environment with physically grounded dynamic objects. On this basis, our framework follows a three-stage pipeline: \textbf{1)} Firstly, we leverage pre-trained expert models to generate high-fidelity 3D representations of the environment and foreground objects respectively. \textbf{2)} Subsequently, to produce physically plausible trajectories and realistic interactions for these objects, we propose a hybrid motion synthesis strategy that integrates priors from physical simulators with the common sense embedded in video diffusion models. \textbf{3)} Finally, we develop an automated composition mechanism that seamlessly fuses the static environment and dynamic objects into coherent, physically consistent 4D scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CP4D can generate explorable and interactive 4D scenes with high visual fidelity, strong physical plausibility, and fine-grained controllability, significantly outperforming existing methods. The project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/CP4D/.

AI.tldr: CP4D提出了一种将静态3D环境与物理合理动态对象相结合的新型4D生成范式，通过物理模拟器与视频扩散模型的混合运动合成策略，生成高视觉保真度、强物理合理性的可探索交互式4D场景。
AI.motivation: 现有4D生成方法忽略物理原理，生成结果物理不一致且视觉上不合理。
AI.method: 1) 利用预训练专家模型分别生成环境与前景物体的高保真3D表示；2) 提出混合运动合成策略，整合物理模拟器先验与视频扩散模型常识；3) 开发自动化组合机制，将静态环境与动态物体融合为物理一致的4D场景。
AI.result: 生成的4D场景具有高视觉保真度、强物理合理性和细粒度可控性，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CP4D通过将4D生成分解为静态环境与物理合理动态对象的组合，有效解决了现有方法物理不一致的问题。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Community Perspectives on Machine Translation
summary: Despite remarkable progress in machine translation (MT), non-AI communities have raised growing concerns about MT systems, suggesting a noticeable gap between technical advancement and the needs of real-world users. For instance, while NLP researchers focus on benchmark performance, end users care about ethical concerns, trust, reliability, costs, and more. We argue that listening to various user communities is essential so that research efforts would be directed towards the problems that the communities care about. To this end, we present a large-scale analysis, for the first time, that investigates what four stakeholder communities (AI developers, professional translators, language learners, and language service providers) post about MT technology on social media. To do so, we construct a dataset of 79,286 posts and comments from Reddit, Facebook, Bluesky, and Mastodon from 2019 to 2025, and analyse where these communities disagree, and how and why. Overall, we find that communities often disagree, and even show strong conflicts due to polarised sentiments on topics such as translation quality, efficiency, and reliability. This is because these communities approach these topics differently: the AI community frames them as technical and computational problems, while non-AI (user) communities care more about quality nuances, time savings, user trust, and broader social issues.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次大规模分析了四个利益相关者社区（AI开发者、专业译员、语言学习者和语言服务提供商）在社交媒体上关于机器翻译技术的讨论，发现不同社区之间存在显著分歧甚至冲突，原因在于AI社区将翻译视为技术问题，而非AI用户更关注质量细节、时间节省、信任和社会问题。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译技术在学术上取得了显著进展，但非AI社区对其存在日益增长的担忧，表明技术发展与真实用户需求之间存在明显差距。研究人员关注基准性能，而终端用户更关心伦理、信任、可靠性和成本等问题。作者认为倾听不同用户社区的声音至关重要，以使研究努力朝着社区关心的方向前进。
AI.method: 构建了包含2019年至2025年间来自Reddit、Facebook、Bluesky和Mastodon的79,286条帖子和评论的数据集，分析了四个利益相关者社区（AI开发者、专业译员、语言学习者、语言服务提供商）在社交媒体上关于机器翻译技术的讨论，考察这些社区在哪些方面存在分歧、分歧的方式及原因。
AI.result: 不同社区经常存在分歧，甚至在翻译质量、效率和可靠性等话题上因极化情绪表现出强烈冲突。AI社区将这些话题框定为技术和计算问题，而非AI用户社区更关注质量细微差别、时间节省、用户信任和更广泛的社会问题。
AI.conclusion: 不同利益相关者社区对机器翻译的认知和需求存在显著差异，研究应更多关注真实用户社区所关心的问题，以缩小技术发展与实际需求之间的鸿沟。

title: Event-driven dynamic trajectories reconstruction and measurement of mechanical parameters for fragments
summary: During warhead detonation, high-density, high-speed, and mutually occluded fragments are generated. Their mechanical parameters (position, velocity, kinetic energy) directly determine the lethality of the warhead fragment field. However, high-intensity flash and smoke in detonation scenarios severely hinder the accurate acquisition of these mechanical parameters. To address this challenge, this paper integrates experimental mechanics approaches and presents an event-driven method for reconstructing the dynamic trajectories of fragments and measuring their mechanical parameters. As a novel brain-inspired visual sensor, event cameras offer microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range lighting change perception, overcoming the difficulty of accurately measuring high-speed targets under strong flash interference. The method constructs a multi-event-camera vision system, adopting three geometric constraints: time-correlated epipolar constraint to find potential matching event point pairs, and trifocal tensor line constraint plus local homography constraint to eliminate mismatches. A comprehensive probability model is established, with entropy weight method determining the weight of each constraint's probability to quantitatively filter mismatches. 3D trajectory reconstruction is achieved via spatial line-line intersection and nonlinear optimization. Finally, the velocity and kinetic energy of the fragments are calculated based on the reconstructed trajectory. This method provides reliable technical support for the mechanical damage evaluation of warhead fragment fields and the tactical protection design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于事件相机的碎片动态轨迹重建与力学参数测量方法，利用多事件相机视觉系统结合几何约束和概率模型，解决了爆轰场景下强闪光和烟雾对高速碎片参数测量的干扰问题。
